title: When Does Low-Bit Quantization Preserve the Decisions of Vector Search?
comment: JMLR-style preprint with theoretical and experimental appendices
summary: Low-bit quantization can achieve high recall on some vector representations and fail sharply on others, while average distortion and global rank correlation do not explain the difference. We study quantized vector search at the level of the comparisons consumed by ranking and graph-pruning algorithms. Our first result is a distribution-free decomposition: the probability that a comparison flips is bounded by the probability mass of exact margins near zero plus the tail probability of the calibrated residual. We then account for dependence between residuals that share a query or graph node, and derive covariance-aware second-moment identities and tail bounds under a joint MGF proxy. For a frozen candidate permutation, we prove a deterministic coupling theorem for Vamana neighbour selection: the approximate replay returns the exact neighbour list exactly when all candidate-level pruning actions agree on the frozen exact states. We connect these results to representation geometry through an exact Gaussian oracle, establish a strict correlation gain from a deterministic magnitude bit in an aligned bilinear model, and give a rare-contamination construction showing why marginal Gaussian diagnostics do not imply the required residual tails. When analytical assumptions are unavailable, a held-out block certificate bounds the selective failure risk of a frozen quantized rule. Across learned, classical, and synthetic embeddings, standardized exact margins predict held-out ranking and pruning flip rates substantially better than global rank correlation. The framework applies to coordinate binary codes, RaBitQ, Lucene BBQ, and product quantizers through a common decision interface.

AI.tldr: 本文研究低比特量化对向量搜索决策的影响,提出了一个基于"比较"(comparisons)而非全局保真度的理论框架。核心发现是:决策翻转的概率由精确裕度在零附近的边界质量与校准残差的尾部概率共同决定(无分布假设);在共享查询或图节点结构下,残差依赖必须通过协方差感知处理;对于Vamana图算法,在冻结候选排列下,精确邻居列表与近似重放的一致性等价于所有候选级剪枝动作的一致性。实验表明,标准化的精确裕度对排序翻转率的预测(Spearman=0.97)和剪枝翻转率(0.99)远优于全局秩相关(0.74/0.05)。该框架适用于坐标二进制码、RaBitQ、Lucene BBQ和乘积量化器等多种量化器。
AI.motivation: 低比特量化在不同向量表示上表现出极端差异(例如同一两比特坐标码在Cohere文本嵌入上恢复95%近邻,在GIST图像描述符上仅恢复2%),而平均失真和全局秩相关无法解释这种差异。现有基于"评分保真度"的分析忽略了图算法实际消耗的是二元比较而非距离估计这一关键事实,且当两个残差共享查询或图节点时存在未被现有理论捕捉的依赖关系。
AI.method: 论文建立了四层理论:(1)决策级风险分解定理——将翻转概率分解为边界质量与残差尾部之和,无需独立性假设;(2)协方差感知排序/剪枝分析——利用联合MGF代理推导次高斯尺度,并包含显式偏差项;(3)冻结轨迹耦合定理——证明Vamana选择调用作为确定性状态机,精确邻居列表与近似重放的一致性等价于候选级动作的一致性;(4)表示桥梁——在高斯oracle下用Stein引理给出符号-线性协方差恒等式,并通过罕见污染构造证明低阶高斯诊断无法单独推出指数尾部。同时提供了免分析假设的保留块证书(基于Hoeffding界)用于无法分析的情形。
AI.result: 在12个数据集×量化器配置上,标准化精确裕度对保留排序翻转率的预测Spearman相关性达0.970,对剪枝翻转率达0.992;而全局距离秩相关性仅分别为0.739和0.053。960个选择调用全部满足轨迹耦合恒等式。在Cohere上,共享查询残差相关性高达0.870,经验协方差使测得差分方差比边际方差之和小7.4倍。512块选择证书平均为16.74%(排序)和18.65%(剪枝),无经验验证风险超过其证书。Stein协方差恒等式在12个角色配置中将残差方差预测到测量值的4.6%以内(中位误差1.2%)。罕见污染构造证实低阶高斯诊断无法保证所需指数尾部。旋转实验显示全局秩保真度(+0.35)的提升无法预测决策风险变化的方向。
AI.conclusion: 低比特向量搜索不能通过单一保真度数理解。决策翻转集中在决策边界附近,其噪声取决于全局度量所掩盖的共享结构。提出的分布无关边界-残差分解实现了风险定位,协方差感知角色分析捕获了共享结构,确定性冻结轨迹耦合将局部决策连接到图算法的邻居列表。在高斯模型下,残差协方差是显式的,且幅度位可证明有助于对齐评分器。保留块证书为分析性描述不可达的量化器提供了选择性风险保证。实际意义在于:应基于决策度量而非保真度度量选择量化器;使用符号熵和资格门两个诊断而非单一统计;并在边界质量大的保留集上应用冻结证书。限制包括:轨迹证书在长路径上饱和,高斯恒等式仅作为oracle结果,保留证书需代表性独立块且不跨分布偏移迁移。

title: Contextual Utility of Quantization Moves in Extreme Low-Bit LLMs
summary: Post-training quantizers select finite code changes using reconstruction proxies or local loss approximations, but the utility of a quantization move depends on the state through which it is executed. We identify two sources of this contextual dependence. First, the displacement of the move matters: evaluating the gradient at the move midpoint captures curvature accumulated along the move that a current-state linearization omits. Across frozen two-bit moves from Llama-3.2 models, midpoint evaluation predicts the direction of exact endpoint loss changes substantially more accurately than current-state gradients. Second, moves interact: exhaustive lattices of legal quantized states are well approximated by quadratic pseudo-Boolean functions, yet their small pairwise components can determine Pareto fronts and cause different evaluation functionals to prefer opposite directions. These effects explain failures of reconstruction-optimal code re-selection and additive composition. Reading each move at its own midpoint repairs the local selection step and improves downstream accuracy and held-out perplexity, while larger supports require evaluating exact endpoints from the state actually reached. Exact-endpoint beam search finds sparse changes that dominate much larger one-shot updates, and repricing the same moves after intervening changes produces widespread sign reversals. These results show that quantization utility is contextual at the granularity of a few moves: reliable construction must evaluate finite changes along their own paths and compose them from the evolving quantized state.

AI.tldr: 本文指出极低比特LLM中量化移动（move）的效用具有上下文依赖性，需在每个移动自身的中点评估有限变化，并从演化后的量化状态进行组合。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练量化方法在评估有限码位改变时使用当前状态梯度或重建代理，忽略了移动路径中的曲率累积和其他移动的交互作用，导致量化效用判断错误。
AI.method: 提出在每个移动自身的中点（midpoint）评估梯度以捕捉路径曲率；将移动集的效用建模为二次伪布尔函数，分析其线性系数和成对项；提出一次性中点选择和重定位Pareto束搜索两种构造方法。
AI.result: 中点梯度预测损失变化方向的准确率（96/97、97/98、390/392）远高于当前状态梯度（68/97、85/98、153/392）；在4B求解器的代码重选步骤中修复了功能破坏，零样本准确率提升2.7-2.9个百分点，HellaSwag损失6.9点的下降被避免；端点束搜索找到仅两个投影的稀疏变更，困惑度降低19%。
AI.conclusion: 量化效用在小至几个移动的粒度上具有上下文依赖性；可靠的构造必须沿自身路径评估有限变化，并从实际达到的量化状态进行组合。

title: Few Rows Tell Them Apart: Equivalence of Queries Mixing Set and Bag Semantics
comment: 27 pages, including 10 pages of appendices; no figures
summary: Bounded SQL equivalence checkers search for a counter-example database of bounded size, and a search that comes back empty proves nothing. We supply missing theory: computable bounds $B$ such that agreement on all databases with at most $B$ tuples per relation implies equivalence. We work in the combined-semantics framework, which captures SQL's mix of duplicate-eliminating (DISTINCT) and duplicate-preserving computation over set-valued relations. For conjunctive queries we prove a bound linear in the query size for fixed multiset width: inequivalent queries already disagree on a database with at most $2^w |Q|$ tuples, where the width $w$ counts only the columns the queries actually read, independently of the total number of multiset variables. Declared keys shrink the bound to $2^{kw} |Q|$ for the smaller key-width $kw$, acyclic foreign keys leave it unchanged, and the result extends to several classes of queries with comparisons, for which equivalence had not previously been characterized. For these fragments, bounded search becomes a terminating, complete decision procedure.

AI.tldr: 本文针对混合集合与包语义的SQL查询等价性问题，给出了可计算的反驳数据库大小上界，使得有界搜索成为终止且完备的判定过程。
AI.motivation: LLM大规模改写SQL的现实需求催生了有界SQL等价性检查器，但其空搜索结果无法证明等价性；缺乏完备性阈值（有界反驳上界）使得"已检查"结果中可能存在本可被反例证伪的不等价对，且混合DISTINCT与多重集语义的查询的经典自连接大小界不再成立。
AI.method: 在组合语义（combined semantics）框架下，分别针对（1）关系查询：证明反例上界为 $2^w|Q|$（$w$为多重集宽度），等价性可由多重集同态刻画；（2）带完整性约束：利用键/外键追踪约简（key-chased reducts），将上界进一步降至 $2^{kw}|Q|$（$kw$为键宽度），且等价性判定落入NP；（3）带常量比较的查询类：将上述结论扩展到此前未刻画的查询片段。所有结论均通过构造性证明给出多项式有界反例数据库。
AI.result: 主要结果：（1）对合取查询，不等价查询在每关系至多 $2^w|Q|$ 个元组的数据库上即可分歧，其中宽度 $w$ 仅计算被读取的多重集列；（2）声明键后界降为 $2^{kw}|Q|$，无环外键不改变该界；（3）扩展到带比较的若干查询类，使其首次具有等价性刻画；（4）这些片段上有界搜索成为终止且完备的判定程序。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了有界SQL等价性检查器的理论基础——给出了可计算的反例大小上界，使得搜索到该界即可确定性报告等价；将启发式有界搜索转变为完备判定过程，特别适用于自连接少且多重集列窄的查询场景。

title: Introducing Consort: A Spec-First Agent Framework for Enforced, Test-Driven Development on Live Database Branches
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, for associated framework, see this https URL
summary: When an agent writes code, the development framework becomes the control system for a non-deterministic worker. Spec-first, agent-driven frameworks have gained rapid traction since 2025; the installable ones, GitHub Spec Kit, obra/superpowers, BMAD, and GSD, and our own, all capture intent through a specification or durable planning artifacts. Since they agree on capturing intent up front, what separates them is how each enforces the engineering discipline that keeps agent-written code clean, correct, and maintainable. Every framework enforces that discipline somehow; they differ in how. We characterize three modes: enforcement by persuasion (prompt discipline the model may ignore), by front-loaded structure (strong specs, then a trusted build), and through controls the agent cannot edit (a deterministic orchestrator, human-approved gates, immutable tests, and a green result that must pass against a live, branched database). We introduce Consort, a spec-first, test-driven agent framework built on the third, enforcing that discipline through controls the agent runs inside but cannot bypass, in which a deterministic orchestrator drives separate role agents through a spec-first design lane and a test-driven build lane on a live database branch. We argue that enforcing the tests and gates in code keeps agent-written code honest and verifiable, while its specialized roles, like the human roles before them, are what make it maintainable, claims we frame as a pre-registered, testable hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Consort,一个基于规范优先(spec-first)的AI编程代理框架,其核心特征是通过代理无法编辑的代码级控制来强制执行工程纪律,并在实时数据库分支上运行完整的测试驱动开发(TDD)周期。论文提出一个三层次的强制执行分类法(说服、前置结构、不可编辑的控制),将Consort与四个主流可安装框架(GitHub Spec Kit、obra/superpowers、BMAD、GSD)进行对比分析,并提出一个可检验的输出质量假设。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型作为非确定性代码作者,传统的"开发框架仅是便利工具"的假设已不再成立。当AI代理编写代码时,框架必须转变为控制系统,以约束概率性过程使其输出可信。然而现有的规范驱动框架在捕获意图方面趋同,但在如何强制执行工程纪律方面差异显著,且现有框架普遍依赖提示工程(可被代理忽略),导致纪律在代理开始编写代码时失效,引发测试删除、过度模拟、虚假报告等失败模式,以及代码可维护性下降等问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出三层次强制执行分类法:(a) 说服式(prompt纪律,模型可忽略);(b) 前置结构式(强规范后信任构建);(c) 不可编辑的控制式(确定性编排器、人工审批门禁、不可变测试、实时分支数据库验证)。2) 设计Consort架构:确定性编排器(状态机)协调多个角色代理(Product Owner、Spec Author、Architect Reviewer、DBA、Test Strategist、Navigator、Driver等),通过两条通道运行——规范优先的设计通道(冻结规范和测试清单)与强制构建通道(在copy-on-write数据库分支上运行红/绿/重构TDD循环)。3) 强制执行原语:不可变测试、诚实的绿色定义(测试运行器对真实分支数据库的实际通过)、跨故事字段契约检查、记忆隔离的角色分离、基于token窗口使用的上下文重置(默认剩余40%时启动新会话)。4) 比较评估:在八个维度上对五个框架进行表格化对比分析。5) 提出预注册的输出质量假设及其实验设计(LLM-as-judge评分,含五项安全措施以确保独立性)。
AI.result: 1) 分析性对比表明,Consort是唯一在所有八个强制执行维度上都实现代码级强制执行的框架(规范冻结哈希、TDD核心强制、不可变测试、实时分支数据库、确定性编排、人工审批门禁、八个命名角色、记忆隔离的上下文管理)。2) 唯一无竞争的维度是数据库在循环中:其他四个框架均无数据库概念,Spec Kit仅停留在设计时数据模型。3) 在论文修订期间,BMAD的bmad-loop引入了确定性编排和代码强制门禁,但其门禁在史诗级之后强制覆盖率和质量阈值,非循环内不可变测试与实时数据验证。4) 输出质量声明(更少的静默回归、无测试博弈、更高可维护性)被明确框架为预注册假设而非已证明结论。5) 论文承认Consort的权衡:以可移植性和轻量级换取代理输出的可验证性,在原型场景中成本不值得。
AI.conclusion: 当代理编写代码时,重要的控制是代理无法忽视的控制,重要的结果是真实数据库实际接受的结果。Consort作为第三种强制模式(不可编辑的代码级控制)的参考实现,其可转移贡献是原则而非产品:在敏感领域(受监管系统、涉及金钱或个人数据的代码、长期可维护性代码)中,代理无法编辑的控制与实时数据验证的结合提供了无论代理行为如何都成立的保证。论文以预注册假设而非既定事实呈现输出质量主张,并以开放的、框架中立的评估工具邀请独立复现。

title: OpenDiscoveryTrace: Process Traces for Evaluating AI Scientist Workflows
comment: Best Dataset Award, ICML 2026 Workshop on AI for Science (AI Scientists: Tools, Co-authors, or Founders?). Code: this https URL Dataset: this https URL
summary: Existing benchmarks for autonomous AI scientists evaluate only final outputs---generated code, hypotheses, or papers---yet discard the reasoning process by which those outputs were obtained. This makes it impossible to audit scientific methodology, diagnose failure modes, or distinguish systematic reasoning from fortunate guessing. We present \textbf{OpenDiscoveryTrace}, a public dataset of 558 complete AI scientific agent trajectories that captures how models reason, not just what they produce. Each trajectory records a structured 9-field-per-step trace---including thoughts, tool calls, observations, errors, revision triggers, and self-reported confidence---as models execute 124 scientific tasks spanning drug discovery, materials science, genomics, and scientific literature analysis. The dataset covers seven models: three frontier models (GPT-5.4, Claude Opus 4.6, and Gemini 3.1 Pro; 124 trajectories each, fully balanced across domains and difficulty levels) and four open-weight models (Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Phi-3.5-mini, and Qwen2.5-1.5B; 30 each), plus 60 live-retrieval variant trajectories. Pilot analysis on 363 LLM-judged trajectories reveals that process traces expose behavioral differences invisible to output-only evaluation: all three frontier models achieve comparable success rates (84--89%), yet Claude Opus 4.6 produces 30$\times$ more errors than GPT-5.4 (2.5 vs. 0.08 per trajectory, $p < 0.0001$, Cliff's $\delta = 0.613$), with qualitatively different error profiles---66.7% tool misuse for Claude versus 83.6% reasoning errors for GPT-5.4. We define five benchmark tasks with baselines from logistic regression, random forests, LSTMs, and Transformer models. The dataset, trace schema, agent harness, and benchmark definitions are publicly available under CC BY 4.0 to support research on process-level evaluation, scientific agent auditing, and AI governance.

AI.tldr: OpenDiscoveryTrace是一个包含558条AI科学智能体完整轨迹的公开数据集，旨在通过记录结构化的过程轨迹（推理过程而非仅最终输出）来支持AI科学家的过程级评估、审计与治理。
AI.motivation: 现有的自主AI科学家基准仅评估最终输出（如代码、假设或论文），而丢弃了产生这些输出的推理过程。这导致无法审计科学方法学、诊断失败模式，或区分系统性推理与侥幸猜测。该工作填补了科学智能体过程级评估的空白。
AI.method: 构建了一个公开的数据集，包含7个模型（GPT-5.4、Claude Opus 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro三个前沿模型各124条轨迹；Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Phi-3.5-mini、Qwen2.5-1.5B四个开源权重模型各30条；以及60条实时检索变体轨迹）执行124个科学任务（涵盖药物发现、材料科学、基因组学和科学文献分析四个领域）。每个轨迹记录结构化的9字段步骤级追踪（基于ReAct框架扩展），包括thought、action、observation、error、revision_trigger、confidence等。定义了5个基准任务（结果预测、错误定位、声明验证、自主性分类、过程质量评分），并使用逻辑回归、随机森林、LSTM和Transformer等模型建立基线。
AI.result: 在363条LLM评判的前沿轨迹上的试点分析显示，尽管GPT-5.4、Claude Opus 4.6和Gemini 3.1 Pro的成功率相当（84–89%），但过程轨迹揭示了显著的差异：Claude Opus 4.6的错误率比GPT-5.4高30倍（2.5 vs. 0.08，p < 0.0001，Cliff's δ = 0.613），且错误类型定性不同——Claude 66.7%为工具误用，GPT-5.4 83.6%为推理错误。在四个领域内的匹配任务比较中，错误率差异稳健显著（每个领域p < 0.0001）。68.1%的首次错误发生在步骤0。基线模型在结果预测任务上均未超过多数基线准确率（AUROC ≤ 0.42），表明该任务具有非平凡难度。LLM标注的内部一致性Krippendorff's α在0.63–0.82之间。
AI.conclusion: OpenDiscoveryTrace是首个提供结构化过程轨迹（包括错误日志、修订跟踪和多阶段科学工作流标注）的公开数据集，填补了AI科学家基准仅评估最终输出的关键空白。该工作证明，仅依靠输出的评估会使这些模型看起来可以互换，但过程轨迹揭示了根本不同的错误处理行为，对模型改进方向（Claude需要更好的工具使用训练，GPT-5.4需要推理层面的修复）和AI治理具有直接启示。数据集、追踪模式、智能体框架和基准定义以CC-BY-4.0许可证公开发布。

title: Adaptive Entangled Game Modules in Artificial General Intelligence
summary: We introduce a probability-wave framework for modeling the collective behavior of interacting adaptive agents, deriving testable eigenmodes through a generalized behavioral intelligence (GBI) nonlocal probability-wave equation. This framework captures a broad range of human intelligence behaviors with analytical mechanisms and offers an indirect method to examine the Liu-Chen-Ao (LCA) hypothesis of nonlocal entangled nerve fibers in the brain through collective trader behaviors. Our empirical analysis of Chinese intraday stock market data demonstrates that adaptive entangled game modes explain 82-94% (89% overall) of observed decision patterns, a sharp contrast to the predictions of neoclassical finance based on independent rational agents. Moreover, 2-12% of behaviors show adaption to intraday news, events, and environments, characterized by dual equilibrium states and abrupt reference point shifts, while purely independent modes occur in less than 5% of cases. These findings empirically support the LCA hypothesis, as observable trading behaviors reflect underlying brain mechanisms and internal intelligence decision-making in behavioral psychology. Our results highlight the necessity of incorporating adaptive entangled game modules into artificial general intelligence (AGI) architectures, addressing the limitations of conventional artificial neural network (ANN)-based AI, which relies on trillions of opaque parameters. By integrating ANN-based AI with probability-wave-based entangled-brain simulations, machine learning can enrich AGI foundation models (FMs) and facilitate the development of human-like processing units (HPUs) that leverage brain-inspired mechanisms. Such HPUs may ultimately create more compact, efficient, and robust AGI systems, particularly for embodied intelligence and robotics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于概率波的非局域方程框架（GBI），用于建模交互式自适应智能体的集体行为，并利用中国股市日内交易数据实证验证其解释力，主张将概率波机制融入AGI架构以突破传统ANN的局限。
AI.motivation: 传统新古典金融理论基于独立理性代理人假设，无法解释实际市场中观察到的集体行为与决策模式；现有ANN-based AI依赖数万亿不透明参数，缺乏对人脑式智能机制的建模。作者旨在通过非局域概率波框架捕捉人类集体智能行为，并间接验证大脑神经纤维非局域纠缠的LCA假说。
AI.method: 提出广义行为智能（GBI）非局域概率波方程，推导出可检验的本征模（eigenmodes），涵盖自适应纠缠博弈模式、独立模式及适应性调整模式；利用中国日内股票市场高频交易数据进行实证分析，量化不同模式对观察决策模式的解释比例。
AI.result: 自适应纠缠博弈模式解释了82%-94%（总体89%）的观察决策模式；2%-12%表现出对日内新闻、事件和环境的适应，呈现双重均衡状态和参考点突变；纯粹独立模式占比不足5%。结果为LCA假说提供了实证支持，表明可观察的交易行为反映了大脑内部机制及行为心理学中的智能决策过程。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了将自适应纠缠博弈模块融入AGI架构的必要性，以弥补传统ANN-based AI的不足；提出将ANN与基于概率波的纠缠大脑模拟相结合，可丰富AGI基础模型（FMs），并促进类人处理单元（HPUs）的开发，最终构建更紧凑、高效、鲁棒的AGI系统，尤其适用于具身智能与机器人领域。

title: Subagents vs Agent Skills: Executing Reusable Knowledge for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
summary: How can language model agents effectively leverage libraries of reusable knowledge to solve long-horizon tasks? Recent work has increasingly focused on agent skills: reusable capabilities represented as skill packages, i.e., multi-file bundles containing instructions, scripts, and other resources that help agents perform specific tasks. Agent skills are typically executed by loading their skill instructions into an agent's context and relying on the agent to follow them. As task horizons grow, however, this approach becomes increasingly brittle, because reasoning quality degrades as more information accumulates in the context window. We investigate an alternative approach in which skill packages are instead invoked as subagents. Rather than loading skill instructions into the main context, subagent execution spawns fresh context windows dedicated to solving individual subtasks. We show that subagent execution outperforms agent-skill execution when skill packages expose clear input-output contracts and their instructions encode the procedural knowledge needed to fulfill those contracts. The tradeoff is additional communication overhead, as extra tokens are required to coordinate between the main agent and its subagents. Our results show that the benefit of reusable knowledge depends not only on its content, but also on how it is organized and invoked.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型智能体在长视野任务中如何有效利用可重用知识库（技能包），对比了"智能体技能"（将技能指令加载到主上下文）与"子智能体"（在独立上下文中执行技能）两种执行方式，发现当技能包具有明确的输入输出契约并编码程序性知识时，子智能体执行优于智能体技能执行，代价是额外的通信开销。
AI.motivation: 随着任务视野变长，智能体技能（将所有指令加载到上下文）的执行方式会因上下文窗口积累过多信息而导致推理质量下降。论文探索一种替代方案：将技能包作为子智能体调用，以隔离上下文、降低单窗口的峰值长度。
AI.method: 论文在 SkillsBench 基准（87 个长视野任务的子集 64 个）上，使用 OpenHands 作为智能体框架，对比两种执行方式：智能体技能（加载 SKILL.md 到主上下文）与子智能体（在独立上下文中以技能指令初始化并仅返回结果）。关键步骤包括：(1) 从成功轨迹中合成具有显式输入输出契约的程序性技能包；(2) 通过添加干扰工具增加上下文压力；(3) 探索技能库的分层组织（树/图/两级任务树）；(4) 测量峰值上下文长度与总 token 消耗。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 使用原有策划技能包（无输入输出契约）时，智能体技能与子智能体执行效果相当或前者更优；(2) 使用合成的程序性技能包（有明确 I/O 契约）时，子智能体执行显著优于智能体技能执行，且小模型（带宽受限更严重）获益最大；(3) 随着干扰工具增加，子智能体执行更优雅地降级；(4) 子智能体在 80% 以上任务中降低峰值上下文长度（强模型），但消耗的 token 总量显著更高；(5) 分层技能库（任务树与图结构）配合混合执行模式（路由节点作智能体技能，叶节点作子智能体）效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论：可重用知识的有用性不仅取决于内容，还取决于其组织与调用方式。当技能包编码程序性知识并具备清晰输入输出契约时，子智能体执行通过封装信息、降低峰值上下文长度来提升性能。其核心启示是规模化智能体系统需要减少上下文负载，模块化是关键——子智能体执行本质上是一种强制模块化的机制。未来方向包括高效的主-子智能体通信协议与技能库重构（类似于软件工程中的代码库组织）。

title: Gradland: On Phenomenal Experience, Differentiated Across Many Dimensions
summary: This paper investigates the hypothesis that the first-order structure of physical interactions, i.e. gradients or Jacobians, characterizes the structure of phenomenal experience. It does so in an idealized world inhabited by neural networks, Gradland, where the physics are known and the functions are (mostly) differentiable. The paper introduces two measures of Jacobian structure: effective rank and cohesion, based on Kirchhoff complexity. Applying the measures to a series of worked examples shows the hypothesis accounts for: (1) the duration of experience, that it can prolong over hundreds of milliseconds; (2) the difference between what is experienced vividly and obscurely; (3) the experience of texture; (4) the blooming buzzing confusion presumably experienced by newborns; (5) the difference between ideas that are held distinctly in mind and ideas that are confused; (6) what learning is like; and finally (7) the paper explains the function of rich, dense experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"微分功能主义"(differential functionalism)框架，核心假设(假设G)为：物理相互作用的一阶结构(即Jacobian矩阵)刻画了现象经验的内在结构。作者在名为"Gradland"的理想化神经网络世界中引入两个Jacobian结构度量：基于奇异值分解的有效秩(ρ)衡量"透明性"(transparency)，以及基于Kirchhoff复杂度的内聚性(χ)衡量"内聚性"(cohesion)，并将二者组合为"内聚秩"。通过一系列工作示例，作者用该框架解释了七种经验现象：(1)经验持续数百毫秒的时长；(2)经验中清晰与模糊的差别；(3)纹理的体验；(4)新生儿James所描述的"blooming buzzing confusion"；(5)头脑中清晰与混乱观念的差异；(6)学习的体验；(7)丰富密集经验的功能(使系统拥有应对世界中无穷变化的组合覆盖能力，消除盲点)。本文是对Balduzzi与Tononi提出的整合信息理论的延伸与替代，用计算上更高效的Jacobian工具替代信息论工具，并将其应用于现代AI所擅长的可微系统。
AI.motivation: 现有意识与现象经验理论面临两个核心困难：(1)整合信息理论等基于信息论的工具计算复杂度极高(双指数级别)，无法扩展到实际神经网络规模；(2)计算功能主义基于图灵机模型，对经验现象的解释力不足。现代AI的惊人能力建立在导数与矩阵乘法之上，作者认为这暗示了导数与矩阵运算作为建模经验现象基础工具的潜力。本文旨在用Jacobian这一可微系统中无处不在的数学对象作为桥梁，连接物理相互作用的结构与现象经验的内在结构，提出一种计算上可扩展、可在现代神经网络框架内工作的"微分功能主义"来替代或补充现有理论。
AI.method: 方法核心由三部分组成：(1)符号与形式化：在有向无环图框架下定义神经网络的输入Jacobian(对输入的偏导数矩阵)与参数Jacobian(对参数的偏导数矩阵)；(2)两个核心度量：有效秩ρ(A)定义为(Σσᵢ²)²/Σσᵢ⁴(物理中称参与比)，度量矩阵能同时承载多少独立"印象"，刻画透明性；内聚性χ(A)基于Kirchhoff复杂度(矩阵生成二部图的所有生成树边权乘积之和的规范化)，度量矩阵各输入输出是否真正相互作用，刻画经验的"粘合程度"；二者的乘积为内聚秩χ_ρ；(3)示例分析：在Gradland中通过MLP与RNN的时间Jacobian结构对比解释经验持续时间，通过relu与sigmoid梯度对比解释清晰与模糊经验，通过随机初始化深度relu网络的梯度破碎解释新生儿的混乱经验，通过Jacobian的连贯性矩阵G=JJᵀ的块对角化解释不同观念的清晰分离。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1)形式化结果显示MLP的对角Jacobian使内聚性为零因而经验无法跨时间延续，而RNN的下三角Jacobian由于跨时间交互产生正内聚性，从而解释了经验的持续；(2)EMA(指数移动平均)通道实验表明，跨多个时间尺度的通道组合比单一时间尺度通道产生更高的内聚秩，解释了大脑中突触与细胞时间常数多样性的作用；(3)relu网络中⟨J_{y_i←x}, x⟩ = y_i的恒等式使其输出与梯度清晰对齐，而sigmoid的饱和使这一关系崩溃，对应了清晰vs模糊经验；(4)24层随机初始化relu网络的梯度在空间上完全去相关，类比于散斑(speckle)，解释了新生儿的"blooming buzzing confusion"；(5)内聚秩高的矩阵(如Hadamard矩阵、混合良好的随机矩阵)对应于"仅有变化才能应对变化"的Ashby必要多样性法则，为系统提供更少的盲点。文末还提出了一个可证伪预测：内聚秩应在麻醉、特定睡眠阶段和癫痫等经验减弱的状态下降低，并与扰动复杂性指数(PCI)相关。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的"微分功能主义"是一种新的组合功能主义，将现象经验与物理相互作用的组合方式(而非计算功能主义中的图灵机操作)联系起来。该方法是基于Jacobian的内禀-外在二元论，类似于Mach的要素一元论、James/Whitehead/Russell的过程哲学或Spinoza的心物平行论。结论强调：(1)Jacobian提供了一个从物理结构到经验结构的可行桥梁；(2)两个度量——透明性(有效秩)与内聚性(Kirchhoff复杂度)——是刻画经验结构的核心工具；(3)丰富密集经验的功能是消除系统盲点，使系统能应对世界中无穷无尽、来自各个角度的探查与攻击；(4)微分功能主义并非完整的意识理论，而是一个最小可操作的范例，可用于测试、修正和构建更完善的意识理论，并与其他理论(全局工作空间、循环加工、高阶理论)相联系；(5)Jacobian结构极其丰富，本文只是触及表面，未来可扩展至高阶项、概率系统、连续时间、生物神经元细节等方向。

title: An Autonomous GeoAI Agent for Arctic Eco-Navigation
summary: Arctic maritime navigation is becoming increasingly important as changing sea-ice conditions expand seasonal accessibility while simultaneously introducing substantial operational, environmental, and community risks. Arctic route planning is inherently a multi-criteria problem: routes that improve vessel safety or efficiency may increase exposure to sea ice, sensitive ecosystems, or nearby communities. Existing routing methods prioritize travel time, fuel use, and navigational risk, often overlooking ecological and community impacts. We introduce a human-in-the-loop, multi-agent GeoAI system for Arctic eco-navigation that integrates operational, physical, ecological, and community-related criteria within a unified routing framework. Multiple specialized agents coordinate geospatial data acquisition and preparation, multi-objective route generation, and skyline-based decision support. The ecological criteria explicitly account for exposure to sensitive areas, including Essential Fish Habitat and seal critical habitat. By considering these ecosystem impacts and potential community burdens while keeping consequential value judgments under human control, the framework supports safer, more transparent, and socially responsible Arctic navigation. Project page and code are publicly available. this https URL , this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向北极生态导航的人机协同多智能体GeoAI系统，将操作性、物理、生态和社区四类准则整合到统一的多准则路径规划框架中，通过专业化智能体协作完成地理空间数据采集、多目标路径生成和基于skyline的决策支持，并显式纳入对Essential Fish Habitat和海豹关键栖息地等敏感区域的暴露，同时将价值判断（权重、公平性定义）保留给人类决策者。
AI.motivation: 北极海冰变化使季节性通航成为可能，但现有路径规划方法主要优化航行时间、燃料和导航风险，忽视了生态系统和社区影响；北极路径规划本质上是一个多准则问题，提高船舶安全性或效率的路径可能增加对海冰、敏感生态系统或附近社区的暴露，亟需一个能够将这些影响纳入决策的框架。
AI.method: 系统采用三层多智能体架构：(1)编排层解析航行请求并引导人类选择目标；(2)三个专业化智能体——Agent1负责从可信源（USNIC、NOAA等）获取、验证和对齐地理空间数据到投影网格；Agent2构建16连通图并执行路由优化（单准则最短路径或多目标Pareto搜索，使用多目标Dijkstra/多目标A*/A*pex近似算法）；Agent3负责路径展示和独立的公平性分析；(3)独立批评智能体进行确定性验证。使用本地开源模型llama3.1:8b，关键设计原则是将权重、ε近似容差和公平性定义等规范性参数留给人类输入。实验设置：白令海峡区域Nome→Kotzebue航线，6米吃水+2米安全裕度的沿海补给船，3km网格250km走廊。
AI.result: 在2026-05-20（冰季，覆盖89%可航水域，5个准则）和2026-09-03（无冰，4个准则）两个实例上，A*pex在ε=0.35下分别用371秒和715秒完成搜索，返回的ε-Pareto集合用单准则锚点扩充后包含9条和8条不同走廊路径；经空间去重后所有代表路径相互非支配，内部一致性验证显示重建图谱复现了所有准则总计（相对误差≤6.5×10⁻⁹），认证ε≤0.282；锚定路径在排名目标上比直接优化差23-36%，而未锚定时差距达48-116%；公平性分析与更多走廊的路径集分歧更大，小半径处为平局，半径≥12km时15个单元中最多7个出现冲突；ε=0.25超出预算14.6倍，ε=0.50将代表路径从229条缩减至5条。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将生态和社区暴露提升为一类决策输入，在可审计的开放数据上支持更安全、透明和社会负责任的北极导航；其价值在于"克制"——拒绝测量、拒绝排名、拒绝合并都是带理由的一类输出；技术偏好和公平性被分开报告，使运营偏好与公平性之间的冲突对人类决策保持可见；当前局限包括不支持时变多准则路由，且缺失证据、被测为零的证据和不可区分证据必须保持概念上的区分。

title: The Menu Is an Execution Prior: State-Path Tool Menus for Online Agents
summary: Language models act through tools, yet practical agents face libraries containing thousands of interfaces. We introduce the tool menu as the short, ordered subset of available tools shown to an agent before execution. The agent can call only tools in this menu. Multi-step tasks require the final action and the prerequisite tools that create its inputs in a usable order. Current constructors rank tools by request relevance, which can surface the final action while omitting or delaying less obvious producers. We introduce the state path, a pre-execution route from the observable request state to the desired outcome, and propose State-Path Tool Menu to learn it. Our framework treats the menu as an execution prior over these routes. Its encoder represents which tools can run from the current state, how their outputs satisfy later inputs, and which orders recur in training paths. A retriever covers an executable entry, the missing-input producers, and the final action. A reranker then places producers before consumers. On ToolBench, our menu raises online success from 0.737 to 0.898 and outperforms retrieval, reranking, generation, and routing baselines without changing the agent. The State-Path menu also covers more complete chains with 32 tools than the official list covers with 128, and its success gain persists across executor families with different model capacities. Our code is at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出State-Path Tool Menu框架，将工具选择从"请求相关性"重构为"可执行路径覆盖"，在ToolBench上将在线智能体成功率从0.737提升至0.898，且不改变智能体本身。
AI.motivation: 现有工具菜单构造器主要按请求相关性排序工具，但多步任务需要的是从可见状态到目标结果的可执行路径（包含入口工具、桥接工具、目标工具的有序集合）。相关性高的最终动作可能因前置工具缺失而无法执行，导致菜单表面相关但实际不可用。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：(1) State-Path编码器，利用三个方向信号（状态兼容性χ、模式流κ、训练路径先验ρ）通过关系感知Transformer学习工具表示；(2) 检索器，采用边际解码策略，联合优化成员资格、路径角色覆盖、缺失字段覆盖与多样性惩罚，输出32个工具；(3) 重排序器，对32个工具进行前缀感知排序，优化前8个位置为可执行前缀，确保生产者先于消费者。最终输出一次性传递给agent，执行循环不变。
AI.result: 在ToolBench上，成功率从0.737提升至0.898（273/304任务），优于COLT、ToolRet、Tool-REX、SkillRouter、ToolGen等基线；完整链覆盖率提升19.4点，入口工具覆盖提升11.8点；32工具菜单的完整链覆盖率超过官方128工具列表；在AppWorld、TRAJECT-Bench、UniToolCall、ToolHop四个基准上均取得最佳主指标；三种评估器一致认为State-Path排名第一；跨执行器家族与跨工具库迁移均获得正向增益。
AI.conclusion: 将工具菜单视为可执行路径的先验而非请求相关性的排序结果，能够显著提升在线智能体的成功率。状态兼容性、模式依赖与训练路径先验三者的结合，可有效恢复被词面相似性掩盖的桥接工具。菜单在执行前一次性构造完成，不干扰智能体原有执行循环和调用预算。

title: Decision-Focused Active Learning for Scale-Aware Critical-Materials Recovery
summary: Choosing a recovery process for scale-up requires connecting laboratory results with product requirements, process costs, and scale effects. We analyze records from Pacific Northwest National Laboratory's Computer Intelligence for Critical Element Recovery and Optimization (CICERO) workflow for autonomous selective precipitation. Active learning uses prior results to choose experiments. In a conditional retrospective benchmark with fitted models and recycled neodymium-iron-boron (NdFeB) magnet records, active learning finds the best recorded result with fewer experiments than nonadaptive space filling. Enrichment is the selected rare-earth-to-iron ratio relative to that in the feed. Adaptive policies reach the recorded enrichment maximum by 16 to 24 wells (individual experiments), versus 48. Our two-stage reconstruction ties two adaptive alternatives at 16 wells. Conditional analyses of recycled samarium-cobalt (SmCo) magnets show a Round 2 tradeoff between purity and nominal yield, the recovery fraction calculated from an assumed starting amount - NdFeB Round 1 routes differ in enrichment. Rankings for produced water from oil and gas extraction depend on phase and dilution assumptions requiring confirmation. We propose choosing batches by their expected reduction in downstream Bayes risk: the minimum expected loss among available process decisions under current beliefs. In exploratory simulations, a hybrid that filters candidates has lower estimated loss than the implemented joint search across routes and conditions. Differences involving the synthetic two-stage policy are small relative to estimation uncertainty. We outline a pre-registered prospective test under a shared loss and logging standard, requiring clarified measurements and records, a defined process decision and relevant outputs, credible economic inputs, and validation at the intended scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向下游工艺决策的主动学习方法（decision-focused active learning），用于关键材料回收工艺的放大选择。核心思想是用"下游贝叶斯风险的预期减少量"作为批次选择标准，统一涵盖离散工艺路线和连续操作条件，并在 PNNL CICERO 自主实验平台的回收钕铁硼（NdFeB）和钐钴（SmCo）磁体历史数据上进行了回溯性基准测试和前瞻性试验设计建议。
AI.motivation: 实验室最优条件未必等于工艺放大后的最优选择；现有实验选择策略（如 ec² 路线判别 + GP-UCB 条件优化）使用不同效用函数，缺乏统一的、以最终工艺决策为导向的批次选取准则。此外，CICERO 历史档案中残留的测量、单位和比例尺信息未充分澄清，使得纯实验目标难以支撑工艺级决策。
AI.method: 1) 定义下游损失函数 L(d,θ,ϕ,s*)，包含工艺成本与惩罚项，作用于目标放大尺度 s*；2) 引入下游贝叶斯风险 R = min_d E[L]，作为当前后验信念下的最优预期损失；3) 以"批次对下游贝叶斯风险的预期减少量 Δ(B)"作为信息价值（value-of-information）获取函数，统一路线与条件的选择；4) 提出三类候选算法：下游感知两阶段策略、联合决策-价值策略、结构化混合策略（ec² 式路线筛选 + 路线专属 GP 准则 + 近似 Δ 分配）；5) 在 NdFeB Round 1 拟合 GP 超参数下做有限池回溯基准（揭示最优井数比较），并在 32 单元合成因子设计下比较三种策略的归一化超额损失。
AI.result: 回溯基准（NdFeB）：自适应策略（两阶段重构、路线专属 GP-UCB、等分路线）在 16 口井即可揭示记录池最大富集值 E=508.97（H10），混合路线 BO 需 24 口井，确定性空间填充需 48 口井。SmCo Round 2 显示纯度与标称产率之间存在权衡，g=0.95 时损失最小条件在 ρ=0.259 处从 H11 切换到 B12；g>0.9692 时无记录条件达标。生产水（油气采出水）的行间排序依赖相态和稀释假设确认。合成探针：结构化混合代理平均超额损失 0.041，低于联合决策价值策略（0.046）和两阶段策略（0.045），但涉及两阶段策略的差异小于世界种子蒙特卡洛标准误。
AI.conclusion: 在条件性模型化 NdFeB 回溯基准上，自适应策略以更少实验达到记录最优；以"下游贝叶斯风险预期减少量"作为批次选择准则为统一离散路线与连续条件提供了规范框架。论文提出了一个预注册的前瞻性对比方案，要求统一下游损失与日志标准、澄清测量与记录、明确工艺决策与相关产出、提供可信经济输入，并在目标尺度上验证。

title: Valerant: An Automatic Navigable Game Map Generator via Action-Conditioned World Model Exploration
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) couple predictive world modeling with action generation, allowing anticipated future states to guide agent behavior. Although WAMs are rapidly advancing embodied AI, general-purpose counterparts remain largely unexplored in games. Existing game-oriented approaches often combine action-conditioned world models with external policies and reward functions to realize WAM-like decision-making, yet they operate mainly in 2D visual observation space and do not instantiate persistent 3D geometry. Extending this paradigm to 3D games introduces a distinct challenge. In autonomous driving and robotics, the physical environment exists independently of the model, providing a persistent 3D world in which selected actions can be executed. Games have no such external substrate; the virtual world itself must be instantiated. Most playable games require a persistent and navigable space, while 3D games additionally require explicit geometry that supports movement and interaction. Action-conditioned video rollouts provide visual observations but not this spatial representation. We present \textsc{Valerant}, a training-free framework that transforms a pretrained action-conditioned world model into a WAM for exploring and constructing 3D game maps. By coupling predictive visual rollouts with SLAM-based spatial reconstruction and exploration-driven action selection, \textsc{Valerant} progressively transforms a single image into a persistent 3D game map. This framework extends WAM-based interaction beyond 2D visual simulation and offers a new approach to reducing manual effort in 3D game-map creation.

AI.tldr: Valerant是一个无需训练的框架，将预训练的动作条件视频世界模型转化为世界动作模型（WAM），通过耦合预测性视觉展开、视觉SLAM空间重建和探索驱动的动作选择，从单张输入图像自动生成可导航的3D游戏地图。该工作将WAM范式从2D视觉模拟扩展到显式3D几何构建，旨在减少3D游戏地图制作中的人工成本。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏导向的世界模型局限于2D观察空间，无法实例化持久化的3D几何结构；而3D游戏（尤其是第一人称射击类）需要持久可导航且支持移动与交互的显式几何空间。动作条件视频展开只能提供视觉观察，无法提供游戏所需的空间表征。该研究旨在弥合WAM式探索与显式3D地图构建之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心模块：(1) 反事实探索流程——从同一预动作状态出发，查询5个候选动作（前移、左转前进、右转前进、原地左转、原地右转）的视频展开；(2) 视觉SLAM（MASt3R-SLAM）对每个候选展开估计相机轨迹并重建3D几何；(3) 探索策略根据映射效用（探索覆盖率与前进进度）选取最佳分支。同时设计了三个鲁棒性模块：鲁棒地面估计（局部自适应参考平面，归一化高度表征）、互补碰撞检测（点云碰撞+深度碰撞双重检测）、死胡同回溯（基于WM-SLAM联合检查点的回溯机制与失败区域记忆）。整体采用分支-重建-评估-提交循环，逐步将选定观测融合为3D点云地图。
AI.result: 在VALORANT游戏截屏数据集上的实验表明，Valerant能够从单张图像自动完成无碰撞探索和增量式3D地图构建。在感知真实性评分（AS）上达到80.00%，用户偏好（UP）达到83.33%，均显著优于基线HY-World 2.0（分别为20.00%和16.67%）。消融实验验证了鲁棒地面估计（RF）、互补碰撞检测（COL）和死胡同回溯（DP）三个模块分别解决了不同失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功将WAM范式从2D视觉模拟扩展至3D游戏地图自动构建，证明了无需额外训练即可将预训练动作条件世界模型与SLAM和探索策略结合，实现从单张图像到可导航3D点云地图的自动生成。未来工作将聚焦于提升几何一致性并将重建点云转化为更丰富、可编辑的游戏资产。

title: XAI-Arena: Can LLMs Assess the Quality of XAI Explanations?
summary: Evaluating the quality of explanations produced by explainable AI (XAI) methods remains challenging because existing approaches often rely on subjective human judgment, limiting reproducibility, scalability, and comparability between studies. We examine whether LLMs can serve as a reproducible and scalable mechanism to make comparative assessments of the quality of XAI explanations. We introduce XAI-Arena, an LLM-as-a-judge framework for scalable, reproducible, multidimensional, and stakeholder-sensitive evaluation of XAI explanation quality. XAI-Arena then allows us to compare XAI explanations along various dimensions, namely, perceived simplicity, clarity, task adequacy, trust calibration, actionability, transparency, faithfulness, and overall interpretability. We then benchmark XAI explanation methods across various datasets, machine learning models, and stakeholder personas. Human validation shows a strong positive association between LLM-generated and human ratings (Spearman's rho=.693, p<.001). Together, LLM-based evaluations can capture systematic differences in XAI explanation quality and provide a scalable and reproducible framework for comparative assessment of XAI explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 XAI-Arena 框架，利用 LLM-as-a-judge 对可解释 AI（XAI）方法生成的解释进行可复现、可扩展、多维度且区分受众的评价，并通过人类验证证明其评分与人类判断具有显著相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有 XAI 解释质量的评估通常依赖主观人类判断，存在可复现性、可扩展性和跨研究可比性方面的局限，难以系统性地比较不同 XAI 方法。
AI.method: 提出 XAI-Arena 框架，将 LLM 作为评判者（LLM-as-a-judge），沿简洁性、清晰性、任务适配性、信任校准、可操作性、透明性、保真度及整体可解释性等多个维度，对跨数据集、机器学习模型和利益相关者角色的 XAI 解释进行比较评估。
AI.result: 在跨数据集、模型与受众的基准测试中，LLM 评分与人类评分呈显著正相关（Spearman ρ=0.693，p<0.001），能够捕捉到 XAI 解释质量上的系统性差异。
AI.conclusion: 基于 LLM 的评估可作为 XAI 解释质量的可扩展、可复现比较框架，但仍应结合人类验证，并进一步面向不同利益相关者完善评估机制。

title: Do Agents Know When They Succeed? Calibrating Agent Confidence from Internal Representations
summary: As agentic systems getting adopted rapidly in safety critical applications, it is vital to measure the confidence associated with the agentic actions. In comparison to the traditional machine learning systems, agentic workflows have complex failure modes with planning, tool invocation and dynamic environment interactions. In this paper, we investigate whether model's internal representations provide stronger signals of eventual task success in multi-turn agentic setups. We introduce two complementary methods: Latent Trajectory Dynamics (LTD), which summarizes changes in residual-stream representations across an an interaction trajectory, and the Action Representation Probe (ARP), which predicts success from representations formed at action decisions. Across three interactive benchmarks (Bash, SQL, Python) and three model families (Qwen14B, Qwen7B, DeepSeek6.7B), our methods consistently outperform surface level generation and sequence-based calibration baselines providing a zero-overhead reliability monitor that requires neither prompt alterations nor multi-sample rollouts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种基于LLM智能体内部隐藏表示的零开销置信度估计方法（LTD轨迹动态特征与ARP动作表示探针），在三类交互式编程基准与三个开源模型上一致优于基于表面输出的置信度基线方法，可作为部署中智能体的被动可靠性监控器。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统正被部署于安全关键场景，但其多轮、工具调用、动态环境交互的特性使传统单轮置信度估计（温度缩放、语义熵、口头置信度等）失效；输出层信号难以捕捉模型内部先于失败的隐藏信号，因此需要利用机制可解释性思路挖掘多轮智能体的内部置信度表征。
AI.method: 1) Latent Trajectory Dynamics (LTD)：从残差流表示中提取28维运动学特征，包括相邻步余弦相似度、层间漂移比、累积路径效率与认知阶段转移速度；2) Action Representation Probe (ARP)：排除submit动作后对动作终点残差状态做平均池化、标准化、PCA降维（64维），再用L2正则化logistic探针预测任务成功，并通过单调Platt映射校准。两者与Calibrated Logprob、HTC基线在严格5折嵌套交叉验证下比较，使用AUROC、Brier、ECE指标。
AI.result: 在InterCode-Bash/SQL/Python基准、Qwen2.5-Coder-14B/7B、DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B共9种（模型×环境）组合下，LTD或ARP在AUROC和Brier上均一致优于Logprob与HTC表面基线。ARP在多数设置下达到最佳AUROC（如Qwen-14B上Bash 0.814、SQL 0.842、Python 0.711；DeepSeek-6.7B上SQL 0.788、Python 0.784）。Logprob基线接近随机水平，HTC较其有提升但仍弱于内部方法。
AI.conclusion: 被动内省LLM智能体的残差流比表面生成文本或序列级注意力统计提供更可靠的任务成功置信度信号；LTD与ARP仅依赖前向传播即可计算、无需提示修改或多rollout，可作为零开销、被动式的实时可靠性保障，为部署中智能体的失败检测与人机协作干预提供基础。

title: ContractEval: Query-Conditioned Execution Matching for Procedural Instruction Conformance
summary: As LLM agents move from answering questions to carrying out procedures, failures can be unwarranted rather than visibly wrong: the final response looks acceptable even though the system skipped the check, branch, dependency, or invariant that made the answer justified. Output-only evaluation sees the answer, and trace-aware judging sees activity, but neither identifies which obligations were active for the query. We introduce CONTRACTEVAL, a diagnostic framework for making those active obligations explicit. It represents procedural instructions as query-active obligations and matches them against response or trace evidence, turning omissions, wrong branches, ordering errors, extra actions, invariant breaches, and output-contract violations into distinct conformance failures. On a controlled suite of audited procedural contracts, output-only and trace-aware LLM judges miss many injected structural failures; under gold expected and observed graphs, ContractEval detects and localizes all of them. LLM-backed extraction preserves much of this signal but remains calibration-sensitive. ContractEval is therefore not a compliance guarantee; it makes procedural conformance auditable rather than implicit in final-answer quality.

AI.tldr: ContractEval 是一个用于评估 LLM 智能体是否遵循程序性指令的诊断框架。它将指令表示为查询条件下的活跃义务图(query-active obligations),并与响应或轨迹证据匹配,将遗漏、错误分支、顺序错误、多余操作、不变量违反和输出契约违反区分开来。在受控扰动基准测试中,纯输出型和轨迹感知型 LLM 评判者漏掉了许多结构性失败,而基于黄金图的 ContractEval 能检测并定位所有失败。
AI.motivation: 当 LLM 智能体从回答问题转向执行程序时,其失败往往是隐性的:最终响应看起来合理,但系统可能跳过了使该回答合理的检查、分支、依赖或不变量。纯输出评估只能看到答案,轨迹感知判断能看到活动,但两者都无法识别哪些义务对当前查询是活跃的。问题的核心在于缺少一个明确的标准——应当对哪些义务进行核对。
AI.method: ContractEval 采用四阶段流水线:(1) 静态契约编译——将指令解析为声明式层次任务网络(HTN);(2) 查询条件化——基于查询提取活跃义务,剪除非活跃分支;(3) 观察图提取——从响应或轨迹中构建已观察执行图;(4) 层次匹配——使用最大权二分图匹配对齐期望图与观察图。通过受控扰动协议(节点遗漏、分支违反、拓扑交换、多余动作、不变量违反、输出契约违反)评估评判者能力。
AI.result: 在 10 个 SOP 风格契约、200 个干净执行和 1400 个评估案例的基准测试上,纯输出型 LLM 评判者平均检测率仅 0.495、定位率 0.400;轨迹感知评判者达到 0.570 检测率和 0.468 定位率;最强轨迹感知评判者(GPT-5.4)仍漏掉 29.0% 的扰动案例。基于黄金期望和观察图的 ContractEval 实现了 1.000 的完美检测和定位。LLM 支持的提取保留大部分信号(GPT-4o 达 1.000/0.916,GPT-5.4 达 0.982/0.903),但观察图校准仍是可扩展性的主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: ContractEval 将程序性一致性从隐性评估转变为可审计的诊断。它将评估单位从答案级判断转变为查询活跃义务的证据,使遗漏、错误分支、不支持的操作和不变量违反可被检查。然而,它并非合规保证——其价值在于通过声明契约的审计到可扩展基准测试的分阶段路径,公开程序性评估的分母。声明契约在正确性重要时应保持审计,观察提取可在校准可接受时自动化。

title: Multi-Agent Agentic Graph Learning via Structural Signatures
summary: Agentic graph learning (AGL) has recently achieved promising results on graph reasoning tasks, where an agent powered by a large language model (LLM) sequentially samples the graph as evidence to support its final prediction. Existing methods either employ a single agent or orchestrate multiple role-based agents to reason and learn over the entire graph, but both essentially rely on a shared reasoning policy across different graph regions, which can be suboptimal for graphs with heterogeneous structural and semantic patterns. Inspired by the progress of multi-agent collaboration on complex reasoning tasks, a natural remedy is to let multiple agents own different memory and collaborate; however, applying this paradigm to graphs directly faces two challenges. First, existing AGL methods typically verbalize graph structures into natural-language descriptions for LLM agents, making the reasoning process sensitive to the ordering of structural information and thereby breaking the permutation-invariant nature of graphs. Second, incorporating increasingly large sampled neighborhoods leads to rapidly growing contexts. To address these challenges, this paper introduces a multi-agent agentic graph learning (i.e., MAAGL) framework. MAAGL partitions the graph into communities and assigns an independent agent to each community for region-specific specialization. MAAGL represents structural and semantic evidence separately. Structural evidence is summarized by a dynamically updated structural signature that is permutation-invariant and fixed in size, while semantic evidence is filtered to the top-k nodes ranked by relevance. Based on historical trajectories with similar signatures, agents estimate their confidence and trigger debate-style collaboration when needed. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets show that MAAGL outperforms SOTA AGL methods.

AI.tldr: 提出MAAGL多智能体代理图学习框架，将图划分为社区并为每个社区分配独立智能体；引入排列不变的结构签名表示结构证据，并按相关性过滤语义证据；基于历史轨迹估计置信度触发辩论协作；在四个基准数据集上优于现有AGL方法并降低token开销。
AI.motivation: 现有AGL方法（单智能体或基于编排的多智能体）本质依赖跨整个图的共享推理策略，对具有异构结构与语义模式的图而言并非最优。将多智能体协作直接迁移到图推理面临两大挑战：1）将图结构口述化为自然语言会破坏图的排列不变性；2）多跳邻居文本化导致上下文与token成本急剧膨胀。
AI.method: 1) 智能体分配：使用社区检测（默认Leiden）将图划分为M个社区，每个社区分配一个独立智能体；2) 智能体专精化：每个智能体在分配的社区内独立推理；3) 证据表示：将结构证据摘要为6维结构签名（4个静态维度：度、PageRank、聚类系数、跨社区比例；2个动态维度：标签熵与多数标签比例），将语义证据过滤为与目标节点最相关的前k个文本属性；4) 协作推理：基于结构签名相似度估计置信度，低于阈值δ时选择top-K置信度智能体进行多轮辩论协作；5) 经验学习：从轨迹中提取(g, θ, ρ)形式的结构化经验，并基于其他智能体轨迹进行跨智能体验证后纳入共享经验集。
AI.result: 在OGB-Arxiv、Cora-full、OGB-Products、Amazon-Computers四个数据集上（涵盖域内与零样本迁移设置），MAAGL在准确率上均取得最优，Macro-F1在OGB-Products与Amazon-Computers上最优、其余数据集与最优基线相当；消融表明结构签名贡献最大；结构签名显著降低跨智能体通信token，自适应搜索终止降低搜索动作数。
AI.conclusion: MAAGL通过区域专精化与排列不变的结构签名有效解决了多智能体协作迁移到图推理的核心挑战，在性能与效率上均优于现有AGL方法；未来工作方向是自动发现或选择任务特定的结构签名维度。

title: CityPlanner: A Sandbox Agent for Executable Urban Planning
summary: Urban planning is a real-world spatial optimization problem that requires selecting feasible actions from large candidate spaces under practical objectives such as cost and service quality. Existing optimization and reinforcement learning methods are effective for fixed formulations, but often depend on task-specific representations and constraint handling. We propose \emph{CityPlanner}, a sandbox-agent framework for executable urban planning. CityPlanner introduces \emph{UrbanSandbox}, a unified file-based environment where agents inspect task files, generate plans, run evaluators, and revise decisions based on executable feedback. To make learning tractable, we further propose atomic-task reinforcement learning, which decomposes long sandbox trajectories into \emph{BuildPlan} for initial construction and \emph{ImprovePlan} for feedback-based refinement. Experiments on a real-world benchmark show that CityPlanner consistently outperforms heuristic, task-specific RL, and general LLM-agent baselines. Ablations verify the contributions of UrbanSandbox, atomic-task RL, and iterative deployment. We release the code and dataset at this https URL

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CityPlanner：一种面向可执行城市规划的大语言模型沙箱智能体。核心是统一文件化环境 UrbanSandbox，以及将长程规划拆为 BuildPlan 和 ImprovePlan 两个原子任务的强化学习流程。模型先通过终端读取城市数据、生成并提交候选计划，再调用评估器获得有效性和分数，最后基于诊断反馈迭代改进。实验在基于 OpenStreetMap 的 5,670 个实例上进行，覆盖土地分配、道路建设和充电站选址。CityPlanner 在 9 个任务—难度组合中的 8 个取得最高分；消融实验显示，从原始 Qwen3-8B 到原子任务 RL、迭代部署和 14B 模型，完整流程可实现三项任务 100% 可行率，并持续提升目标分数。
AI.motivation: 传统优化和任务特定强化学习依赖预先固定的向量表示、动作空间与约束处理方式，难以迁移到候选类型、约束、评估程序和反馈形式各异的城市规划任务。通用 LLM 虽能读写文件并调用工具，但若只进行自然语言推理，容易生成违反硬约束或无法被评估器验证的方案。完整沙箱轨迹又包含大量命令执行、失败提交、上下文累积和重复修改，导致奖励稀疏、训练噪声大、长时序信用分配困难。作者因此将城市规划统一为可执行交互过程，并分解为可独立学习、可重复组合的原子技能。
AI.method: 方法由三部分组成。1）UrbanSandbox：为每个实例提供只读 input/、可写 work/、提交与评估结果目录 outputs/，以及记录 traces 的 logs/；代理通过统一 bash/JSON 终端协议读取候选和约束，写入 outputs/final_plan.json，并运行 evaluate_plan.py。评估器返回可行性、硬错误、诊断信息和任务分数，失败方案获得失败奖励。2）原子任务强化学习：将长轨迹拆为 BuildPlan 和 ImprovePlan；前者从城市图、候选集与约束生成初始可行计划，后者根据当前计划及评估诊断进行局部修改。使用 GRPO 分别采样短轨迹，并以计划级分数或失败惩罚作为终端奖励。3）迭代推理：先执行 BuildPlan，再循环调用 ImprovePlan；采用“可行性优先、可行方案中分数优先”的顺序，只接受严格更优候选，并保留历史最优解，直至达到迭代或耐心预算。基础模型为 Qwen3-8B，先进行终端交互格式的 SFT，再进行原子任务 RL。
AI.result: CityPlanner 在土地分配、道路建设和站点选址三个任务的小、中、大规模实例上，与 GRASP、SA、ALNS、MLP/注意力/GNN+PPO，以及 Qwen3.5、Mimo V2.5、DS-V4 比较。它在 9 个设置中的 8 个排名第一；唯一未领先的是小规模道路建设，GRASP 为 0.717，CityPlanner 为 0.609。代表性结果包括：土地分配中/大规模 CityPlanner 为 0.459/0.451，道路建设中/大型为 0.735/0.704，站点选址中/大型为 0.462/0.397。沙箱消融中，冻结 DeepSeek 采用完整脚手架后，可行率分别达到 95.69%、100%和 98.15%，明显高于纯文本以及 EoH、FunSearch。训练消融中，原子任务 RL 将三项任务可行率均提升至 100%，相对完整轨迹 GRPO 平均提高 8.3 个百分点、目标分数平均提高 20.7%；迭代部署再平均提高 4.9%，升级到 14B 又提高 2.8%。分析还表明，原子任务会重置上下文、降低预填充成本，并保持与强 LLM 代理接近的交互轮数。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明，统一的可执行环境与可组合的原子规划技能，是让 LLM 代理处理异构、强约束城市规划任务的有效方式。UrbanSandbox 将“语言上合理”转化为“程序可验证”，显著提高可行率和评分；BuildPlan 与 ImprovePlan 则缓解长轨迹信用分配及上下文膨胀问题，并在推理时通过反馈驱动改进形成闭环。实验结果支持可执行反馈、原子任务训练、迭代部署和模型扩展各自具有正向贡献。主要局限是多次终端交互和重复评估导致较高计算成本、运行时间高于轻量策略和启发式方法；方法也没有全局最优性保证，最终结果仍受模型能力、奖励定义及评估反馈质量影响。

title: A Function-Space Approach to the Statistical Mechanics of Learning Dynamics
summary: Deep neural networks exhibit regular macroscopic behavior despite highly nonlinear dynamics in vast parameter spaces. We develop a statistical-mechanical description of learning directly in function space, treating parameter configurations as microscopic realizations and functions with their dynamical operators as macroscopic variables. For mean-squared loss, the exact error dynamics are governed by the learning operator \(M=JJ^\ast\). Combining the dynamical Boltzmann weight of the conditional stochastic dynamics with the parameter-space density of states, whose local curvature defines a statistical operator \(B\), and integrating over local fluctuations yields $$ \Phi_{\mathrm{fluc}}(M;B)=\frac{\sigma_\xi^2}{2}\log\det(M^{-1}+B)+\mathrm{const}. $$ At fixed spectrum, this term is rotationally stationary when \([M,B]=0\), is minimized by pairing large eigenvalues of \(M\) with small eigenvalues of \(B\), and generates a local restoring contribution against rotational mismatch. For ReLU-type function spaces under mild stable statistical conditions, \(B=\sigma_\xi^2L^\ast\mathcal K L\), where \(L\) measures coarse-grained second-order structure. Thus the low-\(B\) sector corresponds, up to bounded anisotropy of \(\mathcal K\), to low structural curvature, implying a preference for faster relaxation along smooth, data-adaptive directions. These results identify function space as a natural macroscopic level for studying stable collective organization in learning.

AI.tldr: 本文在函数空间中构建了神经网络学习的统计力学框架，将参数配置视为微观实现，函数及其动力学算子视为宏观变量。对于均方损失，推导出条件涨落自由能贡献的闭式表达式，证明了其在固定谱下由反向谱配对原则决定，并将其与ReLU网络中的结构平滑性偏好联系起来。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在巨大参数空间中表现出强非线性动力学，却涌现出规律的宏观行为（如缩放律、谱结构、平滑性偏好）。现有理论要么冻结在参数空间，要么依赖于特定模型或极限的宏观变量选择，缺乏一个统一的、不预设具体架构的宏观描述层面来理解这种涌现规律性。核心问题是：高度非线性的学习动力学如何在函数空间中产生稳定且可扩展的宏观组织。
AI.method: 核心方法是将学习动力学从参数空间提升到函数空间进行统计力学描述：1) 将均方损失的梯度流精确写为误差场方程 ė = -Me，其中 M = JJ* 为学习算子；2) 在条件化 M 的框架下，构建过阻尼朗之万随机动力学，推导出条件Boltzmann权重；3) 通过参数空间的推前测度引入态密度 Ω(e)，定义统计曲率算子 B = -σ²∇²log Ω；4) 沿活跃子空间对涨落进行二次Laplace近似，积分得到条件自由能贡献 Φ_fluc(M;B) = (σ²/2)log det(M⁻¹+B)；5) 在固定谱轨道上分析旋转稳定性，证明驻点条件 [M,B]=0，并通过交换论证证明反向谱配对为全局最小；6) 对ReLU函数空间，利用激活边界上二阶结构集中这一几何性质，在稳定统计条件下推导 B = σ²L*K L 的具体形式，将低B谱与低结构曲率方向对应起来。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：1) 推导了条件涨落自由能贡献的精确闭式表达式 Φ_fluc(M;B) = (σ²/2)log det(M⁻¹+B)；2) 证明了旋转稳定性的充要条件为 [M,B]=0（定理4.1）；3) 证明了在稳定扇区 B⪰0 中，固定谱下反向谱配对 m_large↔b_small 给出全局最小，同序配对给出全局最大，非极值置换为鞍点（定理4.2）；4) 证明了在反向配对构型附近，每个非简并对具有严格正的二次曲率，产生局部恢复力（推论4.3）；5) 对ReLU函数空间，在假设R1-R3下证明了微态曲率为 B = σ²L*KL，其中 K 为正结构熵度量，其谱在有界各向异性因子 κ_K 精度内度量粗粒化结构曲率；6) 综合得出条件热力学偏好：将更快松弛方向与低结构曲率的数据自适应扇区配对。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明函数空间是研究学习集体组织稳定性的自然宏观层面。通过将动力学几何（由 M 描述）与参数化诱导的统计几何（由 B 描述）分离，揭示了条件涨落扇区对算子匹配的热力学偏好：在ReLU型函数空间中，该偏好表现为将更快松弛与低结构曲率、数据自适应的方向配对。这与经验观察到的谱偏差一致，但并非通过固定基或固定核谱实现，而是由数据加权的微态几何内在定义。论文同时明确指出其局限：仅刻画涨落贡献而非 M 的完整慢动力学，未处理各向异性噪声导致的非平衡扩展，且参数动力学能否实现相应算子旋转仍取决于架构。该框架为未来研究表示几何、谱组织及稳定性等更一般的集体结构提供了基础。

title: From State Synchronization to Cognitive Self-Evolution: An Operational Architecture for Cognitive Digital Twins
summary: As Digital Twin (DT) systems evolve beyond state synchronization toward task-oriented and knowledge-driven operation, Cognitive Digital Twins (CDTs) have emerged as an extension that incorporates cognitive capabilities into twin operation. Existing CDT studies often focus on specific enabling techniques, such as learning modules, knowledge graphs, and large language models, while providing limited insight into how cognition can be systematically integrated into DT architectures. To address this issue, this paper proposes a four-layer CDT architecture consisting of the physical layer, digital-twin layer, cognitive layer, and task layer. The proposed architecture establishes a self-evolving closed operational loop spanning these four layers, in which physical states are synchronized into digital representations, cognition constructs task-specific cognitive models through knowledge, memory, and attention, and task-level decisions are generated under practical constraints. Operational feedback further refines cognitive experience and updates relationships and annotations in the digital representation, enabling subsequent task interpretation, initiation, and reasoning to evolve with system operation. Based on this framework, two representative operation modes are characterized: user-request-driven cognition and self-driven cognition. We further discuss key enabling mechanisms and deployment challenges associated with semantic communication, knowledge querying, task orchestration, and closed-loop synchronization. A lightweight simulation study illustrates reliable closed-loop task feasibility under limited semantic information and improved operational efficiency through accumulated task experience. The proposed framework provides a structured foundation for the design and development of future CDT systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向认知数字孪生（CDT）的四层闭环操作架构（物理层、数字孪生层、认知层、任务层），将认知能力作为内生而非外挂模块融入DT运行流程，支持"用户请求驱动"与"自驱动"两种任务启动模式，通过反馈实现自我演化。
AI.motivation: 现有CDT研究多将认知作为附加决策支持模块（基于强化学习、知识图谱、大模型等单项技术），缺乏对认知如何系统融入DT架构的统一定义；传统DT的闭环仅涉及物理-数字状态同步与预定义目标优化，无法支持任务结果对认知理解与信息组织的反馈重塑，亟需一个将状态同步、认知推理、任务执行与反馈演化统一描述的操作框架。
AI.method: 提出四层CDT架构：P-layer（物理实体及环境）、DT-layer（同步数字表示与反馈标注）、C-layer（由知识、记忆、注意力构建任务专用认知模型）、T-layer（结合认知模型与数字表示生成并评估候选动作）；定义两种操作模式：用户请求驱动（外部语义任务经P-layer触发）与自驱动（DT-layer检测到与历史标注匹配的状态模式后自主触发）；讨论语义通信、知识查询、任务编排、闭环同步等关键使能技术及隐私、激励机制等部署挑战；通过基于PAMAP2与WESAD数据集的轻量化仿真（端-边-云部署，TCN做DT-layer、RGAT做知识检索、MLP做候选排序），对比CDT、CDT-NA（无邻域知识）与DT-S（静态知识库）三种方案。
AI.result: 仿真表明：(1) 闭环任务可行性方面，自驱动模式（Case 2）在低语义比下仍保持高且稳定的可行解命中率，用户请求驱动模式（Case 1）在语义信息丰富后性能接近Case 2，二者均显著优于静态知识库基线DT-S；(2) 经验驱动演化方面，随着任务规模与经验积累，CDT的搜索开销逐步降低，CDT-NA次之但因缺乏邻域共享知识开销仍较高，DT-S因知识静态而无明显下降，验证了闭环经验积累对任务处理效率的提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文将CDT形式化为具有自我演化能力的闭环操作系统，提供了区别于一般"认知增强DT"的统一操作定义；案例研究验证了架构在有限语义信息下的闭环可行性与经验驱动的效率优势；未来方向包括不确定性建模与安全边界、大规模可扩展实现（如分布式知识图谱分区、边缘缓存、跨层卸载）等开放问题。

title: Seven Sources of Physical AI Capability Formation
summary: Capabilities relevant to Physical AI can arise from materially different formation histories, yet existing taxonomies organized by morphology, architecture, learning algorithm, task, or domain do not directly answer what gives rise to a capability. We define a capability-formation source as a factor materially contributing to capability formation, distinct from components or construction steps. We identify seven non-exclusive sources: Recorded-Experience (RE), Predictive-Modeling (PM), Evaluative-Interaction (EI), Surrogate-Environment (SE), Mechanism-Grounded (MG), Embodied-Coupling (EC), and Evolution-Driven (ED) Formation. Using reconstructive induction with theoretical saturation, we traced a research matrix to primary studies, deduplicated the literature, set coding rules, and conducted three rounds of maximum-difference and negative-case sampling. Challenges included curriculum and self-supervised learning, active inference, open-ended and developmental learning, planning and search, neuro-symbolic architectures, digital twins, generative physical world models, and morphology-control co-design. Within the scope and criteria fixed as of September 4, 2026, all 49 evidence records were explainable by the seven sources individually or in combination. No R1-R3 challenge produced an irreducible eighth source, and R3 required no new core definition or substantive boundary rule. We therefore claim theoretical saturation within the stated scope, not logical completeness or exhaustive future coverage. The framework distinguishes similarity in observed capability from similarity in how it was formed, supporting analysis of explanation, transfer, replication, dependencies, governance evidence, and geoeconomic foundations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个分析框架，将物理AI能力的形成来源划分为七个非互斥类别：记录经验(RE)、预测建模(PM)、评价交互(EI)、替代环境(SE)、机制基础(MG)、具身耦合(EC)和进化驱动(ED)，旨在区分能力的表面相似性与形成路径的差异。
AI.motivation: 现有物理AI文献多按形态、架构、算法、任务或领域分类，无法回答"能力从何而来"这一根本问题。两个表现出相同能力的系统可能依赖完全不同的形成基础，这影响了能力的可解释性、可迁移性、可复现性、治理证据以及地缘经济基础的评估。
AI.method: 采用重构性归纳设计(theoretical saturation)作为停止准则。研究团队追溯先前的research matrix至原始研究，去重并建立显式编码规则；进行R0-R3四轮最大差异与负例采样挑战（R0重构核心文献并产生初始七类框架，R1-R3每轮新增7条最大差异/负例证据记录），使用49条编码证据记录和45个公开来源，以2026年9月4日为文献截止日。
AI.result: 49条证据记录均可由七个来源单独或组合解释；R1-R3三轮挑战均未产生不可还原的第八类来源；R3无需新增核心定义或实质性边界规则。研究识别了三组关键相邻边界（RE/EI、PM/SE、EI/ED）以区分易混淆来源，并在负例测试中证明课程学习、自监督学习、主动推理、数字孪生、神经符号架构等候选概念均可还原至现有七类。
AI.conclusion: 研究在既定文献范围、纳入排除规则、编码准则及截止日期条件下达到了理论饱和，宣称一个可审计、可比较、可证伪的词汇体系，用于区分观察到的能力相似性与能力形成条件的相似性。该框架适用于解释、迁移、复现、依赖性、治理证据及地缘经济基础的评估，但不声称逻辑完备性或对未来技术的穷尽覆盖。研究明确提出R4重新开启条件与未来验证方向（如需引入独立双重编码者）。

title: RobustSGPO: Search-Space Control for Agent Harness Evolution
summary: Semantic-gradient-based prompt optimization (SGPO) improves agent harnesses using execution feedback, but its local update rule leaves the choice of edit scope and operation unresolved. We introduce RobustSGPO, which specifies the requested edit, constructs and checks the patch, and continues search from either the incumbent or retained snapshots. We evaluate permission scheduling, cumulative controls, and task-family transfer in the AgentX brainstorming workflow using 120 tasks, 95 runs, and 7,350 candidate attempts. Periodic $1\to2\to3$ scheduling exceeds fixed maximum permission by 0.28 test-score points. RobustSGPO increases completion on 30 held-out tasks from 60.0% to 80.0% and improves test quality from 3.77 to 4.14 under a 20-million-token budget. Category retention reduces source-task degradation after a shift, whereas random retention reaches a higher destination endpoint. Search-space control benefits quality through executable edits and alternative starting points, with measurable retention overhead.

AI.tldr: RobustSGPO通过显式控制编辑选择、可执行补丁构建与保留搜索起点，解决了语义梯度提示优化（SGPO）在多智能体harness演化中编辑范围和操作未指定的问题，在AgentX头脑风暴工作流上将30个保留任务的完成率从60.0%提升至80.0%，测试质量从3.77提升至4.14。
AI.motivation: 现有SGPO采用局部更新规则，但编辑范围（scope）和操作类型（operation）的选择未被明确规定，导致：1）限制单智能体编辑无法修复跨智能体故障；2）开放完整权限空间并不能保证模型有效探索，生成仍集中于熟悉的指令改写；3）任务迁移后缺乏保留备选起点的机制。研究旨在通过显式搜索空间控制弥补"允许空间"与"有效实现空间"之间的差距。
AI.method: RobustSGPO在AgentX的SGPO-I循环基础上引入三层显式控制：(1) 编辑选择——控制器在生成内容前指定范围s（α1/α2/α3三级权限）、操作o（如字段对齐）和目标T的可行类别c=(s,o)；(2) 补丁构建与检查——精确目标检查（exact-target check）对比请求与实际修改对象集；预定义代码构造器执行可重复的添加/删除操作，指令编辑仍由模型生成；(3) 保留搜索起点——采用MAP-Elites启发的归档A[c]，按范围-操作类别存储最高验证分数的完整快照，支持从保留版本而非仅当前最优继续搜索。候选准入仍遵循基于in-cumbent的配对重放规则。
AI.result: 在120个任务、95次运行、7350次候选尝试的实验下：(1) E1调度——周期1→2→3权限调度最终得分4.34，超过固定α3的0.28分；(2) E2消融——SGPO/Planned/Constrained/Structured/RobustSGPO五配置的轮30得分依次为3.82/3.94/4.04/4.20/4.30，RobustSGPO有效类别覆盖率达68%；结构化搜索将结构编辑有效性从48.9%提升至77.8%；(3) E3迁移——类别保留使源任务退化最小（-0.15分），随机保留获得更高目的端点（4.18）；(4) 等代币预算下，RobustSGPO以20M令牌达4.14分，超SGPO 0.37分，但因归档开销对结构化搜索优势从等轮次的0.10缩小至等代币的0.04。
AI.conclusion: RobustSGPO将自由形式的SGPO更新分解为请求编辑、补丁构建检查和保留搜索起点的显式控制。周期性权限调度改善最终质量，预定义增删操作提升结构有效性，完整方法在等代币成本下优于自由搜索；类别保留策略降低迁移后的源任务退化，但伴随搜索开销。结果支持在多智能体harness演化中对编辑选择和搜索起点进行显式控制，但保留策略在适应性与保留性之间存在权衡。

title: Black-Box Red Teaming of Agentic AI: A Taxonomy-Driven Framework for Automated Risk Discovery
summary: Agentic systems are rapidly moving to production, where they read untrusted inputs, call tools with real permissions, and act autonomously, expanding the security surface beyond chat-only models. Yet standard evaluations remain single-turn and fail to capture multi-step agent vulnerabilities. We present a systematic black-box framework for risk-aware agent evaluation requiring only basic system descriptions. Our approach introduces: (1) a seven-domain taxonomy mapping observable behaviors to risk categories, (2) fully automated SAGE-RT red teaming producing 120 adversarial scenarios per domain, and (3) human-validated evaluation using LLM judges. Empirical validation across two agent architectures (CrewAI and AutoGen) with four base models reveals alarming patterns: 56.25\% average governance risk, 65\% privacy risk in multi-agent configurations, and agent behavior vulnerabilities reaching 85\%. Our black-box approach effectively identifies critical architectural vulnerabilities without privileged access, providing a scalable path toward safer agent deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套针对智能体（Agentic AI）的黑盒红队评估框架，包含七领域风险分类法、自动化 SAGE-RT 场景生成与人类验证评估，在 CrewAI 和 AutoGen 两种架构上验证发现治理与隐私风险普遍偏高（最高达 65%-85%），且风险模式由架构而非模型决定。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 安全评估多为单轮静态测试，无法捕捉智能体在工具调用、多步规划与状态持久化下的多步骤漏洞。智能体已部署生产，安全面远超聊天模型，亟需一套仅需系统描述即可执行的黑盒系统性风险评估方法。
AI.method: 1) 设计七领域风险分类法（治理、输出质量、工具滥用、隐私、可靠性与可观测性、行为、访问控制）；2) 基于 SAGE-RT 自动生成每个领域 120 个对抗场景并多轮执行；3) 采用 LLM 裁判打分 + 人工复核高风险结果；4) 在 CrewAI（单智能体餐厅接待员）和 AutoGen（多智能体股票顾问）两个系统上用四种基础模型（GPT-4.1-nano、Mistral Small、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Kimi K2）进行纯黑盒测试。
AI.result: Stock Advisory 多智能体平均风险 40.53%、Restaurant Receptionist 单智能体平均 29.49%；治理风险普遍达 56.25%，Stock 隐私风险高达 65%，GPT-4.1-nano 驱动的 Stock 智能体行为风险飙至 85%；漏洞模式跨模型一致、跨框架相似，说明架构选择而非模型选择是风险主导因素。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在无内部访问条件下规模化发现智能体关键漏洞，为产业提供立即可用的安全评估基座；当前智能体在对抗环境下严重不成熟，呼吁在广泛部署前采用系统性风险评估标准。

title: RESCUE-BENCH: Towards Relation-Aware Multi-Party Emotional Support Conversation Systems
summary: Existing emotional support conversation systems mainly focus on one-on-one seeker-supporter interactions and individual emotional states, leaving interpersonal relations in multi-party scenarios underexplored. In this work, we introduce relation-aware emotional support conversation, a new task that evaluates whether LLMs can capture and utilize the evolving dynamics of relationships to offer more effective emotional support. We construct RESCUE (Relation-aware Emotional Support Conversation Understanding and Evaluation Benchmark) from real couple and family interview conversations, containing 191 samples, 7,079 annotated turns, and 1,064.8 minutes of video. Based on rich annotations of socio-emotional and support-related dynamics, RESCUE defines six tasks that evaluate two core capabilities required for relation-aware emotional support: Relational Understanding and Relation-Sensitive Support. Experiments with ten LLMs show that current models perform relatively well on tasks relying on local emotional or intervention cues, but struggle with relation-intensive tasks such as relation pattern prediction, viewpoint prediction, and support strategy prediction. These findings reveal the limitations of current LLMs in modeling interpersonal relations and making relation-sensitive support decisions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了关系感知情感支持对话（Relation-aware ESC）这一新任务，并构建了RESCUE-Bench基准，用于评估大语言模型在多方关系场景下捕捉和利用人际关系动态以提供有效情感支持的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有情感支持对话系统主要聚焦一对一寻求者-支持者交互和个体情绪状态，忽略了多方场景中的人际关系因素。而在现实家庭和伴侣治疗情境中，关系动态对支持效果至关重要，且AI领域对关系感知ESC的系统性研究仍处于早期阶段。
AI.method: 1) 从真实的伴侣和家庭治疗纪录片访谈视频构建RESCUE-Bench基准（191个样本，7079个标注轮次，1064.8分钟视频）；2) 定义六项任务，分为"关系理解"（情感识别ER、观点预测VP、关系模式预测RPP）和"关系敏感支持"（干预时机预测ITP、支持目标预测STP、支持策略预测SSP）两大维度；3) 标注框架涵盖六个结构化维度（时序与实体信息、言语内容、个体线索、关系姿态、治疗师策略、关系模式）；4) 采用Gemini-3.1-Pro进行预标注，三位博士级标注员进行人工审核；5) 在零样本设置下评估十个主流LLM。
AI.result: 1) 在依赖局部情绪或干预线索的任务（ITP平均F1达82.62%，ER平均LLM评分4.05/5）上表现尚可；2) 在关系密集型任务上表现显著下降：RPP最佳准确率仅45.60%（均值40.45%），VP的LLM评分均值仅3.58/5，SSP召回率仅31.88%、MRR 44.96%；3) 没有任何单一模型在所有任务上一致领先，例如Qwen3.5-Plus在ITP和ER最优但RPP较弱，DeepSeek-V4-Pro在RPP/STP/SSP上表现最佳；4) 模型难以跟踪关系模式的动态演变，无法处理隐式表达的观点，且在细粒度策略选择上存在困难；5) 长尾标签分布导致罕见关系模式和策略的识别准确率极低。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在从个体层面理解转向关系层面推理和支持规划方面存在明显局限，无法有效建模人际关系动态和做出关系敏感的支持决策。RESCUE-Bench为推动关系敏感且语境扎根的情感支持系统研究提供了基础，未来工作需进一步开发能够显式建模支持行动对个体情绪状态和人际关系长期影响的模型。

title: PRAGMA: Evaluating Personalized Guidance with Memory Alignment in Lifelong Conversations
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as personalized assistants that interact with users over extended periods of time. As conversations grow longer, relying on full interaction histories becomes increasingly inefficient and unreliable: long contexts introduce substantial computational overhead, making it difficult for models to consistently identify and utilize the most relevant information for the current request. These challenges have motivated memory systems that structure and retrieve user-specific information. In realistic interactions, users often seek practical guidance such as recommendations, planning, and decision support. Unlike factual recall tasks, personalized guidance requires models to integrate information across multiple past conversations and reason about changing user preferences and experiences. However, existing conversational memory evaluations mainly focus on retrieval and factual recall. To study this challenge, we introduce PRAGMA, a benchmark for evaluating personalized guidance in long-term conversations. PRGAMA contains curated longitudinal conversation histories, evidence annotations, and guidance scenarios grounded in evolving user contexts and incorrect user assumptions. Experiments across retrieval systems, memory systems, and long-context models reveal that current systems struggle both to recover the appropriate conversational evidence and to effectively use it for personalized guidance. Our results highlight the need for memory architectures that support robust conversational retrieval and memory-grounded reasoning beyond evidence recall.

AI.tldr: PRAGMA是一个用于评估长期对话中个性化指导（而非仅事实回忆）的大语言模型基准，涵盖100个用户、400个查询，按记忆动态（事件级/轨迹级）和查询对齐（一致/纠错）两个维度构建为四类查询（Event-Align、Event-Correct、Traj-Align、Traj-Correct）。实验表明，现有检索系统、记忆系统和长上下文模型在检索证据与基于证据生成个性化指导两方面均存在显著不足，尤其在纠错类查询和证据接地（grounding）方面表现很差，揭示了记忆架构需要在检索与生成之间架起更好的桥梁。
AI.motivation: 现有对话记忆评估主要聚焦于检索和事实回忆，而真实场景中用户更需要推荐、规划、决策等个性化指导。这类任务要求模型跨越多轮对话整合信息、推理用户偏好的演变，并在用户假设与历史冲突时进行纠错。已有基准（如LongMemEval、LoCoMo、PersonaMem等）缺乏对开放式个性化指导、轨迹级推理和纠错场景的系统评估，检索与下游个性化推理的关系也未被充分研究。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建：基于Privasis-Zero的100个合成用户，通过可控的、人工校验的生成管道产生纵向对话历史（约160K token/用户），包括事件级经验、跨两个潜在行为轴的轨迹级演变和大量无关干扰会话。2) 查询设计：四类查询——Event-Align（事件一致）、Event-Correct（纠错用户对事件的错误回忆）、Traj-Align（轨迹一致，要求沿抽象描述符推理）、Traj-Correct（轨迹纠错，用户决策与长期轨迹冲突）。3) 评估协议：会话级证据标注用于检索评估（Recall、Exact Recall、F1）；响应评估由GPT-5作为评判模型，按查询类型使用八套评估准则，从Alignment（与用户经验/轨迹的一致性）和Grounding（证据支撑）两维度评分，并由Gemini和Claude进行一致性验证。4) 系统评估：检索系统（Dense、BM25、Window、Query Rewriting、Adaptive-K、Dynamic）、记忆系统（A-MEM、Mem0、SimpleMem）、长上下文Full-Context，以及No-Context、Oracle-Session、Oracle-Summary三种参考设置；生成模型包括GPT-5-mini、Qwen3-30B-A3B，并扩展到GPT-8-120B、LLaMA-4-Scout、Claude-Opus-4.6。5) 进一步分析将记忆管道分解为存储保留、检索可达性和响应利用三阶段进行诊断。
AI.result: 1) Full-Context长上下文基线表现不佳，如GPT-5-mini在Trajectory-Align上仅得8.00 grounding，说明长历史本身不足以支撑个性化指导。2) 各系统在纠错类查询上表现极差：Event-Correct对齐分数在2-8之间，Trajectory-Correct对齐分数低于43。3) 对齐分数普遍远高于接地分数，如A-MEM在Traj-Align对齐81.00但接地16.00，模型常常生成合理但缺乏证据支撑的回答。4) Oracle-Session与Oracle-Summary之间存在显著差距（如GPT-5-mini在Traj-Align上从78/17跃升到99/86），说明仅提供证据会话不够，必须以蒸馏形式呈现。5) 强检索不必然带来强响应：Query Rewriting在Traj-Align上达到95.95 Recall/80.00 Exact Recall，但响应仅为25.00对齐/20.00接地。6) 记忆系统三阶段分析显示保留与利用之间存在权衡：A-MEM保留率~99%但仅~49%可被检索利用；Mem0/SimpleMem保留率较低但下游利用更稳定，结构化/摘要式记忆反而更利于生成。7) 两阶段（先识别不一致再生成）能将对齐提至接近完美，但接地仍然不足；模型存在迎合用户假设的倾向。8) Claude-Opus-4.6整体最强（Oracle-Summary 90.75/92.28），但纠错场景（Event-Correct 65.00对齐）仍是短板；LLaMA-4-Scout和GPT-OSS-120B差距更大。9) 评委一致性：GPT-5与Gemini一致率82.9%，与Claude一致率78.6%，三评委Krippendorff α=0.697。
AI.conclusion: PRAGMA揭示了当前LLM在长期个性化指导任务中的两大瓶颈：检索相关证据以及有效利用证据进行接地推理。即使提供黄金证据，模型若仅获得原始会话仍难以综合出连贯的个性化建议，需要经过蒸馏/结构化才能被有效利用；纠错类查询因模型倾向迎合用户而尤为困难。基准呼吁构建能同时优化保留、可检索性与生成可用性的新型记忆架构，并指出未来应向交互式多轮评估与更细粒度的纵向推理评测方向发展。

title: Safe to Stop? Risk-Constrained Stopping for Sequential Clinical Diagnosis Agents
summary: Clinical diagnosis agents must decide not only what test to request next, but also when to diagnose or defer. Existing agent benchmarks largely evaluate accuracy after fixed or unconstrained interaction, leaving autonomous stopping reliability implicit. We present Cros, a risk-constrained stopping layer combining state-wise error ranking, policy design on disjoint development splits, and LTT-style exact tests of selective diagnostic error and minimum autonomous coverage for complete sequential policies. Its finite-sample guarantee requires the candidate family, testing rule, and any randomization to be frozen before calibration labels are accessed. On a 1,834-episode MIMIC-derived abdominal-pain benchmark, the full ranker achieves exploratory state-error AUROC 0.853, compared with 0.715 for maximum class probability and 0.552 for the backbone's native stop score. On the previously viewed 367-episode evaluation split, analytically averaging over the frozen Cros weights yields 16.9% selective error at 78.8% coverage, cost 5.57, and 0.68 tests, versus 30.8% error at 100% coverage, cost 8.14, and 1.53 tests under native stopping. Forced continuation is non-monotone: error is 28.3% with HPI alone and 34.3% after full workup. However, the uniform-weight mixture ablation is cheaper on this viewed split despite missing the locked development margins, and Cros nominally satisfies the joint criterion in only 6 of 20 development resplits. Because evaluation labels were inspected during earlier development, these findings provide exploratory feasibility and audit evidence, not a confirmatory safety certificate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cros框架，为临床序贯诊断智能体增加风险约束的停止层，在共同骨干轨迹上对选择性诊断错误率和最低自主覆盖度进行精确联合检验（基于LTT多重检验），提供可审计的有限样本保证；但由于评估标签在开发阶段已被查看，结果仅为探索性可行性证据，不构成确认性安全认证。
AI.motivation: 现有临床诊断智能体基准主要评估固定或无约束交互后的准确率，自主停止决策的可靠性缺乏显式保证。无标定置信阈值不提供联合风险-覆盖度的有限样本保证，而无约束经验成本最小化会过拟合选择样本。需要将序贯诊断形式化为带风险约束的选择性停止问题。
AI.method: 方法包括三个组成部分：(1) 状态级风险排序器（直方图梯度提升），估计骨干诊断错误的概率；(2) 在不相交开发分割上冻结候选族、设计和测试规则，通过LP优化在阈值-视野策略网格上进行情景式随机化混合（命题1表明最优基本可行解至多3个非零权重）；(3) 基于LTT的精确二项式p值交集-并集检验，联合检验选择性诊断错误≤α和自主覆盖度≥γ，使用多重检验程序控制FWER。理论保证要求候选族、测试规则和随机化机制在校准标签访问前冻结。
AI.result: 在1,834例MIMIC衍生的腹痛基准上：完整排序器达到状态错误AUROC 0.853（vs 最大类概率0.715、骨干原生停止得分0.552）。367例评估分割上，Cros-Mix解析期望实现16.9%选择性错误率、78.8%覆盖度、成本5.57、0.68次检验，而原生停止为30.8%错误率、100%覆盖度、成本8.14、1.53次检验。强制延续呈现非单调性：HPI单独28.3%、全部检查后34.3%。负面证据包括：无历史排序器几乎匹配完整排序器（0.852）、均匀权重混合在评估上更便宜但未满足开发约束、Cros-Mix仅在20次开发重分割中的6次满足联合准则、类级失败（憩室炎50%、非特异性腹痛100%）。
AI.conclusion: Cros通过选择性错误和自主覆盖度的联合检验使序贯诊断停止可审计。回顾性结果支持可行性和较低成本的确定性-混合权衡，但标签重用、结构化缺失、重分割不稳定和亚组失败需要新的前瞻性锁定研究才能做出任何安全声明。本文仅提供探索性校准检查而非确认性安全证书，确认性结论需要从未访问的队列重新冻结。

title: Decision Shifts, Lost Label Functionality, and an Inconclusive Grounding Audit in Correctness-Gated Multi-Teacher Distillation
summary: Candidate decision correctness and rationale grounding are different objectives. We examine correctness-gated multi-teacher distillation in a fixed experiment. Eight arms share 4,330 sources, a 63.9M-parameter student, 12,990 optimization rows, 406 updates, evidence inputs, and a decoder; seven teacher-based arms use one fixed three-response pool. Three seeds are evaluated on 267 held-out examples. Relative to unfiltered distillation, the correctness-weighted arm differed in accuracy by +0.1660 (95% observed-matrix interval [0.0670, 0.2455]), five-label macro-F1 by +0.1323 ([0.0916, 0.1731]), and task-defined conditional unsafe-action rate by -0.4979 ([-0.5926, -0.3686]). These shifts do not imply uniformly better behavior. Source-label SFT had the highest mean macro-F1 (0.586). The weighted arm had zero Refuted recall in every seed, and two seeds assigned NotEnoughInfo to all 167 claim examples. In an availability-amended audit at one reference seed, weighted and unfiltered outputs had 0/20 versus 1/20 evidence-supported positives and 20/20 versus 19/20 positives containing unsupported material. Samples were non-paired, source overlap was not serialized, and the amendment followed automatic summarization but preceded annotation. The audit therefore cannot estimate a common-source grounding effect and is inconclusive about system-level improvement or harm. Hard filtering already achieved 0.660 accuracy, 0.530 macro-F1, and 0.135 conditional unsafe rate. The implemented weighted arm showed no demonstrated incremental decision benefit over hard filtering. This fixed-matrix failure analysis shows decision redistribution with lost label functionality; the available human audit does not establish a grounding gain.

AI.tldr: 这是一项固定实验矩阵下的失败分析：在多教师蒸馏中引入候选决策正确性门控（correctness-gated weighted MTD），相对未过滤多教师蒸馏在accuracy、5-label macro-F1和条件不安全动作率上有显著的方向性改善，但伴随标签功能丧失（Refuted召回为零、两个种子对167个claim全部输出NotEnoughInfo），且可用的人工审计因样本非配对、修改时间在自动汇总之后、源重叠未序列化等原因无法支撑"接地性提升"的结论。硬过滤已实现相同的聚合模式，权重臂未显示出在硬过滤基础上的增量决策收益。
AI.motivation: 现有知识蒸馏与理性蒸馏工作常将教师候选以"质量感知"方式过滤或重加权，但大多数以决策正确性为目标的门控是否真的会提升学生输出的证据支撑性并不清楚。论文动机在于揭示"决策正确性"与"理性接地性"是两个不同目标，在教师/学生/解码器/数据集固定的受控实验下检验正确性门控的多教师蒸馏是否同时改善聚合决策端点与逐标签功能以及证据支撑性。
AI.method: 1) 任务与数据：基于Yelp评论的英文餐厅领域证据-接地任务，claim verification（Supported/Refuted/NotEnoughInfo）与recommendation query（Answer/Abstain），882条人工语标，4330个学生源，353个人工源×3角色×3模型得到3177个门控开发单元格，加上3个固定教师响应/源构成12990个候选。2) 门控：以scikit-learn LogisticRegression训练组合候选正确性门（16特征），4折源分组交叉验证，阈值τ=0.41。3) 8个监督臂：源标签SFT、仅答案KD、单教师理性KD、未过滤MTD、硬过滤、正确性加权MTD、动态乘积MTD、角色感知加权MTD。学生为63.9M参数MiniMind-3，所有臂共享12990行、406次更新与解码器，3个种子。4) 统计：交叉bootstrap（10,000次）对3种子×22泄漏组矩阵采样给出"观察矩阵百分位区间"，作为描述性稳定性而非置信区间。5) 接地性评估三层：自动决策端点（accuracy/5-label macro-F1/条件不安全动作率）、逐标签反捷径检查、可用的性修改人工审计，正负样本各20条/臂，掩蔽系统与种子标签，由双人独立标注+分歧仅裁决。
AI.result: 主要决策对比：相对未过滤MTD，正确性加权MTD的accuracy差+0.1660（[0.0670,0.2455]）、5-label macro-F1差+0.1323（[0.0916,0.1731]）、条件不安全动作率差−0.4979（[−0.5926,−0.3686]）。但逐标签功能丧失：加权MTD在三个种子上Refuted召回均为0，两个种子将167个claim全部判为NotEnoughInfo；SFT以0.586宏F1最高，硬过滤准确率最高0.660。硬过滤已呈现相同聚合模式，加权臂相对硬过滤无显著增量收益（accuracy差−0.0262，区间[−0.0597,−0.0024]）。人工审计：加权MTD 0/20有证据支撑的答案、20/20含未支持材料、0/20有效引用；审计为单参考种子、修改后、非配对、源重叠未序列化，不能估计共同源接地效应。
AI.conclusion: 在一个固定的实验矩阵中，正确性门控的多教师蒸馏相对未过滤蒸馏改变了决策分布（聚合端点方向性改善），但未建立证据接地的提升：标签功能丧失，人工审计因设计问题无法支持"接地性增强"或"接地性受损"的系统级论断；硬过滤已再现聚合模式，权重增量无证据。结论是有边界地否认了"决策正确性门控即接地性改进"的隐含假设，强调决策正确性与理性接地性为不同目标，并指出逐标签召回与证据质量应与选择性/校准一起报告。

title: Which Tokens Should SFT Actually Learn? A Token-Trimming Perspective on Mathematical Reasoning
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. 14 pages. Code available at this https URL
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) applies a uniform cross-entropy loss to all target tokens, even though different tokens provide unequal learning signals for mathematical reasoning. This uniform treatment can over-sharpen already mastered tokens while amplifying learning pressure on uncertain, low-confidence tokens, leading to suboptimal training dynamics. We propose Trimmed Logit-Gap SFT (TrimSFT), a simple token-level reweighting method that scales the SFT loss according to the logit gap between the gold token and its strongest competitor. TrimSFT trims supervision away from both extremes: tokens already mastered (large logit gap) and tokens weakly supported by the current model (small or negative logit gap), concentrating learning within an intermediate logit-gap region between them. We instantiate this principle with a Gaussian weight centered at margin m with bandwidth {\tau}, requiring no reference model or additional forward pass. We evaluate TrimSFT on six base models from the Llama, Qwen, and DeepMath families across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks. TrimSFT consistently improves over standard SFT, achieving the best average performance on five out of six models, with gains of up to +26.9 points over SFT on MATH500. Further analyses show that the bandwidth {\tau} matters more than the exact margin location, and that half-trim variants that remove supervision pressure from only one side yield inferior trade-offs. A token-level logit-gap distribution analysis suggests that TrimSFT reshapes model confidence in a more balanced way than uniform SFT or monotonic reweighting methods. These results suggest that reasoning SFT can benefit from trimming both extremes rather than treating all tokens uniformly.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Trimmed Logit-Gap SFT（TrimSFT）：不均匀计算监督微调中的所有目标 token，而是依据正确 token 与最强竞争 token 的 logit 差，用以 m 为中心、τ 为带宽的高斯函数缩放交叉熵。方法同时削弱极大 logit gap 的易掌握 token 和极小乃至负 logit gap 的弱支持 token，使训练压力集中到中间置信区间。实验覆盖 6 个基础模型、5 个数学推理基准，所有模型均优于标准 SFT，并在 6 个模型中的 5 个取得最高平均成绩；MATH500 最大提升为 +26.93 个百分点。研究同时表明：窄带宽比 margin 的精确位置更关键；只修剪一侧通常不如双侧修剪，尤其保留低 gap 强监督会造成训练不稳定。
AI.motivation: 标准 SFT 对所有目标 token 统一施加交叉熵监督，但不同 token 的学习价值并不相同。高 logit-gap token 可能已掌握，却继续被过度锐化；低或负 logit-gap token 则可能当前不可学习或噪声较大，却产生异常大的损失。二者都会挤压中间置信区间的有效训练信号。作者据此提出非单调的 token 选择机制，以同时修剪置信谱两端。
AI.method: 给定位置 t 的预 softmax logits 向量 z_t，定义 logit gap Δ_t = z_{t,y_t} − max_{v≠y_t} z_{t,v}。TrimSFT 对 token 交叉熵乘以权重 w_t = exp(−(Δ_t−m)^2/(2τ^2))，m 控制中间目标区间的中心，τ 控制宽度；权重通过 stop-gradient 只缩放损失，不产生二阶梯度。权重由同一次前向传播的当前模型 logits 得出，不需要参考模型或额外前向计算。论文还比较两种单侧变体：TrimSFT-E 仅抑制低于 m 的困难侧，TrimSFT-E 仅保留低 gap 侧监督；并与等权 SFT、基于 Focal Loss 的 FSFT，以及提高高概率 token 权重的 DFT 统一比较。实验从约 86 万条的 NuminaMath-CoT 中随机采样 2 万题，对 Llama3.2-3B、Llama3.1-8B、DeepSeekMath-7B、Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B/7B、Qwen3-4B-Base 各训练 1 个 epoch；采用 AdamW、学习率 5×10^-5、余弦衰减、全局批量 24、最大长度 2048，并在 MATH500、OlympiadBench、Minerva、AMC、AIME24 上各采样 8 个答案，以 average@8 为主指标，辅以 pass@8 和多数投票 best-of-8。主设置固定为 (m,τ)=(1.5,0.8)。
AI.result: TrimSFT 在 6 个模型上均优于标准 SFT，并在其中 5 个获得最佳平均分。六个模型的平均分分别从 1.90 提升到 4.14、4.34 到 7.84、8.75 到 15.52、15.47 到 31.77、20.95 到 35.98、19.25 到 29.00。DeepSeekMath-7B 是例外：TrimSFT 15.52，略低于 DFT 的 15.67。MATH500 上，TrimSFT 六个模型均为最佳；相对 SFT 的最大增益出现在 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B，为 40.02%→66.95%，即 +26.93 个百分点。相较 DFT，TrimSFT 在六个模型中的五个取得更高平均分；FSFT 大多明显退化。重复采样方面，TrimSFT 的 pass@8 和 best-of-8 在 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 与 Llama3.1-8B 上整体优于或匹配基线，表明收益不只来自单次生成质量。消融显示，τ 较小时，不同 m 的结果大多仍高于 SFT；τ 过大时性能明显下降，因此窄而集中的选择区间比 m 的具体位置更重要。半修剪实验进一步发现，TrimSFT-H 持续很差，m=1/3/5 时 MATH500 分别仅 28.75/40.92/42.50；TrimSFT-E 在 MATH500、AMC 上常具竞争力，但在 AIME24 上较不稳定。梯度质量分析表明，TrimSFT-H 将 71.78%–99.04% 的梯度质量置于低 gap 区域，TrimSFT 则显著压低该区域，同时抑制高 gap 区域。logit-gap 分布显示，TrimSFT 相比 SFT 提高了总体 margin，同时比 FSFT 更有效地减少小 gap 质量。token 类别分析还显示，相较 SFT，数字 token 的梯度份额由 5.55% 增至 10.31%，数学符号由 15.76% 增至 22.78%。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出结论：数学推理 SFT 不应对所有 token 施加同等监督，更有效的策略是围绕中等 logit-gap 区间集中优化信号，同时削弱已高度掌握和当前几乎不可学习的 token。TrimSFT 仅以两项轻量超参数改变损失权重，计算开销较小，且不依赖参考模型；但证据主要限于数学推理和单轮 SFT。其在代码生成、开放式指令跟随、长文本推理，以及作为后续强化学习或偏好优化初始化阶段的效果仍待验证。固定 (m,τ) 也可能不适用于所有模型规模和训练分布，未来可研究训练过程中自适应调整 margin 与带宽。

title: Can Artificial Intelligence Support Healthcare and Mental Health Through Early Cyberbullying Detection ? The Impact of Emotion-Aware AI on Proactive Online Safety
summary: Healthcare systems, mental health, and public well-being are increasingly affected by cyberbullying and harmful online interactions. This paper presents CareGuard, an early-warning framework designed to support healthcare-driven mental health protection and proactive online safety through the detection of cyberbullying-related content using advanced natural language processing techniques. CareGuard integrates zero-shot semantic labeling with fine-tuned transformer-based models, including BERT, DistilBERT, and RoBERTa, to enable robust and context-aware classification across sensitive cyberbullying categories. To improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary computation in healthcare-oriented monitoring settings, the framework incorporates an emotion-aware filtering mechanism alongside cosine similarity-based semantic screening, allowing the system to focus on semantically relevant and emotionally salient content. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that CareGuard effectively balances detection accuracy and computational efficiency, highlighting its potential for scalable deployment in healthcare systems, mental health monitoring, and online safety applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CareGuard 框架，一种面向医疗与心理健康支持的早期网络欺凌预警系统。该框架集成零样本语义标注、情感感知过滤机制（基于情感阈值与余弦相似度）以及基于 Transformer（BERT、DistilBERT、RoBERTa）并融合 BiGRU 的混合分类模型。RoBERTa 在四个类别上整体性能最佳（准确率 0.91，Macro F1 0.90，Weighted F1 0.9129），同时还引入了基于 LLaMA-2-7b 的后建模分析模块，用于心理健康影响评估、施害/受害实体抽取及语义摘要生成，并结合 CoT 与少样本提示工程。该框架旨在将传统被动分类转变为主动预警与决策支持，适用于医疗、心理健康监测及在线安全平台。
AI.motivation: 网络欺凌因其匿名性与持续渗透性，比传统欺凌更难察觉与控制，常导致焦虑、抑郁甚至自杀等严重心理后果，对儿童与青少年影响尤甚。现有检测方法多依赖大规模标注数据，专注于静态分类，缺乏对隐式、语境化或讽刺性欺凌的识别能力，且不能提供早期预警或主动干预，难以满足医疗健康与心理健康保护场景的实际需求。
AI.method: CareGuard 采用四阶段流水线架构：（1）Phase A 数据采集与预处理（词干化、去停用词、HTML 清洗）；（2）Phase B 情感感知语义过滤——依据情感阈值 θ_neg 将低于阈值的推文路由至基于余弦相似度的深度语义分析函数 f(C(t), Context(t), M_LLM)，高于阈值者归入噪声集 D_noise；（3）Phase C Transformer 精炼——以 RoBERTa-base + BiGRU 为主分类器，BERT-base 与 DistilBERT 作为辅助模型，加权评分 S_i = αA_i + βPr_i + γR_i + δF1_i，按 S_combined 聚合；（4）Phase D 基于 LLaMA-2-7b-chat-hf 的后建模多任务分析（心理健康影响评估、施害/受害实体抽取、语义要点提取与摘要），结合 Chain-of-Thought 推理与零/少样本提示工程。实验使用 Kaggle 公开数据集，学习率 2×10⁻⁵，batch size 32，验证集早停，测试集 1,137 条样本。
AI.result: 在 1,137 条测试样本上的对比实验显示：RoBERTa-base 与 BERT-base 准确率均为 0.91，Macro F1 为 0.90，但 RoBERTa-base 的 Weighted F1（0.9129）略优；DistilBERT 显著落后（准确率 0.8777，Macro F1 0.8526，错误率 0.1223）。类别层面，RoBERTa-base 在 ethnicity/race（0.89）与 gender（0.90）上最优，not_cyberbullying 为 0.95，religion 为 0.85；BERT-base 仅在 religion 类别（0.88）略胜。混淆流分析揭示 religion 与 ethnicity/race 等敏感少数类容易被误分类为 not_cyberbullying，反映出明显的类别不平衡与语义歧义问题。
AI.conclusion: CareGuard 通过融合情感感知过滤、多 Transformer 精炼与 LLaMA 驱动的后建模分析，将传统网络欺凌检测由被动分类扩展为主动早期预警与决策支持框架。RoBERTa-base 在性能与敏感类别公平性之间取得了最佳平衡，被推荐为部署首选；DistilBERT 虽具效率优势，但在安全关键场景中存在可靠性风险。该框架在医疗、心理健康、教育、社交平台及职场骚扰监测中具有应用潜力，但作者明确将其定位为辅助决策工具而非临床诊断系统，仍需跨平台、多语种、多模态扩展，以及隐私保护与人工审核机制配合。

title: LexAgentHallu: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Profiling Hallucinations in Legal Agents
summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed as tool-augmented legal agents, they introduce agentic hallucinations where tool-call and reasoning errors cascade into fabricated holdings and miscited authority. However, existing legal benchmarks evaluate only single-turn QA with outcome-level metrics, while agentic hallucination benchmarks lack legal-specific diagnostic capability. Neither answers to what extent and how a legal agent hallucinates along its trajectory. To address these limitations, we introduce LexAgentHallu, a legal agentic hallucination benchmark designed to evaluate to what extent and how legal agents fail along multi-step trajectories. Built through a four-stage expert-in-the-loop pipeline, LexAgentHallu contains 3414 instances across 17 legal categories and 6 task types. Each instance is annotated under a dual-layer hallucination taxonomy of 7 high-level categories and 27 fine-grained subclasses, covering both substantive errors and agent-procedural failures. We further design fine-grained metrics that quantify to what extent and localize how each failure occurs along an agent's execution path. Our evaluation across 18 proprietary and open-source agents uncovers a Right-Answer-Wrong-Reason effect and reveals that hallucination subclasses cluster rather than scatter, forming distinct agentic framework, legal task, and category profiles. These findings, invisible to outcome-level evaluation, validate the diagnostic power of LexAgentHallu for evaluating agentic hallucination in law.

AI.tldr: LexAgentHallu 是首个面向法律 LLM 智能体的幻觉诊断基准，包含 3414 条覆盖 17 个法律类别和 6 类任务的专家标注实例，采用"实体法错误+智能体流程错误"双层分类法（7 个中层类别、27 个细粒度子类），通过细粒度指标对 18 个智能体的多步轨迹进行评估，揭示了"正确答案错误推理"（RAWR）效应以及幻觉子类聚类而非分散的结构性特征。
AI.motivation: 现有法律基准仅评估单轮问答的结果准确性，而通用智能体幻觉基准缺乏法律领域诊断能力，无法回答法律智能体在多步轨迹中"在多大程度上以及如何产生幻觉"。本文旨在填补法律领域智能体轨迹级幻觉评估的空白。
