AI.method: 四阶段专家在环（expert-in-the-loop）数据构建流水线：（1）多源数据采集（LexEval、LawBench、UniLaw-Eval、DISC-LawEval、PLawBench 及法考真题）；（2）任务类型特定的难度过滤（闭卷题多模型 rollout 失败保留、开卷题 LLM-as-a-judge 质量打分）；（3）双轨专家标注与验证（验证已有标注或从零构建 gold 答案）；（4）基于双层幻觉分类法（Substantive Layer：权威/教义/程序法/事实涵摄；Agentic Layer：规划推理/记忆/工具调用）生成 rubric checklist 并人工核验。设计评估指标 HF（幻觉频率）、HD（幻觉密度）、SC/PC（实体/流程清洁度）、RAWR（正确答案错误推理率）和 Lift 共现矩阵。采用 7 个分类法专属 LLM-as-a-judge prompt 对完整轨迹（而非仅最终答案）进行逐项二值判定。
AI.result: 对 18 个专有与开源智能体（含 LRAS 三种规格、LawThinker/Plan-and-Execute/ReAct 三种编排框架搭配 Gemini-3.1-Pro、GPT-5.4、Qwen3.5/3.6 系列）评估后发现：（1）所有智能体均存在广泛幻觉，最佳 HF 仍达 0.890；（2）编排框架显著影响幻觉画像——ReAct 抑制实体层幻觉最佳，LawThinker 抑制流程层最佳，Plan-and-Execute 全面平庸；（3）RAWR-S 在正确答题下仍达 68%，RAWR-P 区间 0.07–0.85，证实结果准确不等于推理忠实；（4）任务类型与法律类别画像差异显著（刑事程序与民法高发，法理/宪法低发）；（5）Lift 矩阵揭示幻觉子类呈结构化聚类而非独立散点，例如法律层级错误与教义立场混淆共现 Lift=7.07。Judges 与人类一致性 86.90%，三专家一致性 95.07%。
AI.conclusion: LexAgentHallu 证明了轨迹级诊断评估的必要性——仅凭结果准确率无法揭示法律智能体的实质错误与流程错误的真实画像。基准所揭示的 RAWR 效应与幻觉聚类结构为提升法律智能体可信度提供了新方向，呼吁从结果评估转向轨迹感知评估。局限在于仅覆盖中国法律体系、模型演进需持续追踪、当前评估限于单智能体场景。

title: Procedural Memory Under Change: Reuse and Interference in Controlled Web Tasks
summary: Procedural memory lets language agents reuse successful routines, but reuse presumes that a stored routine remains applicable. We study what happens when that presumption is deliberately violated. The study combines a retrospective, human-assisted interface-adaptation case from BrowserGym TimeWarp with controlled frozen-memory comparisons on synthetic shopping decisions. During the documented WebShop V1-V6 development path, interface-specific code was adapted while the separately stored high-level procedure was not reported to change; this phase does not constitute an autonomous memory-agent evaluation. In the controlled phase, an early pilot produced one task on which two memory conditions selected a more expensive item while the no-memory condition selected the reference minimum. Follow-up probes did not establish a recurring row-order or identity-binding pattern. We then tested four forms of mismatch: changed quantities, a different evidence representation, a conflict between local and global optimization, and distributed promotion evidence, across 32 formal cells. Each cell used one temperature-0 generation with the same local qwen3:8b configuration and no adaptive retry. Across these pairs, none of the predefined diagnostic interference signatures appeared on the tasks for which they were defined when current-task evidence was explicit and sufficient. The result identifies a tested region of non-interference: a procedural memory can be mismatched without becoming behaviorally disruptive. It does not establish general safety or a mechanism. The remaining question is which additional conditions turn applicability mismatch into observable, memory-caused error.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了当存储的程序化记忆(procedural memory)在任务接口、表示或优化目标发生变化时,语言代理是否会产生行为性干扰。通过结合回顾性案例和受控实验,作者发现:在当前任务证据明确且充分时,记忆与任务的不匹配并未导致预设的干扰行为出现,即存在一个"非干扰"的测试区域。
AI.motivation: 长期运行的智能代理依赖程序化记忆复用成功策略,但存储的程序在新任务中可能不再适用。本文旨在厘清"记忆-任务不匹配"≠"可观察错误"≠"记忆因果错误"的区别,探究何种额外条件会使不匹配的程序化记忆产生可观察的行为干扰。
AI.method: 采用两阶段设计:Phase 1为基于BrowserGym TimeWarp Task 57(WebShop V1-V6)的回顾性人机协作界面适配案例研究;Phase 2为冻结提示词对照实验,包括Pilot 01(9个单元)、Batch 02(18个单元,涉及行序与身份绑定探测)和Batch 03(32个正式单元,4对任务×4种记忆条件),测试数量变化、表示差异、局部vs全局优化冲突、分布式促销证据四种失配形式。所有Batch 03单元使用本地qwen3:8b模型,temperature=0,种子=0,单次生成。
AI.result: 核心结果较为狭窄但明确:在Batch 03四个配对中,当当前任务证据明确充分时,预设的干扰签名(数量遗漏、界面混淆、独立局部最小值忽略折扣、分布式证据组合错误)在32个单元中均未出现。Pair 01/02达到8/8参考兼容,Pair 03全局优化8/8正确,Pair 04全局优化和严格任务正确性均达8/8。早期Pilot中T2任务出现A/C条件选择$36.80而B(无记忆)选择$20.00参考最小值的异常,以及T5_A的身份-价格绑定错误,但后续探测未能复现规律性模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出一个"非干扰"的测试区域:程序化记忆可以在不匹配的情况下不产生行为性破坏。但这并非普遍安全性的证明,也未揭示内部机制。关键变量可能是当前任务证据的可访问性。后续研究应减少当前证据的可访问性同时保持任务客观可解,并引入更长轨迹、多竞争记忆、替代模型等条件,以确定哪些额外条件会使不匹配的程序产生行为干扰。

title: Proof-Carrying Cognition: Closing the Verification Gap with Reality-Settled Reward
summary: Frontier gains in language-model reasoning come from reinforcement learning on reasoning traces and are concentrated in domains with a cheap, sound verifier. We argue the field's binding constraint is the verification gap: no scalable, incorruptible reward for reasoning outside formal domains. We make four contributions. (1) Theory: in a joint-Gaussian model of best-of-N selection, verifier-gold correlation rho is the exact exchange rate between test-time compute and capability, and an unsound verifier pays a polynomial penalty N^(1/rho^2); a margin-free copula form predicts realized soundness of real LLM judges to 4% median error. (2) Demonstration: in program-synthesis testbeds with executable ground truth, including a pre-registered scaled replication, unsound verifiers lose Soundness-under-Pressure as optimization grows (0.94 to 0.32 at N=4096) while a sound verifier improves monotonically; reality-anchored settlement beats a frozen verifier under i.i.d. and adversarial pressure, driving the hacking gap from ~0.27 to ~0; soundness scales log-linearly with settled labels, with on-policy settlement ~10x more label-efficient than random labeling. With real LLM judges and unit-test execution as gold, a weak judge loses soundness under best-of-N (p<0.001), a stronger judge is more robust, and selection alone manufactures +0.53 hacking gaps from honest samples. Under real GRPO training, a frozen reward model traces the full overoptimization curve (executed reward collapses 90%) while the same model refit on a 10% settlement stream preserves 6x the executed reward. (3) Paradigm: proof-carrying cognition, where reasoning steps are typed probabilistic claims priced by a self-built world model trained only on held-out reality and settled by proper scoring rules. (4) Benchmark: we specify Soundness-under-Pressure as the headline metric for a reality-settled reasoning benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"证明承载认知"(Proof-Carrying Cognition, PCC)范式,主张当前大语言模型推理能力提升的核心瓶颈是"验证鸿沟"——在正式领域之外缺乏可扩展且不可腐蚀的奖励信号。论文通过理论证明、最小实验演示、大规模预注册复制以及真实模型实验四个层面,系统论证了基于现实锚定的结算机制能够有效抑制学习验证器在优化压力下的Goodhart崩溃,并显著提升验证器的鲁棒性与能力。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在推理任务上的前沿进展高度依赖于强化学习对思维链的训练,但此类收益集中在具备廉价可靠验证器的领域(数学证明、代码执行等)。在缺乏可执行验证器的开放领域中,人类偏好标注与LLM评判器作为奖励信号存在噪声大、可博弈、深度不足等问题,使得模型只能产出流畅但难以问责的推理。本文将这一根本性约束命名为"验证鸿沟",并论证其为该领域下一阶段能力跃升的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 论文采用"理论+演示+范式+基准"四层结构:(1)理论层面,在联合高斯模型下证明验证器与真值之间的相关系数ρ是测试时计算与能力之间的精确兑换率,不可靠验证器需承受N^(1/ρ²)的多项式计算惩罚;进一步提出基于高斯连接函数的Proposition 2(边际无关兑换率律)。(2)演示层面,在六标记和十标记DSL的程序合成测试平台上,使用可执行黄金验证器,系统验证学习验证器在best-of-N压力下的Goodhart崩溃、现实锚定结算对对抗性攻击的修复作用、结算预算的对数线性扩展规律以及"在策略"(on-policy)结算相对随机标注约10倍的标签效率。(3)范式层面,提出"证明承载认知"(PCC):推理步骤以类型化概率声明的形式发出,由系统自建的世界模型定价,并通过严格恰当的打分规则由现实结算。(4)基准层面,定义Soundness-under-Pressure指标作为以现实结算为核心的推理基准的核心度量。实验涵盖合成测试平台、MBPP/HumanEval真实代码基准,以及在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上使用GRPO的真实策略梯度训练对比。
AI.result: 主要实验结果:(1)理论Proposition 1在20,000次试验的高斯模型中精确成立(偏差<0.011σ),但定量迁移在非高斯情形失败——RichDSL中ρ≈0.50的验证器仅实现≈0.32的相对增益;封闭式罚项N^(1/ρ²)在实用N下高估惩罚达24倍,而精确有限N形式在3.4%内匹配。(2)最小DSL实验中,执行验证器在N=2048时单调升至0.83金奖励,而学习验证器在N=512达到峰值后崩溃至0.10,Snd@N从1.00降至0.13;锚定结算使drift降低26%,金奖励从0.154翻倍至0.306;对抗性攻击下冻结验证器陷入被黑最优点(0.178),而锚定验证器将hacking gap从+0.037反转为-0.101。(3)大规模预注册复制(120-300任务)中:10个预注册假设6项通过、3项失败、1项无效——失败项包括兑换率定量迁移、闭合形式罚项的实用性以及绝对崩溃的领域依赖性;但锚定机制在所有三种对抗策略(含结算感知型)下均将hacking gap从0.26-0.28降至约0。(4)真实LLM评判器(Claude Haiku 4.5/Sonnet 4.6)在MBPP和HumanEval上的best-of-32压力下弱评判器显著失去稳健性(p<10⁻³),强评判器显著更稳健;从诚实样本池中通过选择即可制造+0.527的hacking gap,远超指令性欺骗的-0.209。(5)真实GRPO训练(Qwen2.5-1.5B):冻结奖励模型完整复现过优化曲线(代理奖励升至0.615而执行奖励崩90%至0.063),相同RM在10%结算流上重拟合则保留6倍执行奖励(0.397)且仅为执行上限的14%调用成本;以LLM评判器为标签源的对照组(online-judge)仅恢复至0.288,验证现实作为标签源的关键作用。(6)Brier分解显示12轮结算使可靠性降低40%,分辨率提升98%,反驳"结算激励模糊声明"的质疑。(7)预注册诊断修复:高斯连接函数形式将真实LLM评判器的per-problem Snd@32预测中位误差从Pearson的79.3个百分点降至4.1%。已报告的失败:漂移警报准则R-D在seed 0测试中失败(ρs=0.06 vs 注册阈值0.5);两套注册准则本身统计无效。
AI.conclusion: 本文将"验证鸿沟"确立为大语言模型推理能力下一阶段跃升的根本性约束,给出了不可靠验证所付出多项式计算代价的精确量化,并在最小可执行验证器系统中证明了现实锚定结算的修复机制——抑制Goodhart崩溃、对抗性hack的逆转、稳健性的对数线性扩展、10倍的在策略标签效率,以及声明分辨率的提升而非退化。基于此提出"证明承载认知"(PCC)范式:推理步骤作为类型化概率声明发出,由仅以held-out现实预测为损失的自建世界模型定价,由严格恰当的打分规则结算;并提出以Soundness-under-Pressure为核心的现实结算推理基准RSR-Bench作为该领域最重要的近期投入。论文以诚实报告失败预测为方法论标志——五个可被任何前沿实验室证伪的编号预测已在§9.1中明确陈述,其中漂移警报的首次测试已失败。其根本论断是:范式不是被论证出来的,而是被攀登上来的;该基准使"真实"而非"说服"成为胜出之物。

title: UnitBoost: Managing Compound LLM Systems with a Merge Operator, Not a Model
summary: Compound LLM systems often solve a coordination problem by adding a higher-level LLM. The resulting meta-agent reads workers' outputs, writes the final answer, allocates later calls, and decides when to stop. It is expressive, but it also concentrates three control decisions in an opaque, order-sensitive model call. We ask whether the manager needs to be generative at all. UnitBoost replaces that model with a defined meta-level operator: a task-given unit map turns worker outputs into slot-value proposals, a constrained argmax assembles the output, and the slots left unfilled or unsupported become an explicit residual for the next round. The operator is order-free, records unit provenance, and gives a simple guarantee: without coupling constraints, unit-wise maximization under the same admission score dominates selection of any complete candidate. On three held-out benchmarks, it exceeds the best single candidate chosen with gold labels by 0.060-0.195 absolute task-score points and input-matched generative managers by 0.048-0.076. Replacing only the management step improves six compound-system configurations by 0.013-0.182. Residual-directed rounds raise FanOutQA cell F1 from 0.4778 to 0.5524; matched controls show that the true residual outperforms random targets and ordinary rereading, while a label-free supply signal flags exhaustion after one unproductive round. The same analysis measures three conditions in which no such gain is available (one indivisible unit, unavailable unit identity, and an endpoint that charges for every emitted unit) and quantifies cross-unit coupling as a repair cost. The manager gives up semantic freedom and gains order invariance, unit provenance, and testable failure conditions.

AI.tldr: UnitBoost提出了一种确定性的元级算子来替代复合LLM系统中生成式管理器的高层模型调用，通过基于任务定义单元的受约束argmax操作实现工人输出的合并，具备顺序无关性、来源可追溯性和显式残差分配机制。
AI.motivation: 复合LLM系统通常通过添加更高层的LLM来协调多个工人模型，但这种生成式管理器存在三个核心问题：控制决策集中在不透明、顺序敏感的模型调用中；可能引入无支持内容；对工人顺序产生反应。论文质疑管理器是否必须具备生成能力，旨在用确定的算子替代生成式协调，以获得可审计、可测试的控制机制。
AI.method: UnitBoost定义了任务给定的单元映射U将工人输出y_i转换为槽位-值提议(s,v)，通过评分函数q(s,v)和可行性谓词C执行受约束的argmax操作。算法维护一个持久化的单元表ℋ，每轮查询工人后插入新提议，调用ConstrainedUnitArgmax选择当前最优分配，将未填充、不可行或无有效得分的槽位构成显式残差R_t用于下一轮。停止条件基于新槽位供应率ρ_t阈值τ。理论保证：当C为真时，单元级最大化严格优于任何完整候选的选择。
AI.result: 在QAMPARI、ASQA、FanOutQA三个保留基准测试中，UnitBoost超过金标签选择的最佳候选0.060-0.195绝对分，超过输入匹配的生成式管理器0.048-0.076。替换六种复合系统配置的管理步骤可提升0.013-0.182。残差定向将FanOutQA单元格F1从0.4778提升至0.5524；真残差优于随机目标和普通重读。论文同时测量了三种无法获益的边界条件：单一不可分割单元、单元身份不可用、端点对每个发射单元收费。
AI.conclusion: UnitBoost以可控性换取语义自由度：合并本身无模型调用，工人保留提议与修复的生成能力，但接纳、分配与停止由显式、可审计的代码执行。该方法要求任务提供任务给定或机械可恢复的单元，在知识密集型语言任务中跨检索机制和工人池迁移有效，但跨语料库迁移尚未验证。未来元代理设计的核心问题不是管理器是否应具备生成能力，而是其哪些决策真正需要模型。

title: The Era by Eon Benchmark: A Generated Enterprise Estate with Exact Ground Truth for Benchmarking LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents for enterprise systems of record cannot be evaluated on customer production data, and no existing substitute provides ground truth. We present the Era by Eon Benchmark for evaluating LLM agents that use enterprise tools. The benchmark is built around a complete fictional company. It includes product simulators, company-specific internal databases, benchmark questions, and computed answer keys. Industry, company size, business model, application portfolio, and a seed define each company. One seeded entity graph supplies shared company data to simulators of Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack, Gong, and other products. A questionconditioned generator creates the schemas and records for internal databases. It takes shared entities, keys, and values from the same graph before generating database-specific facts. Both mechanisms therefore describe one consistent enterprise estate. Every expected answer is computed from the final records, so grading is exact. Design and answer-key checks validate the internal databases. A realism scorecard and adversarial detector validate the entity graph. Across 23 generated companies, the mean realism score rose from 61.8 to 97.0, with zero records flagged as synthetic. In the reported simulator-track comparison, nine models answered the same 33 questions three times each. Accuracy estimates ranged from 42.4% to 76.8%, and three of 36 pairwise differences remained supported after correction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Era by Eon Benchmark,一个为评估企业LLM智能体设计的合成企业环境生成框架。它通过种子化的实体图(product simulators共享)和问题条件化的内部数据库生成器,构建出一家完整虚构公司的多系统企业环境,所有答案键由生成数据计算得出,从而实现机械式精确评分。
AI.motivation: 现有企业LLM智能体基准(如τ-bench、CRMArena、TheAgentCompany、WorkArena等)存在三大局限:(1)覆盖系统少(仅1-2个);(2)任务与答案需人工编写;(3)数据真实度仅被声称而非被度量。生产数据不可用,沙箱数据稀疏,无法提供ground truth,导致开发者只能观察智能体行为而无法准确测量精度。
AI.method: 方法包含两条互补的生成机制:(1)种子化实体图生成器:给定行业、规模、商业模式、应用组合与种子,确定性生成共享公司事实(员工、客户、销售活动、支持工单、聊天、文档等),通过66个产品模拟器(Salesforce、Zendesk、Slack、Gong、S3、Google Drive等)以MCP工具投影;(2)问题条件化的内部数据库生成器:语言模型设计schema与种植指令,确定性代码生成记录,从实体图复制共享实体/键/值,仅生成数据库特有事实。验证分两类:内部数据库采用设计遵从度、问题区分度、标签完整性、依赖结构四项检查;实体图采用五维真实度评分卡(marginal/joint/temporal/structural/content)与对抗性检测器。评估采用MCP端点,只读,预算受限(25轮、40次工具调用、每响应8000字符),无prompt工具描述,纯靠模型自行发现。
AI.result: 在23家生成公司上,实体图平均真实度评分从61.8提升至97.0,对抗性检测器标记率从55.2%降至0%(最差公司从48.6提升至92.8)。九款模型在同一33题scenario(每题3次重复,共891次作答)上对比,准确率从42.4%(gpt-5.4-mini)到76.8%(claude-opus-4.8)不等;36对模型两两比较中仅3对通过统计显著性校正(均涉及gpt-5.4-mini)。简单过滤类问题准确率92.6%,多跳3.7%、极值6.2%、时序7.4%、排序11.1%、跨系统39.6%。无任何模型答对工单中位解决时间题。891次运行中561次正确、119次错误、99次错误弃答、106次未完成。
AI.conclusion: 该基准通过端到端合成一家完整虚构公司(多vendor应用+内部数据库+问题+精确答案键),克服了企业LLM智能体评估缺乏ground truth的核心障碍,真实度可度量而非凭直觉。但仍存在局限:仅一份scenario报告(33题)、真实度目标依赖源数据正确性、模板生成文本多样性受限。它标志着企业智能体评估从"手写小数据集"迈向"可重复生成的合成企业资产"。

title: Shifting Relational Paradigms for Affective Computing: Affective Resonance, Vitality Affects, and Vocal Interaction Fields
comment: Accepted at Interspeech 2026 for poster presentation. 5 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables
summary: Affective computing has largely followed an individual-state paradigm, extracting discrete emotion labels or arousal/valence from isolated speakers. We argue this framing is incomplete for interaction. Drawing on affective resonance and vitality-contour accounts, we propose a relational framework in which the primary unit of affective analysis is the interactional field constituted within vocal dynamics. As a proof of concept, we present a preliminary empirical study using continuous self-supervised speech representations to detect directional expressive coupling in multi-party conversation. Coupling is regime-specific, concentrated at sub-second timescales, and collapses under exclusive-speech negative controls, consistent with a relational account of affective dynamics. We introduce design frameworks for Artificial Affective Resonance Intelligence grounded in Affective Resonance Dynamic Ontologies, supported by null-calibrated directional coupling analyses across interaction regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了情感计算中以个体状态为中心的范式，提出以交互场（interactional field）为基本分析单元的关系性框架。基于Mühlhoff的情感共振理论、Stern的生命力情感（vitality affects）和能动主义（enactivism）的参与性意义建构，作者提出了情感共振动态本体（ARDO）和人工情感共振智能（AARI）两个设计概念。通过AMI会议语料库的WavLM连续表示与Granger因果分析，经验证明方向性表达耦合具有交互机制特异性，集中在亚秒级时间尺度，并在排他性语音控制条件下消失。
AI.motivation: 现有情感计算主要采用个体状态范式，从孤立的说话者中提取离散情感标签或唤醒度/效价维度。这种框架将情感视为个体的属性，而非交互的涌现属性，忽略了交互场本身的动态组织。声学趋同（entrainment）研究虽然考察了交互中的特征收敛，但通常将其操作化为说话者轨迹间的特征相似度，而非方向性、交互配置或场级涌现。情感计算缺乏对情感行为如何在关系性维度上随时间展开的稳健模型。
AI.method: 理论框架：综合Mühlhoff的情感共振三公理、Stern的生命力情感与生命力轮廓（时间性、强度、形式三维度）、De Jaegher和Di Paolo的参与性意义建构，提出ARDO和AARI的设计框架。经验方法：使用AMI会议语料库的四说话者近场耳机音频（重采样至16kHz，60秒非重叠窗口），提取WavLM-Base+ 12层transformer的连续隐藏状态（不进行量化或K-means聚类），定义"表达性"（expressiveness）为跨层激活散布统计量；将语音活动检测映射到WavLM特征帧网格；定义三级交互条件——Tier A（重叠语音/共同在场）、Tier B（非重叠单人语音活动池化）、Tier C（按说话者方向分离的非重叠活动）；使用双变量和四说话者条件向量自回归（VAR）模型进行Granger因果检验；通过循环移位零分布校准短序列滞后选择中的规模膨胀问题；使用方向性支持分数（DSS，∈{-1,0,+1}）在窗口级别汇总方向性，经FDR控制。≤1秒为微观尺度，>1秒为宏观尺度。
AI.result: 1) 规模膨胀校正：循环移位零检验证实短序列Granger检验存在显著的规模膨胀（Tier A/micro在p<0.05时膨胀2.4倍，p<0.01时膨胀5.9倍），验证了零校准的必要性。2) 校准后方向性耦合：Tier A微观尺度在校准后q=5%时显示出约+6.6pp（双变量）和+7.4pp（能量控制条件分析）的额外拒绝率，效应具交互机制特异性；Tier B较弱，Tier C接近零基线。3) DSS分布：Tier A微观尺度下非零支持质量最高且方向性胜出近对称；Tier B和Tier C强烈趋向零支持，表明共同在场条件之外的二元耦合较弱或不存在。4) 耦合集中于亚秒级时间尺度，与能量代理不同步（经能量残差化后仍存在），支持多维生命力动力学。5) 严格q=1%时效应衰减但仍具机制特异性。限制：仅AMI语料库；Tier B宏观分析功效不足；Granger仅捕捉线性预测依赖，无法区分收敛与发散耦合；表达性代理不测量效价或离散情感。
AI.conclusion: 情感计算需要从建模个体情感状态转向将交互场作为情感组织的主要场所进行建模。经验证据表明声学耦合是机制调节的、时间局部化的，在互惠取向被移除时消失，符合关系性情感共振而非个体状态趋同。ARDO将交互场而非个体状态形式化为建模对象，AARI则架构性地将响应定位于场内的生命力动力学而非外部观察。声音层被视为表达性回应的场域而非诊断通道。系统应参与共振场而非观察共振场，评估标准为所维持的关系耦合质量而非分类准确率。

title: AgentAudit: An Open, Extensible Framework for Full-Lifecycle Trust Evaluation of AI Agents
summary: Existing evaluation frameworks mostly assess only one part of AI agents, such as task completion (AgentBench) or security robustness (AgentDojo, ASB), rather than the complete pipeline of planning, tool selection, tool execution, memory and reasoning. Failures can occur at any stage, yet existing benchmarks rarely identify their precise source. AgentAudit evaluates the entire execution trace across ten capability, grounding, security and behavioural dimensions, namely instruction integrity, planner, memory, tool selection, tool invocation, tool correctness, alignment, tool faithfulness, security and execution integrity, combined with behavioural classification and failure attribution to pinpoint the exact stage responsible for an observed failure. AgentAudit can evaluate any LLM-based AI agent, since it attaches to the agent instead of replacing it. It reads only the recorded execution trace and does not interfere with how the agent runs, so it places no constraint on the agent's internal implementation. We evaluate five language models (OpenAI GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 5, Sarvam 105B, Llama 3.3 70B and Gemini 2.5 Flash) across nine capability and adversarial tasks. Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5 obtain the highest mean Composite Trust Scores (95.1 and 80.6 out of 100, respectively), while Sarvam 105B, Llama 3.3 70B and Gemini 2.5 Flash trail substantially (57.6, 45.7 and 22.6). All traces were scored by a single fixed judge model, which was itself one of the evaluated models, a limitation discussed in Section VII.E. More importantly, models with similar task-completion behaviour can diverge sharply in trustworthiness, as several non-frontier models are repeatedly classified Unsafe_Compliance on adversarial tasks rather than merely failing them, a distinction that pass/fail benchmarks cannot surface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentAudit，一种不干扰智能体运行的事后审计框架，通过解析执行轨迹，对智能体在规划、记忆、工具选择与调用、行为对齐、工具忠实性、安全性及执行完整性等方面进行细粒度评估，并结合行为分类与失效归因定位具体故障阶段。在五个模型、九类能力与对抗任务上的实验显示，Claude Sonnet 5 的综合可信度最高（95.1/100），GPT-5 次之（80.6/100）；其他模型明显落后。任务完成率相近的模型，其安全行为和可信度仍可能存在显著差异，说明仅用成败难以全面衡量智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评测通常只关注任务完成能力或安全鲁棒性之一，无法覆盖从规划、记忆、工具选择与执行到推理的完整链路，也难以判断失败究竟发生在哪个阶段。论文因此需要一个可附加于任意 LLM 智能体、能基于执行轨迹进行全流程审计，并同时提供行为分类和精确失效归因的评测方法。
AI.method: AgentAudit 以外部审计器形式附加到目标智能体，不替换或干预其内部实现，只读取智能体产生的执行轨迹。其评估框架覆盖十个维度：指令完整性、规划器、记忆、工具选择、工具调用、工具正确性、对齐、工具忠实性、安全性和执行完整性。审计器进一步对行为进行分类，并将观测到的失败映射至具体执行阶段，从而定位故障来源。实验评估了 OpenAI GPT-5、Claude Sonnet 5、Sarvam 105B、Llama 3.3 70B 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash 五个模型，在九项能力任务和对抗任务上的表现，并使用综合可信度分数进行比较。所有轨迹由一个固定且单一的评审模型评分，而该评审模型本身也是被评估模型之一。
AI.result: Claude Sonnet 5 获得最高平均 Composite Trust Score，为 95.1/100；GPT-5 为 80.6/100。Sarvam 105B、Llama 3.3 70B 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash 的得分分别为 57.6、45.7 和 22.6，整体明显落后。多个非前沿模型在对抗任务中反复被归为 Unsafe_Compliance，即不只是一般性地任务失败，还表现出不安全的服从行为。研究还发现，任务完成行为相近的模型，其可信度可能差异很大；这说明传统通过/失败基准无法揭示智能体在安全性和执行可靠性方面的差异。单一固定评审模型既是实验一致性的来源，也构成主要方法学局限。
AI.conclusion: 智能体的可靠性不能仅以任务完成情况衡量。AgentAudit 通过对执行轨迹进行全流程、可定位的多维审计，揭示了模型在工具使用、规划、记忆、忠实性和安全行为上的差异，并能够区分一般失败与 Unsafe_Compliance 等高风险行为。结果支持将细粒度轨迹审计纳入智能体基准测试；但后续研究应解决评审模型自评偏差，并通过多评审模型或人工标注验证评分的一致性与稳健性。

title: Scored vs. Generated Readouts in Behavioral Language Models: An Empirical Study of Elicitation Format
summary: Language models fine-tuned on customer behavior can predict outcomes and generate explanations, but these readouts are often treated as interchangeable. Holding model checkpoint and prompt content fixed, we compare probabilities obtained by scoring answer tokens with predictions generated after a written rationale. Across 13 model-domain cells covering four retail tasks in three markets, including two using fully public data and checkpoints, the scored readout ranks outcomes more accurately in 12 of 13 cells (two-sided sign test, p approximately 0.003), by 1.5 to 14.5 points in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). Paired bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero in every newly measured cell. The gap varies with task-specific supervision and mismatch between training and serving formats, ranging from -2.2 points for an untuned base model to +13.7 for rationale-format supervision. Analysis of approximately 9,000 rationales identifies two correlates: reduced reliance on the dominant predictive feature and convergence on stock formulations. Probability saturation does not track the gap. A third readout, eliciting a probability before any verdict, improves calibration (Brier score from 0.47 to 0.15) while ranking within noise of scoring, but only for outcome rates represented in training; it is worse than scoring when the scored head is already calibrated. We interpret these differences through the objectives matched by each readout, identify training choices that narrow the gap, and propose retaining generated rationales while sourcing ranking from the scored head.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在基于真实客户行为微调的语言模型（行为模拟器）上，"评分式读出"（直接读取YES/NO概率）与"生成式读出"（先写理由再作答）两种调用方式的差异。核心发现：在13个模型-领域单元中，评分式读出在12个单元中排序效果更优（AUC高1.5–14.5分），差距随任务特定监督强度和训练-服务格式不匹配程度而扩大。论文还发现两个相关因素——放弃主导预测特征、模板趋同——以及引入第三种读出方式（先报概率再下结论）的适用边界。最终建议：部署时保留生成式理由用于可解释性，但排序决策应来自评分式读出。
AI.motivation: 业界普遍将行为模拟器的预测能力与解释能力视为可互换，假设让模型先推理再回答至少对预测无害。然而，目标营销系统中错误的排序会无声地错配激励预算，而理由的流畅性无法暴露这种排序退化。论文直接检验这一"可互换性假设"。
AI.method: 控制变量实验设计：固定模型检查点和提示内容，仅改变读出方式。比较三种读出：scored（评分）、generated（生成理由后作答）、verbal-p（先报概率再下结论）。评估域包括四个零售预测任务（SEA杂货优惠券、SEA电商券、品类调整响应、美国杂货促销），五个检查点（基座、多任务SFT、人物SFT、推理SFT、域内SFT）以及一个外部前沿推理API。指标：AUC、Brier分数、Spearman相关、自助置信区间、符号检验。分析约9000条生成理由的每行特征。
AI.result: 主要结果：评分式读出在13个单元中的12个排序更优（双侧符号检验 p≈0.003），AUC差距1.5–14.5分。最大差距出现在推理格式SFT（+9.3至+13.7），最小在域内决策格式SFT（+3.0）。无任务调优基座反而呈反向差距（-2.2）。排序消融显示仅决策位置（推理前/后）就造成-8.7 AUC分。相关性分析：锚点放弃（Spearman从0.72降至0.31）和模板趋同（前三模板占33%）可正确排序各单元差距，但概率饱和不能。第三种读出verbal-p恢复校准（Brier从0.47降至0.15），排序接近评分读出，但仅适用于训练中出现过的结果率，且当评分头已校准时反而损害性能。
AI.conclusion: 可互换性假设不成立。评分式读出对应判别模型的原生二元交叉熵目标，生成式读出将证据路由通过文本瓶颈再读概率，瓶颈丢失或扭曲的信息无法恢复。差距随任务特定监督和训练-服务格式不匹配而增长。对部署的建议：（1）排序信号来源应使用评分式读出；（2）理由生成可保留但应在决策之后；（3）评分头失校时可使用verbal-p读出；（4）优先采用域内决策格式监督；（5）通过锚点相关性和模板占比两个诊断指标评估现有部署的成本。

title: Decision Transformer for UAV-Mounted RIS-Assisted Dynamic D2D Communications
summary: This paper studies unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-mouted reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted device-to-device (D2D) communication with stochastic link activation. It models UAV motion and attitude, time-varying Rician angles, and angle-dependent RIS reflection. A joint optimization of UAV trajectory, attitude, and RIS phases is formulated to maximize average sum rate under mobility, energy, and hardware constraints. The problem is addressed using deep reinforcement learning and a Decision Transformer trained on expert trajectories from multiple scenarios. Results demonstrate effective cross-scenario generalization, with zero-shot transfer outperforming direct DRL transfer and online fine-tuning achieving competitive performance with fewer interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对UAV搭载RIS辅助的动态D2D通信系统，提出了一种基于Decision Transformer (DT) 的联合优化框架，用于联合优化UAV轨迹、三维姿态和RIS相移，以最大化平均和速率。该方法通过DDPG专家生成多场景离线轨迹数据进行DT预训练，并在新场景中实现零样本部署和高效在线微调，展现出优于直接DRL迁移的跨场景泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统固定部署的RIS灵活性差，难以应对动态通信环境中的链路阻塞；现有UAV-mounted RIS研究要么忽略三维姿态，要么使用过于简化的ULA模型，未考虑UAV姿态、时变Rician信道与入射角相关反射特性之间的耦合；此外，传统DRL策略对环境变化鲁棒性差，在未见过的场景中性能下降且需要大量在线交互进行适配。
AI.method: 1) 系统建模：构建UAV运动模型（位置、速度、加速度）、三维姿态模型（yaw/pitch/roll旋转矩阵）、时变Rician信道模型（基于UPA阵列响应）、入射角相关的RIS反射系数模型；2) 问题建模：联合优化UAV轨迹、三维姿态和RIS预设反射系数，最大化平均和速率，受移动性、能量、硬件等多重约束；3) 解决方案：a) 比较PPO、DDPG、SAC、TD3四种DRL算法，选择DDPG作为专家策略；b) 在8个不同初始位置场景中训练DDPG专家生成离线轨迹数据集；c) 在多场景专家轨迹上预训练Decision Transformer，通过序列建模预测动作；d) 在新场景中实现零样本部署，并基于精英轨迹选择（Top-K）进行在线微调。
AI.result: 1) DRL算法比较：DDPG性能最优（≈29.5 bps/Hz），显著优于PPO（25.0）、TD3（20.5）和SAC（17.0 bps/Hz）；2) 在两个未见场景（初始位置[15,15,4.5]和[25,25,4.5]）中：微调后的DT性能接近场景特定的DDPG专家水平；零样本DT性能优于直接从相邻场景迁移的DDPG策略，但存在较大波动；3) DT通过多场景离线训练获得了有效的跨场景决策能力，在线微调仅需80条候选轨迹中的Top-50即可达到专家级性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将Decision Transformer应用于UAV-mounted RIS辅助D2D通信系统的联合优化问题，证明了基于专家数据的序列建模方法在UAV-RIS控制中具有出色的泛化能力和样本效率。零样本DT优于直接DRL迁移，微调DT以更少的交互次数达到与场景特定DRL专家相当的性能，为动态通信环境中的可泛化高效控制提供了新思路。

title: Grounded Evaluation and Repair for NL-to-PDDL Problem Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for translating Natural Language (NL) planning descriptions into PDDL problem instances. However, standard evaluation criteria such as syntactic validity or planner success can substantially overestimate faithfulness to the described task: a generated problem may be parseable and solvable while misrepresenting the intended initial state, goal, object structure, or optimization target. This paper studies an end-to-end NL-to-PDDL pipeline that combines LLM generation, checks in terms of PDDL parsing, planning and validation, a domain-conformance checker, an LLM critic, and iterative repair. Fine-grained repair feedback is constructed from the domain description, the generated problem, the natural language problem description, and operational diagnostics. Reference-based comparisons against curated benchmark PDDL problem descriptions are used for post-hoc benchmark analysis, and these offline checks include renaming-invariant structural matching and semantic equivalence, where domain support is available. Across Planetarium, AutoPlanBench, and curated PDDL~2.1 problems, results show that operational success and benchmark-reference reconstruction can diverge substantially. Results also show that structured repair can be useful, and that PDDL~2.1 remains challenging for reference reconstruction, even when operational success improves.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种端到端的自然语言到PDDL问题生成的流水线，集成LLM生成、解析检查、规划验证、领域一致性检查和LLM批评家反馈驱动的迭代修复。研究表明，传统的语法有效性或规划器成功率等评估指标可能高估生成问题与原始任务的忠实性，操作性成功与基准参考重建之间存在明显差距，尤其在PDDL 2.1的时序和数值扩展中。
AI.motivation: 现有NL-to-PDDL生成工作的评估通常仅依赖语法可解析性或规划器求解成功，这可能严重高估生成问题实例对原始自然语言任务描述的忠实性——一个生成的问题可能可解析且可求解，却错误地表达了初始状态、目标、对象结构或优化目标。因此，亟需更严格的、面向部署的评估协议与反馈驱动的修复机制，以在操作性接受度与基准参考重建之间进行区分。
AI.method: 论文提出了一个统一的generate-and-repair流水线，包含：(1) 初始生成阶段，使用LLM（gpt-4.1-mini为主，附加gpt-5.5和opus-4.7）从NL描述和PDDL域文件生成problem.pddl，可选加入同域少样本示例；(2) 在线操作性评估，包含解析、域一致性检查、规划（Fast Downward/TFD/ENHSP）、VAL验证和LLM批评家五项联合标准；(3) 离线基准分析，包括重命名不变结构匹配和语义等价（仅Planetarium支持的领域）；(4) 迭代修复循环，使用粗粒度和细粒度反馈（来自检查器诊断、规划器/验证器结果和批评家输出），最多三次尝试。实验在Planetarium、AutoPlanBench经典域以及六个IPC 2002衍生的PDDL 2.1域上进行。
AI.result: 关键实验结果表明：(1) 操作性成功与基准参考重建显著背离——例如Planetarium+FS的运行中，操作性接受率为0.583，但语义和结构参考匹配率仅0.417；(2) 少样本提示效果不均匀，对Planetarium、不支持语义的APB和PDDL 2.1有改善，但支持的APB反而略有下降；(3) 迭代修复对操作性指标提升更明显，对结构重建提升有限；(4) PDDL 2.1中操作性成功率可达0.733（+FS），但结构精确匹配率仅0.067，存在大量操作性通过但结构不匹配的情况；(5) 批评家人工审计显示其与人工忠实性判断一致性仅13/24，存在假阳性和假阴性；(6) 强模型（gpt-5.5、opus-4.7）经典域近乎饱和，但PDDL 2.1的结构重建差距仍然显著。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论认为NL-to-PDDL生成不能仅依赖可解析性或规划器成功率来评估。所提出的操作性接受标准（解析+域一致性+规划+VAL+批评家）比单纯规划成功更严格，但仍不等同于任务忠实性，应作为在线停止条件使用；而语义等价和结构匹配应作为离线基准分析信号。少样本提示和迭代修复有价值但非万能，修复机制可在操作性维度奏效，却难以恢复基准的精确编码。PDDL 2.1（时序与数值构造）的基准重建仍是开放难题，需要更强的批评家、反馈机制以及面向指标敏感性的诊断。总体上，NL-to-PDDL生成的进步不仅需要更强的生成器，也需要更强的批评家、更严格的基准分析与跨场景的修复机制。

title: Time-Frequency Geometric Cross-Attention for Chunked Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Modern vision-language-action (VLA) policies predict a whole chunk of actions: one to two seconds of coordinated motion emitted in a single forward pass. Yet an action chunk is essentially a short multivariate trajectory, but inside these models it is a sequence of generic per-timestep hidden tokens decoded by a linear head. This under-serves two motion structures. First, frequency: a chunk superimposes a smooth global trend and fine corrective motion across time scales, and a single token entangles them. Second, cross-phase geometry: motions of different phases (reach, contact, grasp adjustment, settling) unfold along very different, near-orthogonal directions in representation space, yet are tightly related for the task and arise across the time axis. Dot-product attention scores alignment by an inner product, so it favors aligned tokens and is least sensitive near orthogonality, leaving such relationships for the network to recover through a detour. We introduce Time-Frequency Geometric Cross-Attention (TFGCA), a drop-in module repairing both blind spots. TFGCA uses a per-dimension learnable stationary wavelet transform to decompose the action chunk into time-frequency tokens, and each time token retrieves information from them via a cross-attention that fuses the dot product (similarity) with the wedge-product magnitude (sensitive to near-orthogonality) through a learnable weight. A zero-initialized residual reproduces the base behavior at initialization, so it can be dropped onto a pretrained VLA and fine-tuned jointly. Relative to the same-source base, TFGCA improves in-distribution LIBERO by +1.5 on average, the OOD LIBERO-Plus by +6.3, the randomized average under RoboTwin domain randomization by +28.5, and the overall success rate on three real-robot AgiBot A2 tasks by +11.67 points, with larger gains out of distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TFGCA（时间-频率几何交叉注意力），即插即用模块修复块状视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中点积注意力遗漏的两个运动结构：多尺度频率内容和跨阶段近正交关系。该模块通过逐维可学习平稳小波变换进行分词，并将点积相似性与楔积大小（对正交性敏感）以可学习权重融合，在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin及真实AgiBot A2机器人上均取得显著提升，OOD增益尤为突出。
AI.motivation: 块状VLA策略将动作块视为通用隐藏令牌序列解码，忽略了两个关键运动结构：(1) 频率结构——动作块叠加了跨时间尺度的全局趋势与精细修正运动；(2) 跨阶段几何关系——抓取、接触、调整、沉降等阶段沿表征空间中近乎正交的方向展开。作者在RoboTwin数据中发现"时序正交分工"(TO-DoL)现象，但点积注意力对正交方向最不敏感，必须通过迂回方式重新编码此类关系。
AI.method: TFGCA包含三个阶段：(1) 动作空间投影将隐藏令牌映射到逐维控制空间，并施加辅助对齐损失；(2) 逐维可学习平稳小波变换(SWT, db2初始化)分解为保持长度对齐的多频段令牌，联合编码多维动作内容；(3) 时间令牌查询、频率令牌作键值的交叉注意力，分别计算点积与楔积分数，各自softmax后以可学习权重β混合。输出投影W_O零初始化以保持恒等映射，使模块可安全附加到预训练VLA并联合微调。理论分析（命题1）证明楔积通道可实现点积无法实现的排序。
AI.result: 相对同源π₀.₅基线：LIBERO近饱和分布内平均+1.5%(98.2% vs 96.7%)；LIBERO-Plus OOD七类扰动Total +6.3%(73.0% vs 66.7%)，其中Noise+13.9、Camera+9.4、Robot+10.5；RoboTwin 2.0清洁环境+3.7、随机化(零样本)+28.5(42.7% vs 14.2%)；AgiBot A2真实机器人三任务整体+11.67个百分点(61.67% vs 50.00%)。OOD场景增益尤为显著，组件消融验证SWT、楔积通道、对齐损失三者均为必需。仅新增约4.23M参数(≈0.10%骨干)。
AI.conclusion: TFGCA作为轻量级即插即用模块，有效修复了块状VLA策略对动作轨迹多尺度频率内容与跨阶段近正交关系的表征缺失，通过小波分词与楔积-点积混合注意力在多个基准上提升性能，尤其在域外泛化场景中增益显著。局限性包括：短块(T=10)下频率叙事较弱；Q/K路由机制仅作为激励假说而非因果证明；尚需未来工作验证TO-DoL与楔积通道的因果关联。

title: Structural Process Supervision for Latent Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Latent reasoning approaches enhance token-level efficiency and robustness by replacing verbose, explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens with compact continuous-space embeddings. However, existing methods lack direct process supervision over these latent embeddings, which often leads to representation collapse and uneven information distribution. To address this, we propose Prototype-Mediated Process Supervision (PMPS), which introduces learnable reasoning prototypes as semantic anchors to provide structural process-level supervision for latent reasoning. PMPS projects latent embeddings and explicit CoT embeddings into a shared prototype space, achieving many-to-many soft alignment between unequal-length representations through prototype assignment. Meanwhile, we introduce a Progressive Sequential Alignment (PSA) module to further guide training: positional priors initially encourage sequential alignment structure, then gradually relax to permit adaptive matching. Experimental results show that PMPS compresses output token length to under 50% of explicit CoT on GSM8K-Aug. Compared to leading baseline SIM-CoT, our method achieves average accuracy gains of 2.08% across different model families. On GPT-2, PMPS even surpasses CoT-SFT. On larger models and a more challenging task, PMPS consistently attains the highest accuracy among all latent reasoning methods with comparable output length.

AI.tldr: 提出PMPS（Prototype-Mediated Process Supervision）框架，通过可学习的推理原型作为语义锚点，为潜在链式思维推理提供结构化过程级监督，解决现有潜在推理方法中表征坍塌和信息分布不均的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在推理方法缺乏对潜在嵌入的直接过程级监督，导致表征坍塌（如奇偶坍塌、尾部坍塌）和信息分布不均，限制了模型性能。
AI.method: 1. 提出PMPS框架：引入K个可学习原型作为共享语义锚点，将潜在嵌入和显式CoT嵌入投影到统一原型空间，通过Sinkhorn-Knopp算法实现软分配，建立不等长表示间的多对多对齐；2. 设计双向交叉预测损失（ℒ_c2l和ℒ_l2c）强制每个潜在嵌入捕获差异化推理语义；3. 引入渐进式序列对齐（PSA）模块，通过高斯位置先验和余弦退火策略，在训练初期鼓励序列对齐结构，后期逐步放宽约束以允许自适应匹配。
AI.result: 在GSM8K-Aug上将输出token长度压缩至显式CoT的50%以下；在GPT-2上平均准确率比SIM-CoT基线提升2.08%，甚至超过CoT-SFT；有效消除了CODI中的奇偶坍塌和SIM-CoT中的尾部坍塌现象；在更大模型（Llama-3.2-3B）和更具挑战性的MATH任务上同样取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: PMPS是一种新颖的潜在推理训练范式，通过结构化过程级监督在多种模型系列、规模和任务难度上一致达到潜在推理方法的SOTA性能，同时将输出token长度减少超过50%，具有强大的泛化性、鲁棒性和可扩展性。

title: Belief-State Engine: Augmenting LLMs for Principled Planning Under Partial Observability
comment: Total number of pages: 19, total number of figures: 5
summary: Large language model agents produce fluent action sequences across a wide range of tasks, yet they fail in characteristic ways once the environment becomes partially observable. Ambiguous feedback pushes them into premature commitments. A single informative observation can collapse their uncertainty onto the wrong hypothesis. Policies drift as the history grows. We trace these symptoms to a common structural cause. An LLM agent, as commonly deployed, is a history-conditioned policy with no explicit belief over hidden state. We propose an architectural fix. The Belief-State Engine (BSE) is an inference module placed outside the LLM. It maintains a Bayesian posterior over the latent states of a given POMDP (Partially Observable Markov Decision Process) model, and at each decision step it exposes only that posterior to the LLM. The raw action-observation log is not shown. We set out a minimal four-axiom specification of what a belief-consistent internal state must satisfy, and prove that the LLM paired with the BSE is a sound Markov policy on the belief MDP induced by the underlying POMDP. It therefore inherits the Bellman optimality guarantees of classical POMDP theory, provided the LLM is never exposed to the raw history. We evaluate the architecture on the Tiger POMDP and a red-team attack-graph task, against six baselines: a reactive LLM, Chain-of-Thought, ReAct, a natural-language belief tracker, QMDP, and POMCP. Across both domains, the BSE-augmented agent improves task return, belief calibration, and decision consistency. Ten targeted ablations isolate the contribution of each architectural choice confirms that the effect is not specific to any one model. Code, environment specifications, prompt templates, and seed logs accompany this paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信念状态引擎（BSE），一种置于LLM外部的推理模块，通过维护POMDP上的贝叶斯后验并仅将后验暴露给LLM，使LLM智能体在部分可观测环境下获得经典POMDP的Bellman最优性保证。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体普遍采用历史条件化文本策略，缺乏对隐状态的显式信念表征，导致在部分可观测环境下出现过早承诺、观测坍缩和策略漂移等结构性失败。根本原因在于文本累积不等于信念维护，原始历史的序列化对语义等价的重写不具有不变性，LLM策略因此并非信念可测。
AI.method: 1）提出四条独立公理（A1递归可更新性、A2预测充分性、A3概率内化、A4信念可测策略）刻画信念一致性内部状态的形式要求；2）证明规范后验β是满足结构性公理的最粗糙表示，贝叶斯滤波器是在可达子单纯形上的唯一更新算子（定理1-4）；3）建立策略不变性与信念MDP价值等价性（定理5-6），证明POMDP互模拟下歧义保持性（定理7）；4）证明LLM与BSE的组合是信念MDP上的可靠Markov策略（定理9）；5）算法1实现完整两步贝叶斯滤波器（预测步+观测修正步），采用对数空间数值稳定实现；6）架构上BSE外置于LLM，通过序列化器σ将后验Δ(S)映射为结构化prompt，解析器ψ提取动作，原始动作-观测日志永不进入LLM提示。
AI.result: 在Tiger POMDP（N=40配对种子）上BSE达到95%成功率（38/40），平均折扣回报3.06，显著优于Reactive和NL-Tracker的80%成功率和-12.00回报；BSE平均执行1.45次listen动作以积累证据后再行动。消融实验中AB2（去观测修正）出现教科书式开环失败（23/25回合超时仍listen，熵固定为ln2）。在K=6攻击图上（N=40）任务回报差异统计上不显著，但BSE在网络覆盖度（42.1% vs 32.5%）和决策一致性（JSD中位数0 vs NL-Tracker的0.043）上明显优于基线。AB1（去预测步）在攻击图上几乎无影响，因参考环境的转移核为单位阵，导致该消融无法验证其预测效应。
AI.conclusion: BSE通过将信念维护职责从LLM转移至外部贝叶斯滤波器，结构性消除了历史条件化LLM智能体的三类病理失败。理论层面，LLM-BSE组合继承经典信念MDP的Bellman最优性保证，前提是LLM不被暴露于原始历史。实证层面，Tiger POMDP上的清晰分离验证了概率性信念表示相对于无信念或非概率信念的关键作用；攻击图上的统计不显著性和部分消融的失效反映了参考环境的未实现占位符与有限的实验预算（N=40而非300×3）。未来工作应朝向粒子滤波与变分近似的量化误差理论，以及多智能体交互式POMDP扩展。

title: OntologyAligner: Ontology-Aligned Retrieval and Hierarchy-Guided Large Language Model Reranking for Biomedical Ontology Normalization
summary: Biomedical ontology normalization maps free-text expressions to standardized concepts, enabling consistent integration and analysis of biomedical data. This task remains challenging because lexical variation and subtle distinctions among hierarchically related concepts can obscure concept boundaries. We present OntologyAligner, a three-stage framework that combines ontology-aligned retrieval, large language model candidate reranking, and selective hierarchy-guided refinement. We also construct PhenoNormBench, a unified benchmark comprising 13,390 samples from seven Human Phenotype Ontology datasets. OntologyAligner achieved state-of-the-art performance on HPO normalization, with 88.78% Macro Top-1 Accuracy and 86.75% Micro Top-1 Accuracy, exceeding the strongest baseline by 4.85 and 5.07 percentage points, respectively. Ablation analyses showed complementary contributions from all three stages, and sensitivity analyses demonstrated stability across candidate-set sizes and model backbones. Applications to MONDO, MEDIC, and NCBITaxon further established portability to other ontologies. OntologyAligner offers a generalizable framework for accurate mapping of biomedical text to structured ontology concepts. PhenoNormBench and the code are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出OntologyAligner框架，用于生物医学本体规范化（将自由文本映射到标准化本体概念），并在HPO及其他本体任务上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 生物医学本体规范化因词汇差异和层次相关概念间的细微区别而具有挑战性，现有方法难以准确划定概念边界，需要更有效的统一解决方案。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：1) 本体对齐检索（ontology-aligned retrieval）；2) 大语言模型候选重排序（LLM reranking）；3) 选择性层次引导精炼（selective hierarchy-guided refinement）。同时构建统一基准PhenoNormBench（13,390样本，源自7个HPO数据集）。
AI.result: 在HPO规范化任务上达到SOTA：Macro Top-1准确率88.78%，Micro Top-1准确率86.75%，较最强基线分别提升4.85和5.05个百分点；消融实验验证三阶段互补贡献；灵敏度分析显示对候选集大小和模型骨干稳定；在MONDO、MEDIC、NCBITaxon上也验证了可移植性。
AI.conclusion: OntologyAligner提供了一个可泛化的框架，可准确地将生物医学文本映射到结构化本体概念，PhenoNormBench和代码已开源。

title: Reference-Based Bias Detection in LLMs via Relative Representations of Hidden States
summary: Existing bias auditing methods typically rely on model outputs, requiring costly benchmarks or judge models and potentially missing internal shifts that never appear in generated text. We propose a reference-based method that audits bias in hidden-state representations across related model variants, for example before and after fine-tuning. Because fine-tuning reshapes representation geometry, absolute hidden states are not directly comparable, so we encode each sentence by its similarities to a fixed set of anchor sentences, yielding relative representations in a shared comparison space. There we measure how target groups shift in their association with positive and negative attributes, a quantity we call the Representational Bias Shift $\Delta B$. Across three model families and the WildGuardMix, DecodingTrust and ToxiGen benchmarks, $\Delta B$ correlates with output-level bias change in 15 of the 18 settings we test, reaching $|r| = 0.84$ ($p < 0.001$) under full fine-tuning and becoming more model-dependent under parameter-efficient adaptation. Thresholding $\Delta B$ detects checkpoints whose bias increased with ROC AUC between $0.65$ and $0.99$, and on WildGuardMix and DecodingTrust it separates them better than a SEAT-based baseline for all three families. $\Delta B$ is also stable under changes to the anchor set, attribute sets and target templates. Our method requires no task-specific evaluation data and audits a model in about three minutes, using $3$-$50\times$ less compute than the output-level benchmarks considered here. We view it as complementary to output-based auditing rather than a replacement for it.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于参考模型与相对表示的LLM隐藏层偏见审计方法 ΔB，通过锚句相似度构建共享比较空间，避免跨模型微调后几何不对齐问题；ΔB 与三个外部偏见基准在18组设置中15组显著相关（|r|最高0.84），并以3–50×更低计算成本实现。
AI.motivation: 现有偏见审计依赖模型输出（成本高、标注依赖、可能遗漏未显化在生成中的内部偏移），且微调后绝对隐藏状态不可直接比较。需要一种轻量、不需任务专属评测数据的隐藏层偏见漂移检测方法，用于审计微调副作用与跨版本漂移。
AI.method: 1) 将句子编码为其与固定锚句集合的余弦相似度向量（相对表示），将审计模型与参考模型投影至同一比较空间；2) 在该空间中用欧氏距离衡量目标句与正/负属性句集合的关联强度 B_rel；3) 定义 Representational Bias Shift ΔB = B_aud − B_ref；4) 在Mistral/Llama/Gemma 三族模型上对WildGuardMix、DecodingTrust、ToxiGen 三个外部偏见基准做对照验证，通过安全/有害检查点线性插值构造7级偏见光谱。
AI.result: 全微调下ΔB与外部偏变化的Pearson相关在18组设置中15组显著，最高|r|=0.84（DecodingTrust上Llama，p<0.001）；阈值化ΔB检测偏见增强检查点ROC AUC介于0.65–0.99；在WildGuardMix与DecodingTrust上ΔB全面优于SEAT基线。相对表示（RR）优于Procrustes-SEAT（接近随机）和CKA漂移。对锚句来源、属性句措辞、目标模板、池化策略及训练随机种子均稳健。LoRA下信号减弱且模型依赖更强，Gemma-3-4B最弱。计算成本约3分钟/模型，比WildGuardMix快约3–5×，比ToxiGen/DecodingTrust快约15–50×。
AI.conclusion: 相对表示为审计相关模型变体（共享锚句集、隐藏空间未对齐）提供了可用的比较空间；ΔB 是输出级偏见审计的互补手段而非替代品，可作为微调监控或早期停止信号。其有效性依赖有意义的参考模型，在参数高效适配下尤其对Gemma较弱，且仅报告相对漂移而非"无偏"认证。

title: RAP: Research Attention Prediction Reveals Target-Conditioned Evidence Acquisition Biases
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as research agents, yet their ability to track shifts in research attention is difficult to evaluate because reviews and research ideas lack uniquely verifiable outcomes. We introduce Research Attention Prediction (RAP), a rolling benchmark covering 278 AI/ML fields and 1,390 episodes. At each cut-off, an LLM agent searches a temporally restricted arXiv corpus and predicts the next six months' paper shares across eight frozen research directions. Search generally helps, but all four diagnostic models perform worse than an exact-count exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) baseline in compositional accuracy. We identify two linked bottlenecks. Under cumulative-history access, State carry-forward outperforms direct Forecast for all four diagnostic models; frozen-evidence replay links a shared component of this reversal to Forecast-oriented policies retrieving a smaller share of recent evidence. Even with exact historical activity, future-specific updating remains limited, with only GPT-5.5 plus reopened Search slightly surpassing EWMA. Fine-tuning on realised outcomes improves Qwen3-4B's forecast Spearman correlation by 0.105 on held-out fields at later origins, with gains also on change-rich episodes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出研究注意力预测(RAP)基准,评估LLM智能体预测研究活动分布的能力。覆盖278个AI/ML领域、1390个episode,使用7个LLM智能体在受时间限制的arXiv语料上进行检索与预测。核心发现:所有诊断模型的组合预测精度均低于简单的EWMA基线;累积历史访问下,State carry-forward优于直接Forecast;Forecast目标会使检索偏向远离近期证据;GPT-5.5配合Search仅勉强超越EWMA;在Qwen3-4B上进行结果监督微调可获得+0.105的Spearman提升,但未能修复根本的证据获取偏差。
AI.motivation: LLM日益作为研究智能体协助科学工作流,但其跟踪研究注意力随时间演变的能力难以评估,因为综述和研究想法缺乏唯一可验证的结果。现有评估要么回顾性评估已发表工作(无法保证定量准确性),要么预测个别论文/发现(缺乏对同一字段内联合归一化活动分布的重复智能体预测)。需要一种滚动、以结果为依据的分布预测基准来评估LLM智能体预测未来研究活动的能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建RAP基准:278个AI/ML领域(从356,357篇arXiv论文中提取),5个半年度滚动起点(2024-01至2026-01),1390个episode;2) 每个字段冻结8个研究方向代码簿,使用首次提交日期定义历史证据和未来结果;3) 5个评估条件(A0无搜索/A1固定窗口/A2固定状态/A3累积历史/A4累积状态),配对的State-Forecast对照分离证据获取与读出;4) 冻结证据重放:在字节相同的证据上重新执行不同读出,定位获取vs读出贡献;5) Search选项反事实:对86,284条记录查询重新执行,分离查询文本与时间范围选项;6) 精确历史干预:提供精确的预T方向分布以绕过自然获取;7) Full-SFT:Qwen3-4B在45个训练字段的90条轨迹上进行全参数监督微调。
AI.result: 1) 所有7个诊断模型的自然条件均低于EWMA基线(0.803 Spearman);2) 累积历史访问下,State carry-forward在4个诊断模型上均优于直接Forecast,差距从+0.035到+0.082;3) Forecast策略将检索证据分配给近期6个月窗口的比例为47-80%,而State策略为100%;4) 冻结证据重放显示获取贡献占主导(+0.020到+0.061),读出贡献较小;5) 精确历史干预下,仅GPT-5.5+Search略超EWMA(+0.012),其余模型未能可靠超越;6) Full-SFT使Qwen3-4B在Test字段后期起点的Spearman提升+0.105,变化丰富子集提升+0.159,但残差方向对齐和6个月修订对齐增益仍未解决。
AI.conclusion: RAP将研究助手的前瞻性组件转化为密集、滚动、可追溯验证的预测问题。当前智能体能利用检索改进预测的活动水平,但无法将这些证据可靠地转化为校准的偏离持续性的更新。在累积文献访问下,前瞻性目标会改变智能体的检索行为:Forecast目标在给出最终答案前重定向证据获取,牺牲有用的近期状态证据。精确历史干预表明这并非绝对无法预测(GPT-5.5表现出部分条件性更新)。RAP不将arXiv提交份额等同于科学判断;它为分别测试证据获取、当前重建和未来特定更新提供了工具。

title: Agent-Based ML-LLM Fusion with Self-Optimizing Prompts for Plateau Weather Alerts
summary: To address insufficient contextualization, weak generalization, and poor scenario adaptation in tourism meteorological services, we propose SmartWeatherAgent--a unified three-stage architecture integrating intent recognition, hazard prediction, and reasoning-enhanced generation. The system fuses rule-based methods with large language models to parse queries at multiple granularities and employs a LightGBM model enriched with highland-specific features (e.g., wind speed abruptness rate), achieving an F1-Macro score of 0.605 with 1.60 ms latency on high-wind, precipitation, and low-temperature events. A 12-round micro-step prompt self-optimization loop boosts the composite warning quality score S_final from 4.2 (B01) to 8.9 (B12, +112%). Key improvements include a sharp rise in B08 from data source citation (6.5 -> 8.5), sustained high performance in B10 via physical mechanism explanation, and a peak scientific rigor score of 9.2 in B12 through explicit uncertainty statements. The system autonomously generates structured warnings that integrate causal mechanisms, spatiotemporal evolution, quantitative evidence, regulatory references, and confidence statements--enhancing professional depth, logical rigor, and scientific soundness, and advancing meteorological services toward proactive perception, explainable decision-making, and intelligent agency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SmartWeatherAgent，一个面向高原旅游气象服务的端到端智能预警框架。其核心是融合规则方法与LLM（Qwen3）的三级架构（意图识别+灾害预测+推理增强生成），并引入12轮微步提示自优化循环，使最终预警质量评分提升112%（4.2→8.9），同时LightGBM模型在毫秒级延迟（1.60ms）内达到F1-Macro 0.605。
AI.motivation: 高原旅游气象服务存在动态性强、空间异质性高、场景依赖度大等特点，现有静态规则系统和通用大模型存在上下文感知弱、泛化能力差、缺乏自进化机制等问题，无法满足游客个性化决策需求。
AI.method: 1. 意图识别模块：正则表达式+Qwen3 LLM融合，分类六类查询意图；2. 灾害预测模块：基于LightGBM，融合高原特征（风速突变率、阵风比、降水爆发指标、循环时间编码等38维特征），在拉萨2024-2025历史数据（12168条）上训练；3. 提示自优化模块：12×5轮"生成-评估-优化"闭环，采用三阶段分层约束（核心要素→量化指标→机理解释），通过S_final=0.35·S_semantic+0.30·S_logical+0.35·S_scientific加权评分驱动优化。
AI.result: 1. LightGBM综合评分S=0.55，F1-Macro=0.61（摘要称0.605），准确率97%，延迟1.60ms，优于GB/CB/XGB/RF；2. 提示优化使S_final从4.2(B01)提升至8.9(B12，+112%)，B08数据溯源使分数从6.5→8.5，B10物理机理解释维持高水平，B12不确定性表述达9.2；3. 输出集成因果机理、时空演化、定量证据、监管引用和置信声明，标准差<0.5表明稳定可复现。
AI.conclusion: SmartWeatherAgent通过ML-LLM融合架构和闭环提示自优化，在高原旅游气象预警中实现了专业化、结构化和标准化的预警生成。但存在三大局限：仅基于拉萨数据（地理泛化受限）、提示进化受预定义维度约束（缺乏开放感知能力）、未集成实时气象数据流（真实场景鲁棒性待验证）。未来工作将集成实时数据、多模态交互和元提示自反思优化器。

title: Kernel-Managed Shared Memory for System-Wide Personalization
summary: AI systems become more useful when they can adapt to the people using them, but in multi-agent systems, useful context learned by one agent often remains unavailable to others. We present kernel-managed shared memory, a system-level abstraction in which specialized agents write structured, tagged memories while the agent-system kernel, not individual agents, governs retrieval, privacy enforcement, and prompt injection. We implement and evaluate this design on AIOS and compare it against three alternatives across three assistant models (GPT-4o, Llama-3.1:8B, Qwen-2.5:7B) and 1,800 total trials. Against an unmanaged external memory backend (Mem0) using identical underlying storage, kernel-managed retrieval and injection improve personalization scores by 2.4-4.0 points on a 5-point scale (e.g., 1.05 to 4.69 profile usage on GPT-4o), with every comparison significant at p < 10^-18. Against standard retrieval-augmented injection, gains are similarly large and consistent across all three models. Against full, unfiltered context concatenation, a soft ceiling on available context rather than on response quality, kernel-managed injection statistically matches performance on two of three models and shows a small, model-specific deficit on the third, while using substantially shorter prompts: end-to-end latency is 15-61% lower across all three models, with corresponding reductions in per-call token usage and inference cost. These results indicate that centralizing memory management in the agent-system kernel, rather than leaving retrieval and privacy enforcement to individual agents, delivers most of the personalization benefit of unconstrained context at a fraction of its cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"内核管理的共享记忆"(kernel-managed shared memory)抽象，在多智能体LLM系统中将记忆的检索、隐私强制和提示注入集中到agent-system kernel而非各智能体内部，基于AIOS实现并在3个模型(GPT-4o、Llama-3.1:8B、Qwen-2.5:7B)上完成1800次试验对比。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体系统中，一个智能体学到的用户上下文常常无法被其他智能体复用，且传统"智能体自管记忆"的设计存在逻辑重复、隐私保护薄弱、缺乏写入排序保证等问题；需要一个系统级抽象来统一管理跨智能体的个性化记忆。
AI.method: 设计"内核管理的共享记忆"系统级抽象：(1) ProfileAgent/TaskAgent写入带结构化元数据(owner_agent、user_id、memory_type、sharing_policy)的记忆，AssistantAgent不做检索；(2) 内核通过五步操作(写前读排序→检索→可见性过滤→排序截断→注入)完成个性化；(3) 通过基于owner/sharing policy的可见性规则实现静态隐私不变量(Eq.2)；(4) 通过per-user_id序列号写入屏障实现读后写一致性(Eq.3，5000ms超时fail-open)；(5) 将JSON格式记忆渲染为自然语言再注入。
AI.result: 对mem0_default：个性化分数提升2.4-4.0分(GPT-4o profile usage从1.05→4.69)，所有对比p<10^-18；对vanilla_rag：优势同样显著且一致；对naive_concat(全上下文拼接上限)：在GPT-4o上Profile/Integration维度持平、Task维度略高(p=0.006)，Qwen-2.5:7B三个维度均持平，Llama-3.1:8B Task/Integration显著较低(0.13-0.19 rank-biserial)；端到端延迟降低15-61%，隐私实验n=450完全私有端暴露率为0/450。人评验证显示kernel_shared与naive_concat质量不可区分(均4.17)且远高于mem0_default(1.00)。
AI.conclusion: 在agent-system kernel中集中管理记忆检索、隐私强制和注入，以远低于全上下文拼接的成本获得了大部分个性化收益，且相比非托管记忆后端或标准RAG提供更可靠的个性化能力；但Llama-3.1:8B上相对naive_concat的小幅模型特定缺陷尚无法解释，留待未来工作；身份解析的对抗鲁棒性和中等共享配置下的隐私验证也是未来工作方向。

title: Beyond Surface Imitation: Contrastive Modeling for Reasoning Path Alignment in Multimodal In-Context Learning
summary: In-context learning (ICL) is widely used in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and achieves strong performance across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, existing multimodal ICL methods often rely on surface level imitation of in-context demonstrations, making it difficult for MLLMs to align their responses with the reasoning path required by the given multimodal input. This limitation becomes more pronounced in complex multimodal tasks, thereby restricting further improvements in MLLM performance. To address this issue, we propose a new multimodal ICL framework that combines contrastive demonstration modeling with the self-refinement capability of MLLMs. Specifically, our framework reformulates each demonstration by explicitly contrasting a suboptimal response with a better response under the same input, together with a reasoning path that reveals how the response should be refined. This contrastive formulation makes the reasoning path toward the desired response more explicit and guides the MLLM beyond superficial imitation. Furthermore, because effective refinement depends on the current response, we introduce a response-conditioned retrieval mechanism to select demonstrations whose reasoning paths are more relevant to the current response. In addition, we use a lightweight alignment controller to predict response quality and determine whether further refinement is needed. Experiments on three types of multimodal tasks show that the proposed framework consistently improves MLLM performance, with particularly notable gains on visual question answering (VQA).

AI.tldr: COMIL是一种多模态上下文学习框架，通过对比式示范建模、响应条件检索和轻量级对齐控制器，使多模态大语言模型超越表面模仿，实现推理路径对齐，在视觉问答等任务上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态上下文学习方法主要依赖于对示范的表面级模仿，使MLLM难以将其响应与多模态输入所需的推理路径对齐，尤其在复杂多模态任务中，这一限制更为突出，限制了MLLM性能的进一步提升。
AI.method: COMIL框架包含三个核心组件：1) 对比式示范建模，将每个标准ICL示例重构为结构化四元组(输入, 次优响应, 更优响应, 推理路径)，显式展示从次优响应到更优响应的精炼过程；2) 响应条件检索机制，根据当前响应与示范中次优响应的相似度来选择演示，使检索到的推理路径更相关于当前响应的精炼；3) 轻量级对齐控制器，预测响应质量并确定是否需要进一步精炼，通过任务特定评估指标进行监督训练。
AI.result: 在四个数据集(CIFAR10、Flickr30k、VQAv2、OKVQA)和四个开源MLLM(Gemma-3-27B、InternVL3.5-14B、Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3.5-4B)上的实验表明，COMIL在16个MLLM-数据集设置中的13个取得最佳性能。在VQAv2上使Qwen3.5-9B准确率达到81.9%，在Flickr30k上使Gemma-3-27B的CIDEr分数达到0.587。同时在闭源MLLM(Claude Sonnet 4.6和GPT-4o)上也表现优异。相比SC-CoT，平均延迟降低51.6%，token消耗减少82.7%。
AI.conclusion: COMIL通过对比式示范建模、响应条件检索和轻量级对齐控制器的组合，有效引导MLLM超越被动输出匹配，实现基于证据的推理路径对齐。该框架在多模态分类、生成和推理任务上均表现一致改进，在推理密集型任务上增益尤为显著，并且具有良好的泛化能力，可应用于闭源MLLM。

title: Why Sample What You Can Enumerate? Exact Policy Optimization for Genomic Tool Selection
summary: Reinforcement learning over a frozen reasoner has become a common recipe for teaching a policy which external tools to invoke. We show that this recipe becomes structurally mismatched in specialist scientific settings where the complete tool-subset space is enumerable. There, a small set of recurring computational capabilities covers the domain, so the space of tool subsets is combinatorial yet small enough to enumerate, and GRPO still estimates an action expectation from a handful of sampled rollouts. Worse, the approximation degrades as training succeeds: as the policy concentrates on preferred subsets it resamples them, sampled rewards collide, and the group-normalized advantage vanishes. On genomic reasoning the fraction of questions yielding no reward signal rises from 0.2% under a uniform reference policy to 20.8% after GRPO training. As a remedy, we introduce FGPO (Full-Group Policy Optimization), which (1) scores every tool subset and optimizes the exact action expectation, so each update sees the complete action space, and (2) precomputes the reward of each question--subset pair into an exhaustive table, removing frozen-reasoner calls from the training loop entirely. Across five frozen reasoners and three genomic benchmarks, FGPO outperforms GRPO in all 15 settings by 6.75 points on average and up to 14.20, while a standard on-demand GRPO schedule would require 2.4 times as many frozen-reasoner reward evaluations and, on GenomeQA, FGPO cuts invoked tools per question from 2.36 to 1.40.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FGPO（Full-Group Policy Optimization），针对基因组工具选择任务中工具子集空间可枚举这一特点，用精确策略优化取代 GRPO 的采样估计，避免了"死组"导致的训练信号消失问题，并在多个基准上显著优于 GRPO。
AI.motivation: 在基因组推理等专家科学领域，工具子集空间虽组合但可枚举（如4个工具仅16种子集），GRPO 仍用少量采样来估计动作期望，但随着训练推进，策略集中于偏好子集，导致采样奖励碰撞、组归一化优势消失，产生"死组"问题。在 GenomeQA 上，死组率从均匀策略下的 0.2% 升至 GRPO 训练后的 20.8%。
AI.method: FGPO 包含两个核心组件：(1) 精确目标函数——对全部 2^n 个工具子集打分并优化精确动作期望，使每次更新都看到完整动作空间；(2) 穷举奖励表——预先计算每个问题-子集对的奖励，将冻结推理器调用从训练循环中完全移除。在 LLM 策略实现中采用 per-token 长度归一化的候选评分和熵正则化，并设计受控的候选评分评估规则（对所有方法统一）。
AI.result: 在 5 个冻结推理器和 3 个基因组基准（GenomeQA、GenBench-X、BM4）的全部 15 个配置中，FGPO 均优于 GRPO，平均提升 6.75 分，最高 14.20 分（统计显著性 p<10^{-4}）。On-demand GRPO 需要 2.4 倍的冻结推理器奖励评估次数。在 GenomeQA 上，FGPO 将每次问题调用的工具数从 2.36 降至 1.40，输入 token 比 All-Tools 减少 3.45 倍。500 个训练问题即可超过 GRPO 用 2002 问题训练的结果。死组率从 17-21% 随 G 增大持续上升，k-子集剂量-响应实验显示准确率随动作覆盖度单调递增。
AI.conclusion: 采样式分组优化在可枚举工具选择空间中会出现结构性失配：随策略集中，死组率上升导致学习信号消失。FGPO 通过精确优化完整动作期望解决了这一问题，在三个基因组基准和五个冻结推理器上一致提升性能，同时调用更少工具。未来工作可扩展到更大工具库，通过自适应构建紧凑的候选集并在选定集内保持精确优化。

title: What Should an Agent Forget? Separating What Is Stored from What Is Used
summary: Persistent language agents need stored experience to remain available across time, while each answer requires evidence suited to a particular question. A superseded fact can mislead a current-state answer and still be essential for a historical query. We present RD-Forget, a training-free framework that separates what an agent stores from what it uses. A retained source archive preserves observations, and a query-conditioned memory view controls their influence on the current answer. A frozen language-model curator extracts relevant evidence, groups facts into semantic slots, and preserves the relations needed for multi-hop reasoning. Same-slot replacement links suppress superseded values in current-state contexts, while intent-aware retrieval makes earlier evidence eligible again. A rate-distortion formulation guides construction of the answer-time view within a memory budget. Experiments span conversational memory, knowledge updating, fact consolidation, long-context reasoning, and personalization under a shared answering pipeline. The results associate accurate answers with both query-relevant evidence construction and control over obsolete alternatives. Configurations without forgetting or query conditioning have the largest score deficits, while slot grouping, historical access, and relation preservation contribute complementary functions. Retaining history while selectively controlling its use offers a practical way to accommodate changing facts and future questions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RD-Forget 框架，将持久化语言智能体的"存储"与"使用"解耦：源档案保留全部观测，查询条件化的记忆视图控制证据对当前答案的影响；并通过率失真公式在内存预算内构建答案视图。
AI.motivation: 持续演化的语言智能体面临"存储哪些历史"与"使用哪些证据回答"两类决策的冲突——过时事实可能误导当前状态回答，但仍对历史查询必不可少。单纯删除或保留均不可行，需要将存储与使用显式分离。
AI.method: 三阶段无训练框架：(1) 冻结 LLM 策展人按查询从历史中抽取证据，按 subject|relation|scope 语义槽分组，保留多跳推理所需的关系链；(2) 同槽替换链接抑制当前状态下的过时值，但通过意图感知检索（archive rescue + 历史意图标识 h(q)）允许历史查询重新激活；(3) 采用率失真公式在 2048 token 预算内贪心打包答案视图。
AI.result: 在 AMB-Text、LME-KU、MAB-FC 三个主套件以及 BEAM、PersonaMem 意图套件上，RD-Forget 在全部 4 个骨干模型 × 8 个评测组合中均取得最高准确率。在事实整合任务上，较强基线增益达 11–26 个百分点；Luna 消融实验显示 −FORGET 与 −QC（查询条件化）缺陷最大，−RESCUE、−SLOT、−CLOSURE 起补充作用。
AI.conclusion: 将"存储"与"使用"分离使遗忘成为关于查询局部证据的决策：过时事实可在当前答案中被抑制，同时在历史查询中保留可用。记忆槽粒度与意图感知检索共同实现这一分离，为应对事实在变化与未来问题共存提供了实用路径。

title: TRACE: Training Reasoning Agents for Causal Exploration with Synthesized Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has advanced language-model reasoning in domains such as mathematics and code, where objective answers are inexpensive to check. Diagnostic reasoning over complex data lacks this advantage: establishing the true cause of an anomaly often requires costly expert investigation and may remain ambiguous after the fact. We ask whether this asymmetry of verification can instead be engineered. We sample an intervention, inject it into a controlled simulator, and generate the observations it would produce. The hidden intervention provides an oracle label and objective reward, while the agent must still investigate noisy, confounded, and distributed evidence. We instantiate this approach in TRACE, a digital-advertising diagnostic environment with 12 root causes and fine-grained segment attribution. Agents investigate each episode using Python and SQL and must identify both the root cause and, when applicable, the affected segment assignment. On a held-out 235-episode test set, the strongest prompted baseline, Claude Opus 5, reaches 0.686 FullAttr@1. Supervised fine-tuning raises Qwen3.5-35B-A3B from 0.159 to 0.637, and subsequent RL with synthesized rewards reaches 0.757, outperforming all evaluated prompted baselines, including frontier closed-source models and a prompted Qwen3.5-122B-A10B model. The resulting policy also uses substantially fewer tool calls than the prompted 35B base. These results provide evidence that access to a scalable, objective training signal can be a more important constraint than model scale alone. More broadly, simulation-based verification can make otherwise ambiguous diagnostic reasoning tasks amenable to scalable reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: TRACE提出"模拟器-预言机-强化学习"流水线，通过在受控模拟器中注入隐藏干预并以干预标签作为客观奖励，使原本难以验证的诊断推理任务变得可规模化。在数字广告诊断环境上，经SFT+RL训练的Qwen3.5-35B-A3B以0.757的FullAttr@1超越包括Claude Opus 5在内的所有提示基线，证明可扩展的客观训练信号比模型规模更重要。
AI.motivation: 诊断推理（如数字广告归因）缺乏类似数学/代码的客观验证器，专家调查成本高昂且事后仍可能模糊，导致RLVR难以应用。核心动机是工程化"验证不对称"——能否通过模拟器生成带隐藏标签的诊断任务，使产生难题的过程同时提供客观答案。
AI.method: 1) 设计TRACE数字广告模拟环境：分阶段构建活动群体、采样12类根因（含campaign-wide、segment-mix、segment-specific、no-signal）的干预、按泊松-多项式-速率机制渲染多表数据；2) 预言机验证器仅保留注入信号可被识别且能排除混淆因素的剧集；3) 采用GRPO+三组分（r_attr含Jaccard切片相似度的分级归因奖励、r_full二元全归因奖励、r_fmt格式奖励）合成奖励；4) 先以Claude Opus 4.8拒绝采样做SFT，再用RL微调Qwen3.5-35B-A3B。
AI.result: 在235集留出测试集上，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B的FullAttr@1从基础0.159经SFT提升至0.637，再经RL提升至0.757，超过Claude Opus 5（0.686）、GPT-5.6 Sol（0.565）等闭源前沿模型及Qwen3.5-122B-A10B提示版（0.283）；同时工具调用从22.05次降至11.73次。消融显示r_full对二维切片归因（0.00→0.27）和SFT初始化至关重要，KL惩罚反而降低性能。二维切片归因（0.27）与无信号校准（0.49 vs Opus的0.87）仍是主要短板。
AI.conclusion: 当领域存在可控生成模型时，干预本身可同时充当难题生成器与验证器，使原本模糊的诊断任务具备客观训练信号。在该诊断设定中，后训练信号的可获取性比模型规模更具约束力；模拟器-预言机构造为软件运维、数据质量等场景的RLVR扩展提供了通用路径。

title: From Symbolic Perception to Logical Deduction: A Framework for Guiding Language Models in Geometric Reasoning
summary: Plane geometry remains a significant challenge in AI, requiring the integration of visual perception and mathematical reasoning. While Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) naturally handle visuo-linguistic inputs, they are often computationally intensive and opaque. We demonstrate that a pure Large Language Model (LLM), when equipped with specialized modules, can rival state-of-the-art LMMs on complex geometry problems. Our framework integrates a Geometric Vision Parser, which translates diagrams into symbolic form, with a Symbolic Solver that performs formal deductions, thereby mitigating hallucinations and promoting interpretable reasoning. To enable rigorous evaluation, we curate a benchmark of challenging problems from the 2025 Chinese Zhongkao examinations, ensuring data novelty and testing deeper deductive skills. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves performance comparable to Gemini 2.5 Pro while delivering clearer, human-like solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结合几何视觉解析器（Geometric Vision Parser）和符号求解器（Symbolic Solver）的混合框架，使纯LLM（DeepSeek-R1）在平面几何推理任务上达到甚至超过顶尖大型多模态模型（如Gemini 2.5 Pro）的性能，并发布基于2025中国中考的新基准ZhongkaoGeo。
AI.motivation: 现有大型多模态模型（LMM）虽然能原生处理图文混合输入，但存在计算开销大、推理过程不透明、在几何领域因训练数据分布偏差而表现受限的问题；同时传统形式化系统（如InterGPS、AlphaGeometry）虽精确但依赖形式语言，存在信息损失、规则脆弱、输出可读性差等局限。作者希望验证"配备专门模块的纯LLM"在几何推理上能否匹敌甚至超越SOTA LMM，并提供更可解释、更类人的解题路径。
AI.method: 框架由三个核心模块组成：(1) 几何问题形式化模块——采用自底向上的解析流水线（细调YOLO Pose+Hough变换提取点、线、圆等几何基元，再用YOLO+Texteller识别符号与文本，最后用贪心策略将符号绑定到基元，并加入"文本对齐"步骤纠正视觉误读）；(2) 几何定理推理模块——采用Literal Expansion、Fact Deduction、Fact Filtering三步，通过基于规则的关系扩展（如collinear传递）和约束驱动的剪枝策略将搜索复杂度从O(N^k)降至O(N_valid)，输出与原问题相关的角度/共线等演绎事实；(3) LLM答案生成模块——将原始题目、解析出的形式化空间关系和经过过滤的演绎事实组装为结构化提示，引导DeepSeek-R1生成类人、可解释的逐步解答，抑制暴力坐标法。基准方面，构建了三级ZhongkaoGeo（基于中国中考，L1=89题/2023及以前，L2=83题/2024-2025初，L3=105题/2025省会及直辖市官方卷），规避数据污染并提供多子题、综合题等高难度样本。
AI.result: 在ZhongkaoGeo-L1和L2上，本方法（Ours）准确率分别达92.13%和74.30%，Major@3投票后达93.26%和78.31%，在L2上首次超越Gemini 2.5 Pro（73.49%）；在L3上得分率88.4%，超过Gemini 2.5 Pro的87.2%且方差相近；图关系解析（ZhongkaoGeo-L3）全面优于Qwen-VL-2.5-72B，三类关系全部正确的题目数从23跃升至81（提升3.5倍）；案例分析表明符号求解器引导模型走演绎路径，避免冗长坐标计算与最终错误猜测。
AI.conclusion: 工作表明"纯LLM+专用模块"在几何推理上可匹敌甚至超越SOTA LMM，且具有更高的可解释性；ZhongkaoGeo基准为几何推理评估提供了更新、难度更高、抗污染的新标准；通过约束LLM推理空间（形式化解析+定向演绎）推动AI数学向透明、人可读的演绎推理路径迈进。

title: Cyber-Financial Contagion: Modeling the Propagation of an AI Vendor Compromise Through the Banking System
summary: The banking system now depends on a small set of shared artificial intelligence vendors for fraud screening, credit decisioning, anti-money-laundering triage, customer analytics, and internal decision support. This paper studies how a compromise inside one of those vendors can propagate along a chain of operational, informational, and financial linkages until it triggers losses that look, from the outside, like a classical banking crisis. We build a four-layer heterogeneous network that couples AI vendors, financial institutions, interbank exposures, and customer accounts, and we propose CFC-Prop, a stochastic epidemic-and-clearing model that runs on that network. On a synthetic dataset with 60 vendors, 220 banks, roughly 2,500 vendor-bank service edges, and 1,400 interbank exposures, CFC-Prop reproduces the heavy-tailed loss distributions and the sharp dependence on patch latency that are consistent with prior cyber-financial evidence. We also train an early-warning model, CFC-GNN, that uses vendor-side incident telemetry and graph structure to flag high-cascade-risk vendors before impact. Across four baselines the proposed model reaches AUROC 0.82 and AUPRC 0.60 while keeping calibration errors bounded. We release the full code, synthetic data, and reproducible scripts. The results argue that cyber concentration among AI vendors is a first-order financial-stability problem and give supervisors a concrete quantitative tool for reasoning about it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究银行系统因AI供应商集中化而面临的级联风险，提出CFC-Prop流行病-清算模型在四层异构网络（AI供应商、银行、银行间敞口、客户账户）上模拟AI供应商被攻陷后的系统性风险传播，并训练CFC-GNN早期预警模型识别高风险供应商。
AI.motivation: 银行业务（反欺诈、信贷决策、反洗钱、客户分析等）高度依赖少数共享AI供应商，一旦其中一家被攻陷，其风险可能通过运营、信息和金融关联链传导，引发类似传统银行危机的系统性损失；AI供应商的网络安全集中化构成金融稳定的首要问题。
AI.method: 构建四层异构网络（AI供应商、银行、银行间敞口、客户账户），提出随机流行病-清算模型CFC-Prop在该网络上模拟级联传播；基于供应商端事件遥测与图结构训练图神经网络早期预警模型CFC-GNN，用于在影响发生前标记高风险供应商。
AI.result: 在包含60家供应商、220家银行、约2500条供应商-银行服务边和1400条银行间敞口的合成数据集上，CFC-Prop复现了与已有网络金融证据一致的重尾损失分布及对补丁延迟的强依赖；CFC-GNN在四个基线下达到AUROC 0.82、AUPRC 0.60，并保持校准误差可控。
AI.conclusion: 研究论证了AI供应商的网络安全集中化是金融稳定的首要问题，并为监管者提供了一个具体的、可量化的工具，用于推理和应对由此引发的级联风险。

title: Fortunate Recall: Ontology-Driven Memory Lifecycle Management for Persistent Coherence in LLMs
comment: Preprint, under review. 2 figures. Code, benchmark and run logs: this https URL
summary: Current LLM memory systems treat all personal facts identically, so stores grow without bound while retrieval precision degrades. The core challenge is lifecycle management: which memories should persist, which should be replaced, and at what rate, conditioned on the behavioral type of each fact. Fortunate Recall (FR) is a composable policy layer that classifies personal facts into a 10+1 behavioral ontology and applies category-specific lifecycle policies (differential temporal decay, slot-key supersession, event-time validity, and category-aware retrieval routing) as deterministic functions over LLM-extracted metadata. FR-Bank, our infrastructure-independent implementation, reaches a 76.9% pass rate on LifecycleBench, a new 516-question temporal-disambiguation benchmark, ahead of Mem0, A-MEM, Memory-R1, and MemoryOS (61% to 70.5%), and 75.2% on the full LongMemEval-S under the canonical Wu et al. judge protocol, so lifecycle policies impose no measurable cost on standard retrieval. A pre-registered ablation locates the gains: replacing the typed layer with three generic lifecycle primitives leaves correctness statistically unchanged (-1.7pp, 95% CI [-6.0, +2.7]), so the generic lifecycle metadata carries the correctness advantage, while the behavioral ontology carries calibration, halving downstream confabulation (12.0% vs 24.2%, p<0.001). End-to-end, FR-Bank cuts confabulation from Mem0's 45.1% to 22.4% over answered queries and from 32.2% to 13.0% over all queries while answering more of them correctly (31.2% vs 18.6%); the ranking replicates on the open-weight Kimi K2.5. The decomposition transfers to BEAM, an independently built benchmark: 46.8% correct vs Mem0's 32.9% over 280 questions, with the ontology's benefit concentrated in contradiction resolution and saturating near seven policy clusters. The ontology, benchmark, and code are released.

AI.tldr: Fortunate Recall (FR) 提出了一种基于行为本体（10+1类）的LLM记忆生命周期管理策略层，通过对个人事实进行差分时间衰减、槽位键替换、事件时间有效性和类别感知检索路由等确定性策略，解决现有记忆系统将所有事实等同对待导致存储无限增长和检索精度下降的问题。其实现FR-Bank在新的LifecycleBench基准上达到76.9%通过率，显著优于Mem0（61%）、A-MEM（65.3%）、Memory-R1（66.9%）和MemoryOS（70.5%），并将Mem0的端到端虚构率从45.1%降至22.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM记忆系统将所有个人事实统一对待，使用平面向量存储或知识图谱，存储无限增长的同时检索精度下降。核心问题在于生命周期管理：哪些记忆应持久、哪些应被替换、以何种速率替换，这取决于每个事实的行为类型。不同类别的事实（如用户族裔、当前饮食偏好、六个月前的牙医预约）需要差异极大的持久化动态。
AI.method: FR将每个提取的事实分类到10+1行为类别（身份、关系纽带、智识兴趣、健康、项目、爱好、偏好、财务、义务、物流、其他），为每个类别应用特定的生命周期策略：差分时间衰减（半衰期从19天到4天）、槽位键替换（基于标准化(subject, attribute)对）、事件时间有效性（对于义务和物流，到期日临近时激活度上升）、类别感知检索路由。生命周期策略层是纯确定性数学（关闭形式对数分数），LLM仅在摄入时和检索时的一次轻量候选选择步骤中使用。核心机制可表达为：l(e,q,t) = βσ(e,q) + logρ(c_e|q) - λ_{c_e}Δt_e + logV_{c_e}(t,h_e) + logΩ(e) + logM_q(ξ_e)。论文还提供理论保证：定理1证明(σ,Δt)评分器无法识别生命周期状态；定理2证明元数据基(c,κ,ξ,h)的充分性和最小性；定理3证明每个分量的个体必要性；定理4证明校准是凸可行性问题。
AI.result: FR-Bank在LifecycleBench（516题，9个攻击向量）上达到76.9%通过率（95% CI [73.3, 80.6]），优于所有基线。端到端虚构率在已回答查询上从Mem0的45.1%降至22.4%，在所有516个查询上从32.2%降至13.0%。LongMemEval-S在Wu等人ICLR 2025评判协议下达到75.2%±0.70pp。预注册消融实验表明：通用生命周期元数据承载正确性优势（与无类型基线统计无差异，Δ=-1.7pp），而行为本体承载校准优势（将虚构率从24.2%减半至12.0%，p<0.001）。在独立构建的BEAM基准上验证可迁移性：46.8%正确率 vs Mem0的32.9%。两代生成器（GPT-5.4和Kimi K2.5）上结果排名一致。
AI.conclusion: FR将生命周期元数据附加到每个存储事实并对其应用确定性的类别条件策略。两个相同策略栈的不同实现达到统计上不可区分的LifecycleBench通过率（p=0.10），同时将Mem0的端到端虚构率从45.1%降至22.4%，且回答更多正确查询。非识别性和个体必要性定理建立了元数据基(c,κ,ξ,h)作为结构上必要的表示。控制消融将功劳划分为：通用元数据承载正确性优势，行为本体使按类别校准可行（无单一全局权重可行），将虚构率减半，并在矛盾解决上增加一项局部可复现的正确性增益。本体粒度收益在约七个策略簇处饱和。

title: ConvMem: Convolutional Memory for Long-Context Reasoning
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities, they often struggle with extremely long contexts due to fixed context limits. To address this, sequential approaches like MemAgent extend the effective context by reading text in segments and iteratively updating a fixed-size memory. However, this sequential paradigm suffers from high latency and requires costly reinforcement learning (RL) training, which can lead to overfitting on specific datasets. To overcome these limitations, we propose ConvMem, a training-free, highly parallelizable framework that reformulates long-context reasoning as a hierarchical convolution. Inspired by CNNs, ConvMem treats an LLM prompted with a specific query as a convolutional kernel. This kernel summarizes text segments hierarchically, shortening the reasoning path from a linear chain into a logarithmic tree. Specifically, ConvMem integrates \textit{Configurable Strides} and \textit{Skip Connections} to ensure robust evidence capture and propagation, while employing \textit{Multi-Kernel Convolution} to decompose complex queries into disentangled semantic channels. This design not only mitigates error accumulation but also enables massive parallelization across both text segments and reasoning threads. Experiments on RULER-HotpotQA and RULER-2WikiMultiHopQA demonstrate that ConvMem outperforms training-free baselines and avoids the risk of overfitting to parametric priors often observed in RL-trained models on out-of-distribution tasks.

AI.tldr: ConvMem是一个无需训练、灵感来源于CNN的层次化框架，用于长上下文推理。它通过将LLM视为卷积核来并行化处理文本片段，将推理路径从线性链转变为对数树，从而解决现有记忆代理的顺序瓶颈和过拟合问题。
AI.motivation: 现有处理长上下文的顺序记忆代理（如MemAgent）存在两个关键缺陷：一是由于严格的时序依赖导致推理延迟高且无法并行化；二是依赖强化学习（RL）训练，容易过拟合到特定数据集，产生基于参数化记忆而非上下文推理的"幻觉"。因此，需要一种既能保持高保真上下文推理，又能高效并行化的方法。
AI.method: ConvMem受CNN启发，将冻结的LLM视为语义卷积核。主要包含三种机制：(1) 可配置步长（Configurable Strides）：使用重叠窗口（W=8000, S=1600，5倍过度扫描）确保上下文连续性和多视图鲁棒性；(2) 跳跃连接（Skip Connections）：相关性评分r=2的关键原始片段绕过压缩直接传递到最终层，缓解细节丢失；(3) 多核卷积（Multi-Kernel Convolution）：将复杂查询分解为最多5个子问题，部署不同核并行处理，实现语义通道解耦。整个过程通过L层（深度约log N）递归聚合，将线性复杂度O(N)降低到对数复杂度O(log N)。
AI.result: 在RULER-HotpotQA（分布内）和RULER-2WikiMultiHopQA（分布外）基准测试中，ConvMem在28k到896k的上下文长度下均显著优于所有无训练基线（RAG-BM25、MemAgent-W/O-RL、Mem-α-W/O-RL）。在分布外的2WikiMultiHopQA上，ConvMem（F1: 59-72）大幅超越RL训练的MemAgent（F1: 58-63），证明后者存在过拟合到参数化先验的问题。消融实验验证了5倍过度扫描、W=8000核大小和跳跃连接的必要性。
AI.conclusion: ConvMem通过将层次化卷积范式引入长上下文推理，成功将线性推理路径转化为对数树结构，有效缓解了错误累积并实现了大规模并行化。作为一种无需训练、忠实于输入上下文的推理引擎，它在泛化能力上显著优于基于RL的记忆代理，揭示了后者倾向于回归为参数化检索系统的风险。该框架为长上下文推理提供了一条兼顾计算效率与推理保真度的路径。

title: JarvisGUI: Towards Cross-Device GUI Agents with Dynamic Task Composition
summary: Real-world GUI usage frequently involves workflows that span multiple devices and platforms, requiring the transfer of intermediate results, maintenance of shared state, and coordination across heterogeneous environments. However, existing GUI benchmarks overwhelmingly evaluate agents on single-device, statically defined tasks, thus leaving such cross-device capabilities largely unexamined, resulting in an overly optimistic assessment of agents' readiness for real-world usage. We introduce JarvisGUI, a dynamic benchmark that evaluates GUI agents on cross-device workflows requiring coordinated interaction across heterogeneous platforms, including Android, Windows, and Ubuntu. Specifically, JarvisGUI formulates GUI tasks as input-output transformations under a lightweight type system, which allows us to automatically compose multi-step, cross-device workflows and dynamically evaluate agent performance within a unified framework. By evaluating agents in virtual environments spanning multiple operating systems, JarvisGUI reveals that state-of-the-art open-source GUI agents struggle with the state-transfer awareness, cross-platform contextual reasoning, and long-horizon dependency management required for real-world workflows, exposing a critical capability gap invisible to existing benchmarks.

AI.tldr: JarvisGUI是一个用于评估GUI智能体跨设备工作流能力的动态基准测试，覆盖Android、Windows和Ubuntu三个平台，通过类型系统和采样式任务组合自动构建多步骤跨设备任务，揭示当前开源GUI智能体在状态转移感知、跨平台上下文推理和长程依赖管理方面存在显著能力差距。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI基准测试普遍采用单设备、静态任务假设，忽视了真实场景中跨设备工作流（涉及中间结果传输、共享状态维护和异构环境协调）的普遍性，导致对智能体实际部署能力的评估过于乐观。HCI研究表明跨设备工作流是日常工作的常见模式（67.5%用户拥有两个以上设备，37%的多设备案例涉及单任务内的顺序设备切换），但缺乏大规模、系统的跨设备GUI基准测试。
AI.method: 1) 基于Docker虚拟化构建覆盖Android、Windows、Ubuntu的异构多设备环境；2) 提出轻量级类型系统，将GUI任务建模为带类型的输入-输出槽（slot），支持子类型兼容的自动组合；3) 采用采样式自动任务组合算法（Algorithm 1）将有向任务图动态拼接成多步骤跨设备工作流；4) 使用LLM-as-a-Judge（Qwen3-30B-A3B）在任务真实性、连贯性、可评估性三个维度上过滤任务（Cohen's Kappa≈0.92）；5) 采用Planner-Grounder两级架构，Qwen3-VL-Plus作为中心化规划器处理跨平台协调，各模型作为定位器执行精确点击；6) 评估指标包括原子任务TSR、复合任务TSR和子任务SSR。
AI.result: 在6个主流开源GUI智能体上的评估显示：原子任务整体TSR为28.8%-42.4%，其中Ubuntu表现最好（50%-60.7%），Windows最弱；多设备依赖任务（MD）几乎全部失败（TSR 0%-2%），多设备独立任务（MI）TSR 6.5%-10.6%；单设备依赖任务（SW）TSR 4%-16%。任务成功率随子任务数量增加急剧下降，4个以上子任务时接近零。主要失败模式包括：状态推断瓶颈（难以推断目标设备环境状态）、长程关键路径（中间步骤失败导致整条链断裂）、多设备上下文认知过载（无法将隐式指令映射到正确平台）、平台偏差（Windows表现最弱）。
AI.conclusion: JarvisGUI首次系统性地研究跨设备GUI智能体任务，证明了当前开源GUI智能体在状态转移、跨平台推理和长程依赖管理方面存在关键能力差距，这是现有基准测试无法发现的；该基准通过类型系统和动态任务组合为评估真实跨设备工作流提供了可扩展、可验证的框架，未来工作将扩展更多设备组合、无障碍场景和超长程任务。

title: Quantifying Logical Consistency in Transformers via Query-Key Alignment
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in various natural language processing tasks, yet their ability to perform multi-step logical reasoning remains an open challenge. Although Chain-of-Thought prompting has improved logical reasoning by enabling models to generate intermediate steps, it lacks mechanisms to assess the coherence of these logical transitions. In this paper, we propose a novel, lightweight evaluation strategy for logical reasoning that uses query-key alignments inside transformer attention heads. By computing a single forward pass and extracting a "QK-score" from carefully chosen heads, our method reveals latent representations that reliably separate valid from invalid inferences, offering a scalable alternative to traditional ablation-based techniques. We also provide an empirical validation on multiple logical reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating improved robustness of our evaluation method against distractors and increased reasoning depth. The experiments were conducted on a diverse set of models, ranging from 1.5B to 70B parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer注意力头内部Query-Key(QK)交互的轻量级逻辑一致性评估方法（QK-score），通过单次前向传播计算特定注意力头中答案token的查询向量与语句结束token的键向量之间的点积，来量化逻辑推理的有效性。该方法在ProntoQA-OOD、PARARULE Plus和Extended-MultiLogiEval等多个逻辑推理基准上进行了验证，实验覆盖1.5B到70B参数规模的多款LLM，结果表明所选头在多步推理和含干扰项的场景下均优于基线，且具有跨数据集的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在多步逻辑推理任务中通过Chain-of-Thought提示有所改进，但仍缺乏评估逻辑转换连贯性的机制。传统的基于消融的机制可解释性方法计算成本高昂且难以扩展。本文旨在提出一种高效、轻量级的替代方案，利用Transformer注意力头内部的Query-Key对齐信号作为逻辑一致性的代理指标。
AI.method: 给定三元组(context, statement, answer)，其中answer为"true"或"false"，在每一层l的每个注意力头h上计算QK-score：S_QK^(l,h) = q_{a_i}^(l,h)ᵀ · k_s^(l,h)，即答案token（"true"或"false"）的查询向量与语句结束标记的键向量之间的点积。通过单次前向传播提取所有头的QK-score，无需修改模型或逐头消融。在校准集上选择最佳头，然后在评估集上测试其区分有效与无效逻辑推理的能力，并验证跨数据集迁移性。
AI.result: 1）域内评估（ProntoQA-OOD）：在Modus Ponens和组合推理规则设置下，QK-selected头在不同推理深度（1-5跳）和不同干扰项数量下均一致优于基线。例如LLaMA3 70B在组合规则深度5时达到0.8353，基线为0.7948；LLaMA3.1 8B在深度4时QK为0.7239，基线为0.5888。2）跨数据集评估：在PARARULE Plus上5个头中有3个比基线提升超过10%；在Extended-MultiLogiEval上2个头优于基线。3）QK-score独立于位置编码，专注于语义对齐；高QK-score头表现出对干扰项的鲁棒性，起到"验证锚点"的作用。
AI.conclusion: QK-score框架成功识别出一致捕捉逻辑有效性的注意力头，作为"推理检查点"。该单次前向传播方法绕过了基于消融方法的计算开销，并具有较好的跨数据集泛化能力。该方法为揭示LLM如何处理多步逻辑关系提供了一个可处理的窗口。未来工作可探索QK-scoring与CoT提示的协同，并将其扩展到其他可解释性场景。局限性包括：需要较大的校准数据集（约400题）、仅在Instruct/Chat模型上验证、未涵盖所有可能的逻辑规则集。

title: From Plausible to Actionable: A Position on LLM Self-Explanations
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate natural language explanations that rationalize their own decisions, a phenomenon commonly referred to as self-explanations. Such explanations have emerged as a promising direction for explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), particularly for interpreting LLM behavior. However, while self-explanations often appear plausible, whether they faithfully reflect a model's underlying reasoning process remains an open question. In this opinion paper, we argue that self-explanations can be highly plausible, questionably faithful, and yet highly actionable. From a traditional XAI perspective, we identify the limitations of standard evaluation protocols for LLM-generated self-explanations and propose practical guidelines for assessing their plausibility and this http URL , we argue that evaluation should extend beyond these criteria to actionability, highlighting applications of LLM rationalization capabilities that support informed decision-making and appropriate action across diverse stakeholders.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇观点论文,主张将LLM自解释的研究焦点从"可信性(faithfulness)"转向"可操作性(actionability)"。作者认为LLM生成的自解释虽具有高度表面合理性(plausibility),但其忠实性存疑,且现有评估协议存在根本缺陷,因而应将其重新定位为面向非专家用户的沟通界面、人类决策支持工具及促进审议的倡导者。
AI.motivation: LLM自解释在XAI领域被视为有前景的方向,但其是否真实反映模型的内部推理过程仍是开放难题。作者认为传统XAI评估框架(尤其是基于扰动的忠实性评估)对LLM并不适用,继续追求"可信性"目标意义有限,因此需要重新思考自解释的真正价值所在。
AI.method: 本文为立场/观点论文(position paper),采用论证式方法:首先梳理自解释"高合理性、低忠实性"的现象及其原因,继而系统剖析现有合理性评估(忽略利益相关者专业差异、忽略主观任务中的解释多样性)和忠实性评估(基于Jacovi & Goldberg的三个假设——模型假设、预测假设、线性假设均不适用于LLM)在LLM场景下的具体局限,最后提出"可操作性"框架及三类应用场景。
AI.result: 1.合理性评估局限:未考虑利益相关者专业背景差异;在主观/歧义任务中依赖单一参考答案会掩盖有效观点的多样性;LLM的谄媚行为和优化为生成连贯响应的倾向人为抬高了合理性得分。2.忠实性评估局限:三假设均失效——LLM的非确定性使"模型假设"不成立;LLM对提示高度敏感使"预测假设"不成立;LLM可忽略输入依赖先验知识、扰动可能引入可利用伪影,使"线性假设"不成立。3.高合理性叠加低忠实性会导致"对抗性有用性"(adversarial helpfulness),引发自动化偏倚风险。4.提出三条应用路径:(a) 作为面向非专家的沟通界面,将复杂解释转译为自然语言;(b) 作为人类决策支持中的"论据"而非"决策",通过安全协议约束输出;(c) 作为"LLM作为倡导者"(LLMs as advocates)范式,通过多模型提供多元视角促进审议。
AI.conclusion: 论文呼吁XAI社区超越将合理性与忠实性作为自解释的主要目标,转而强调其"可操作性"价值——即支持不同利益相关者做出知情决策并采取适当行动的能力。自解释应被视为面向非专家的沟通界面、决策支持工具和审议促进工具,而非字面意义上的内部推理披露。

title: Scores Alone Do Not Prove Discovery: The Discovery Certification Protocol for Auditing AI Research Agents
summary: AI research agents combine prior knowledge, public sources, and experimental feedback to produce useful results. The Discovery Certification Protocol (DCP) turns claims about these results into executable recovery and feedback tests. Gate 1 validates useful improvement on sealed evaluation. Gate 2 gives matched agents the registered starting information and observed Web content while withholding the target research history. Every valid method reaching the numerical target supplies a recovery witness and triggers the Core veto. DCP Core requires adequate controls, zero observed recoveries, and a finite-sample bound on recovery in one fresh registered episode. Optional Gate 3 measures the average effect of truthful feedback relative to a specified neutral policy from a shared checkpoint. DCP Evidence adds this effect after independent null calibration and a registered effect margin. Two controlled audits exercise the complete protocol in SQLite optimization and virtual catalyst control under different models. Each produced zero recoveries in 96 episodes, with an upper bound of 0.0468. Each paired study yielded 30 truthful recoveries and zero neutral recoveries, with passing 60-pair null studies. Additional cases exercise Core, recovered, and audit-incomplete decisions. A deterministic, LLM-free verifier reproduces the decisions from frozen evidence. DCP provides a common evidence language for useful outcomes, alternative routes, and feedback effects across AI research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"发现认证协议"（DCP），用于审计AI研究代理产生的成果是否真正构成"发现"。该协议通过三个关卡（Gate 1-3）将关于研究结果的声明转化为可执行的恢复测试和反馈测试，并使用确定性的非LLM验证器从冻结证据中复现决策。
AI.motivation: 随着AI研究代理（如AlphaTensor、FunSearch、AlphaEvolve等）在算法发现、数学构造和实验自动化方面取得进展，如何区分"真正的发现"与"通过已知方法或公开信息就能达到的结果"成为关键问题。仅凭分数无法证明发现本身——需要一种可执行的审计协议来判断：(1)结果是否有用；(2)是否仅依赖起点信息就能复现；(3)实验反馈是否真正贡献了改进。
AI.method:
DCP定义五个对象（K背景、E₀初始观察、L*研究历史、A*最终输出、P验证规则），通过三个关卡审计一个数值结果：
- Gate 1：在封闭评估上验证有用改进（LCB ≥ δ_min）
- Gate 2：给匹配代理相同的起点信息和观察到的Web内容，但扣留目标研究历史L*；任何有效方法达到x-ε即触发Core否决（恢复证人是构造性否决）
- Gate 3（可选）：从共享检查点c开始，随机配对比较"真实反馈"与"中立策略"的平均效应，需通过独立的零校准和注册的效应边际
Core决策要求充分对照、零观察恢复、以及单个新注册episode的有限样本恢复概率上界。Evidence决策还需通过中立通道的零校准。统计上采用Bonferroni校正、配对精确区间、Clopper-Pearson界等方法，错误预算预先分配。
AI.result:
在两个完整审计中取得Core+ Evidence决策：
1. SQLite-Web（DeepSeek-v4-flash）：主分数0.8855（基线0），96次挑战者episode全部未恢复（最高0.6734，恢复线0.8805），上界0.0468 < ρ；30对真实反馈全部恢复vs零中立恢复，99%区间[0.6379, 1.0]，通过60对零校准
2. 虚拟催化剂优化（DeepSeek-v4-pro）：主分数1.0（基线0.599），96次未恢复（最高0.8146，恢复线0.95），同样的反馈效应
校准案例覆盖了完整决策空间：设备校准→Core；多维背包→恢复否决；仿射→审计不完整。完整审计成本约56-61美元/435-507次会话。确定性非LLM验证器从冻结证据中复现所有决策。
AI.conclusion: DCP提供了一个通用的证据语言，将效用、替代路径和反馈效应分开并独立验证。它将发现报告转变为可提交、可挑战、可验证的共同实验记录。该协议可前瞻性使用（预注册）或回顾性使用（重构结果并寻找恢复证人），适用于程序、模型、数据产品和实验方案等异构研究输出。论文的核心贡献在于将"分数"与"发现"区分开来——任何达到数值目标的合法方法都能提供恢复证人，真正的Core认证需要充分对照下的零恢复与有限样本概率界。

title: Scaling Post-Training Ternarisation to Qwen3-8B Capability Retention, Reproduction, Lossless Packing, and Packed Execution
