summary: Ultra-low-bit language models promise reductions in storage and memory traffic, but a nominal "1.58-bit" label does not specify the deployed representation or its execution cost. We study a scale-up of an aggressive post-training conversion pipeline from Qwen3-4B to Qwen3-8B. The conversion uses KOTMS rotation, E2M-ATQ adaptive ternarisation, and GPTQ-style error compensation in a weight-only A16 configuration. We do not claim these algorithms as new. Our contribution is the end-to-end scale-up characterisation: an external reproduction gate, matched 4B/8B capability analysis, cross-corpus perplexity, effective-bit accounting, lossless lattice-aware packing, and direct packed execution. The 8B model reaches a three-corpus perplexity ratio of 1.361x, with WikiText-2, C4, and PTB ratios of 1.318x, 1.393x, and 1.371x. On eight zero-shot tasks at n = 500, mean accuracy is 64.6% versus 72.4% for FP16, corresponding to 78.5% chance-corrected retention and a 7.8-point absolute cost. The matched 4B run retains 69.6%, yielding an 8.9-point 8B advantage. The packed checkpoint is 8.24 GiB and preserves the recorded perplexity to measurement precision. Direct packed execution reaches 15.52 tokens/s in 7.35 GiB, while a preliminary packed GEMV remains slower than FP16 cuBLAS. The result is a validated scale-up baseline: model size improves robustness to aggressive post-training discretisation, actual serialisation is solved for the measured artefact, and direct execution is feasible, while broader seeds, calibration distributions, and kernel optimisation remain open.

AI.tldr: 将Qwen3-4B后训练三值化(W1.58A16)流程扩展到Qwen3-8B,在RTX 5070上完成外部再现、4B/8B匹配能力对比、损失less格点感知打包及直接打包执行。结果显示模型增大对激进离散化具有更强鲁棒性,但内核优化仍是未解决的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 名义上的"1.58-bit"标签并不能说明部署时的实际表示或执行成本。作者将Qwen3-4B的激进后训练转换流程扩展到Qwen3-8B,验证规模化后能力保留、打包可行性及直接执行可行性,为超低比特LLM部署提供端到端实证基线。
AI.method: 采用已有算法组合:KOTMS正交旋转+E2M-ATQ自适应三值化+GPTQ误差补偿的权重仅A16流程(不主张算法新颖)。仅对252个线性投影(q/k/v/o与MLP gate/up/down)做转换,嵌入、LM head、norm、激活和KV cache保留FP16。表征为含四个显著性掩码(num_mask=4, orders=[2,2,1,1])的双层三值平面,覆盖0.5%/3.1%/10.0%/86.5%,有效权重比特约1.64 bits/weight。校准使用WikiText-2(64样本,2048 token,seed=0,percdamp=0.01)。评估为8个zero-shot任务(n=500),使用机会校正保留率R=(A_s-B)/(A_t-B)。
AI.result: 1) 外部再现:转换模型zero-shot平均62.00 vs TWLA公布62.05(差0.05),WikiText-2 PPL 12.758;本地FP16基线与公布值相差7.9%。2) 跨语料困惑度:三语料平均比率1.361×(WikiText-2 1.318×、C4 1.393×、PTB 1.371×)。3) 能力:8任务均值64.6% vs FP16 72.4%,机会校正保留78.5%,绝对代价7.8点。4) 匹配4B/8B对比:4B保留69.6%,8B高出8.9点,集中于知识密集任务(ARC-Easy +29.2、LAMBADA +18.2、ARC-Challenge +16.9、MMLU +10.8),HellaSwag与PIQA两任务4B反超。5) 数学:6个学科均高于25%四选一机会底线。6) 打包:16.9 GB→8.24 GiB,WikiText-2 PPL差异0.000085,PTB差异0.000996;拟合单格点失败(相对误差50.5%,PPL≈18477)证明序列化必须与量化协同设计。7) 执行:直接打包执行达15.52 tokens/s(7.35 GiB),相比之前CPU卸载1.48 tokens/s提升10.49×;但4096×2560 GEMV上打包Triton核比FP16 cuBLAS慢4.6×。
AI.conclusion: 经验上验证了后训练激进三值化可扩展到8B:8B匹配保留78.5%能力,比4B高8.9点;格点感知打包产出8.24 GiB基本无损的检查点;直接打包执行在RTX 5070上达15.52 tokens/s,7.35 GiB内存占用,使12 GB级GPU本地部署技术上可行。然而初步打包GEMV比FP16 cuBLAS慢4.6×,剩余工程瓶颈已从"能否直接运行"转为"内核还能优化多少"。作者明确不主张算法新颖,不宣称"三元普遍快于FP16",也不将两点比较视为扩展定律。后续工作需要更多随机种子、扩展校准语料(细Web-Edu)、嵌入与head量化、不同规模模型及跨形状批量核优化。

title: Distribution-Consistent Inference for Dynamic Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as a powerful paradigm for scaling model capacity while preserving efficient inference in large foundation models. However, most MoE models use a fixed top-$k$ expert selection policy, assigning the same expert budget to every token even when fewer experts may be sufficient. Inference-time dynamic top-$k$ routing can reduce computation without retraining, but existing methods often overlook the distributional shift caused by deviating from the training-time routing configuration. We show that reducing the number of activated experts consistently increases the RMS scale and variance of SMoE outputs, inducing a representation mismatch that contributes to downstream performance degradation in addition to the loss of expert capacity. To address this correctable component, we propose Layer-wise Distribution Alignment (LDA), a lightweight inference-time correction that uses layer-wise calibration statistics to align reduced-routing representations with the default configuration. Across multiple SMoE LLMs, benchmarks, and routing strategies, LDA recovers much of the performance lost induced by the distributional shift under reduced routing while preserving sparse-inference efficiency with negligible overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Layer-wise Distribution Alignment（LDA），一种轻量级免训练的推理时校正方法，通过逐层对齐SMoE输出的均值和标准差统计量，修复因减少激活专家数量而引起的表征分布偏移，从而在保持稀疏推理效率的同时恢复模型性能。
AI.motivation: 动态top-k路由可减少SMoE推理计算量，但现有方法忽略了偏离训练时路由配置所导致的分布偏移；减少激活专家数会系统性放大SMoE输出的RMS尺度与方差，引发与残差流的尺度失衡和路由轨迹偏差，造成独立于专家容量损失之外的下游性能退化。
AI.method: 首先通过经验观察与理论推导证明：在路由分数重归一化下，减少top-k会增加归一化路由分数的平方和，从而放大SMoE输出的RMS尺度；进而提出LDA，利用校准集估计默认路由与减少路由下各层SMoE输出的逐维均值和标准差，在推理时对每层SMoE输出施加逐维仿射变换（z-score风格），将其统计量对齐到默认配置。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B、kanana-2-30b-a3b-instruct、GLM-4.7-Flash三个SMoE大模型、13个基准（含通用知识、数学推理、代码生成、指令跟随）和多种路由策略（固定top-k、动态top-p、PESF动态剪枝）上的实验表明，LDA在显著减少激活专家的同时大幅恢复性能损失（如k=4下GSM8K从74.15%恢复到87.49%）；统计检验显示改进显著（p<0.05），推理开销可忽略，且对校准集选择和样本量具有鲁棒性，逐维对齐优于全局缩放基线。
AI.conclusion: 减少激活专家导致的性能退化不仅源于专家容量损失，还来自可校正的表征分布和尺度偏移；LDA作为免训练、轻量级的逐层分布对齐方法，能有效解耦吞吐增益与性能惩罚，是动态稀疏MoE推理的实用方案。

title: Talking to Itself While Coding: What Makes Comments Help Code Generation?
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate natural-language comments while writing code, and these comments become part of the context used to generate the code that follows. However, it remains unclear which properties of comments affect code-generation performance. We study this question through observational analyses and controlled interventions. On LiveCodeBench, neither comment frequency nor broad comment intent reliably predicts pass@1. We then prefill weaker recipient models with comment blocks written by stronger source models, allowing us to separate comment surface form from the solution content they convey. Comments from source solutions that pass the tests raise recipient pass@1 by 17.2% on average. In contrast, comments describing failed solutions provide no reliable gain, while comments written for a different problem reduce pass@1 by 20.8%. Finally, across a wide range of models and prompt variants, most recipient models show no significant recovery of the external-comment gain, and the best case recovers only 24%. These results show that comments help code generation not merely because they are comments, but because they can provide correct solution content that prompting cannot reliably elicit.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大型语言模型(LLM)在代码生成过程中自我生成的注释(self-emitted comments)如何影响其自身的pass@1性能。通过观察性分析和对照干预实验,发现注释的形式(频率、风格)并不决定代码生成质量,真正起作用的是注释内容是否描述了正确的解题方案;但模型很难通过提示工程自我生成具有正确解题内容的注释。
AI.motivation: LLM在代码生成时会在同一前向传播中同时输出自然语言注释和代码,这些注释成为模型后续生成代码的上下文。然而,注释的哪些属性(表面形式、意图、顺序、内容正确性)真正影响代码生成性能尚不清楚。这对理解LLM内部工作机制和设计更好的提示策略具有重要意义。
AI.method: 研究采用两阶段方法:(1)在LiveCodeBench上对88个模型进行观察性分析,测量注释的表面形式(注释token占比、PEP-8分类)和意图(WHY/WHAT分类)与pass@1的相关性;(2)设计对照干预实验:用较弱"接收模型"配合较强"源模型"生成的注释块,通过控制变量分离注释的不同属性——包括source-correct(正确内容)、source-wrong(错误内容)、shuffled(打乱顺序)、wrong-topic(不同主题)、random-text(随机文本)。进一步在14个模型上测试10种提示变体是否能复现外部注释的提升效果,并在RepoClassBench上对C#和Java进行泛化验证。
AI.result: 主要发现:(1)注释的表面形式和意图与pass@1无可靠相关性(88个模型中tok-cmt%跨度达700倍但pass@1相近);(2)正确的注释内容使接收模型pass@1平均提升17.2%(12对模型全部Holm显著),错误内容无提升,错误主题使pass@1下降20.8%,随机文本下降17.9%;(3)顺序打乱后仍保留68%的提升效果,说明注释作用类似局部提示;(4)14个模型×10种提示变体的网格实验中,自提示最多恢复24%的外部注释增益,且同一提示对不同模型效果方向相反;(5)在RepoClassBench的C#和Java仓库级任务上结论一致。结论:注释帮助代码生成是因为其内容承载了正确的解题信息,这一信息无法通过提示可靠地从模型自身引出。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出核心结论:LLM在代码生成时"自言自语"(写注释)的价值不在于注释本身的形式或意图,而在于注释内容是否描述了正确的解题方案。正确的内容注释可使弱模型pass@1平均提升17.2%,但这一增益仅在由更强的外部模型提供时才显著——弱模型难以通过提示工程自我生成具有正确解题内容的注释。因此,实践上建议:(1)用none-vs-base对比快速检测模型对注释的依赖;(2)根据模型特性定制注释策略,因为抑制注释可能造成高达14.5%的性能损失;(3)要弥合这一差距,未来需要训练时方法而非提示工程。

title: DiffLUT-Net: Differentiable Training of FPGA LUT Networks with Learnable Connectivity
summary: Field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) enable efficient neural-network inference, but most deployment flows either accelerate multiply-accumulate operations or convert pretrained quantized models into lookup tables (LUTs). We present DiffLUT-Net, an FPGA-native network connected by six-input LUTs that are trained from scratch. We jointly learn the 64 truth-table entries of a LUT and the source to each of its six input ports using a differentiable LUT function relaxation and hardware source selection. After training, the truth tables and connections are discretized, unused logic can be pruned, and the network is exported directly as synthesizable Verilog. Across five benchmarks, DiffLUT-Net achieves favorable accuracy-resource trade-offs. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly learning LUT functions and sparse connectivity for compact FPGA-native inference. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: DiffLUT-Net 是一种 FPGA 原生神经网络，其基本单元为六输入查找表（LUT），通过可微 LUT 函数松弛与硬件源选择联合训练 64 个真值表条目与六个输入端口的连接，可直接导出为可综合 Verilog，在五个基准上实现了精度与资源的良好折中。
AI.motivation: 现有 FPGA 推理部署方法要么仅加速乘累加（MAC）运算，要么将预训练量化模型转换为 LUT 网络，未能从训练阶段就联合学习 LUT 真值表内容与稀疏拓扑，从而限制了 FPGA 原生实现的精度-资源效率。
AI.method: DiffLUT-Net 将网络构建为六输入 LUT 的有向无环图，通过可微 LUT 函数松弛使 64 个真值表条目可端到端梯度学习，并采用硬件源选择机制学习每个 LUT 六个输入端口的稀疏连接。训练完成后将真值表与连接离散化、剪枝未使用逻辑，并导出为可综合 Verilog。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试上，DiffLUT-Net 相对于已有方法取得了更有利的精度-资源权衡，验证了联合学习 LUT 真值表与稀疏连接对于紧凑型 FPGA 原生推理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化 LUT 真值表内容与稀疏拓扑，能够生成可直接综合的高效 FPGA 原生网络，为紧凑、可部署的 FPGA 推理提供了一条新路径。

title: Smart Adaptive Computing Across the Continuum: LLMs in IoT-Edge-Cloud Resource Management
comment: This is the Accepted Manuscript, after peer review, not the Version of Record; no post-acceptance changes. Presented at FRAME 2026 (Euro-Par 2026). Subject to Springer's AM terms of use: this https URL
summary: Managing resources across IoT, edge, and cloud layers calls for continuous, context-aware decisions under constraints that rarely stay fixed. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) handles this class of problems well, and large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to augment DRL pipelines, yet the architectural relationship between the two is seldom made explicit. We build on Wang et al.'s taxonomy of Continuum Orchestration Systems employing DRL techniques and extend it with two further dimensions. The AI Augmentation Paradigm measures how LLMs are exploited, while the Feedback channel captures whether and through which system path the execution feedback returns to the LLM in order to close the MAPE control loop at the LLM Orchestration layer. We apply this taxonomy to six recent system architectures and find a common gap, as none combines full LLM orchestration with full agent-layer feedback in a Cloud Continuum setting. We relate this gap to a missing cross-tier feedback abstraction, bridging the incommensurable per-tier signals and the LLM Orchestrator.

AI.tldr: 本文针对物联网-边缘-云资源管理中LLM与DRL的架构关系不明确的问题，扩展了Wang等人基于DRL的连续体编排分类法，新增"AI增强范式"和"反馈通道"两个维度。通过对六个近期系统的分析，发现当前研究存在一个共同空白：无系统能够在云连续体环境中实现LLM编排与智能体层反馈的完整结合，并归因于缺失跨层级反馈抽象机制。
AI.motivation: DRL虽擅长处理云连续体中连续、上下文感知的资源管理决策，但其策略可解释性差、难以处理自然语言意图和安全约束。LLM虽能弥补这些不足，但在DRL+LLM的混合架构中，二者的架构关系（LLM是直接决策者、编排者还是闭环编排者）以及反馈机制设计仍缺乏系统性分类与明确指导。本文旨在填补这一架构关系层面的研究空白。
AI.method: 1) 在Wang等人"控制范围(SARL/MARL)×训练范式(标准/联邦)"二维分类法基础上，新增两个维度：AI增强范式（LLM0纯DRL、LLM1直接LLM决策者、LLM2 LLM编排者）和反馈通道（F0无反馈、F1平台直接反馈、F2子智能体反馈、F3专用中介反馈）。2) 设计通用参考架构（图1a），定义编排层（LLM）、智能体层、环境层三层的抽象关系。3) 将六个近期系统（AgentEdge、IntentContinuum、SALLMA、Habib et al.、CyberOps-Bots、AURA）映射至扩展分类法中进行对比分析。4) 基于分析结果识别架构空白并提出中介组件设计方案。
AI.result: 分类结果：六个系统中，三个为LLM1级（AgentEdge为F0、IntentContinuum和SALLMA为F1），三个为LLM2级（Habib et al.为F0、CyberOps-Bots为F2、AURA为F3）。关键发现：i) 仅AURA(F3)和CyberOps-Bots(F2)在智能体层闭合反馈环路；ii) 这两个系统均局限于单一部署层级，未涉及云连续体的多层级异构性；iii) 无系统同时实现LLM编排+联邦训练的组合。具体挑战：延迟失配（LLM推理开销使其无法放入关键控制路径）、LLM调用成本（以Claude Sonnet 4为例，每周期约0.05美元，按控制频率可每日达数百美元）、反馈抽象缺失（不同层级信号不可比）。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出：连续体中LLM2级闭环编排的关键缺口不在于技术不可行，而在于缺少跨层级反馈抽象。解决方案是引入Mediator中介组件，将AURA中集中式对齐控制器(CAC)的角色从单层级扩展为跨层级，将异构的层级专属信号整合为结构化表示，使编排器能够判断哪个层级或策略需要调整。该中介与被评估的智能体保持架构分离，从而将反馈通道定位于F3。未来研究方向包括将该方案应用于LLM2-MA-Standard云连续体，以及将分类法扩展至分布式联邦学习和持续学习的智能体层。

title: Auditable Emergency Triage for Maternal and Newborn Care in India
summary: At Noora Health, our nurses answer more than 50,000 medical queries per month on our WhatsApp-based service that provides caregivers with on-demand support. Their most time-critical task is emergency triage: deciding which queries need immediate in-person attention. To support them, we built a system that uses a large language model (LLM) to classify whether a message is an emergency and provide a rationale for interpretability. But the system was opaque: analyzing mistakes meant reading reasoning chains for each message, which is infeasible at our scale. Prompt changes meant re-running a full evaluation to prevent regressions, which was both costly and operationally challenging. Clinicians follow a decision tree to make this call, but it was never documented or passed to the model, which relied on a flat list of danger signs. To address these issues, we decomposed triage into two steps: an LLM extracts canonical symptoms and patient context from the query using a clinician-authored vocabulary, and a deterministic rule engine captures the scenarios that indicate an emergency. We show that the new system raised recall from 0.565 to 0.810 and F1 from 0.606 to 0.702, with structured rules driving most of the accuracy gains while the decomposition provides auditability: clinical experts can inspect each stage of the new system to see whether the query was mistranslated, symptoms were incorrectly extracted, patient context was wrongly inferred, or the necessary rules were missing. They can add new rules independently without causing regressions and avoid running costly evaluations. Since deployment, the new system has triaged 152,421 patient queries and flagged 28,535 (18.7%) as emergencies. The over-escalation rate has been 17.8%, without any increase in missed emergencies. Clinicians have also added 48 new rules since deployment, evidence of the faster correction loop we set out to build.

AI.tldr: Noora Health部署了TRACE系统，将基于LLM的急诊分诊重构为两阶段架构：LLM负责从多语言患者咨询中提取规范化症状和患者上下文，确定性规则引擎（由临床医生管理）负责最终的急诊判定。该系统在保持高召回率的同时提供了完整的可审计性。
AI.motivation: Noora Health的WhatsApp服务每月处理超过50,000条医疗咨询，其中急诊分诊是最紧迫的任务。原有的端到端LLM系统存在三个核心问题：(1) 不透明——分析错误需要逐条阅读LLM推理链，无法规模化；(2) 任何提示词修改都需要重新运行完整评估以防止性能回归，成本高昂且需要多团队协调；(3) 模型使用扁平的危险症状列表，未反映临床医生实际使用的、结合患者上下文的决策树。论文动机源于一个观察：在低资源、多语言、多方言混合的印度母婴医疗场景中，单纯优化模型无法解决根本问题，需要重新设计流程，使临床专家能够独立审计和修改系统。
AI.method: TRACE（Triage by Rule-based Application on Context-aware Extractions）采用两阶段分解架构。第一阶段使用LLM（Gemini-2.5-Flash）完成两个子任务：(a) 将七种语言的查询（含罗马化印地语等代码混合文本）翻译为英文；(b) 基于临床医生策展的745条患者表述映射到184个规范化症状的词汇表，提取查询中的规范化症状和患者上下文（如孕期、婴儿年龄）。第二阶段使用由临床团队维护的确定性规则引擎（141条独立规则 + 90条组合规则，共231条），结合护理类别和患者档案做出急诊判定。规则分为独立型（如惊厥直接判为急诊）和组合型（如腹痛+阴道出血=急诊；胎儿活动减少仅在孕中2-3期为急诊）。系统正式定义为输入三元组(m, c, P)映射到输出y∈{emergency, non-emergency}。实验采用四组消融对比：LLM-KB（基线，端到端LLM + 危险症状列表）、LLM-Rules（端到端LLM + 结构化规则）、TRACE-NoCtx（TRACE架构但不含上下文推断）、完整TRACE。数据集为769条真实患者咨询（251条急诊），由两位内部临床医生独立标注，以高级临床医生的标签为准。
AI.result: 在427条测试集上，TRACE将召回率从基线LLM-KB的0.565提升至0.810，F1分数从0.606提升至0.702。消融研究表明：(1) 将危险症状列表替换为结构化规则（LLM-Rules）即可将召回率从0.565提升至0.837、F1提升至0.689，说明规则化是主要精度驱动力；(2) 完整的分解架构（TRACE）与LLM-Rules在召回率和F1上无统计学显著差异（置信区间重叠），但提供了可审计性；(3) 上下文推断未带来可测量的性能增益。TRACE的中位延迟为2.55秒，略快于LLM-Rules（2.72秒），但成本是LLM-Rules的1.5倍。错误分析展示了系统如何将每个错误归因到具体环节：翻译错误、症状提取错误、上下文推断错误、或规则缺失，每个环节都有明确责任人。自部署以来，TRACE已对152,421条患者咨询进行分诊，标记28,535条（18.7%）为急诊，过度升级率为17.8%，未出现漏诊急诊增加，临床医生已独立添加了48条新规则。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出两个层面的结论。技术层面：将临床决策与语言理解解耦的分解架构在医疗急诊分诊场景中具有实践价值，确定性规则引擎不仅能保持性能，还能提供完整的可审计性——每个决策都可追溯到具体规则、症状提取或翻译步骤。流程层面：对于领域特定的AI解决方案，更重要的是模拟领域专家的工作方式而非优化模型本身；正确的流程设计应赋予领域专家对生产质量的自主权，使其能够审计问题、追踪错误到具体组件，并在无摩擦的情况下独立修正问题。这条经验超越了具体技术选择，对在低资源环境中部署高风险AI系统具有广泛参考意义。

title: Edu-QuRating: Multi-Dimensional Educational Data Curation with Distilled Pairwise Judgements
summary: Educational data filters have become a practical way to improve language-model pre-training, but most filters treat educational value as a single scalar property. This may be too broad for some applications, especially if the data set already features a high density of educational material. Useful learning material needs to be accurate, engaging, well structured, and appropriate for the intended audience and application (e.g. learner- vs teacher-facing). Following QuRating (Wettig et al. 2024), we introduce Edu-QuRating: a pipeline for multi-dimensional educational data scoring and curation. Edu-QuRating defines education-specific rubrics, uses an LLM judge to label sampled document pairs and distills those pairwise preferences into reusable Edu-QuRaters, which can score individual text chunks on a set of educational criteria. Across two sequence-classification base models and six educational criteria, the best Edu-QuRater recovers held-out GPT-4.1-mini pairwise judgements with mean accuracy 0.917. We then apply the resulting scorers in two applications. First, we investigate the potential of Edu-QuRaters for corpus filtering to improve pretraining of small language models. We scored 322.25M FineWeb-Edu-Fortified documents to obtain a filtered pre-training mixture. In matched single-run pre-training comparisons, models trained with Edu-QuRating-based mixtures reached higher observed aggregate accuracy across nine benchmarks than the FineWeb-Edu baseline, with gains concentrated in particular tasks. Second, we used Edu-QuRater scores as reward terms for GRPO post-training. In held-out pairwise judge evaluations, combining Edu-QuRater and answer-structure rewards produced responses preferred to the Qwen3-4B base model on both pedagogical quality and instruction following.

AI.tldr: Edu-QuRating 是一个多维度教育数据策展流水线，通过蒸馏 LLM 对文本对的成对偏好判断，训练出可重用的 Edu-QuRater 评分器，对教育文本在多个教育维度上打分。它在预训练数据过滤和 GRPO 后训练奖励两个下游应用中均显示出效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的教育数据过滤器（如 FineWeb-Edu）将"教育价值"视为单一标量属性，这过于粗糙。教育内容需要具备准确性、吸引力、结构合理性和适合目标受众等多个维度，简单的标量过滤难以满足精细化教育应用的需求。
AI.method: 1. 定义三套教育评分维度：核心教育质量（6维）、学生面向基础素养（7维）、教师面向基础素养（7维），共20个输出维度。2. 从 FineWeb-Edu-Fortified 中采样文档对，使用 GPT-4.1-mini 作为 LLM 法官，通过单次推理读取 A/B token 的相对概率生成软标签偏好，将 LLM 调用次数减少20倍。3. 使用神经 Bradley-Terry 目标训练序列分类模型（Sheared-LLaMA-1.3B 或 Gemma-3-4B-PT），将成对偏好蒸馏为单文本评分器。4. 在322.25M文档上应用评分器进行预训练语料过滤（采用事实准确性、课程吸引力、教学结构三维度的50-50-50百分位合取规则）。5. 将评分器作为 GRPO 后训练的奖励函数用于教育响应的微调。
AI.result: 1. 在保留测试集上，最佳 Edu-QuRater（Gemma-3-4B-PT）恢复 GPT-4.1-mini 成对偏好的平均准确率达到0.917。2. 验证损失在200k成对样本后趋于饱和（0.245），增加更多样本收益很小。3. 预训练实验中，所有 Edu-QuRating 过滤的数据混合在九项基准测试上均高于 FineWeb-Edu 基线（基线0.3806，50-50-50为0.3903，严格教学法为0.3962，混合 DCLM 为0.3961），增益集中在 ARC-CF 和 HellaSwag 等特定任务上。4. GRPO 后训练中，Edu-QuRater 与答案结构奖励结合产生最高教学质量胜率（81.08%）和高于基线的指令跟随胜率（68.24%），优于单一奖励配置。
AI.conclusion: Edu-QuRating 证明了多维度教育评分框架的可行性，能有效将 LLM 偏好判断蒸馏为可扩展的评分器，并在预训练数据过滤和奖励建模两个应用中均带来改进。这为基于教育标准的系统性内容策展提供了方法论基础，特别适用于教育资源稀缺的低中收入国家场景。但存在以下局限：评分器受限于上游语料覆盖；预训练实验每种混合仅一次运行；GRPO 评估规模较小；尚未在真实课堂环境中验证效果。

title: SCCM : Stream Cruise Control Method for Automated Drift Detection and Adaptation
summary: Real-world datasets often exhibit evolving distributions, known as concept drift. Ignoring drift degrades predictive performance, while reliance on fixed hyperparameters further limits model adaptability under changing conditions. Adaptive learning addresses this challenge by continuously updating models online, allowing them to incrementally adjust and remain effective as data distributions evolve. This paper presents the Stream Cruise Control Method (SCCM), a comprehensive framework for drift detection and adaptation in online regression. SCCM enables automated adaptation through early-response, pre-update drift detection, drift magnitude quantification, KPI-window-based thresholding for local false-alarm mitigation, dynamic hyperparameter tuning, and model recalibration. SCCM also adopts an in-memory design for real-time adaptability, unlike purely reactive methods that typically activate adaptation only after performance degradation is observed. By using dynamic thresholding and remaining agnostic to data distributions, SCCM supports KPI-based monitoring across varying data streams, including high-dimensional and large-scale settings. SCCM is integrated with four online regression models and evaluated on 18 synthetic datasets covering abrupt, incremental, and alternating gradual drift, together with eight real-world datasets. The evaluation uses both R2 and MSE and compares against eight detector--adaptation baselines. Results show improved predictive performance and effective drift handling across the evaluated online regression settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SCCM（Stream Cruise Control Method）的在线回归框架，用于自动化概念漂移检测与自适应。该框架通过预更新控制层集成KPI窗口监测、CFAR启发式自适应阈值、漂移幅度量化、比例化超参数调整及有界重校准，在18个合成数据集和8个真实数据集上显著优于8种基于ADWIN/KSWIN的检测器-适应基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有漂移检测方法存在三大核心缺陷：(1) 反应式检测导致显著检测延迟，模型在适应前已处理大量漂移后数据；(2) 检测器仅提供二值化漂移判定，缺乏漂移幅度估计；(3) 检测、适应与超参数调优相互解耦，无法实现及时且成比例的模型更新。集成方法虽具鲁棒性但计算开销大，难以满足高流速、资源受限场景需求。
AI.method: SCCM作为模型无关的元自适应预更新控制层，在模型更新前对每个传入实例执行以下操作：(1) 基于有界KPI窗口（KPI-Win）维护近期预测性能统计；(2) 利用CFAR启发的局部阈值机制τ=z·σ（z=Φ⁻¹(1-ρ)）进行漂移检测，并设置安全带ζ抑制误报；(3) 计算漂移幅度DM并将其划分为稳定/渐进/突变三等级；(4) 通过scale-map机制将漂移幅度映射为有界、模型特定的超参数调整（如OLR-WA的α、RLS的遗忘因子λ、PA的C）；(5) 当突变漂移在超参数调整后仍持续时，执行有界重校准（使用3-5个额外样本）。整个过程为内存驻留设计，无固定阈值，对数据分布无假设。
AI.result: 在18个合成数据集（突发、渐进、交替渐变三类漂移，各6个）与8个真实数据集（涵盖医疗、金融、能源、环境、海洋、零售等领域，数据规模从1k到814k，维度从4到145）上，SCCM与四种在线回归模型（OLR-WA、PA、RLS、LMS）集成后：(1) 预测性能：在合成流上MSE相对最强基线降低68.1%-88.3%，真实数据集上OLR-WA的R²提升0.0407，PA/RLS/LMS的MSE降低71.1%-77.8%，所有改进经Wilcoxon符号秩检验+Holm校正后均显著（p<10⁻³，秩双列相关系数+0.58至+1.00）；(2) 漂移检测：合成流上F₁分数显著优于ADWIN和KSWIN（增量漂移F₁=0.93 vs 基线0.09-0.14，交替渐变F₁=0.97 vs 基线0.14-0.20），检测延迟从5+个增量降至<1个增量；(3) 计算开销：5.68 ms/1k样本（vs 独立学习器3.72 ms），峰值内存4.35 MB，低于WINDOW/SSPT/OHL配置。
AI.conclusion: SCCM是首个面向在线回归的统一预更新漂移处理框架，通过将检测、幅度量化、比例化超参数控制与有界重校准集成于单一控制回路，克服了传统检测-适应管线的延迟与解耦问题，其实用性、可扩展性和模型无关性在广泛的合成与真实场景中得到了充分验证。

title: Efficient Leakage-Free Neural Architecture Search under Leave-One-Subject-Out Evaluation
summary: Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) evaluation estimates generalisation performance for subject-based classification but makes Neural Architecture Search (NAS) computationally expensive because a fully nested implementation requires N independent architecture searches and, assuming approximately linear training cost, scales as O(N^2). We propose a leakage-free, block-based approach that shares NAS runs across subjects. On the BioVid Heat Pain dataset, our approach increased the mean accuracy from 82.79% to 83.39% while reducing the number of parameters by up to 99.2%.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于分块的无数据泄漏NAS方法，通过在LOSO评估中跨被试共享架构搜索，将BioVid热痛数据集上的早融合基线准确率从82.79%提升至83.39%，参数量减少最高达99.2%，运行时长从约90小时降至约12小时。
AI.motivation: 在基于被试的分类任务中，留一被出（LOSO）评估是衡量泛化性能的标准方法。然而，由于完全嵌套实现需要对N个被试各自独立执行一次NAS，训练成本近似线性时总复杂度达O(N²)，计算开销极大，阻碍了NAS在生理信号分类中的实际应用。
AI.method: 将N个被试划分为B个不相交的外层块；对每个外层块b，排除该块后在其余被试上通过K折被试不相交的内层交叉验证评估候选架构，使用基于均值准确率减去β倍标准误差的选择准则J_b(a)（β=1.0）；用Optuna的TPE采样器执行NAS，选出每块最优架构a_b*；随后用全部非目标被试数据重新训练并在被排除的目标被试j上一次性评估。NAS次数从N次降为B次。
AI.result: 在BioVid热痛二分类（无痛vs.痛）任务上，使用5个外层块和3折内层划分，5次NAS替代了原本87次独立搜索；早融合（EF）准确率从Thiam等人2019年的82.79%提升至83.39%，参数量从7.7M降至61.4k至1.79M（压缩76.7%~99.2%），完整流程在Google Colab L4 GPU上从约90小时降至约12小时。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了LOSO设置下计算可行的NAS，在提升准确率的同时大幅压缩模型规模和运行时间；局限在于架构组件及其参数量方差较大；未来工作包括研究部署架构选择、多分类任务表现、对晚融合架构的适用性，以及在情感计算等其他LOSO分类问题上的推广。

title: From Fixed Keys to Readable Schemas: Small Language Models for Vehicle Agent Function Calls
summary: In-vehicle assistants must translate natural-language requests into accurate vehicle function calls under strict memory and latency constraints, making small language models (SLMs) attractive for on-device deployment. For such models, a key design choice is how the available function surface is presented. Two approaches are to represent each function with a dedicated Functional Token (FT) or provide function schemas directly in the prompt. FTs enable compact inference but are restricted to functions learned during training, whereas Schema-in-Prompt (SIP) can generalize to unseen functions at the cost of longer prompts and higher inference overhead. We introduce a benchmark of 9,822 single-turn examples spanning 79 vehicle functions derived from Android Automotive, including held-out functions and requests requiring refusal. We compare both approaches under matched fine-tuning across four SLMs from 270M to 1.7B parameters. On functions seen during training, scaling provides limited benefit: the 270M model can match the 1.7B model, while the strongest overall performance occurs at 0.6B. On held-out functions, FT achieves zero accuracy by construction, whereas SIP generalizes and improves substantially with scale. On out-of-scope requests, FT can invoke an unavailable function it was trained to emit, while SIP more reliably refuses based on the functions offered. This flexibility comes with higher memory use and latency. Our theoretical analysis explains how SIP enables generalization and why longer schema contexts increase inference cost. Overall, function-surface representation, rather than model scale alone, determines the capabilities and failure modes of SLM-based vehicle function calling.

AI.tldr: 本文针对车载SLM代理的功能调用场景，系统比较了两种函数表面表示方式（Functional Token与Schema-in-Prompt），基于Android Automotive构建了9,822条基准测试，在270M至1.7B参数的四个SLM上进行了匹配微调对比实验，并从理论上解释了泛化机制及延迟-内存权衡。
AI.motivation: 车载助手需在严格内存和延迟约束下将自然语言请求映射为车辆功能调用，但可用函数表面在不同车型、年款和配置间会变化。对于适合设备端部署的小型语言模型（SLM），如何向模型呈现可用函数表面是一个关键设计选择，直接影响泛化能力、拒绝能力和部署成本。
AI.method: 1. 基于Android Automotive VehiclePropertyIds构建单轮函数调用基准（9,822样本，79个车辆函数），分为Seen（训练目标）、Unseen（保留目标）和Out-of-Scope（需拒绝）三部分；2. 比较Functional Token（FT，为每个函数分配专用词汇token）和Schema-in-Prompt（SIP，在prompt中提供函数schema）两种表示；3. 在Gemma 3-270M、FunctionGemma-270M、Qwen3-0.6B和Qwen3-1.7B四个SLM上进行匹配微调对比，每个配置训练3个种子；4. 理论分析任务级输出支持差异、schema介导的泛化机制及推理成本；5. 在Device Proxy上测量延迟和内存。
AI.result: 1. Seen函数上：FT和SIP表现相似且接近饱和，270M即可匹敌1.7B，最佳表现出现在0.6B；2. Unseen函数上：FT因构造原因准确率为零，Qwen3-1.7B的SIP达到84.1%准确率，泛化能力随规模显著提升；3. Out-of-Scope请求上：SIP正确拒绝率显著高于FT，尤其当不可用函数存在训练token时（FT仅有2.9-5.1%拒绝率 vs SIP的81-93%）；4. 部署成本上：SIP的Device Proxy首次调用时间是FT的26-98倍，峰值内存是2.4-4.2倍，额外增加1,785-1,905 prompt tokens。
AI.conclusion: 函数表面表示方式（而非单纯的模型规模）决定了基于SLM的车载功能调用的能力和失败模式。FT适合函数表面稳定且推理约束严格的场景，SIP适合需在不修改学习输出表示的情况下适应函数变化的系统。未来工作应扩展到自然驾驶请求、多语言、多轮交互以及车载硬件上的测量。

title: A Statistical Approach to Estimating Sample Size of Machine Learning Models
summary: Sample size determination for machine learning (ML) prediction models is challenging because conventional power analysis typically requires the predictor-outcome relationship and effect structure to be specified a priori. Nonlinear ML models learn complex prediction surfaces that do not admit straightforward analytical power calculations. We propose a framework that approximates nonlinear ML models with localized linear representations and estimates sample size requirements by evaluating statistical power across these local regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于ReLU网络的局部线性化框架，用于估计非线性机器学习预测模型的样本量。通过将复杂预测面分解为多个多面体线性区域，在各区域内计算经典F检验统计功效，并以体积加权覆盖率作为全局聚合指标来确定所需样本量。在合成数据集和UCI真实数据集上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于参数统计模型（如线性回归）的样本量计算方法依赖于预先指定的函数形式和全局效应结构，无法直接适用于支持向量机、随机森林、神经网络等具有复杂非线性预测面的机器学习模型。现有数据驱动的样本量评估方法（如Rajput的经验指南、Ghasemzadeh的模拟框架、Riley的过拟合控制）多为全局标准，未考虑特征空间不同区域效应大小的异质性。临床研究中机器学习模型常因样本量不足和验证程序不当而受限。因此亟需一种连接机器学习灵活性与传统统计功效分析的样本量确定框架。
AI.method: 方法包含四个阶段：(1) 基模型拟合——在先导数据上训练任意非线性ML模型得到参考预测面f_base；(2) ReLU代理近似——训练带ReLU激活的前馈神经网络f_ReLU逼近f_base，因ReLU的连续分段线性特性，特征域被划分为有限个凸多面体线性区域K={R_1,...,R_L}；(3) 局部线性化与功效计算——在每个区域R_l内计算局部决定系数R_l²和Cohen效应量f_l²，通过效应量阈值τ_{R²}过滤低信息区域形成活跃集K_a，利用非中心F分布计算局部功效π_l(n_l)，其中非中心参数λ_l=n_l·R_l²/(1-R_l²)，局部样本量分配n_l=N·p_l（p_l为区域概率质量）；(4) 全局优化——定义体积加权覆盖率功效Power_vol(N;β)=ΣV_l·I(π_l(Np_l)≥1-β)/ΣV_l，以各区域几何体积V_l为权重，所需样本量N̂为满足Power_vol(N;β)≥γ的最小N值。补充材料将框架推广至多变量逻辑回归，采用大样本正态近似结合局部方差膨胀因子（VIF_l）计算二分类结局的功效。
AI.result: 合成实验覆盖维度d∈{2,3,4,6}和节点密度K∈{2,5,7,13}，目标覆盖阈值γ=0.90、局部功效1-β=0.80。结果显示：(1) 效应量阈值τ_{R²}从0.02升至0.26时，所需样本量N̂系统性降低，如d=2,K=2的RF配置从252降至156；(2) 结构复杂度（节点密度K）增加导致N̂增大，如d=2 RF在τ=0.26下N̂从156(K=2)增至2075(K=13)；(3) 不同架构（RF、SVM、MLP）因特征空间划分方式不同导致N̂差异，MLP在Concrete数据集上N̂最小（6206），SVM在Abalone数据集上最大（约50000）。UCI真实数据集（Abalone、Concrete、Liver Disorders）验证中，采用GMM近似特征密度，γ=0.80，各数据集/架构组合下经验覆盖率均收敛至约0.80，方差较小。逻辑回归扩展在各CPWL配置下也表现出稳定的样本量估计与覆盖率收敛。局限性包括：依赖特征密度估计（GMM在高维稀疏区域可能误设）、高维下ReLU区域数量爆炸导致计算可扩展性问题。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过ReLU网络的分段线性特性将非线性预测面分解为多面体区域，实现了局部功效计算与体积加权全局聚合的结合，扩展了经典功效分析至非线性机器学习预测场景。合成与实证评估表明该方法能产生内部一致的样本量估计，反映拟合预测面的结构特征（效应量异质性与区域碎片化）。该方法不替代传统功效分析，而是作为其在非线性预测场景中的补充工具。未来工作将聚焦于改进密度估计方法、提高高维可扩展性，并拓展至生存分析等时间-事件终点模型。

title: The Vibe Shift in Software Engineering: Evaluating AI-Led Conversational Programming for Performance, Cognition, and Responsible Adoption
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables, Published by International Journal on Advanced Science, Engineering and Information Technology (IJASEIT)
summary: This study evaluates Vibe Coding, an emerging AI-led conversational programming paradigm that enables developers to generate software through natural-language interaction with large language models. Using a mixed-methods design, the study assessed performance efficiency, cognitive implications, and responsible adoption in comparison with traditional and AI-assisted coding environments. Thirty participants, including professional developers and advanced computing students, completed equivalent programming tasks under three experimental conditions. Quantitative data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and repeated-measures ANOVA, while qualitative data were examined through thematic analysis. Results show that vibe coding significantly improved development efficiency, reducing task completion time by 27% compared with traditional coding and 12% compared with AI-assisted coding. However, these gains were accompanied by lower maintainability indices and higher security vulnerabilities, indicating trade-offs in software quality. Usability results yielded a good rating (SUS = 71.4), while cognitive workload remained moderate (NASA-TLX = 55.5), reflecting reduced syntactic effort but increased linguistic reasoning. Thematic analysis identified trust calibration, loss of control, cognitive adaptation, and prompt-engineering strategy as key constructs. Notably, perceived loss of control was associated with increased security risks due to reduced transparency and validation of AI-generated outputs. Based on these findings, the study proposes a three-pillar framework for responsible adoption: hybrid integration of human and AI capabilities, human oversight and transparent accountability, and context-aware deployment. Overall, vibe coding enhances productivity but requires critical oversight, reinforcing its role as a transformative yet transitional paradigm in software development.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了 Vibe Coding（基于自然语言与大型语言模型交互生成软件的 AI 主导对话式编程范式），通过混合方法设计，比较其与传统编程和 AI 辅助编程在开发效率、认知影响和负责任采用方面的差异。
AI.motivation: Vibe Coding 作为一种新兴编程范式快速发展，但其在软件质量、可维护性、安全性和认知影响方面的权衡尚不明确，亟需实证研究来评估其有效性与负责任采用路径。
AI.method: 采用混合方法设计：30 名专业开发者与高级计算机专业学生在三种实验条件下（传统编程、AI 辅助编程、Vibe Coding）完成等效编程任务。定量数据采用描述性统计和重复测量 ANOVA 分析，定性数据采用主题分析法。评估工具包括系统可用性量表（SUS）和 NASA-TLX 认知负荷量表。
AI.result: Vibe Coding 显著提升开发效率，任务完成时间比传统编程减少 27%，比 AI 辅助编程减少 12%。但可维护性指数降低，安全漏洞增加。可用性良好（SUS=71.4），认知负荷中等（NASA-TLX=55.5）。主题分析识别出信任校准、控制感丧失、认知适应和提示工程策略四个核心构念，且控制感丧失与安全风险增加相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出负责任采用的三支柱框架：人机能力的混合集成、人类监督与透明问责、情境感知部署。Vibe Coding 虽增强生产力但需批判性监督，仍是软件开发中变革性但过渡性的范式。

title: Teacher Geometry Shapes Learnability in Teacher-Student Networks
summary: Teacher-student systems, in which a teacher neural network generates training labels so that a student neural network can learn to implement the same function, are widely used as an abstract setting to study learning. However, the structure of the teachers is often overlooked by assuming randomly-generated, normally-distributed parameters. This hides substantial variation in how learnable different teachers are. We formalize learnability as the success rate of converging to the global minimum, as a function of overparameterization, learning algorithm, student initialization distribution, and teacher geometry. We both identify an easy distribution that maximizes node dissimilarity and a hard distribution that minimizes it, and show that these two distributions induce markedly different success rates across a large range of settings and for different activation functions. To explain the gap, we study the loss landscape of small neural networks that contain two distinct kinds of suboptimal local minima, out-of-bounds (OOB) minima at the edge of the data distribution and interior minima within. Assuming infinite data and a fast readout layer, we analytically reduce the loss landscape of small networks to two dimensions, showing that the region of attraction of interior minima changes as a function of teacher structure. In larger networks, maximally dissimilar teachers induce more interior minima, while minimally dissimilar teachers induce more OOB minima. Motivated by these analyses, we show that differentially increasing the learning rate of the readout layer and decreasing the learning rate of the inner biases increases success rates. These findings provide an important step in narrowing the gap between the study of teacher-student networks and more structured functions that arise in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文研究教师-学生神经网络框架中教师网络几何结构对学生学习成功率（learnability）的影响。作者发现传统研究中常用的正态分布教师参数掩盖了不同教师之间的巨大难度差异，并通过定义三种具有不同节点相似度的教师分布（最大差异、标准、最小差异），系统性地揭示了教师几何结构如何通过影响损失景观中局部极小值的类型与数量来显著改变学生网络的收敛成功率。
AI.motivation: 在理论研究中，教师-学生设置通常假设教师参数服从正态分布，这隐藏了不同教师之间显著的可学习性差异。本文希望填补这一空白，系统性地研究教师几何结构如何影响学生网络通过梯度优化找到全局最小值的概率，从而缩小理论与实际应用之间的差距。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 定义三种教师分布——最大差异分布（节点权重向量尽可能分散且读出权重均衡分配正负）、最小差异分布（节点权重集中在同一锥形区域内且读出权重相同）以及标准正态分布；(2) 通过训练大量学生网络（50个种子）测量收敛到全局最小值的概率；(3) 在单神经元和双神经元ReLU网络中，通过假设无限数据和快速读出层，将损失景观解析地简化为两个维度；(4) 研究微分学习率（读出层与内部偏置采用不同学习率）对成功率的影响。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 最大差异分布的教师始终具有最高的全局最小值收敛成功率，标准分布居中，最小差异分布最低，这一结论在ReLU、softplus和tanh激活函数下均成立；(2) 损失景观中存在两类次优局部极小值——超出数据范围（OOB）的极小值和内部极小值，最小差异教师导致更多OOB极小值，最大差异教师导致更多内部极小值；(3) 初始教师-学生重叠度与成功率呈正相关，且最大差异分布具有最高的初始重叠度；(4) 提高读出层学习率并降低内部偏置学习率能显著提高所有分布的成功率，主要是通过减少OOB神经元实现。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出结论：教师网络的节点权重分散度（几何结构）是决定学生网络学习难度的关键因素。分散且具有不同读出符号的教师更容易学习，因为标准初始化的学生节点本身具有多样性，能更好地匹配分散的教师特征。这一发现为理解为什么某些函数对神经网络更易学习提供了框架，并提出了一种简单的训练干预措施（微分学习率），可显著提高训练成功率，对实际应用中训练小型网络具有潜在价值。

title: Watermarks Without Verification: AI Text Watermarking After the EU AI Act
summary: On August 2, 2026, the obligations of Article 50 of the EU AI Act took effect, requiring generative AI providers to mark the content their systems produce and ensure it can be detected as AI-generated. Days later, Anthropic disclosed that every Claude model released after that date embeds a watermark based on SynthID-Text in all generated text, enabled by default with no user opt-out; Google has deployed SynthID-Text in Gemini since 2024. Users objected that the watermark degrades quality, particularly for code, that it secretly encodes identifying information, and, in mutual contradiction, that it is easily removable and inescapable; the vendor answered with assurances of unchanged quality, no identifying information, and robustness to light editing. In this work, we argue that neither the objections nor the assurances can currently be verified and that this unverifiability, rather than watermarking itself, is the substantive governance failure. We sort the contested assertions by what it would take to settle each and evaluate the open-source SynthID-Text implementation on two open-weight models, because no public tool can test the deployed systems. On prose, the measured effect of the watermark does not exceed that of changing the sampling seed. On code, the cost is three points of correctness on one model and below measurement on the other, while detection remains near chance, a limitation of detectability rather than quality. The remaining gaps trace to withheld access or missing institutions and we map each to a requirement: release of matched outputs, configuration disclosure, accredited audits, a shared evaluation protocol, and interoperable detection.

AI.tldr: 本文针对2026年8月欧盟AI法案第50条生效后,Anthropic(基于SynthID-Text)对Claude模型默认启用文本水印所引发的公众争议,系统梳理了用户质疑与厂商承诺,认为真正的问题不是水印本身,而是这些主张均无法被独立验证。论文对开源SynthID-Text在两个开源模型上进行了散文与代码的评估,并提出五项制度性要求以弥合验证缺口。
AI.motivation: 欧盟AI法案第50条要求生成式AI对其输出进行机器可读的标记并确保可被检测为AI生成,但当前部署的水印机制缺乏外部验证手段,导致公众在缺乏证据的情况下做出最坏假设,产生了相互矛盾的反对意见(既说水印"易移除"又说"不可逃避")和未经检验的移除工具。文章认为,这种"不可验证性"才是治理失败的实质。
AI.method: 1) 将争议中的各方主张(4项用户质疑、5项厂商承诺、1项厂商承认的局限、2项其他厂商提出的关切)按"验证所需条件"分类为(a)可公开测试、(b)需厂商配合、(c)需新制度。2) 综述水印文献,区分基于失真(distortion-based)与无失真(distortion-free)两族方案。3) 对开源SynthID-Text在Gemma-2-9B与Llama-3.1-8B上进行家族级评估:三臂对比(水印/无水印/种子控制)、500个散文提示与364个编程问题,指标包括困惑度变化、胜率、语义相似度、pass@1正确率及检测AUROC/TPR。4) 将不可验证主张映射为五项具体制度要求。
AI.result: 散文方面:水印对困惑度的影响(-0.3%)不超种子变化(+1.5%);胜率0.501/0.515(近随机);语义相似度与种子控制组差异在0.5%以内。代码方面:Gemma上pass@1差异+0.4点(等价),Llama上-3.1点(置信区间[-6.0,-0.3],小但存在);代码检测AUROC仅0.55-0.57(近乎随机),散文AUROC达0.78-0.82。代码检测弱源于低熵与短长度双重劣势。结论是用户对质量的质疑在家族层面"与证据不成比例",真正的局限在于可检测性而非质量。
AI.conclusion: 水印技术的质量成本已被充分测量且很小,真正的治理失败在于缺乏验证制度。五项要求:(1)厂商发布成对的水印/无水印输出及返回分数的检测器;(2)披露部署配置(失真模式、强度、熵截止阈值);(3)建立经认证的独立审计制度,覆盖密钥管理、检测器校准与争议处理;(4)建立含语言与内容类型细分报告的共享评估协议;(5)建立跨厂商的互操作检测接口及水印与签名元数据的一致性规范。前两项可由单一厂商完成,后三项需要审计机构、协议与多边协调机制。文章判断水印未来走向(可信溯源基础设施 vs. 合规仪式)取决于这些制度能否在公众信任耗尽前到位。

title: Cascading Gradient Inversion via LT-Code Inspired Peeling in Federated Learning
summary: Federated learning shares model updates rather than raw data, yet these updates can be inverted to reconstruct the clients' training data. Analytic reconstruction attacks, which invert a gradient in closed form, degrade as the batch grows: prior single-round attacks recover only about half of a batch of size $100$ even when the attacker fully controls the network parameters, and known upper bounds limit what any such method can recover. We establish a connection between gradient inversion and the theory of erasure-correcting codes, and use it to construct attacks that exceed these bounds. Our attacks recover batches exactly, together with every sample's label, from a single FedSGD round, and certify each recovery without ground-truth data. On eight image and tabular benchmarks they outperform prior single-round attacks by a wide margin. Even a passive attacker who only observes an honestly trained network recovers $94$--$100\%$ of ImageNet batches at sizes up to $128$, more than prior single-round attacks achieve even with active manipulation of the model, and in the active setting more than $90\%$ is recovered at batch sizes of several hundred. These results show that the privacy leakage of federated learning has been underestimated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受LT码（喷泉码）剥离解码器启发的级联式梯度反演攻击方法。该方法通过迭代恢复并从残差梯度中减去被恢复样本的贡献，使得原本非孤立的样本可以变为孤立样本并被恢复，从而突破现有单轮分析型梯度反演攻击在批次大小上的凸包上界限制。作者设计了两种参数操纵方法（Soliton-Free和Soliton-Data），将第一层神经元的激活度分布塑形为鲁棒孤子分布，显著提升恢复率。在八个图像和表格基准数据集上的实验表明，该被动攻击能在批次大小达128时恢复94%–100%的ImageNet批次，主动攻击在批次大小达数百时仍能恢复90%以上样本，且每个恢复均无需地面真相数据即可认证。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习（FL）虽然只共享模型更新而非原始数据，但研究表明这些更新可被反演以重构客户端训练数据，揭示了严重的隐私泄露问题。现有的解析型（analytic）梯度反演攻击（如Boenisch等人提出的CaH攻击）依赖于从第一层梯度中识别"孤立样本"（即仅被单个神经元激活的样本），但这一方法存在根本性限制：能被恢复的样本数量受限于批次凸包的顶点数（由Diana等人证明）。该上界随批次大小增长缓慢，对低维表格数据尤为严格。先前主动攻击在批次大小为100时仅能恢复约一半样本，且已知理论上界限制了任何此类方法的恢复能力。差分隐私和安全聚合等防御手段虽被广泛部署，但安全聚合本身对某些隐私攻击并不充分。因此，有必要突破现有解析攻击的理论上限，重新评估联邦学习的实际隐私泄露风险。
AI.method:
本文建立梯度反演与纠删码理论（特别是Luby变换码/LT码）之间的类比关系。在LT码中，信息比特通过校验比特的随机线性组合编码，剥离解码器通过反复定位度为1的校验节点来迭代恢复信息比特。本文将批次中的B个样本类比为信息比特，将第一层N个神经元类比为校验节点：当某神经元仅被单个未恢复样本激活时（度为1），该样本可通过权重梯度与偏置梯度列值的比值精确恢复。核心创新在于"级联恢复"机制：一旦孤立样本被恢复并从残差梯度中减去（通过一次反向传播计算其梯度并从总梯度中扣除），残差梯度在剩余未恢复样本上仍保持相同的解析形式，可能产生新的度为1神经元，从而触发迭代级联。

为最大化级联长度和成功率，本文进一步控制第一层神经元激活度的分布，使其逼近LT码理论中最优的鲁棒孤子分布（robust soliton distribution）。为此提出两种参数操纵方法：（1）Soliton-Free（SF）：无需辅助数据，基于特征近似均匀分布的假设，利用高斯近似计算预激活的均值和方差，通过设置偏置使每个神经元的激活度等于从鲁棒孤子分布中抽取的目标值；（2）Soliton-Data（SD）：利用一个辅助批次（实验中取自测试集），通过排序辅助样本上的预激活值并精确设置偏置阈值，使辅助批次上的激活度完全等于目标值。

标签恢复方面，本文利用残差偏置与logit对第一层预激活的Jacobian矩阵之间的关系：对每个候选样本，在K个候选标签中搜索使残差拟合误差为零的标签。该拟合过程同时充当真实性认证——无需地面真相数据即可区分真实样本与无效线性组合。级联算法（Algorithm 1）反复执行：计算候选比值、去重、认证、减去已认证样本的贡献，直至无新样本被恢复。

在被动（诚实但好奇）设置下，攻击使用标准随机初始化；在主动（恶意）设置下，可操纵权重和偏置。架构假设仅为：网络以全连接层+ReLU激活开始，其余层任意，使用交叉熵损失。
AI.result:
在八个标准基准数据集（CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、MNIST、EMNIST、Fashion-MNIST、SVHN、ImageNet、HARUS）上的实验使用两层MLP（N=1000个ReLU神经元）和TensorFlow 2.21.0实现。主要结果包括：

1. **被动设置**：在标准随机初始化（无需任何参数操纵）下，攻击在ImageNet、CIFAR-100、CIFAR-10等上在批次大小B=64时恢复率达到94.7%–100%，在B=128时仍保持高恢复率。被动SPEAR++在相同网络宽度下最多只能重构约65个样本且在B=150时失败，而本文方法在B=128被动设置下即可达到此前主动攻击才能实现的水平。

2. **主动设置（Soliton-Data）**：在所有数据集上一致取得最高恢复率。例如在HARUS上，B=512时达到100%恢复，B=1024时仍达34.7%；在ImageNet上，B=512时SD-Ind恢复74.4%；在MNIST/EMNIST上，B=400–512时SD-Mir恢复98%以上；在CIFAR-10上，B=300时SD-Ind恢复99.7%。

3. **Soliton-Free**：无需辅助数据，在B=300时于Fashion-MNIST等数据集恢复98%以上，在ImageNet B=256时恢复99.3%。

4. **标签恢复与认证**：所有八个数据集上恢复样本的标签准确率均为100%，且每个恢复均通过残差拟合自动认证，无需地面真相。

5. **可视化分析**：通过激活掩码网格（N×B）追踪级联过程，表明级联从稀疏行（低激活度神经元）与异常样本（atypical samples）的交点开始，逐步向典型样本扩散。凸包内部样本在外部样本被剥离后变为新凸包的顶点并变得可恢复，从而绕过了凸包上界限制。

6. **计算成本**：每次迭代包含O(FN)比值计算、去重、一次联合前向/反向传播及Jacobian-向量积。反向传播次数等于迭代次数而非恢复样本数，内存消耗为残差梯度矩阵O(FN)。

该方法表明联邦学习的隐私泄露被严重低估：在批次大小达数百的单轮FedSGD通信中，主动服务器可恢复超过90%的训练样本。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明通过将梯度反演问题与LT码的剥离解码过程建立类比，可设计出迭代级联式的分析型攻击，克服此前隔离型方法受凸包顶点数限制的根本性瓶颈。级联恢复——即恢复孤立样本后将其从残差梯度中减去以暴露新的孤立样本——使得凸包内部样本在外部样本被剥离后变得可恢复。Soliton-Free和Soliton-Data两种构造通过将第一层神经元激活度塑形为鲁棒孤子分布，显著延长了级联长度。实验证实，在单轮FedSGD中，被动攻击即可在批次大小达128时实现近完全恢复，主动攻击在批次大小达数百时仍能恢复90%以上，远超此前单轮攻击的性能。这些结果表明联邦学习的实际隐私泄露远超此前认知，凸显了差分隐私等强防御措施的必要性。

title: Which Medical Questions Deserve Rationales? Perturbation-Sensitive Selection for Robust QA
summary: Medical question-answering datasets often contain answer labels, whereas high-quality rationales remain scarce, noisy, or costly to validate. This changes the acquisition question: rather than asking which questions should be labeled, we ask which already-labeled questions should receive rationale supervision under a fixed token budget. We study an offline version of this problem in which candidate rationales are visible to the selector but withheld from downstream training unless selected. We propose root-mean-square Robustness-based Sample Prioritization (RMS-RSP), which perturbs hidden states only at rationale tokens and measures the resulting shift in the gold-versus-best-distractor margin. Across five medical QA datasets, MedGemma-4B-IT, three training seeds, ten budgeted non-RSP selectors, and an unbudgeted full-supervision reference, RMS-RSP provides a deliberately qualified result. Its locked-budget accuracy is 60.61% on average versus 60.08% for Random, with a statistically resolved gain only on AfriMed-QA (+1.44 points). Its full-budget accuracy area is not better than Random. However, after three answer-option reorderings, RMS-RSP improves robust accuracy and semantic consistency by 1.91 and 2.85 points on average, respectively, with the same direction on all five datasets. Training on every pool rationale raises macro accuracy to 63.74%, but consumes 29--254 times more rationale tokens and does not uniformly improve robustness. These findings do not establish universal accuracy gains; they instead suggest that rationale-local boundary sensitivity can identify supervision that improves invariance to semantically equivalent formatting changes.

AI.tldr: 针对医学QA中已有答案标签但缺乏高质量推理过程（rationale）的场景，提出RMS-RSP方法：在固定token预算下，通过对rationale token的隐藏状态注入RMS缩放高斯噪声并测量"正确选项与最强干扰项"边界的变化，选择对决策边界最敏感的rationale样本进行监督训练。在五个医学QA数据集上的实验表明，该方法在标准准确率上并非普遍优于Random，但在答案选项重排的鲁棒性上一致性地提升了准确率和语义一致性。
AI.motivation: 医学QA数据集通常只有答案标签，而高质量的rationale稀缺、噪声大或验证成本高。传统的主动学习关注"哪些问题应被标注"，但本文关注的是预算约束下"哪些已标注的问题值得获得额外的rationale监督"。无差别使用所有rationale会浪费预算并引入噪声推理。同时，现有推理数据选择方法多面向数学/编程任务，未直接评估rationale与医学决策边界的耦合程度。
AI.method: 提出RMS-RSP（RMS Robustness-based Sample Prioritization）：（1）在答案已训练模型基础上，对候选rationale token的隐藏状态注入α=0.10的RMS缩放高斯噪声，扰动三个倒数层（{-2,-4,-8}），每层4次；（2）测量"正确选项logit与最强干扰项logit之差"（gold-distractor margin）在扰动前后的变化；（3）对所有扰动的margin偏移取均方根作为评分，值越大表示rationale对决策边界越敏感；（4）按分数贪心选择直至耗尽token预算。同时设置Signed-RSP消融（取有符号均值）。下游训练采用1:1配对（选中rationale + 未选中answer回放）。
AI.result: 在五个医学QA数据集（AfriMed-QA、MedExpQA、MedExQA、PubMedQA、MedMCQA）上使用MedGemma-4B-IT：（1）锁定预算准确率五数据集均值60.61% vs Random 60.08%，仅AfriMed-QA差异统计显著（+1.44点），Token-AUBC不优于Random；（2）经过三次答案选项重排后，RMS-RSP在所有五个数据集上一致性地提升鲁棒准确率（ReAcc +1.91点）和语义一致性（ReCon +2.85点）；（3）全监督参考（使用所有rationale）平均准确率达63.74%，但消耗29-254倍token，且在PubMedQA上反而降低鲁棒性；（4）Signed-RSP在准确率上略优于RMS-RSP（60.87 vs 60.61），但鲁棒性大幅低于RMS-RSP。
AI.conclusion: 本文并不声称普遍提升医学QA准确率。其可辩护的核心结论是：在固定rationale token预算下，选择对gold-distractor边界局部敏感的样本作为监督，能一致提升模型对答案选项重排的不变性。RMS聚合保留扰动量级信息，更适合以鲁棒性为目标的场景；符号聚合则在标准准确率上略优。该方法应被视为离线策展层，适用于对已有候选解释进行筛选后再投入昂贵的专家验证，不适用于经典的无标注前主动学习。

title: Looped GPT-BERT: Trading Parameters for Computation in Small Language Modeling
summary: When training data are limited, increasing parameter count is not the only way to improve language-model performance. A small parameter set, when repeatedly applied, can also deliver comparable performance. We study Looped GPT-BERT in the BabyLM 2026 Strict-small setting, combining GPT-BERT's masked next-token and causal language-modeling objectives with depth-wise parameter sharing. We train on a preprocessed 7.48M-word English corpus and compare objective ratios, non-looped and looped architectures, and loop counts. Our final $4\times12$ model uses four physical layers for twelve recurrent traversals and contains 12.18M parameters. The BabyLM 2026 leaderboard reports an Overall Average of 35.42 and an NLP Average of 48.48. Compared with public BabyLM 10M Strict-small GPT-2 and GPT-BERT baselines, it achieves comparable performance on selected linguistic and downstream metrics, including BLiMP and GLUE, with fewer parameters. The loop ablations show that additional recurrent computation can improve training and preserve strong performance on selected linguistic tasks, whereas poorer performance on other tasks may reveal an inherent limitation of the looped design: using only a few physical layers restricts the model's representational space.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在数据受限场景下，通过深度循环参数共享（Looped GPT-BERT）以"少参数、多计算"的设计替代纯参数扩展，在 BabyLM 2026 Strict-small 赛道中实现与更大基线相当的语言建模性能。
AI.motivation: 在大规模语言模型中，参数与数据可联合扩展；但在低资源、受限数据的预训练场景下，单纯增加参数并非唯一路径。作者想验证：能否用少量共享参数的循环复用，以更少的可学习参数换取足够的语言能力，从而在 BabyLM 这种受控数据预算下提升参数效率。
AI.method: 1) 数据准备：从 BNC Spoken、CHILDES、Gutenberg、OpenSubtitles、Simple English Wikipedia、Switchboard 六个语料出发做规范化清洗，得到 7.48M 词的 new_data1 语料，并训练 8k BPE tokenizer。2) 混合目标函数：复用 GPT-BERT 的 MNTP（masked next-token prediction）+ CLM 联合目标，按行分配 BERT:GPT 模式，最终采用 1:3 比例。3) 循环主干：将 12 层独立 Transformer 替换为 4 个独立参数化的物理层，每轮前向将静态输入 x 加到上轮状态 z_t 后重复应用同一 4 层栈，实现 4×L 形式的循环深度。4) 训练配置：hidden=384、FFN=1280、6 heads、序列长 128、全局 batch 32768 tokens、LAMB 优化器、峰值 LR 0.0141、cosine 衰减 2600 步、10 epoch、最终模型 12.18M 参数（4×12）。5) 评估：按 BabyLM 2026 Strict-small 流程跑 BLiMP/Supplement、EWoK、Entity Tracking、COMPS、GlobalPIQA、Reading、AoA 等零样本任务以及 GLUE/SuperGLUE 微调，并对比 12 层非循环、4×1、4×3、4×6、4×12 等不同循环次数与不同 BERT:GPT 比例。
AI.result: 最终 4×12 模型在 BabyLM 2026 排行榜上取得 Overall Average 35.42、NLP Average 48.48，参数仅 12.18M。BLiMP 71.19（GPT-2 基线 124M 为 65.23，GPT-BERT causal-focus 31M 为 71.66），GLUE 62.55（GPT-2 63.80、GPT-BERT 65.13），在 BLiMP 等任务上以更少参数达到接近最强基线的水平；但在 AoA、Entity Tracking 等任务上明显较弱。消融显示：循环深度从 4×1 增加到 4×3 带来显著训练损失下降和 BLiMP 提升（65.08→71.21），但 4×3→4×6→4×12 增益递减；BERT:GPT 比例从 1:1 改为 1:3 可大幅降低训练损失并提升 BLiMP、Supplement、COMPS，但 Entity Tracking 从 38.66 降至 22.87。推理代价方面，4×3 延迟与吞吐优于 12 层非循环模型，4×6 与 4×12 则随循环数倍增。
AI.conclusion: Looped GPT-BERT 在受限数据与小参数预算下，可通过循环共享层在 BLiMP 等句法任务上接近或匹配更大基线，证明"少参数多计算"路径在低资源预训练中可行；但 Entity Tracking、AoA 等需要更丰富表征空间的任务上循环模型明显落后，说明共享层替代独立层并非均匀有效；循环深度与 BERT:GPT 比例的选择需要按任务权衡，整体属于"参数高效但能力有边界"的折中方案。

title: When Auditors Fabricate: Batch-Size Degradation and Confident Hallucination in LLM Detection of Planted Document Contamination
comment: 8 pages, 3 tables. Preprint also deposited at Zenodo, doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21939088
summary: Large language models are increasingly proposed as automated auditors of document quality, yet their reliability as detectors of planted errors is poorly characterised. We construct a contaminated corpus of 150 academic papers spanning supply chain management and medical research, injecting 450 known contaminants of three types: typographical corruption, semantic reversal, and absurd out-of-context insertion. We then evaluate Google Gemini 3.0 Pro's ability to recover a 180-contaminant answer-key subset across 60 documents under three prompting regimes of increasing scale: single document, small batch, and large batch. Detection holds at small scale and then collapses: 50% recovery on single documents, 60% on small batches, and 2.8% on large batches. The failure mode at scale is not abstention but fabrication. Rather than reporting incomplete processing, the model produced confident findings including invented contaminants of its own, absurdities such as "telepathic squirrel" and "quantum-powered toaster" that mimic the style of the planted material but do not appear in any document. Detection also varies by contamination type: absurd insertions were recovered at 75% in completed evaluations, while semantic reversals and typographical corruptions were each recovered at only 50%. The corruptions most likely to occur in the wild, plausible ones, are the ones most often missed. We conclude that LLM document auditing degrades not gracefully but deceptively, and outline the harness such systems require: bounded batch sizes, direct content injection, and mechanical verification of every reported finding against source text.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个含有150篇学术论文（供应链管理与医学研究）的污染语料库，注入450处已知污染（分为三类），评估Google Gemini 3.0 Pro在不同提示规模下的检测能力。结果显示，单文档检测率为50%，小批次为60%，大批次骤降至2.8%。大规模下模型并非拒答，而是"伪造"——捏造不存在的污染内容。研究还发现污染类型间检测率差异显著，荒谬插入达75%，而更可能在现实中出现的语义反转与排印错误均仅50%。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型被广泛提议用于自动化文档质量审计，其作为"种植错误"检测器的可靠性缺乏系统性表征。研究者旨在揭示LLM在规模化审计任务中是否可靠，以及其失败模式究竟为何。
AI.method: 构建含150篇学术论文（供应链管理、医学研究）的受控污染语料库，注入450处已知污染（分为三类）：①排印损坏（typographical corruption）；②语义反转（semantic reversal）；③荒谬语境插入（absurd out-of-context insertion）。在三个递进规模的提示机制下评估Gemini 3.0 Pro的检测能力：单文档、小批次、大批次。重点考察180个污染子集的答案回收率，并分析失败模式（是否拒答还是捏造）。
AI.result: 1. 检测率随规模呈非线性崩溃：单文档50%，小批次60%，大批次骤降至2.8%。2. 大规模失败模式并非"放弃作答"，而是"伪造"——模型自信地生成完全不存在的污染内容（如"心灵感应松鼠""量子驱动烤面包机"）。3. 污染类型间检测率差异显著：荒谬插入75%，语义反转与排印损坏均仅50%。4. 现实中最可能出现的"合理型污染"恰恰最易被遗漏。
AI.conclusion: LLM文档审计能力的退化并非"优雅降级"，而是"欺骗性降级"（deceptive degradation）。为此类系统提出三项必备"防护框架"（harness）：①有界批次规模（bounded batch sizes）；②直接内容注入（direct content injection）；③对每一条报告结论进行机械化、源文本对照核验（mechanical verification）。在缺乏上述保障时，规模化LLM审计不可信。

title: Kernel-Complexity Edge Sanitization for Training-Free Defense against Structural Graph Attacks
comment: 12 pages. Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse applications, yet they remain highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks that maliciously perturb graph structure. Existing defenses often lack rigorous theoretical grounding, rely on attack-specific heuristics, or require costly retraining procedures such as adversarial training. To address these limitations, we propose Kernel-Complexity Edge Sanitization (KCES), a training-free and model-agnostic framework for defending against structural attacks. KCES is built upon Graph Kernel Complexity (GKC), a principled metric derived from the graph Gram matrix that appears in a generalization upper bound on the GNN test error. From this bound, we define an edge-specific KC score that quantifies each edge's structural influence via its induced change in GKC. KCES then identifies and prunes high-KC edges, which are empirically enriched with adversarial perturbations under structural attacks, to mitigate their harmful impact. Computationally efficient and scalable, KCES operates as a lightweight preprocessing step without retraining and can be seamlessly integrated with existing defenses. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KCES consistently outperforms representative robust baselines across diverse attack settings and scales effectively to large graphs. Supported by theoretical analysis and extensive empirical validation, KCES provides a principled and efficient framework for securing GNNs. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出KCES（Kernel-Complexity Edge Sanitization），一种基于图核复杂度的无训练、模型无关的图结构防御框架，通过剪枝高KC分数的边来抵御针对GNN的结构性对抗攻击。
AI.motivation: GNN易受结构性对抗攻击（如Nettack、Metattack）影响，现有防御方法存在缺乏理论依据、依赖攻击特定启发式、或需要昂贵的对抗训练等局限。
AI.method: 1) 定义图核Gram矩阵（GKGM），将图聚合嵌入核定义中；2) 提出图核复杂度（GKC）指标，源于GNN测试误差的泛化上界；3) 定义KC分数为移除某边后GKC的变化量；4) 通过K-Means生成伪标签，保持无监督特性；5) 剪枝KC分数最高的边作为预处理步骤。
AI.result: 在Cora、Citeseer、Pubmed、Flickr、Ogbn-Arxiv等数据集上，针对Nettack、Metattack、DICE、MINMAX、PRBCD等多种攻击，KCES均 consistently优于RGCN、ProGNN、GNN-Jaccard、GNN-SVD、GNNGuard、AirGNN等基线。在Ogbn-Arxiv（PRBCD攻击）上达到58.62%，而ProGNN因内存不足无法运行；在Pubmed上KCES仅需6.40秒（200轮训练），而ProGNN需7340秒。
AI.conclusion: KCES提供了一种原则性强、高效且可扩展的GNN结构防御框架，作为即插即用的预处理模块，能与多种GNN架构兼容；其核心思想是将图结构修改与核诱导的几何复杂度相联系，而非仅依赖局部相似性启发式。未来工作可扩展至特征感知或边重加权变体以应对非结构攻击。

title: Fine-Tuning a KV Cache Concatenation-Aware Model or Recomputing KV Caches? Why Not Both?
summary: In Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, a large number of retrieved chunks are concatenated to form the input context so that users can receive high-quality responses based on external knowledge. As a result, the input context length increases substantially, leading to a larger prefill workload and, in turn, a longer time to first token (TTFT). While previous works that reuse precomputed key-value (KV) caches effectively reduce TTFT for long-context inputs, it remains unclear whether response quality is preserved when the input context becomes very long. In this paper, we propose a combined approach that (i) fine-tunes the model while taking KV cache concatenation into account and (ii) selectively recomputes a subset of the KV caches. By applying both techniques, we demonstrate improved accuracy for long-context inputs. Experiments on the RULER benchmark show that, for a 124k-token input, our method improves the RULER score by 9.7 point over the baseline that recomputes KV caches only. Moreover, TTFT is reduced by 80% compared with full attention.

AI.tldr: 针对RAG系统中长上下文KV缓存拼接导致的质量退化问题，本文提出将KV缓存拼接感知的模型微调（Block-attention）与选择性KV缓存重计算（CacheBlend, 15%重计算率）相结合的方法。在124k token输入下，RULER基准比仅使用CacheBlend提高9.7分，TTFT相比全注意力降低80%。
AI.motivation: RAG系统将大量检索到的文档块拼接成输入上下文，导致输入长度大幅增加。KV缓存拼接（concatenation）虽能有效降低TTFT，但由于预计算的KV缓存缺少跨块（cross-attention）注意力，会产生偏差并随上下文长度增加而恶化。现有方法（仅微调或仅重计算）在长上下文下准确性不足。
AI.method: 结合两种互补策略：(1) 基于Block-attention的微调——在训练中假设块间无cross-attention，使模型适应拼接场景（调整全层参数）；(2) 基于CacheBlend的选择性重计算——依据第一层key entry偏差选择约15%的token位置进行重计算（针对特殊token和attention sink的大偏差）。两种方法从不同层面减少key entry偏差：微调影响全层分布，重计算主要消除大偏差异常值。实现上采用分层并行加载：SSD→CPU→GPU传输、KV缓存合并与位置调整、重计算三个阶段并行。
AI.result: 基于Llama3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct的实验：(1) RULER基准在124k token下，Block-attention+CacheBlend（Proposed）平均得分56.7，优于Normal+CacheBlend（47.0）和Block-attention+0%（6.2），相比仅CacheBlend提高9.7分；(2) 在4k–124k全长度范围内均表现最优，性能退化最小；(3) 四项RAG任务（2Wiki、HQA、NQ、TQA）均取得最佳准确率；(4) SSD加载场景下124k token的TTFT相比全注意力降低80%；(5) 每个缓存文件含16个文档时最优（避免文件开销过大）。
AI.conclusion: 将KV缓存拼接感知微调与选择性重计算相结合的策略能够显著降低长上下文下的质量退化，二者具有互补性。该方法在保持接近全注意力准确性的同时大幅降低TTFT，具有实际部署价值。局限性包括：当前选择性重计算依赖FlashInfer+attention mask，计算开销较大；未充分评估基于注意力分数的重计算方法（A³、KVShare）；未评估与Link0、APE等方法的组合；尚未应用于思考模型（thinking models）。

title: BRACE: Anchored Bellman-Residual Correction for Stale Critics in Asynchronous RL
summary: Asynchronous reinforcement learning has become the standard way to scale training for language models, but the resulting policy lag biases the critic toward the stale behavior policy. Existing work on asynchronous LLM training corrects the actor and leaves this bias unaddressed, while the off-policy value correction of classical RL does not carry over to long-horizon agentic tasks, since a short correction horizon leaves the regression target free of the reward and a long one lets the product of importance ratios drift exponentially with the trajectory length. We propose BRACE, an anchored Bellman-residual correction for stale value models. BRACE bounds the correction horizon to a prefix of policy tokens and anchors a constant-weight Monte-Carlo tail beyond it, which separates policy correction from reward propagation. BRACE improves mean@1 on BrowseComp-Plus by $2.4\%$ over the strongest baseline, runs $2.46\times$ faster per step than synchronous training, and remains stable $50$ updates off-policy.

AI.tldr: BRACE提出了一种面向异步RL中过时critic的修正方法，通过限制修正视界为k个策略token并在其后锚定常数权重的蒙特卡洛尾部，分离策略修正与奖励传播，在长视野智能体任务上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 异步强化学习是大语言模型训练的主流方式,但行为策略μ与目标策略π之间的滞后使critic回归目标偏向过时策略V^μ。现有工作只修正actor而忽视critic偏差,且经典离策略价值修正(如V-trace)在长视野、稀疏奖励场景下不可行——短视界丢失奖励信号,长视界则导致重要性比率乘积随轨迹长度指数漂移。
AI.method: BRACE包含两个核心组件:(1) k-封顶修正视界——将重要性加权残差限制在位置s之后的k个策略token内,从而解耦奖励传播(需到达终点)与乘积控制(限制为k个因子),critic收敛于混合策略V^{π_ρ̄}而非V^μ;(2) 蒙特卡洛尾部——在视界j=min(s+k,T)之后使用常数权重1,使得尾部残差精确伸缩至终端奖励γ^{T-s}R,消除尾部残差在V上的交替项(标准差O(√(T-s-k))),保持奖励系数与封顶视界一致。BRACE仅在critic目标和优势上区别于标准PPO,actor仍使用PPO截断目标。
AI.result: 在四个长视野智能体任务(Search-R1、BrowseComp-Plus、DAPO-Math、工具增强GSM8K)的16项指标中取得13项最优,BrowseComp-Plus上mean@1较最强基线提升2.4%(0.245→0.269);效率上每步运行速度达同步训练的2.46倍,仅比异步PPO多1.5%开销;稳定性上在版本间隔达50时仍保持稳定训练;消融实验证实k-封顶与MC尾部均为必要组件;k=20与k=100表现相近(差距<0.01),ρ̄=1.2、c̄=1.1为最佳超参数配置。
AI.conclusion: BRACE解决了异步RL中critic侧的累积偏差问题,通过封顶视界与锚定尾部的设计在长视野智能体任务中同时实现偏差修正与数值稳定。未来工作可将BRACE与actor侧修正方法结合,并基于偏差深度而非固定值自适应设置k。

title: With a Thermomix You Lose the Ability to Cook: A Kitchen Machine Analogy for Applications of Generative AI in Education
comment: First two listed authors have shared first authorship
summary: The rapid adoption of generative AI tools such as ChatGPT has sparked intense debate about their risks and opportunities for education, as well as the ways researchers should investigate them. In this paper, we approach these discussions through an analogy with the Thermomix, a smart kitchen appliance that has similarly provoked both enthusiasm and critique. By mapping Thermomix use cases onto examples of learning with generative AI, and situating them within the ICAP and SAMR frameworks, we show how different modes of tool use can either support or undermine meaningful engagement and learning. The Thermomix metaphor underscores that the central question is not whether learners employ AI, but how such use shapes their learning processes. In doing so, we provide a conceptual lens for researchers and practitioners to critically examine - and more effectively guide - the integration of generative AI into educational practice.

AI.tldr: 论文借助 Thermomix（智能厨房设备）与生成式 AI 的类比，区分不同工具使用方式对学习参与度和学习成效的影响。核心观点是：教育讨论不应停留在“是否使用 AI”，而应关注 AI 如何被整合进学习过程，以及这种整合能否促进深度学习。
AI.motivation: 生成式 AI 快速进入教育场景，引发了关于其风险、价值及研究方式的争论。作者希望借助一个同样引发支持和批评的智能设备作为分析隐喻，超越简单的“支持或反对 AI”二元对立。
AI.method: 采用概念性类比分析：将 Thermomix 的典型使用情境映射到学习者使用生成式 AI 的情境中，并使用 ICAP（交互—建构—主动—被动）和 SAMR（替代—增强—重塑—重新定义）框架进行解释和分类。
AI.result: 工具使用的具体模式决定了其教育价值。某些使用方式能够促进积极投入、互动、知识建构和更高层次的学习活动；另一些方式则可能导致认知替代、浅层参与或学习过程中的被动依赖。不同工具虽功能不同，但对学习过程具有相似的结构性影响。
AI.conclusion: 生成式 AI 的教育意义不能仅由工具是否被使用来判断。研究者与教育实践者应重点分析学习者如何与 AI 互动、AI 承担何种认知功能，以及使用方式如何影响学习过程，并据此更有针对性地设计和指导 AI 融入教学。

title: Forward-Free LLM Depth Pruning via Weight Redundancy
summary: Depth pruning reduces large language model (LLM) inference cost by removing complete Transformer blocks. Activation-based methods collect hidden states through forward passes on calibration data, while existing forward-free methods score each Transformer block separately without measuring similarity between blocks. We propose Weight-Redundancy Pruning (WRP), a forward-free depth-pruning method that estimates inter-layer redundancy from checkpoint weights to select blocks without calibration data or model forward passes. WRP compares attention output and MLP down-projection weights across layers and combines their pairwise similarities with relative projection-scale information. The resulting all-pairs similarity matrix guides layer grouping and block selection. Across multiple pruning settings, model families, and downstream tasks, WRP consistently outperforms existing forward-free magnitude pruning and approaches the performance of activation-based methods.

AI.tldr: 提出WRP(Weight-Redundancy Pruning),一种无前向传播的LLM深度剪枝方法,通过比较checkpoint权重估计层间冗余,在无需标定数据和前向推理的情况下选择要剪枝的Transformer块,性能显著优于基于幅度的无前向方法,接近基于激活的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度剪枝方法存在两类局限:激活式方法需要校准数据前向传播,在大模型上可能超出GPU内存;现有无前向方法(如Mag+)独立评分每个块,无法捕捉层间冗余关系。本文旨在直接从checkpoint权重中提取层间冗余信号,实现既无需前向传播又能全局衡量层间相似性的剪枝。
AI.method: 1. 权重空间块描述子:对注意力输出投影W^o和MLP降维投影W^down,经中心化后构造Gram矩阵G^a = ỸỸ^⊤,用线性CKA计算跨层投影相似度S^proj。2. 投影尺度相似度:用七个投影(q,k,v,o,gate,up,down)的Frobenius范数构成向量f_ℓ,中心化后用余弦相似度得到S^scale。3. 综合相似度矩阵S = (S^proj + S^scale)/2。4. 基于归一化Laplace谱隙(eigen-gap)自动选择聚类数K∈{2,4},采用谱聚类+两阶段分配策略(LoRP式)选取冗余最高的P个块;首尾块受保护。无需任何前向传播、梯度或通道匹配。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen3-14B、Mistral-Nemo-12B三种模型、六种剪枝预算、九个zero-shot任务上的实验显示:WRP在六种设置下平均比Mag+提升14.38分(10.68–17.15分),平均准确率57.41,接近激活式方法LoRP的57.93,并在Qwen3-14B 8/40设置下取得最佳剪枝平均成绩。25%剪枝时,prefill延迟降低21–23%,decode延迟降低23–25%,峰值GPU内存降低21–22%。
AI.conclusion: WRP证明仅依靠checkpoint权重即可提供有效的层间冗余信号,实现无需校准数据与前向传播的深度剪枝,在显著优于纯幅度剪枝的同时接近激活式方法的性能,为大模型压缩提供了更灵活、更低资源门槛的方案。

title: Strangers to Themselves: What Language Models Say About Themselves Is Generic
summary: Language models can fluently describe how they would behave: whether they would cave to pushback, misuse a tool, or lie under pressure. Is that description actually about the model speaking? We turn self-knowledge into a prediction test. Across nine behavioral evaluations, we measure how a model behaves under different conditions, ask it to predict those rates, and compare its predictions with controls that remove the self from the question. We find that: (i) Direct self-report is weak (r = +0.04), and even showing the model the exact items only raises prediction to +0.24. Crucially, the same item-informed question about "capable AI agents in general" does just as well (+0.28), while other models' answers about themselves predict the target model at least as well as its own. (ii) Frontier scale does not detectably change this pattern: any gains in prediction are not self-specific, and are consistent with a better theory of how AI assistants behave rather than better self-knowledge. (iii) First-person framing does have one robust effect: it shifts reports in the flattering direction, understating harmful behavior relative to the same question about a generic agent. (iv) Finetuning on a model's own behavioral record can teach narrow self-predictions, but it also changes the behavior being predicted and the gains do not transfer broadly. The practical implication is simple: asking a model what it would do mostly reveals a theory of AI assistants in general, plus a favorable bias, rather than privileged knowledge of that model.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将自我知识转化为预测测试，跨9项行为评估、12个模型，系统检验语言模型关于自身行为的陈述是否真正指向该模型本身。核心发现：直接自报告与行为的预测相关仅为r=+0.04，即使展示完全相同的项目也仅提升至+0.24；将问题主语改为"通用AI智能体"反而表现更好（+0.28），其他模型的自我报告比模型自身的预测更准（+0.35 vs +0.24）。前沿规模也未能带来自我特异性的提升；第一人称框架主要产生自利偏差（有害行为被低估-0.15）。微调可获得局部收益但会改变被预测的行为且难以迁移。结论：模型关于自身的陈述实质上反映的是关于AI助手的一般性知识加上自利偏差，并非该模型的特权自我认知。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型在长周期、工具调用、自主交互场景中部署，开发者可能依赖模型关于"自己会如何行为"的陈述来推断其实际行为。已有研究记录了模型陈述与揭示行为之间的差距，也有研究在特定场景中发现陈述可预测行为，但缺乏将"询问模型自身"与"询问通用AI"或"询问其他模型"进行对照的基线，因而无法判断陈述的准确性来自特权自我知识还是关于AI助手的通用知识。
AI.method: 设计了一个"行为-预测协议"：将自我知识操作化为跨条件的预测准确度。在9项公开行为评估（涵盖人口统计偏见、谄媚、能力、奖励作弊、滥用与压力下撒谎、智能体策略违反、智能体失调）上，针对每个评估的每个条件，测量模型行为率，然后通过不同信息量（抽象描述→模型自身历史→逐字测量项）、不同主语（"你"/特定命名模型/"通用AI助手"）、不同形式（直接率/迫选/配对比较）共15种预测方法获取预测，以Pearson相关系数r作为主要评分指标。所有方法设置在dev集上选择并锁定，在frozen test集上单次评估；引入噪声上限过滤、信度门槛、其他模型的均值作为对照（零模型特权访问），并在测试前完成预注册声明。研究覆盖12个模型（6个中小规模+3个前沿基座各2种推理设置）。
AI.result: (i) 直接自报告预测自身行为仅r=+0.04，展示完全项后提升至+0.24；通用主语条件表现同等甚至更好（+0.28），其他模型的自我报告预测目标模型优于其自身（+0.35 vs +0.24），自利优势仅+0.02。(ii) 前沿规模未带来自我特异性的显著提升（+0.02，CI包含零），收益来自对AI助手行为的更好理论。(iii) 第一人称框架使报告在自利方向偏移-0.15（有害行为上）。(iv) 在自身行为记录上微调可习得特定自我预测，但也会改变被预测行为，收益无法跨评估或抽象层级迁移。Binder式属性预测微调大幅提升单提示自我模拟精度却未触动"倾向性"自我知识。预注册声明中13项中有9项完全复现，3项未复现被如实报告。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型关于自身行为的描述本质上是对"AI助手一般如何行为"的通用预测加上自利偏差，而非对该模型的特权认知。"我不会做X"不应被视为保证。实践启示：在无法直接测量的场景中，测量近邻模型或使用通用智能体问题能以更少偏差获得同等信息；项目知情的通用智能体问题是现有最佳的校准形式。模型可能具备某些激活层面的自我信息但未能自发调用——这构成"信息存在但未语言化"与"信息缺席"的区分，为未来激活层面的探针研究留下了开放问题。

title: Improving Cross-Lingual Token Representations by Adding a Pinch of SALT
summary: Cross-lingual sentence encoders enable scalable transfer across hundreds of languages, powering applications such as translation mining and zero-shot learning in low-resource settings. Although trained for sentence-level alignment, they are increasingly also applied to token-level tasks such as hallucination detection and sequence tagging, exposing a mismatch between training and usage. We propose SALT, a lightweight post-training method that improves token representations by injecting span-level supervision into existing sentence encoders. Across five multilingual token-level benchmarks, SALT achieves the best overall results on four of them, outperforming alternative fine-tuning strategies and competitive encoders. It also improves sentence-level performance on cross-lingual retrieval and classification tasks. These results demonstrate that span-level supervision is an effective signal for improving both token and sentence representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SALT（Span-Aligned Learning for cross-lingual Tokens），一种轻量级后训练方法，通过向现有跨语言句子编码器注入span级监督信号（包含span对比损失、span翻译损失和句子级插值损失），改善其token级表示质量。该方法无需修改架构，在五个多语言token级基准测试中的四个上取得最优，并同时保持或提升了句子级性能。
AI.motivation: 跨语言句子编码器（如SONAR、MEXMA）虽针对句子级对齐训练，却越来越多地被用于token级任务（如词对齐、序列标注、幻觉检测等），存在训练目标与使用场景之间的结构性错配。现有改进方案多依赖词级对齐信号，但词级对齐过于严格，因为语义常常分布在多个token构成的短语（span）层面。
AI.method: SALT包含三个目标函数：(1) span级对比损失（CON_Span）：基于平行句中提取的语义对齐span对，鼓励跨语言等价span的嵌入相似；(2) span级翻译损失（MT_Span）：使用冻结解码器，基于源span嵌入解码目标span；(3) 句子级插值损失（INT）：通过MSE约束训练后的编码器保持原始句子级嵌入空间。span提取方法包括基于LLaMA-70B的方法和轻量级自监督启发式方法CASE（Constituent Alignment Span Extraction，基于token对齐和句法成分约束）。基于SONAR编码器，在NLLB Primary数据集上训练，无需架构改动。
AI.result: 在五个token级跨语言基准（词对齐AER、PAN-X、Massive、UDPOS、WiC）上，SALT在四个上达到最优或并列最优，AER降至0.171，PAN-X达0.622，Massive达0.452，WiC达0.585。句子级性能（FLORES-80跨语言检索、MTEB分类）也得到保持或提升。几何分析显示，SALT显著改善了hubness（skewness从11.5降至3.5），降低了语言可分性（F1从0.46降至0.35），且CASE自监督提取方案可达到与LLaMA-70B相近的性能。
AI.conclusion: span级监督是提升多语言表示的有效且原则性的归纳偏置，能够同时改善token级和句子级表示质量。SALT作为轻量级后训练方法，无需架构修改即可应用于现有编码器。

title: MetroLLM-Bench: Evaluating Language Models as Transit Kiosk Runtimes
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Code and data at this https URL (tag paper-v1.2); DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21893944
summary: We introduce MetroLLM-Bench, a 955-case benchmark for testing language models as the policy layer of a transit kiosk. It covers six real metro systems, ranging from 37 to 414 stations, and eleven categories that include routing, fare calculation, disruptions, accessibility, and adversarial input. In each case, the model must call structured tools and submit a machine-renderable terminal state containing an outcome, a per-ticket fare quote when applicable, and a kiosk action. Fourteen deterministic scoring components form Tier 1; eight semantic-quality components form Tier 2, six of which use a language-model judge. We report Tier 1 and the combined score of both tiers. A stratified 75/25 split reserves 717 cases for training-data generation and 238 for held-out evaluation. We evaluate twenty-six models from six vendors, of which twenty-three are ranked. On the held-out partition, a 4B Qwen 3.5 student trained through parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) exceeds both GPT-5.6 tiers on Tier 1 (91.3 against 90.6 and 90.0) and matches GPT-5.4 full at maximum reasoning effort (91.4), with a 2.6 GB Q4_K_M footprint. Larger 9B and 27B students provide no further Tier 1 improvement over the 4B student at this training scale. Across the four Qwen sizes, the PEFT gain over the corresponding base model decreases from +7.03 points at 2B (three training seeds) to -0.91 at 27B; every seed shows the same direction at every size. A deterministic rule-based baseline reaches 84.6 on Tier 1, with the remaining language-model advantage concentrated in policy adaptation, compound scenarios, accessibility, and temporal reasoning. Muse Glimmer 30B leads the composite ranking, and serving configuration alone moves the Qwen 3.5-to-3.8 comparison by 2.7 Tier 1 points. The benchmark, harness, reproduction guide, and fine-tuned students are released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MetroLLM-Bench是一个包含955个测试用例的基准测试，用于评估语言模型作为地铁售票机策略层的表现。该研究测试了26个模型，发现经过参数高效微调的4B参数Qwen 3.5学生模型在确定性任务上可以超越GPT-5.6并匹配GPT-5.4（满参数模式），且只需2.6 GB存储空间。研究还发现PEFT的效用随基础模型能力提升而递减，在27B参数时变为负值。
AI.motivation: 传统地铁售票机的策略逻辑需要通过代码部署周期来更新（开发者工单、补丁、回归测试、发布窗口）。本研究探索用语言模型替代这种基于代码的策略层，使操作员能通过自然语言描述灵活应对车站关闭、新票价、节假日时刻表等变化。地铁售票机是检验这一方案的理想测试床：输出必须正确（票价错误会导致计费错误）、可渲染（售票机有固定的显示槽位）、可适配（规则会变）、可审计（操作员需要解释售票机的行为）。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含6个真实地铁系统（MARTA、Doha Metro、BART、台北捷运、CTA、北京地铁，共37-414个车站）和11个类别（路线、票价、故障、无障碍、文化、政策、多轮、对抗、时序、工具幻觉、复合压力）的955案例基准测试。每个案例要求模型阅读自然语言系统描述（"框架手册"），通过ReAct循环调用6个结构化工具（route_planner、fare_calculator、station_info、line_info、disruption_feed、knowledge_base），然后提交包含结果、票价报价和售票机操作的机器可渲染终端状态。评分采用双层结构：Tier 1包含14个确定性评分组件（如路由和票价正确性、工具调用准确性、渲染状态有效性），Tier 2包含8个语义质量组件（其中6个使用Claude Haiku 4.5作为语言模型评判器）。采用系统分层75/25划分（717个训练、238个测试）。对Qwen 3.5的2B、4B、9B、27B四个尺寸进行了QLoRA（rank 16，3个epoch）微调实验，每个尺寸使用2-3个独立训练种子。
AI.result: 主要结果：（1）在238个测试用例上，4B参数的Qwen 3.5 PEFT学生模型以91.32的Tier 1得分超过GPT-5.6 luna（90.63）和sol（90.00），与GPT-5.4满参数xhigh推理模式（91.37）相当，且只需2.6 GB的Q4_K_M GGUF存储空间；（2）PEFT增益随基础模型能力提升而单调递减：2B为+7.03分，4B为+2.00分，9B为+1.65分，27B为-0.91分，每个种子的方向都一致；（3）确定性基于规则的基线在Tier 1上达到84.6，语言模型的优势集中在策略适配、复合场景、无障碍和时序推理类别；（4）Muse Glimmer 30B在综合排名中领先；（5）服务配置本身可使Qwen 3.5与3.8的比较相差2.7个Tier 1分，表明全局服务配置并非跨模型代际中立的。GPT-5.4内部，推理努力比模型尺寸影响更大。
AI.conclusion: 在该有界售票机任务上，专有前沿API并非必需。2.6 GB的开源Qwen 3.5 4B PEFT学生模型在确定性任务性能上可匹配前沿API。容量上限实验表明：在测试配置下，4B即达到测得的Tier 1平台期，9B和27B PEFT均无改进，且27B适配相对其基础模型显著降低Tier 1。九次运行仅在一块高端消费级GPU上耗时9.4 GPU小时。但该结论有边界：学生模型在综合得分上仍落后于GPT-5.6 luna、sol和GPT-5.4 xhigh，前沿行在对抗性案例上保持优势，GPT-5.4 xhigh在时序案例上也保持优势。结果表明，当运营任务被有意限制在有限范围内时，经过适配的开源模型可以在其核心可执行要求上匹配前沿API。

title: Direct Diversity Optimization for Diverse Successful Trajectories in Preference Post-Training
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 19 pages, 11 figures
summary: LLM agents for sequential decision tasks are often post-trained with trajectory-level outcome labels, but such labels provide little supervision for preserving multiple successful branches from the same decision state. We study this problem as successful strategy coverage: how broadly a model realizes distinct successful strategies under a fixed rollout budget. We present Direct Diversity Optimization (DDO), an offline post-training method that combines Divergence-Tree Collection (DTC) with the Reference-Relative Target-Odds Objective (RTO). DTC constructs state-aligned branch sets rooted at shared decision states, and RTO trains the model to match reference-relative targets over successful alternatives. DDO achieves the strongest task success and successful strategy coverage among the compared post-training methods across BabyAI, BabaIsAI, and WebShop. It also achieves the highest recovery rate after local action replacement and higher task success and coverage than successful-only imitation and decoding-time diversification controls.

AI.tldr: 提出Direct Diversity Optimization (DDO)方法，通过Divergence-Tree Collection (DTC)构建同一决策状态下的多分支标注集，并使用Reference-Relative Target-Odds Objective (RTO)在偏好后训练中保留多条成功策略，以同时提升任务成功率与成功策略覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 标准偏好后训练方法（如DPO）使用轨迹级成功/失败标签进行训练，容易导致策略坍缩到单一成功轨迹，丧失同一决策点下多条可行替代方案的保留能力。这种策略坍缩在遇到环境扰动时会使智能体缺乏回退路径。
AI.method: DDO包含两个核心组件：(1) Divergence-Tree Collection (DTC) 从成功源轨迹出发，恢复中间决策状态，由专家模型生成并执行多个产生不同动作的替代分支，记录每个分支的二值结果标签；(2) Reference-Relative Target-Odds Objective (RTO) 在同一状态的成功分支集S⁺上定义参考相对目标分布q，通过幂律重归一化控制多样性强度（参数α），并以soft logistic损失对齐π_θ与q在成功-成功、 success-失败 对上的对数优势比。
AI.result: 在BabyAI、BabaIsAI和WebShop三个基准上，DDO在任务成功率与成功策略覆盖率（ESD和H-ESD）上均优于DPO、DivFreq/DivProb以及TieDPO等基线方法。消融实验表明DTC主要提升成功率，RTO同时提升成功率和覆盖率，两者结合达到最佳联合性能。在BabyAI局部动作替换恢复测试中，DDO恢复率达75.2%，高于DPO（69.7%）和DivFreq（70.1%）。在35B专家模型规模下仍保留122B专家模型92%以上的性能。
AI.conclusion: DDO通过将轨迹级结果标签转化为同状态分支级的偏好监督，有效解决了标准偏好后训练中的策略坍缩问题，同时提升任务成功率和成功策略覆盖率，在顺序决策任务中展现出更强的鲁棒性和适应性。

title: Beyond Training: A Feasibility Taxonomy for Inference-Time AI Governance
summary: Compute governance today is a governance of training: the thresholds, reporting requirements, and frontier-AI regimes now in force attach to training compute and treat the trained model as the regulatory unit. That picture is incomplete: capability increasingly migrates to the deployment stage through inference-time scaling, agentic scaffolding, and compression onto consumer hardware. This paper asks which mechanisms are available once the regulatory object shifts from the training run to the inference call. We develop a feasibility taxonomy of twenty inference-time mechanisms across monitoring, verification, and enforcement, each rated on a four-point readiness scale against a documented four-vendor evidence base. We then stress the taxonomy against a two-dimensional adversary model (three capability tiers crossed with four adversary roles) and map each mechanism to four governance scenarios (domestic regulation, bilateral or multilateral coordination, industry self-regulation, and compute-marketplace governance). Fifteen of the twenty mechanisms have commercial technical substrates in production today, although governance-grade assurance and adversarial robustness vary substantially. The adversary analysis shows that this readiness holds only against a cooperative deployer and a low-to-medium-capability user: no mechanism rates adequate against a high-capability state-level deployer, and fine-tuning removes the model-internal components of the enforcement cluster, although platform-external controls can persist. A substitution analysis connects the taxonomy to a companion hardware paper as a conditional substitution principle describing when inference-stage and hardware-stage mechanisms provide comparable regulatory coverage under stated conditions. A second-rater reliability check on a random subset of the readiness ratings returned a quadratic-weighted Cohen's kappa of 0.74.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对推理阶段AI治理机制的可行性分类法，包含20个机制，分布在监控、验证和执行三大类中，按四级准备度评级。基于四供应商证据基础和二维对手模型进行评估，并通过与硬件级治理的替代分析相连接，提出了有条件替代原则。
AI.motivation: 当前计算治理以训练为核心，将训练后的模型视为监管单元。但能力正通过推理时缩放、智能体脚手架和向消费硬件的压缩迁移到部署阶段。现有阈值制度（如欧盟AI法案、美国行政命令）对推理保持沉默，构成监管盲点。文献中已有零散的技术提案和治理讨论，但缺乏系统化的推理时治理机制分类框架。
AI.method: 研究方法包括：(1) 从27个候选机制中通过两源规则和差异性检查筛选出20个机制；(2) 基于四供应商证据基础（AWS Bedrock、Anthropic、OpenAI、Google Vertex AI）进行准备度评级；(3) 构建二维对手模型（能力等级C1-C3 × 对手角色R1-R4 = 12个单元）；(4) 进行第二轮评估者可靠性检查（加权Cohen's kappa = 0.74）；(5) 将机制映射到四种治理场景；(6) 与配套硬件层治理论文进行替代分析。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(1) 20个机制中15个已具备商业技术底座可在生产环境部署；(2) 仅有1个机制在对抗高级别部署者时表现充分；(3) 微调攻击可使模型内部执行机制失效，但平台外部控制仍可维持；(4) 验证集群（V1-V3）是当前准备度的关键缺口；(2) 提出了有条件替代原则：当训练-推理替代通道开放时，并行替代机制失效，分层替代机制（M4、V3、E3）变得结构上必要；(3) 不同治理场景对同一机制的重心不同：国内监管侧重执行，多边协调侧重验证，市场治理侧重运行时控制，自我监管侧重推理透明度。
AI.conclusion: 核心发现是一种精确陈述的张力：商业平台已暴露广泛的治理相关原语，但治理级覆盖随着保证、对抗控制、本地部署要求的提高而下降。推理时治理应被视为包含硬件级治理和出口管制的堆叠中的一层，而非替代品。全面治理需要组合多种场景，使每个场景覆盖其他场景结构性无法覆盖的部分。最重要的政策干预是弥合验证集群的产品化差距，这是同时提高每个治理场景上限的共同约束。

title: A Trust-Network-Based Federated Learning Framework for Multi-Center Aging Clock Prediction
summary: Aging clocks quantify biological aging and help characterize individual health status. What protein interactions are important for accurate aging clocks, and are they zeroth-order or higher-order? Addressing these questions requires learning from large molecular datasets distributed across medical centers, where privacy constraints prevent centralized data sharing. Federated learning offers a natural solution but faces four challenges in this setting: limited local sample sizes, sparse and directional inter-center trust, the need to retain discriminative age prediction while supporting interpretation, and model drift and forgetting under heterogeneous cross-center data. We propose TNFL, a trust-network-based federated learning framework that progressively propagates models along directed pairwise trust relations without centralized aggregation. TNFL combines an age-aware mixture-of-experts model with generative replay to preserve previously learned information and reduce forgetting and drift. Experiments across multiple molecular datasets show that TNFL enables effective aging-clock prediction with limited local data, provides interpretable age-dependent prediction patterns, and maintains stable performance across interaction orders. To investigate the biological questions, we analyze TNFL-identified pairwise protein interactions and their higher-order organization through functional and network analyses. The identified interactions repeatedly form coordinated higher-order subnetworks spanning multiple aging-related biological systems, with several proteins recurring across subnetworks. These findings suggest that TNFL captures molecular relationships beyond isolated pairwise associations and reveals coherent higher-order biological organization associated with aging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于信任网络的联邦学习框架TNFL，用于多中心衰老时钟预测。该框架通过有向信任关系链进行模型传播，无需中央聚合服务器，结合年龄感知的混合专家模型（AgeMoE）和生成式回放机制，有效应对局部数据有限、跨中心信任稀疏不对称、模型漂移和遗忘等挑战。同时分析发现，蛋白质相互作用不仅以成对形式存在，还形成了跨越神经、血管、内分泌、代谢、炎症和应激系统的高阶子网络。
AI.motivation: 现有的衰老时钟研究需要利用多中心大规模分子数据，但隐私限制阻碍了数据集中共享。标准联邦学习依赖全局信任的中央聚合服务器，不适用于仅有稀疏有向信任关系的多中心场景，且无法同时解决局部数据有限、可解释性需求和跨中心异质性导致的模型漂移与遗忘问题。此外，蛋白质相互作用是零阶（单个）、成对还是高阶的生物学问题尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: TNFL框架将联邦学习组织为沿有向信任对的渐进式模型传播，无需集中聚合。该方法结合了两个核心组件：(1) AgeMoE——一种年龄感知混合专家模型，采用Transformer编码器与MoE回归头，通过对称KL散度对路由权重施加年龄正则化以促进相邻年龄样本间的路由平滑性，从而提供年龄依赖的可解释预测模式；(2) 生成式回放——采用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）生成伪样本，通过预测一致性过滤保留高质量样本，用于在跨中心顺序更新中保留先前学习的信息并减轻漂移/遗忘。框架形式化了有向、消息特定的信任关系，并证明了沿信任序列的下游保密性安全性质。
AI.result: 在三个多中心数据集（UKB-Center、UKB-Imbalance、GEO-Methylation）上的实验表明：(1) TNFL相比局部训练显著降低MAE（如UKB-Center上降低0.69年），并在异质性更强的场景中优于FedAvg（UKB-Imbalance降低0.12年，GEO-Methylation降低0.34年）；(2) TNFL兼容多种衰老时钟骨干网络（线性回归、XGBoost、MLP、Transformer），其中AgeMoE+生成式回放表现最优且全局测试方差最低；(3) 跨交互顺序的MAE范围低于0.5年，累积MAE退化低于0.2年，遗忘率大多为负值，表明先前访问中心的性能得到保留或改善；(4) 在模拟测量变异性（中心偏移和样本噪声）下性能仅小幅下降（全局MAE从2.33增至2.40）；(5) 生物学分析表明，模型识别的蛋白质对反复形成高阶子网络，涵盖神经血管内分泌模块、系统应激与心代谢信号、多系统协调，复发蛋白（GFAP、NEFL、GDF15、GIP、ELN、LTBP2、CXCL17等）充当连接多个衰老相关生物过程的枢纽信号，与衰老标志框架一致。
AI.conclusion: TNFL提供了一个统一的联邦学习框架，通过有向信任网络传播模型，同时结合年龄感知MoE和生成式回放，有效应对多中心衰老时钟建模的四大挑战。其预测性能与基于服务器的FedAvg相当甚至更优，同时无需全局信任的中央聚合器，并展现出对交互顺序、测量变异性和信任网络结构变化的鲁棒性。生物学层面，该框架揭示了衰老相关蛋白质相互作用从零阶（个体蛋白质）→ 成对→ 高阶子网络的连贯组织结构，表明衰老相关分子效应并非孤立的成对关联，而是形成了跨多个生物系统的协调高阶组织，与衰老标志框架相一致。

title: Active Adaptation, Not Static Defense: Temporal Dynamics of Preventative Steering in Adversarial Fine-Tuning
summary: Large language models remain fragile against malicious fine-tuning, motivating training-time defenses against harmful persona drift. Preventative Steering injects undesirable-trait persona vectors during fine-tuning and removes them at evaluation time, yet the mechanism behind its lasting protection remains unclear. Analyzing its temporal optimization dynamics, we find that the defense emerges from an early compensatory adaptation phase followed by a steady-state phase where the corrective signal decays; in parameter space, attention output projections emerge as the dominant residual-write route for defensive updates. Through Intervention Delta Preservation (IDP) and IDP Continuation experiments, we further show that preserving or reinjecting the weight offset fails to maintain protection, indicating that preventative steering relies on active adaptation rather than a static defense. Motivated by this finding, we propose Progressive Intensity Scheduling (PIS), which starts with a moderate injection strength and increases it after static-strength alignment begins to decay. Across the evaluated Qwen2.5 and Gemma-3 models, PIS improves safety robustness over static-strength steering while reducing harmful trait expression.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了"预防性引导"（Preventative Steering）在对抗性微调中保护大语言模型安全性的时序动力学机制。研究发现该防御依赖持续的主动适应而非静态偏移，据此提出渐进强度调度（PIS）方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在恶意微调下容易丧失安全对齐，而预防性引导（在微调时注入不良人格向量、评估时移除）的长效保护机制尚不清晰，需要理解其是临时表征偏移还是参数层面的主动适应。
AI.method: 1. 通过残差空间分析追踪预注入状态 h_l、潜在状态 Y 和定向梯度推力 X，揭示两阶段优化动力学（适应期 + 稳态期）；2. 通过参数空间相位轨迹分析 W_o 和 W_down 的有效写入路径；3. 设计 IDP 和 IDP Continuation 解耦实验验证结构偏移的独立性；4. 提出 PIS 调度策略，先以中等强度 α_base 训练，待静态强度对齐衰减后线性增至 α_max。
