AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B/32B-Instruct 和 Gemma-3-12B-IT 上，T_start=200 时 PIS 最优：Qwen2.5-32B 安全均值从 80.18 提升至 86.98，恶性人格均值从 3.04 降至 1.38；Qwen2.5-7B 安全均值从 67.55 提升至 71.95；Gemma-3-12B 安全均值从 48.36 提升至 54.68。一致优于静态强度基线，且证明效果非源于平均注入强度的提升。
AI.conclusion: 预防性引导的保护源于训练过程中的主动参数适应而非可重用的静态偏移；IDP 和 IDP Continuation 实验证实结构参数偏移无法独立维持防御。PIS 通过时序调度注入强度维持引导信号与优化轨迹的耦合，在多个模型上以极低的实现复杂度显著提升对抗恶意微调的安全鲁棒性。

title: Hierarchical and Permutation-Invariant Feature Transformation Learning via Policy-Guided Embedding Search
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication at CIKM 2026
summary: Feature transformation improves predictive performance on tabular data by constructing informative abstractions from raw features. Recent generative approaches encode transformation knowledge into continuous embedding spaces for efficient exploration of candidate strategies, but face three key limitations: (1) overlooking hierarchical relationships between low-level features, operations, and high-level abstractions; (2) enforcing order-sensitive embeddings on inherently permutation-invariant transformation sequences, thereby introducing systematic bias; and (3) relying on gradient-based search, which is ill-suited to non-convex transformation spaces. We propose a framework with two complementary components. First, a permutation-invariant hierarchical module captures interactions across features, operations, and abstraction levels, with a self-attention pooling mechanism that maps semantically equivalent structures to consistent embeddings aligned with downstream performance. Second, a policy-guided multi-objective reinforcement learning strategy initializes the search from empirically strong seeds and jointly optimizes predictive accuracy and transformation efficiency. Extensive experiments on diverse tabular benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our framework against strong baselines. Our code and data are publicly available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出PHER框架，针对自动化特征转换（AFT）任务，解决现有生成式方法在层次建模、排列不变性和搜索策略三方面的不足：通过排列不变的层次模块编码token级和concept级特征转换知识，并利用基于PPO的策略引导多目标强化学习在非凸嵌入空间中搜索最优转换序列。在19个数据集上验证了有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式自动化特征转换方法存在三大局限：(1)忽略原始特征、数学运算与高层抽象概念之间的层次关系；(2)对本质上排列不变的转换序列施加顺序敏感的编码，引入系统性偏差；(3)依赖基于梯度的搜索方法，但转换嵌入空间通常是非凸的，易陷入局部最优。
AI.method: 提出PHER框架，包含两个核心组件：(1)排列不变的层次建模模块——token级编码器使用Transformer捕获特征-运算交互，concept级编码器使用自注意力池化机制（以可学习种子向量为Query，concept嵌入为Key/Value）实现排列不变性；采用三阶段训练策略（token级训练→concept级训练→token-concept对齐）；(2)策略引导的多目标强化学习搜索——选取性能top-K记录作为种子嵌入，通过PPO的actor-critic架构联合优化预测精度和转换序列长度。
AI.result: 在19个数据集（14个分类、5个回归）上，PHER在所有数据集上均优于RDG、ERG、LDA、AFAT、NFS、TTG、GRFG、DIFER、MOAT等9个基线方法。消融实验验证了层次建模、排列不变性和RL搜索三个组件各自的有效性；鲁棒性实验显示PHER在不同下游模型（RF、XGBoost、KNN、DT）上均稳定；搜索种子消融表明高质量种子初始化显著优于随机初始化；超参数敏感性分析显示ε=0.2、λ=0.9时性能最佳；t-SNE可视化证实排列后嵌入保持一致性；可追溯性案例研究显示约70%的重要特征由PHER生成，性能提升23.7%。
AI.conclusion: PHER通过排列不变的层次建模和策略引导的多目标搜索，有效解决了生成式特征转换中的层次关系缺失、排列偏差和非凸搜索空间三大挑战，在多个数据集和下游模型上展现了优越的性能和鲁棒性。未来可探索轻量化的概念建模框架或改进RL搜索策略以提升计算效率。

title: LiteRAG: Cost-Efficient Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Graph-based retrieval can improve multi-hop question answering, but existing approaches often incur high query-time costs and produce diffuse, oversized contexts that reduce generation efficiency. We present LiteRAG, a graph-based retrieval method that replaces expensive retrieval-time LLM control with query-conditioned algorithmic exploration and reasoning-chain context construction. On DistComp, a benchmark for multi-hop retrieval over distributed-systems papers, LiteRAG attains the highest overall quality among the evaluated methods (0.798) while reducing per-query latency by over 100$\times$ and cost by over 99% relative to GraphRAG Global and DRIFT. On UltraDomain, it matches LinearRAG on overall quality while using about 14$\times$ fewer tokens. An ablation study indicates that LiteRAG's query-adaptive thresholding and community-aware hub penalization are the main drivers of its token-efficiency gains.

AI.tldr: LiteRAG是一种基于图的检索增强生成方法，通过用查询条件驱动的算法图探索替代检索时的LLM调用，并采用推理链上下文构建，在多跳问答任务中以显著更低的延迟和成本实现了最优或具有竞争力的答案质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于图的RAG方法在多跳问答中虽能提升检索质量，但严重依赖LLM在检索时进行图遍历、社区摘要与证据聚合，导致查询延迟高、成本高，且返回的上下文过于庞大、信息密度低，迫使生成模型在大量弱相关信息中搜索证据，稀释了有用信息。
AI.method: LiteRAG由三阶段组成：(1)查询条件锚点选择——结合语义相似度、词法匹配和社区相关性对候选节点评分，按阈值筛选锚点集；(2)查询条件子图扩展——采用查询自适应动态阈值和社区感知的枢纽惩罚进行有界并行图遍历，避免固定跳数遍历的低效和高度节点的噪声；(3)推理链上下文构建——利用多信号共识评分对子图实体排序，将保留的关系转化为紧凑的"实体→关系→实体"推理链条目而非原始文本块，生成信息密度高、约2000 token的最终上下文。
AI.result: 在DistComp（D_1280，含约50万token）上，LiteRAG以Q_total=0.798取得最高整体质量，同时延迟仅1.42秒、单查询成本0.0003美元；相比GraphRAG Global降低延迟100倍以上、成本降低99%以上，相比GraphRAG DRIFT成本降低超过99%。在UltraDomain Mix上与LinearRAG并列最高质量（0.801），但token用量减少约14倍、成本降低约92%。固定2,000 token预算下，几乎所有基线出现2%–16%的质量下降，LiteRAG无下降。消融实验表明查询自适应阈值化和社区感知枢纽惩罚是token效率提升的主要驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 将图探索与LLM推理解耦，并将上下文构建视为检索的核心环节，可以以极低的执行预算获得高质量的多跳问答效果；LiteRAG的紧凑、结构显式的上下文能够在严格的token预算下保持答案质量，为图基RAG系统提供了良好的质量-效率权衡。未来的工作可以进一步细化检索控制并在更多领域测试上下文策展原则。

title: A-JIT: Agentic Just-In-Time Software Construction
comment: Technical report for presentation at VMIL 2026
summary: Traditional software delivery assumes a static paradigm: code is constructed prior to execution and deployed as a fixed artifact. We present Agentic Just-In-Time Software Construction (A-JIT), a paradigm that replaces static binaries with dynamic, software systems that can perpetually evolve to meet changing demands. In A-JIT, an application is an integrated assembly comprising code, a runtime harness, and an embedded AI agent that continuously observes system usage and live execution traces. Much like a traditional JIT compiler specializes machine code to runtime execution paths, A-JIT specializes software logic, workflows, and tool interfaces to meet the specific needs of the end-user. By integrating synthesis directly into the ambient application lifecycle, A-JIT enables applications to dynamically construct missing implementations, generate new capabilities on the fly, and continuously adapt to end-user behavior. We demonstrate how this model supports trace-driven human-AI co-construction and opens a new design space for adaptive, self-evolving software.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A-JIT（Agentic Just-In-Time Software Construction），将传统JIT编译思想从机器码特化扩展到软件逻辑、工作流和工具接口的运行时动态构造，使应用能够在执行过程中根据用户行为和执行轨迹持续演化、生成缺失实现和新能力。
AI.motivation: 传统软件交付采用静态范式：代码在执行前完成构建并部署为固定制品。这种模式难以适应运行时变化的用户需求，也无法在执行过程中灵活整合AI合成能力。作者希望借鉴JIT编译器将编译融入运行时的思想，将软件开发过程本身嵌入运行时，使代码可按需即时生成与演化。
AI.method: A-JIT依赖四项关键机制：① Bosque编程语言的一级 hole 构造（?_+元数据），用于显式标注待实现代码；② 支持运行时即时构造、热加载与时间旅行调试的运行环境；③ 借力Tecton值生成框架为部分实现自动合成具体输出值，并利用IO对逐步合成完整实现；④ 基于BAPI格式的"tactile values"，支持人类/AI直接读写、嵌入表达式并验证类型与语义约束。结合嵌入式AI代理持续观测用户行为与执行trace，动态填充hole并特化软件逻辑。
AI.result: 论文以天气预测单位转换函数（Forecast→ForecastSI）为运行示例，展示了：A-JIT能自动检测partial实现，调用Tecton生成正确的ForecastSI输出值；通过累积IO对由LLM代理合成完整convert函数；BAPI值能利用$src等表达式表达输出，并能检测如low/high互换之类的语义错误；并提出在终端用户场景（如客服工单系统）通过trace聚类与hole抽象自动生成定制化工作流工具的愿景。
AI.conclusion: A-JIT开辟了"自适应、自演化软件"的新设计空间，将合成直接整合进运行时生命周期，支持trace驱动的人机协同构建，并为应对代理系统带来的软件工程挑战提供了可行路径；所有支撑系统已在BosqueCore开源。

title: DiSCo: A Distribution-First Steering and Cultural Prior Evaluation Framework for Measuring Cultural Preference Bias in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in globally used assistants, yet their default choices in culturally grounded everyday situations can systematically favour some cultures over others, affecting localisation, user trust, and equitable behaviour. Existing cultural benchmarks evaluate accuracy against a single "correct" answer, making it difficult to characterise an LLM's cultural preference prior when multiple culturally grounded responses are all valid; they also conflate default preferences with context-driven adaptation. We propose DiSCo, a distribution-first forced-choice evaluation framework that isolates default cultural priors and tests steerability via a four-level context gradient (C0--C3). Using DiSCo-Bench (304 items) derived from BLEnD spanning 12 cultures, we evaluate six diverse instruction-tuned LLMs. Default priors are heavily concentrated, with UK and US together absorbing approximately 35\% of all selections despite representing only 2 of 12 cultures. Most critically, prompt-based steering consistently widens the selection gap between high- and low-resource cultures, and injecting explicit cultural facts produces negligible distributional disruption, confirming that cultural preference bias cannot be resolved through prompt-based personalisation alone.

AI.tldr: DiSCo提出了一种以分布为先的强制选择评估框架，通过四级上下文梯度（C0–C3）隔离LLM的默认文化偏好先验并测试其可引导性。基于BLEnD构建的DiSCo-Bench（304题，12文化）在6个LLM上的评估显示：默认先验高度集中于英美（占35%选择），提示引导反而扩大高低资源文化间的差距，显式文化事实注入对分布几乎无扰动（JSD<0.02）。
AI.motivation: LLM在全球部署时，其在文化场景中的默认选择可能系统性偏向某些文化，影响本地化、用户信任与公平性。现有文化基准以"单一正确答案"评估准确率，难以刻画多文化场景下的偏好先验分布，且混淆了默认偏好与上下文驱动的适应性。
AI.method: 1) 数据集构建：将BLEnD的393道国别MCQ改写为国家中性形式，为每选项生成文化事实字符串，过滤虚拟文化行，得到150,816行DiSCo数据集，并从中采样304题12文化的DiSCo-Bench。2) 四级上下文评估协议：C0无上下文（默认先验）、C1加位置提示、C2加位置+意图指令、C3同时注入四选项文化事实（无目标）。C3采用4×4选项-上下文独立轮转以控制首位偏倚。3) 八项指标：KL散度、Gini系数、文化选择分布（CSD）、合规率（CR）、信号提升（SL）、先验粘性指数（PSI）、统计平价差（SPD）、JSD。4) 评估模型：DeepSeek V3.2、LLaMA 3.3 70B、Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.4 Nano、Qwen3 8B、Gemma 3n E4B，temperature=0。
AI.result: 所有6个模型的默认先验高度集中于英美（合计35%选择），KL=0.12–0.20、Gini=0.33–0.40。C1合规率0.43–0.57，C2提升至0.50–0.66但PSI仍达0.34–0.50。所有模型的SPD在C2后不减反增（-0.037至-0.085），提示引导扩大了高低资源文化的选择差距。C3事实注入后JSD均<0.02，分布几乎不变，确认先验深度根植于模型权重。Northern Nigeria、Ethiopia、Assam在所有条件下始终位列最底部。首位偏倚在所有模型中存在（PPR=0.28–0.42），通过独立上下文轮转成功隔离控制。
AI.conclusion: 文化偏好偏倚在LLM中是稳定且抵抗提示干预的结构性属性，跨模型族一致存在。提示引导不仅不能缩小反而扩大高低资源文化间的公平性差距，需要训练层面的干预（数据平衡、文化感知微调、检索增强）而非提示工程来解决。该研究将文化对齐重新定位为分布偏好与公平性问题，而非单一正确答案任务。

title: GANDR: Claim Auditing for Verifiable Legal Answer Generation
summary: In high-stakes domains such as legal practice, a language-model answer is only useful to the extent that a reader can verify each claim against the source the system cites. Current grounded-generation pipelines score the answer as a whole, so a correct conclusion can rest on fabricated or loosely matched citations and still score well. Closing this gap requires both a system built for per-claim verification and an evaluation that measures it. We introduce GANDR (Grounded ANswer DRafter), a two-agent system in which a Drafter writes an answer in a structured legal-reasoning format and a separate Critic, with the same view as a human verifier, audits each claim against its cited source and emits a per-claim audit trace on every round. We pair it with a strict correctness criterion requiring every citation to resolve to a passage the retriever returned. On a 185-item legal benchmark where all six systems share one backbone, one retrieval surface, and one citation instruction, GANDR ranks first on every primary metric, reaching 70.8% strict accuracy and leading the strongest baseline by 11.3 points (p<0.01). Reverting the protocol-anchored commit rule lowers strict accuracy by 22.7 points, and the strict lead stays positive on three further backbones, at +3.2 to +6.5 points. This lead traces to the Drafter configuration and the protocol-anchored commit, not to rewriting. Against two law-trained annotators the audit flags under-supported claims at F1 0.84 as a binary detector, while its four-way verdict labels agree only weakly and are advisory. Code is available upon request.

AI.tldr: 提出 GANDR（双智能体法律答案生成与逐条审计系统），在严格正确性指标下显著优于五种基线，并随每条答案输出可审计的逐条核验轨迹。
AI.motivation: 在高风险法律领域，大模型生成答案虽结论正确却常伴随虚构或松散匹配的引用，整体评分掩盖了逐条可验证性的失败。现有评估以整体打分，无法激励系统在生成阶段就内建引用可核验性。
AI.method: 采用 CREAC（结论/规则/解释/应用/结论）结构化生成作为验证契约，由 Drafter 生成法律备忘录，由独立上下文（无 Drafter 思维链）的 Critic 调用 protocol_check、原子 cite_verify、SEF rubric_score 三个工具逐条审计。编排器的提交规则锚定在基于正则的结构检查（Round-1 anchor），而非 Critic 的 PASS/REWRITE 判定；通过则直接提交，失败最多 T=3 轮改写，最终失败时返回 passed=False 并附完整审计轨迹。评估采用严格正确性（结论正确 + 每个引用标记解析到检索返回的段落）与 Stable & Correct@k 指标，由跨谱系模型 Claude Opus 4.7 作为评判。
AI.result: 在 185 题 LegalBench/LegalBench-RAG 基准上，GANDR 在严格正确性达 70.8%，领先最强基线 B2 11.3 个百分点（配对 McNemar p<0.01，Bonferroni 校正后 p=0.03）。将提交规则还原为原 0.95 原子核验门槛，严格正确性下降 22.7 个百分点。在 GLM-4.7-Flash、gpt-5.4-mini、gpt-5.4 三种其他骨干上严格正确性领先 +3.2 至 +6.5 个百分点。审计轨迹作为二元"需关注"检测器对法律训练标注者达 F1 0.84（精度 0.80，召回 0.88），但四类标签 κ 仅 0.275，仅作建议性使用。98.6% 项目在首轮即通过结构锚定提交。
AI.conclusion: GANDR 将逐条可验证性作为生成阶段的一等公民而非事后评分补丁，贡献在于双智能体架构与协议锚定的提交规则；该系统被验证为针对已提供权威文献的引用纪律层，而非开放语料法律研究。审计轨迹是可靠标记但标签仅作建议；多源备忘录与更难检索场景留作未来工作。

title: RiLM: Parameter-Efficient Language Modeling via Geodesic Decoding
summary: Language models under one million parameters matter for edge deployment, domain adaptation, and reproducible research, yet a two-layer LSTM or Transformer at embedding width d = 128 still spends roughly one third of its capacity on the output matrix W_out in R^(d x |V|). We propose Riemannian Language Models (RiLM), which remove that layer entirely: context unfolds as a trajectory on a Riemannian manifold, and next-token probabilities arise from squared geodesic distance between the current state and vocabulary embeddings. The same embedding map serves input and output -- decoding is geometry. We instantiate the framework on flat R^d (Flat RiLM) and the Poincare ball H^d (HypRiLM) with a shared MLP composition map phi (~290k parameters, d = 128, |V| = 2000). Across five seeds on WikiText-2, HypRiLM reaches 54.2 +/- 0.2 validation perplexity versus 87.6 +/- 0.6 for Flat RiLM; tied and matched LSTM, Transformer, and SSM controls remain at 113-147 PPL on WT-2 -- HypRiLM leads by roughly 2x over the strongest tied recurrent baseline (SSM, 113.0 +/- 3.8). Penn Treebank and a 10k-vocabulary stress test confirm that geodesic decoding transfers across corpora and larger |V|, while hyperbolic curvature helps selectively. We also characterize boundary collapse in naive hyperbolic recurrence and show how Mobius stabilization restores trainability. Claims are scoped to controlled small-model comparisons, not full-vocabulary state of the art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RiLM（黎曼语言模型），通过几何解码（测地线距离替代独立的输出矩阵W_out）实现参数高效的小型语言建模。在~290k参数、d=128、|V|=2000的受限设置下，HypRiLM（双曲Poincaré球）在WikiText-2上达到54.2±0.2验证困惑度，显著优于Flat RiLM（87.6±0.6）以及绑定和参数匹配的LSTM、Transformer、SSM基线（113–147 PPL）。同时识别并解决了朴素双曲递归中的"边界塌缩"问题，提出基于Möbius平移的稳定更新方案。
AI.motivation: 在百万参数以下的语言模型中，输出矩阵W_out占据了约1/3的参数预算（如d=128, |V|=2000时约256k），限制了边缘部署和领域适应。传统的LSTM/Transformer要么保留它，要么通过权重绑定来部分缓解，但仍使用与状态运动方式脱节的线性解码器。此外，语言的层次特性在欧氏空间中嵌入失真较大，双曲空间虽然能更好地表示层级结构，但很少用于控制上下文的时间组合。论文旨在探索是否可以用流形几何同时替代词向量和整个解码器。
AI.method: 核心思想是将状态h_t视为黎曼流形上的点，词汇嵌入e_w也位于同一流形上。使用共享的MLP组合映射φ（~33k参数）读取切空间中的状态和当前词嵌入，提议更新方向，状态沿测地线移动。下一个词的概率通过h_t与各词汇嵌入之间的负平方测地线距离softmax得到，即p(w|h_t) ∝ exp(-d_M(h_t, e_w)²/τ)。该机制消除了独立的W_out，使输入嵌入和输出分类耦合。两种实例化：(1) Flat RiLM（M=R^d，欧氏特例，h_{t+1} = h_t + φ(h_t, e_w)）；(2) HypRiLM（M=Poincaré球H^d）。针对双曲空间中朴素指数映射更新导致的状态迅速逼近边界（‖h_t‖→1/√c）从而使所有距离趋于一致的"边界塌缩"问题，提出在原点处计算切向增量后用Möbius加法平移的方案：δ_t = exp_0(s·φ(log_0 h_t, log_0 e_w))，h_{t+1} = h_t ⊕_c δ_t。训练使用掩码NLL损失、截断BPTT（k=8）、上下文长度64、batch size 128、10个epoch。双曲模型使用学习率3e-3、曲率c=1.0、梯度裁剪范数1.0。
AI.result: WikiText-2（5个种子，2k词汇）：HypRiLM达到54.2±0.2 PPL，Flat RiLM为87.6±0.6 PPL；未绑定的LSTM（149.9±2.7）和Transformer（137.4±5.1）在~776k参数下仍差84–96 PPL。公平对比下（绑定基线d=128，匹配基线~290k），HypRiLM在所有基线上以59–93 PPL的优势胜出，包括强SSM绑定基线（113.0±3.8）。Penn Treebank（3个种子，2k词汇）：Flat RiLM以40.9±0.6 PPL优于HypRiLM（69.8±0.5），两者均远低于各绑定和匹配基线（108.9–214.3 PPL）。10k词汇压力测试：Flat RiLM（341.8±0.5）和HypRiLM（345.8±16.0）均约为SSM绑定（708.3±9.0）的一半，但此时平面几何略稳定于双曲。消融显示双曲曲率c=1.0对结果贡献显著（c=0.1时HypRiLM退化至71.1 PPL），spline φ仅带来微小改善。边界塌缩验证：朴素exp_h_t在3步内‖h_t‖≈0.999，困惑度等于|V|=2000（均匀基线）；Möbius方案训练后‖h_t‖稳定在[0.29, 0.71]。推理速度：Flat RiLM约0.15 ms/token，HypRiLM约0.52 ms/token，双曲开销约为平面版本的3.5倍。
AI.conclusion: RiLM将小型语言建模重新定义为流形上的几何问题：上下文是一条路径，解码通过到词汇点的距离而非单独的输出矩阵。在受控规模（~290k参数，2k词汇）下，测地线解码是一种在参数稀缺情况下耦合表示与预测的具体方法。稳定的Möbius递归是关键工程贡献——没有它，双曲RiLM无法训练。HypRiLM在WikiText-2上大幅优于公平的LSTM、Transformer和SSM基线；Flat RiLM在Penn Treebank上更优；两者在两个语料上都优于绑定和匹配控制。该方法不是十亿参数预训练的替代方案，但在中等词汇量和参数稀缺场景下提供了对W_out的原则性替代。作者建议流形选择应作为验证集决策而非默认，并期望解码思想在中等|V|时最有用，规模化时是否需要曲率仍是开放问题。

title: One Loop, Two Gains: Can Active Learning win the Lottery for Free?
summary: The lottery ticket hypothesis posits the existence of winning tickets: sparse subnetworks that, when trained in isolation from their original initialization, match the accuracy of the full dense network. The predominant method for discovering such tickets, iterative magnitude pruning, alternates pruning with full retraining from scratch until convergence over many cycles. Similarly, deep active learning also retrains a model from scratch after each acquisition round as new labels become available. Despite this shared reliance on iterative retraining with a substantial computational overhead, the two paradigms have been studied separately. We observe that the iterative training loop inherent to pool-based active learning already provides the exact computational structure that iterative magnitude pruning exploits, and propose Improve & Prune (I&P), a method that integrates magnitude pruning into each active learning retraining cycle at practically no additional cost. This raises a key empirical question: can iterative magnitude pruning produce winning tickets under the non-stationary data regime of active learning? We investigate this question across multiple acquisition functions, architecture families, and image classification datasets, including an active fine-tuning scenario. Our results demonstrate that I&P yields sparse, deployable models at each active learning iteration. Those match the accuracy of their dense counterparts at sparsities up to 95%, effectively obtaining winning tickets as a byproduct of the active learning pipeline. These per-iteration sparse models can address two computational bottlenecks - per-round model retraining and acquisition scoring over the unlabeled pool - that currently prevent the practical adoption of DAL on large architectures and large unlabeled pools.

AI.tldr: 提出Improve & Prune (I&P)方法，将迭代幅度剪枝(IMP)集成到深度主动学习(DAL)循环中，无需额外训练成本即可在每次DAL迭代中发现彩票中奖子网络，在95%稀疏度下保持密集模型精度，同时降低约50%的计算量。
AI.motivation: 深度主动学习(DAL)和彩票假设(LTH)各自独立研究，但都依赖迭代重训练的计算结构。DAL面临大模型重训练和大规模未标注池采集打分的计算瓶颈；IMP虽能发现稀疏子网络但本身计算昂贵。两者结构性重叠的天然结合尚未被探索。
AI.method: Improve & Prune (I&P)：在每次DAL重训练后附加一个剪枝步骤。流程为：1)掩码扩展(随机按层级重新激活部分被剪权重)；2)在掩码约束下训练至收敛；3)按幅度剪枝并进行短轮微调(φ个epoch)；4)用稀疏模型进行采集打分。关键创新是允许掩码动态扩展-收缩而非单调缩减，适应DAL的非平稳数据分布。采用非结构化幅度剪枝和逐层随机重激活。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100、Imagewoof、Tiny-ImageNet、Places365四个数据集、六种采集函数(Margin/CoreSet/BADGE/SAAL/MaxHerding/UHerding)、CNN与Transformer架构(ResNet-18/50、ConvNext v2 Tiny、DeiT-S、DINO ViT-S)上，I&P在95%稀疏度下统计性匹配密集模型精度(单侧Wilcoxon非劣效检验，p<0.05)。Tiny-ImageNet上节省约50%累积MACs；随机剪枝基线(Rand Prune)90%以上微调无法收敛。固定掩码随数据增长性能退化，验证了逐轮掩码调整的必要性。
AI.conclusion: I&P首次证明彩票中奖子网络可在非平稳数据分布下被发现，将DAL与LTH统一为单一循环，同时实现稀疏可部署模型和计算效率提升。稀疏模型还为基于距离的采集函数提供二次加速的嵌入维度缩减。局限性：非结构化稀疏在当前主流GPU上无法直接转化为等比例加速；评估限于图像分类；Places365上ViT架构与Dense差距稍大(约1%)。

title: OmniMed-FL: A Robust Multimodal Federated Learning Framework for Clinical Diagnosis
summary: Simultaneous assessment of medical imaging and patient records is often required in clinical diagnosis. However, standard machine learning algorithms cannot analyze these data types together. Meanwhile, compliance with HIPAA and GDPR can constrain centralized aggregation of sensitive patient data. This leaves a crucial void of secure fusion of visual and textual context across distant networks. Thus, we present OmniMed-FL, a controlled systems study of multimodal federated learning for five-class clinical condition classification (Normal, Pneumonia, COVID-19, Pleural Effusion, Cardiomegaly). Our proxy corpus pairs 3,000 public chest radiographs with 3,000 class-conditioned synthetic notes, matched by class, not by patient. The framework benchmarks eight fusion strategies, three initializations, four missing-text imputation rules, and matched federated baselines under non-IID Dirichlet partitioning across 3 to 20 hospital clients. As all notes are synthetic and pairing is not patient-level, these are descriptive proxy comparisons, not estimates of diagnostic performance or deployment readiness. Within those limits with clients ($K=5$) and severe skew ($\alpha=0.1$), local-only training achieves a macro-F1 score of 0.297, FedAvg achieves $0.662\pm0.074$, FedProx $0.737\pm0.085$, a matched FedMME-style one-shot ensemble $0.647\pm0.080$, and our SCAFFOLD-AdamW adaptation $0.070\pm0.015$, the 0.075 FedProx-FedAvg gap falling inside the wider of the two two-seed standard deviations. Over a $4\times3$ grid, label skew costs up to 0.27 F1 whereas a near-sevenfold client increase costs at most 0.10, while bidirectional volume grows linearly to 183.5 GiB at $K=20$. Multimodal fusion leads on both corpora, scoring 0.956 against 0.934 for text and 0.664 for images on the synthetic corpus and 0.906 against 0.880 and 0.737 on the radiograph corpus, for $2.3\times$ the model state of text alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniMed-FL，一个用于五类临床胸片诊断的多模态联邦学习框架基准。该框架在受控代理语料上系统性评估了 8 种融合策略、3 种初始化方式和 4 种缺失文本填补规则，并与 FedAvg、FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedMME、P-FIN 等匹配基线在非独立同分布（Dirichlet 分区）下进行了 3 到 20 个客户端的比较研究，旨在量化标签偏斜、客户端数量、融合算子和多模态通信成本对系统性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 临床诊断通常需要同时分析医学影像和患者记录，但由于 HIPAA/GDPR 合规约束，敏感数据无法集中聚合。现有的临床联邦学习系统多为单模态，无法融合视觉与文本信息；与此同时，集中式视觉-语言模型虽性能较好但牺牲了数据本地化。该研究旨在填补"多模态精度"与"数据本地化"二者不可兼得的空白，探索在分布式医院网络中安全融合影像与文本信息的可行性与系统性折中。
AI.method: 1. 任务定义：五类临床条件分类（正常、肺炎、COVID-19、胸腔积液、心脏肥大）。2. 数据构建：构建两个受控代理语料——Dataset A（程序生成的合成 X 光图 + 模板合成临床文本）和 Dataset B（来自 Kermany、NIH ChestX-ray、COVID-19 Radiography Database 的 3000 张公开胸片 + 配对的类别条件合成文本），均为类级别配对而非患者级配对。3. 编码器：DistilBERT 文本编码器投影至 256 维，ViT-Base/16 视觉编码器产生 512 维特征。4. 八种融合策略：投影拼接、双投影拼接、门控残差融合、残差/非残差交叉注意力、解码器 A/B、Token 编码器。5. 联邦协议：FedAvg/FedProx/SCAFFOLD-AdamW 适配等基线，3 个本地 AdamW epoch，T=8 轮，batch=16，FP32，Dirichlet α∈{0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1, 5}，K∈{3,5,10,20}。6. 损失函数：标签平滑交叉熵 + 焦点损失 + 熵多样性正则 + 置信度惩罚。7. 评估指标：Macro-F1、通信量（双向 V=2KT|θ|b）、GPU 时间、峰值内存、检索质量。8. 缺失文本处理：零填充、确定性 FIN、Gaussian β-NLL、不确定性加权聚合等 P-FIN 风格策略。
AI.result: 1. 严重偏斜下（α=0.1, K=5）：Local-only 0.297、FedAvg 0.662±0.074、FedProx 0.737±0.085、FedMME-style（匹配 24 epoch）0.647±0.080、SCAFFOLD-AdamW 适配 0.070±0.015；FedProx 与 FedAvg 的 0.075 差距在两种子标准差范围内，无显著差异。2. 多模态融合最优：合成语料上拼接融合 0.956 vs 文本 0.934 vs 图像 0.664；胸片语料上残差交叉注意力 0.906 vs 文本 0.880 vs 图像 0.737，但比纯拼接（0.813）更高。3. 反坍缩组件（类平衡采样+熵多样性）在严重偏斜下牺牲约 0.075 F1 换取五类预测多样性（0.7→0.9）。4. 可扩展性：标签偏斜影响显著（α=0.1 时 F1 仅 0.643-0.738），而客户端数从 K=3 增至 K=20 最多仅下降 0.10 F1；双向通信量线性增长至 K=20 时 183.5 GiB。5. 多模态成本：相对纯文本分支模型状态 2.3×、墙钟时间 3.1×、内存 2.1×，但 F1 提升 0.026。6. 初始化：公开预训练编码器+随机任务头（0.831）比全随机初始化（0.647）高约 0.18；池化起点因在报告集上选择而存在偏差（0.877）。7. 联邦保留集中式 99.1% 性能。
AI.conclusion: OmniMed-FL 表明在受控代理基准下：(1) 多模态融合在所有实验设置中均优于单模态；(2) 联邦训练能保留集中式训练的绝大部分性能；(3) 标签偏斜而非客户端数量是影响准确率的主导因素；(4) 通信量随客户端数线性增长而精度几乎不下降；(5) 多模态融合带来约 2-3 倍的模型状态、运行时和内存开销；(6) 公开预训练编码器初始化可显著提升联邦训练性能。但作者明确强调这些是描述性代理比较而非临床部署就绪性评估：合成文本、类别级别（而非患者级别）配对、各类来自不同源数据集等局限使结果无法外推至真实临床诊断场景。未来工作需引入患者配对的多机构放射学数据、形式化差分隐私审计、异步聚合和端到端通信测量。

title: Can Foundation Models Moderate Online Content? Evaluating Instruction- vs. Example-Driven Policy Operationalization
summary: The growing complexity of content moderation policies presents a critical challenge for their consistent operationalization. While foundation models possess the basic capabilities needed to confront this challenge, whether they can reliably moderate online content remains an unanswered question. In this paper, we systematically compare two competing paradigms for Vision-Language Model (VLM) guidance: an instruction-driven approach where models reason from policy precepts, and an example-driven approach where they generalize from prior precedents. We ground this investigation in ModerationBench, a new benchmark of 4,000 manually annotated, in-the-wild posts from the Bluesky platform. Our experiments reveal that foundation models can substantially outperform Bluesky's deployed moderation system, nearly tripling its $F_1$ score (0.60 vs. 0.22) on Random Posts in the benchmark, with both instruction- and example-driven paradigms achieving comparable peak effectiveness. Our findings thus chart a path toward reliable and adaptable policy operationalization at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了基于Bluesky平台的ModerationBench基准（4000条多模态人工标注帖子），系统比较了指令驱动与示例驱动两种VLM内容审核范式，发现基础模型在F1分数上接近Bluesky现役审核系统的三倍（0.60 vs 0.22），且两种范式峰值性能相当，但指令驱动范式在效率与可扩展性上显著优于示例驱动范式。
AI.motivation: 在线内容审核政策日趋复杂（部分平台政策词数超26000），传统基于规则与模式匹配的自动化系统脆弱且难以处理上下文细微差异，而基础模型（VLMs）的实际审核能力尚未得到系统评估，核心问题在于：基础模型能否可靠地将复杂政策落地到实际审核决策中。
AI.method: （1）构建ModerationBench基准：包含4个数据集子集（Random Posts、Moderated Posts、Near-moderated Posts、Safe Posts）共4000条多模态帖子，每条由人工按BMS政策标注；（2）评估两类范式：指令驱动（提供政策标签What、原因Why、实施细则How的组合）与示例驱动（Random/Prototypical/Contextual示例选择策略）；（3）评估多种模型：开源权重（gemma4、qwen3.5等）与前沿闭源（gemini3.5、gpt5.6）VLM，以及专用AI安全模型（llama-guard、shieldstral）；（4）分析决策一致性、判断一致性（政策引用分布）与实际效率。
AI.result: （1）Bluesky部署系统存在显著覆盖缺口：近35%与已审核内容语义相似的帖子未被标记但人工判定为违规；（2）指令驱动VLMs大幅优于BMS（F1：0.60 vs 0.22于Random Posts），开源模型gemma4接近前沿模型gemini3.5（0.52 vs 0.60）；（3）政策细节（How）对一致性至关重要，可将F1提升25%并使标记率减半；（4）示例驱动最佳方法（Prototypical）达到相近F1（0.59），但推理延迟增加6倍以上，成本高出2.7×–32×；（5）专用AI安全模型（llama-guard）效果不佳，无法通过提示有效适配平台政策；（6）模型间决策高度一致但体现"审核多元性"——不同VLM对同一帖子给出不同但合理的政策解读。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型能够可靠地落地内容审核政策，性能显著优于现有部署系统；指令驱动与示例驱动范式峰值效果相当，但指令驱动范式因高效、可扩展且能灵活适应政策演变，更适合平台规模部署；专用AI安全模型因固定分类法限制难以有效转向平台特定政策；模型间分歧反映对同一政策的合理不同诠释而非随机差异，凸显了理解与调和审核差异的重要性。本研究为透明、可适应的平台治理奠定了基础，但仍存在视频/音频模态、上下文依赖、系统性偏见、实时流式部署等开放问题。

title: Emergency Department Revisit Quality Review Screening: Exploring Human Decision-Making and Artificial Intelligence Support
summary: Background: Emergency Department (ED) return visits are commonly reviewed for quality assurance, but are often limited (e.g., to revisits within 48-72 hours) to increase actionable finding yield while minimizing chart review burden. Those limitations may lead to missed quality improvement opportunities. Methods: We conducted an exploratory, retrospective study of randomly selected ED visits to a multihospital health system having an ED revisit within 1-14 days to the same health system. Given only each visit's primary diagnosis, raters (2-3 clinicians and GPT-4 large language model [LLM]) assessed characteristics of the diagnosis pairs, including the "target": whether a pair warranted further assessment. Informed by rater response analyses, an algorithm leveraging an LLM-populated knowledge graph ("KGA") was created to automatically screen for potentially concerning pairs, then preliminarily assessed. Results: 99 diagnosis pairs were included. GPT-4 responses poorly correlated to clinician raters, rating nearly all (94%) pairs as warranting follow-up (4.4-13.3 times more than clinicians). However, prompt engineering was minimal. Among clinician raters, revisit medical gravity was consistently significantly associated with the target, while a differential diagnosis/complication composite was significantly associated on unadjusted, but not adjusted (though less powered) analysis. The KGA achieved 83-100% positive predictive value for at least one clinician rater determining further assessment was warranted based on the diagnosis pair. Conclusion: These results can inform next steps for improving screening with LLMs like ChatGPT. Further research is warranted to validate this preliminary work's finding that the KGA may enable enhancing the scope and yield of screening without substantially increasing reviewer workload.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了利用大语言模型（如GPT-4）和知识图谱算法（KGA）来扩大急诊科（ED）回访质量审查范围（从传统的48-72小时延长至1-14天）的可行性，旨在识别可能被传统筛查遗漏的质量改进机会。
AI.motivation: 传统的急诊科回访质量审查通常仅限于48-72小时内的回访以提高可操作发现率，但这可能导致遗漏重要的质量改进机会。本研究旨在探索如何利用LLM和知识图谱扩大筛查范围，而不显著增加审查人员的工作负担。
AI.method: 采用回顾性探索性研究设计，随机抽取某多医院系统中1-14天内发生急诊回访的病例。2-3名临床医生和GPT-4作为评估者，仅基于每次就诊的主要诊断，评估诊断对特征（包括是否需要进一步评估的"目标"变量）。基于评估者响应分析，构建了利用LLM填充知识图谱的算法（KGA）来自动筛查潜在问题诊断对。
AI.result: 共纳入99对诊断。GPT-4的评估与临床医生相关性较差，将近94%的诊断对评为需要随访（比临床医生高4.4-13.3倍）。临床医生评估者中，回访医疗严重程度与目标变量显著相关；鉴别诊断/并发症复合变量在未调整分析中显著相关，但调整后分析（统计效能较低）中不显著。KGA对至少一名临床医生判定需要进一步评估的诊断对实现了83-100%的阳性预测值。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果可为改进LLM筛查提供方向。KGA的初步发现值得进一步验证，该方法有望在不显著增加审查工作量的情况下扩大筛查范围并提高产出。但GPT-4作为独立筛查工具目前尚不成熟，需进行提示工程优化。

title: Forgetting Only What Matters: Layer-Selective Unlearning toward Robust LLMs
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables, AACL-IJCNLP 2026, conference paper
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can memorize and reproduce sensitive, copyrighted, or otherwise undesirable training content, creating privacy, safety, and regulatory concerns. Machine unlearning offers a practical alternative to full retraining, but many existing methods apply broad or fixed parameter updates that can degrade utility and remain brittle under deployment changes such as post-training quantization, where forgotten knowledge may partially re-emerge. We propose Forgetting Only What Matters via Unlearning Layers (FOM-UL), a layer-level unlearning framework that selects transformer layers using a forget-to-retain significance score. This score identifies layers with high influence on the forget set and low sensitivity to the retain set, allowing FOM-UL to concentrate updates where they are most effective while leaving most of the model unchanged. This targeted update strategy improves the forgetting-utility trade-off and provides an empirical path toward quantization-resilient unlearning by reducing the chance that small, diffuse updates are erased by low-bit rounding. Across TOFU, KnowUnDo, and MUSE-style evaluations, FOM-UL reduces residual memorization compared with strong GA, NPO, KLD, SURE, ReLearn, and LUNAR-based baselines while preserving retain-set utility close to the vanilla model. Under 8-bit and 4-bit post-training quantization, FOM-UL maintains stronger memorization suppression and utility preservation than competing methods, and adversarial prompt evaluations show lower recovery of forgotten content. Overall, FOM-UL provides an efficient unlearning strategy that improves targeted forgetting, utility preservation, and deployment robustness without claiming formal guarantees of erasure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FOM-UL（Forgetting Only What Matters via Unlearning Layers），一种面向大语言模型的层级选择性遗忘框架。该方法通过计算"遗忘-保留显著性分数"（forget-to-retain significance score）来识别对遗忘集影响大、对保留集敏感度低的Transformer层，并仅对这些层进行更新，从而在遗忘效果、保留效用和计算效率之间取得更好平衡，并在后训练量化（8-bit、4-bit）下表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM遗忘方法存在两个核心问题：(1) 全局或固定区域的参数更新会产生广泛副作用，损害模型对无关知识的保留能力；(2) 这些分布式的小幅更新容易被后训练量化（如4-bit、8-bit）的舍入操作抹除，导致被遗忘的知识部分"复活"（quantization-induced recovery）。此外，针对性的对抗/越狱提示也可能恢复被遗忘的内容。因此需要一种更精准、更鲁棒的层级选择性遗忘策略。
AI.method: FOM-UL包含三个关键设计：(1) **遗忘-保留显著性分数**：计算每层遗忘集梯度范数与保留集梯度范数的比值 Sig(ℓ)=‖∇_forget‖/(‖∇_retain‖+ε)，据此排序并筛选层集合 S；(2) **三损失选择性更新**：在选中层内同时优化遗忘损失（梯度上升）、失配损失（KL散度驱使输出分布偏离原始模型）和保留损失（梯度下降），其他层完全冻结；(3) **迭代扩展机制**：初始选择少量高分层，若遗忘指标未达标则按 Sig 排序逐步扩展 S。理论上通过 Lemma 1（梯度比值是最优贪婪准则）和 Lemma 2（扩展层集不会恶化最优遗忘效果）给出形式化证明。此外通过 Theorem 1 解释为何层集中化更新能产生超出量化步长的参数变化，从而避免量化反转。
AI.result: 在TOFU、KnowUnDo、MUSE（含BOOKS/NEWS）等基准上，使用GPT-2、Llama-3.2-1B、Gemma-3-1B及Llama-2-7B等模型，FOM-UL在M1（逐字记忆）、M2（知识记忆）、M3（隐私泄漏，越接近0越好）和M4（效用保留，越高越好）四项指标上均优于GA、NPO、KLD及其与GDR/SURE的组合，以及ReLearn、LUNAR、MemFlex等强基线。在8-bit和4-bit后训练量化下，FOM-UL的剩余记忆更低、效用保持更好；在对抗/越狱提示评估中，攻击泄漏率（ALR）仅为11.6%，低于SURE+NPO（16.5%）和LUNAR（19.8%）。运行效率方面，仅更新约7M参数（基线SURE+NPO为1.7M、LUNAR为1.75M），GPU显存6-8GB，单次约20分钟。此外在4-bit量化下，层局部更新的Bin-Change Fraction达5.6%（基线GA仅0.7%、NPO仅0.9%），印证了量化鲁棒性机制。消融实验确认三个损失组件缺一不可。
AI.conclusion: FOM-UL提供了一种高效的层级选择性LLM近似遗忘方案，通过 forget-to-retain 显著性分数精准定位目标层，将更新集中于少数关键层而非全模型，改善了遗忘-效用权衡，并在对抗提示和低比特量化下表现出更强鲁棒性。研究表明层级别的遗忘-保留定位是实用且部署友好的遗忘方向，但作者明确指出该方法不提供形式化的擦除保证——高度纠缠或冗余编码的知识仍可能需要扩展更新层集或在更对抗性环境下额外迭代。

title: Semigroup-JEPA: Latent Dynamics Consistency for Zero-Shot Physics Generalization
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models learn a compact latent representation of the world that supports prediction and planning, but their capability to learn physics and generate physically realistic dynamics remains hitherto untested. In this work, we introduce SemiGroup-JEPA (SG-JEPA), which extends the LeWorldModel framework by supplying the parameter governing the physics to the temporal model via action-conditioning and jointly training an encoder and predictor through an autoregressive latent rollout. To evaluate the model's ability to generalize out of distribution, we design dynamical tasks under different gravitational fields that, despite obeying the same physical law, exhibit qualitatively different dynamics, ranging from floating motion in weak gravitational fields to rapid bouncing in strong ones. In contrast to DINO-WM, SG-JEPA reduces open-loop prediction error by up to 2 times on two-dimensional datasets, and increases control success rate up to 2.5 times for three-dimensional robotic datasets, for which we train independent diffusion policies. To explain this advantage, we develop a linear feature model that separates local law-conditioned error from its recursive amplification under rollout. Guided by this model, we find that back-propagating the multi-step rollout loss into the representation trains the encoder to keep the features that the predictor can carry forward, and that those are the features the dynamics depend on, so most of the gain comes from the encoder learning better features rather than from the predictor learning better dynamics. See project page at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出Semigroup-JEPA (SG-JEPA)，通过将重力作为动作条件输入并联合训练编码器与预测器，在重力分布外实现零样本物理泛化，在长时程预测和闭环控制任务上显著优于DINO-WM和LeWorldModel，并通过线性特征模型理论解释增益主要来源于编码器学到了更好的特征。
AI.motivation: 现有JEPA世界模型（如DINO-WM、LeWorldModel）虽然在固定转换定律下表现良好，但其是否真正学到了物理动力学以及能否泛化到分布外（如不同重力场）的动力学仍未被验证。如果世界模型能真正学到动力学，将使智能体在新环境中零样本适应。
AI.method: 1) 架构：将重力标量作为动作的额外坐标输入，通过动作编码器融入预测器；2) 训练目标：采用K步自回归潜在rollout损失（带折扣γ）+ SIGReg正则化，联合训练ViT编码器和GRU/SSM/Transformer预测器；3) 理论分析：建立线性特征模型，将局部一步误差与rollout递归放大分离，证明误差界依赖于重力覆盖因子；4) 8个MuJoCo数据集：在窄重力范围内训练，在更宽网格（含OOD值）上评估。
AI.result: 1) 2D数据集：SG-JEPA将开环预测误差较DINO-WM降低最高2倍；2) 3D机器人数据集：控制成功率提高最高2.5倍（Arm Catcher Ball从9.5%提升至23.3%）；3) Approach Ball位置预测误差较DINO-WM降低34%，较LeWM降低50%；4) 机制分析：优势主要来自编码器学到的表征（GRU训练的编码器替换预测器后优势仍保持），且教师强制下远OOD重力误差已降低32%；5) 递归rollout将局部优势在长时程上放大数倍；6) 稀疏重力后训练可在未观测重力值上进一步降低误差。
AI.conclusion: SG-JEPA通过重力条件化和递归潜在rollout联合训练，在零样本物理泛化上取得显著提升；理论表明增益主要来自编码器表征（而非预测器动力学），且重力条件化本身不保证外推，还需足够的重力覆盖。局限包括：仅测试标量重力、形状迁移不均、线性理论模型与非线性神经预测器存在差距。

title: IBIB: A Protocol for Measuring Enterprise AI Systems by Serving Route, Not Model Identifier
summary: Enterprises deploy systems, not checkpoints. Usable capability depends jointly on weights, serving route, precision, output contract, and harness, yet all 18 audited benchmarks score advertised model identifiers. We treat this as measurement error and give a protocol that makes it reportable. It has three parts. A gold-blind capability-binding preflight verifies that a route can execute the evaluation contract before any task reaches it; a reliability-inclusive first-pass scoring rule keeps failure in the score while keeping unsupported capability out; and adjudication is structurally score-blind. We call the protocol IB2 and release its algorithms, classification tables, request contract, and manifest schemas. Its reference instantiation, 128 locked tasks and 987 assertions over document, spreadsheet, chart, tool and database work, stays sealed: the procedure is the artifact, not the corpus. Across eleven systems, four results. Capability availability is measurable: two complete single-route runs on identical weights later failed distinct predicates of the finalized binding gate, while a third passed that gate before a fresh run. The advertised identifier exposed neither limit. Discrimination is not uniform: four of seven suites saturate under a six-system band, with the spread almost entirely from governed database work and multi-tab joins, so we report interval-backed resolution groups, not ranks; two of the nominal five-label output's four cuts fail multiplicity adjustment. Serving-arm choice moved one declared revision and precision from 77.38 to 82.54, paired interval [0.11,10.60], though the arms differ in access mode, harness generation, and the serving tool-call parser, and harness generation is a property of our evaluator, not any endpoint. Excluding failed responses from denominators changes the point ordering, so reliability inclusion changes a conclusion, not its wording.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 IB² 协议（Iterate Business Intelligence Benchmark），主张评估企业AI系统应以"服务路由"而非"模型标识符"为测量对象。协议包含三个核心部分：黄金盲能力绑定预检、可靠性包含的首轮评分规则、结构性分数盲的裁决机制。作者在11个商业AI系统上进行实证，发现4/7测试套件已在六系统频段饱和，且同一模型经不同服务路由可产生5.16分的显著差异。
AI.motivation: 现有18个审计过的基准测试均基于广告模型标识符评分，但企业实际部署的是完整服务系统（权重+服务路由+精度+输出契约+评估工具链）。服务路由的图像限制、token上限、工具调用解析器、引导解码后端均可独立改变模型的可观测能力。因此基准分数无法区分"模型失败"与"路由拒绝"，即测量误差本质上不可报告。
AI.method: （1）系统定义：八元组 S=⟨m,r,p,e,Ω,𝒯,𝒞,H⟩，其中r为服务路由、Ω为观测信封、𝒞为输出契约、𝒯为工具实现、e为推理力度、p为精度、H为评估工具链契约，绑定前禁止拼接多路由结果。（2）能力绑定预检（算法1）：十谓词黄金盲门控（路由/参数识别、上下文上限、结构化输出、图像信封13张、25工具目录、工具连续、完成上限32,768、推理遥测、用量成本遥测、留存控制），三处置（Bound/Withheld/PartialCoverage）。（3）黄金盲裁决（算法2/表5）：原始结果经允许投影πallow去除黄金/评分后，按决策表分类（Score/Recover/Retry/Coverage/Hold），其中合同失败重试一次且首轮失败保留在主评分中。（4）失败闭合可比性（算法3）：运行计划JCS规范化+SHA-256哈希校验，仅当完全相等才允许追加。（5）配对套件分层任务集自助法（算法4）：20,000次重抽样，每对无序系统取规范种子，仅描述任务集敏感性而非运行方差。评估契约固定：13图像/25工具/≤12次调用/≥32,768完成token/严格JSON/65536字节SQL。基准为128任务/987断言的7套件企业银行（S1单表、S2多表、S3可选PDF、S4图像OCR、S5图表、S6工具、S7受控DB）。
AI.result: 11系统结果（IB²-7 Full）：GPT-5.6 Sol 88.34、Claude Fable 5 87.37、GPT-5.6 Terra 85.95、Qwen3.8-27B 82.54、GPT-5.6 Luna 78.65、Claude Sonnet 5 75.40、Muse Glimmer 30B 73.66、Kimi K3 72.99、Qwen3.6-27B 68.27、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 53.32、GLM-5.2+5V-Turbo 41.10。核心发现：（1）同一权重经3条FP8路由的完整128任务运行：DeepInfra 26.12分（13图被4图限制拒绝）、CoreWeave 62.25分（262144广告上限但32,768截断）、Provider P 68.27分（通过完整十谓词门）——广告标识符不暴露前两条路由的能力限制。（2）Qwen3.8-27B相同权重下RunPod臂77.38 vs AkashML臂82.54，差5.16分，配对区间[0.11,10.60]。（3）4/7套件饱和（频段中位数≥90且n90≥4）：S6（96.9）、S4（95.5）、S1（93.3）、S3（92.1）；S7与S2具判别力；S5频段未解决亦未分离。（4）T1|T2切（[0.11,6.80]）与T2|T3切（[0.05,7.62]）经Bonferroni校正（55次比较需≈99.9%）与BCa重计算均失败，顶部三层合并。（5）去除失败响应后GPT-5.6 Luna反成第一（90.10），Kimi K3/Qwen3.6-27B大幅上升。（6）GLM的24/27次S6失败为解析器特征（23个JSON裹在散文里），属合同层失败而非权重层。Stage 0再发泄露对Qwen3.8-27B排名影响1.30–2.86分。
AI.conclusion: 协议使"能力可用性"成为可报告量——这是模型标识符基准无法表达的属性。系统级测量是封闭式权重模型唯一可获得的比较基础（因Property 2），开闭权重系统的公平比较只能在S层面进行。绑定前能力验证+首轮可靠性纳入+分数盲裁决三件套将"模型失败"与"路由拒绝"分离。协议的可转移贡献在于程序而非语料：路线绑定、黄金盲裁决、失败闭合恢复、饱和判据均可应用于其他公共语料——这正是作者建议的下一步（开放给第三方银行使用），以直接回应私有语料不可证伪的伦理质疑。冻结v1版本要求：补严格JSON推理谓词、补OCR能力谓词（S4单车道）、重组挑战储备、添加Stage 0零包含计数、独立双人黄金审查。v0.13.2是候选校准而非认证发布。

title: LBFAST: A Lightweight Moment-Represented Lattice Boltzmann Solver for Multi-GPU Architectures
summary: We present LBFAST, a GPU-oriented lattice Boltzmann solver based on a lightweight moment-represented formulation, in which post-collision populations are reconstructed on the fly from a reduced set of moments rather than stored explicitly. This approach significantly lowers the memory footprint, enabling large three-dimensional simulations within the constraints of modern accelerator architectures, where VRAM capacity and bandwidth are critical resources. The method is assessed through standard single- and two-component benchmarks demonstrating good accuracy and stability. Extensive scaling experiments on multi-GPU systems show near-ideal weak scaling up to 512 GPUs and sustained performance across different velocity sets. The combination of reduced memory usage, competitive throughput, and stable energy efficiency makes the proposed formulation a practical route for large-scale lattice Boltzmann simulations on current and emerging HPC platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LBFAST，一个基于轻量级矩表示（moment-represented）公式的GPU导向格子Boltzmann求解器，通过即时重建碰撞后分布来显著降低显存占用，并支持多GPU分布式并行计算，在Leonardo超算上展示了最多512个GPU的近理想弱扩展性能。
AI.motivation: 标准格子Boltzmann方法（LBM）需要存储每个格点的完整离散分布函数，导致三维模拟显存占用巨大，成为GPU大规模计算的主要瓶颈。作者希望通过矩表示的轻量化公式，仅存储少量宏观相关的矩量，按需重建分布函数，从而降低显存占用和数据传输带宽需求。
AI.method: LBFAST采用轻量级矩表示格子Boltzmann（LLB）公式，结合截断至二阶的Hermite展开和正则化思路，仅存储10个Hermite系数（密度、3个速度分量、6个对称二阶张量分量）而非完整分布函数。在不可压速度-压力框架下，通过保守Allen-Cahn方程输运相场ϕ，密度和粘度由相场线性混合重建。代码使用CUDA Fortran+OpenACC实现，MPI实现1D/2D/3D域分解，采用非阻塞通信与计算重叠、双缓冲布局、共享内存halo等优化策略。支持D3Q19、D3Q27和高阶D3Q27h三种速度集。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA A100 GPU集群（Leonardo超算）上，单组分Taylor-Green涡衰减和双组分Laplace定律测试均验证了精度（粘度相对误差约1.3×10⁻³，表面张力相对误差约6.8%）。对于512³格点，轻量级公式相比标准D3Q19减少约47.4%显存、相比D3Q27减少约63%。强扩展到512个GPU时性能逐步饱和；弱扩展在所有配置下接近理想并行效率（图3），1D分解略优于2D/3D。能量效率（nJ/LUP）在弱扩展中保持稳定（图4），表明并行化未引入额外能耗开销。单GPU单精度D3Q19约2.3 GLUPS，512 GPU单精度D3Q19达1131.4 GLUPS。
AI.conclusion: LBFAST证明了轻量级矩表示LBM在现代GPU加速超算上的可行性和高效性，其通过减少显存占用、保持良好可扩展性和稳定能效，成为大规模多组分流体模拟的有力工具，为下一代HPC平台上的CFD应用提供了实用路径。

title: SMCC-Empowered Digital Twins for Sensorless Monitoring in Large-Scale AI-Driven IoT Systems
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE INTERNET OF THINGS JOURNAL for possible publication
summary: The deployment of AI-driven Digital Twins (DTs) in large-scale Internet-of-Things (IoT) ecosystems demands continuous, high-fidelity synchronization between the physical environment and its virtual replica. Conventional approaches rely on dense sensor deployments, which introduce prohibitive costs in terms of hardware, energy, and network bandwidth. In this paper, we propose SMCC-DT, an integrated Sensing-Memory-Communication-Computation (SMCC) framework that enables sensorless monitoring of physical assets by exploiting Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) waveforms at the 6G Edge. Under the SMCC-DT paradigm, a single radio signal simultaneously extracts environmental telemetry (Sensing) and delivers it to an Edge server (Communication), where a large-scale AI model is loaded into constrained memory (Memory) and executed (Computation) to update the DT state. We formulate the DT synchronization problem as a cross-layer optimization that jointly allocates transmit power, beamforming vectors, memory partitions, and CPU frequency to minimize the end-to-end synchronization latency subject to sensing accuracy, throughput, memory capacity, and computational budget constraints. Because the resulting mixed-integer nonlinear program is NP-hard, we design a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)-based Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) agent, termed SMCCAGENT, that learns near-optimal resource allocation policies online. Extensive simulations over a 500-node industrial IoT testbed demonstrate that SMCC-DT reduces DT synchronization latency by 38.7% and total energy consumption by 27.4% compared to state-of-the-art orthogonal and compute-only baselines, while sustaining sensing accuracy above 95% and model inference throughput above 30 frames per second.

AI.tldr: SMCC-DT：一种基于ISAC的无传感器数字孪生同步框架，通过PPO-DRL联合优化感知-内存-通信-计算四层资源，在500节点工业IoT场景中实现低延迟低能耗。
AI.motivation: 大规模IoT中传统密集传感器部署带来硬件、网络带宽和高能耗问题，且大型AI模型在边缘端的内存与算力受限，亟需一种无传感器且跨层协同的DT同步方案。
AI.method: 1) 利用6G ISAC波形同时感知与通信；2) 建模四层SMCC系统模型（CRLB感知、Shannon通信、内存分区、DVFS计算）；3) 构造混合整数非线性优化问题P1（证明NP-hard）；4) 设计SmccAgent（PPO+DRL），分层动作空间+奖励整形；5) 500节点工业IoT仿真验证。
AI.result: 同步时延降至12.3 ms（K=500），较正交分配降低38.7%；能耗降低27.4%；感知精度>95%、推理吞吐>30 FPS；消融实验证实四层缺一不可，内存优化贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: SMCC-DT验证了ISAC+跨层SMCC+DRL协同设计的有效性，可显著降低延迟与能耗；未来将拓展至多服务器联邦、RIS辅助及6G硬件实测。

title: HELIOS: Guardrailed LLM-Driven Evolution of Autonomous Resource Orchestration Policies for Multi-Cloud Distributed Systems
summary: Operating latency-sensitive services across multiple public clouds creates an optimization surface no single provider autoscaler can see: on-demand vCPU prices differ by provider, spot discounts and interruption risks vary by provider and instance type, egress fees penalize state movement, and provider-level failures can take down single-cloud deployments. Large language models (LLMs) are appealing orchestrators because they can synthesize non-trivial decision logic from a natural-language environment description. However, placing an LLM on the critical path of every scheduling decision is impractical: for a 200-service fleet, per-decision inference would cost more than the cloud capacity it manages and add multi-second latency to a millisecond-scale control loop. HELIOS moves the LLM off the critical path. The LLM evolves executable orchestration policies, small Python programs over a fixed feature interface, against a trace-driven multi-cloud simulator. Only the champion program runs in production, wrapped in guardrails that enforce capacity feasibility, SLO-class placement rules, and churn budgets regardless of evolved code's proposal. On real workload traces (PlanetLab, Bitbrains, Azure) combined with 2026 price and interruption-frequency data from AWS, Azure, and GCP, the evolved policy reduces penalized operating cost by 45% versus a single-cloud best-fit baseline and by 9-19% versus calibrated multi-cloud heuristics. It matches an oracle-informed MILP planner's premium-SLO performance at 40% lower cost and outperforms a DQN meta-controller trained with 2.6x more environment interactions. Guardrails are essential: without them, the same policy family degrades to 97-98% premium-tier downtime under a 10x spot-hazard stress test, versus 0.17% when guarded. We release the simulator, policies, LLM prompt/response archive, and per-generation fitness logs for full reproducibility.

AI.tldr: HELIOS 提出了一种 LLM 离线驱动的进化式多云编排策略合成框架，将 LLM 从调度决策的关键路径移开，仅生成小型可审计的 Python 策略程序，并在形式化的护栏层保护下投入生产运行。在真实工作负载轨迹（PlanetLab、Bitbrains、Azure）和 2026 年 AWS/Azure/GCP 价格数据上，进化策略相比单云基线降低 45% 的惩罚性运营成本，并保持 SLO 稳定性。
AI.motivation: 多云环境下，按需价格、spot 折扣、中断风险、跨云 egress 费用各异，单云 autoscaler 无法利用这些异质性；LLM 虽然能合成复杂决策逻辑，但在线每步调用 LLM 在成本和延迟上不可行（200 服务舰队每日推理开销超过被管理的云容量本身，且会引入秒级延迟到毫秒级控制环）。因此需要一种将 LLM 能力摊销到离线、同时确保生产安全的方案。
AI.method: HELIOS 采用 LLM 作为离线策略合成器，通过 5 代进化循环（共生成 19 个候选程序、38 次仿真评估）让 LLM 在固定特征接口（knobs/priority/score/migrate_urgency 四个 Python 函数）上编写/变异候选策略；候选程序由基于真实轨迹与真实价格目录构建的 1100 行多云仿真器评估适应度 J = Cost + β_std·V_std + β_prem·V_prem。胜出的程序投入生产，外层包裹五重护栏（G1 预留可行打包、G2 高级 SLO 隔离 spot、G3 每步迁移预算、G4 驻留与冷却期、G5 不可行投影），无论策略提出什么都被强制约束。评估基线包括单云 BFD、阈值 HPA、贪心多云、手写种子、MILP 规划器（带预留预言）与 DQN 元控制器。
AI.result: 在 PlanetLab（持有日）、Azure 与 Bitbrains（含真实内存维度）三套真实轨迹上，进化策略均取得最低惩罚性成本：相比单云 best-fit 降低 45%，相比标定多云启发式降低 9–19%；以比 MILP 规划器低 40% 的成本匹配其 premium SLO 表现；并以 2.6 倍环境交互预算的 DQN 元控制器表现更优。护栏在 10× spot 中断压力测试下起决定性作用：无护栏时同族策略 premium 等级宕机率达 97–98%，加护栏后仅 0.17%。进化还识别并拒绝了三种看似合理但有害的"基因族"（基于实际利用率的排空、无锚定 premium 打包、自适应预留）。
AI.conclusion: HELIOS 证明 LLM 可通过离线进化合成可审计、低运行成本的多云编排策略，再借助形式化护栏层把 LLM 生成代码从"信任负债"转变为"有界搜索空间"，既保留 LLM 合成决策逻辑的优势（可审计、低运行时开销），又不把实时控制让渡给不透明模型。论文贡献涵盖问题形式化与瓶颈分析、基于 LLM 的进化策略合成、带安全契约的护栏层，以及在真实轨迹与真实价格上的全面评估，并发布完整仿真器、策略、LLM 提示/响应存档与逐代适应度日志以保证可复现。

title: TFR-GNN: Topology- and Fault-Aware Graph Neural Scheduling for Heterogeneous Distributed Computing Systems
summary: Scheduling workflow directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) on heterogeneous distributed systems is a classical NP-hard problem, and the list-scheduling heuristic HEFT remains the defacto standard because of its low complexity and strong makespan. In real deployments, however, machines fail: commodity and pre-emptible nodes are far less reliable than dedicated ones, and a makespan-optimal but reliability-agnostic placement can be dramatically slowed by node failures. We show empirically, on real workflow structures from the WfCommons/Pegasus corpus, that no single fixed heuristic is best across the joint space of failure intensity and cluster load: with no failures HEFT is optimal, whereas under failures a reliability-aware placement can reduce the expected makespan by up to 52% when spare capacity exists. Motivated by this, we present TFR-GNN, a graph neural scheduler that combines bidirectional dependency attention over the task DAG, topology attention over the (bandwidth-weighted) machine graph, and a cross-attention placement head augmented with a failure-gated reliability tilt and an optional replication gate. We train TFR-GNN by distilling a best-of-portfolio fault-tolerant oracle into a single one-shot policy. On real workflows and a bimodal-reliability cluster model, TFR-GNN matches HEFT exactly when there are no failures, reduces the expected makespan under failures by 14.8% on average (up to 47%) over HEFT, beats a fixed reliability-aware baseline (R-HEFT) by 11% and matches a per-scenario hindsight oracle as a single policy without any deployment-time tuning, and generalises to unseen applications and to workflows an order of magnitude larger than those seen in training, while producing schedules in well under a second for graphs of nearly 5,000 tasks. All results are produced by a verified event-level simulator on real workflow data; no experimental numbers are synthetic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TFR-GNN，一种面向异构分布式系统的拓扑与故障感知图神经网络调度器。它结合双向依赖注意力、拓扑注意力和跨注意力放置头，通过故障门控的可靠性倾斜和可选复制门实现自适应调度，并采用蒸馏训练从最佳启发式组合中学习单一策略。在真实工作流上的实验表明，无故障时与HEFT完全一致，故障下平均减少14.8%的预期完成时间，并能泛化到未见过的应用和更大规模的工作流。
AI.motivation: 经典HEFT调度启发式在无故障环境下表现优异，但在真实分布式系统（尤其是包含易失性spot/preemptible节点）中面临节点故障问题。故障感知的放置策略可显著降低预期makespan，但最佳策略取决于故障强度和集群负载的联合空间——没有单一固定启发式在所有场景下都最优。这需要一种能自适应跨整个操作域的单一学习型策略。
AI.method: 1) TFR-GNN架构：双向GAT处理任务DAG依赖、密集注意力处理带宽加权机器图、跨注意力生成任务-机器放置亲和力；故障活动门控a(s)在零故障时使所有容错机制消失，架构上保证退化为HEFT。2) 训练方法：先尝试策略梯度（REINFORCE、RLOO等）但发现HEFT是强局部最优、无法发现协调的可靠性感知放置；改为蒸馏训练——对每个场景从{HEFT, R-HEFT, FT-HEFT}组合中选出最佳作为教师，通过教师强制模仿学习单一策略。模型仅62,870参数，单CPU推理。
AI.result: 1) 无故障时TFR-GNN与HEFT完全一致（1.000×），优于PEFT(1.127×)、Min-Min(1.265×)等；2) 故障下平均减少14.8%预期makespan（最高47%），达到per-scenario hindsight oracle的99.8%；3) 在稀疏容量下增益高达40%（M=96），且使用的冗余计算为零（策略性放弃复制）；4) 泛化至三个未见应用（如soykb降至0.593×）和训练集10倍规模工作流（达4,846任务）；5) 调度时间4846任务仅701ms，与HEFT同量级。消融显示故障感知头贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: TFR-GNN展示了学习型调度器可通过架构性的自适应保证（零故障时精确退化为HEFT）和蒸馏训练，在异构故障环境中实现单一策略的跨域最优。关键发现是：在重启式故障模型下，放置策略主导复制策略；蒸馏优于直接策略梯度。该工作为故障感知调度提供了新的方法论，并将启发式组合蒸馏为统一策略的思路推广到更广泛的场景。局限：基于事件级仿真、仅考虑重启模型、未优化风险敏感目标。

title: Breaking Fault Lines: Unifying TEE-Assisted BFT Consensus in Partially Trusted Worlds
summary: This paper revisits TEE-assisted BFT under a universal partial-TEE model, where an arbitrary subset of replicas execute inside TEEs while the remaining replicas operate without hardware trust guarantees. We show that heterogeneous trust changes the structure of quorum formation and fault tolerance. In particular, we derive a tight resilience bound f < max {n/3, m/2}, where n is the total number of replicas and m is the number of TEE-enabled replicas. The result reveals a sharp threshold phenomenon: TEEs improve fault tolerance only once they exceed two-thirds of the deployment. Guided by this characterization, we introduce two protocol principles: (1) a dual-quorum construction that safely combines TEE-only and mixed quorums, and (2) a TEE-leader fast path that leverages hardware-enforced non-equivocation to reduce both consensus and view-change latency. We realize these ideas in Raftel, which is, to our knowledge, the first HotStuff-style BFT protocol designed explicitly for arbitrary partial-TEE deployments, and in chained-Raftel, a pipelined variant that further accelerates mixed-trust execution. We implement both protocols atop Intel SGX and evaluate them in LAN and WAN environments. Our results show that Raftel achieves up to 625 TPS with sub-670 ms latency in WAN settings, outperforming HotStuff by up to 308 TPS in throughput while approaching the performance of fully TEE-assisted protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在部分可信执行环境（TEE）部署下通用的BFT共识协议Raftel及其流水线变体Chained-Raftel，填补了现有TEE辅助BFT协议假设所有副本均具备TEE这一不现实前提的空白，通过理论分析推导出紧致弹性界限并设计双法定人数构造与TEE领导者快速路径，显著提升异构信任环境下的性能与容错能力。
AI.motivation: 现有TEE辅助BFT共识协议普遍假设所有副本均配备TEE，这在实际部署中不切实际。真实部署中，由于硬件类型限制、区域可用性、成本以及增量迁移等因素，TEE副本仅占部分，迫使系统进入混合信任（mixed-trust）状态。经典BFT协议假设无副本可信，而现有TEE辅助协议假设同质信任，两类设计均无法适应真实的异构部署，因此亟需一个能在任意TEE/非TEE混合配置下统一工作的BFT协议。
AI.method: 1. 提出通用部分TEE模型（universal partial-TEE model），形式化n个副本中m个为TEE副本的混合信任设置；2. 通过扩展经典不可区分性论证，证明弹性紧致界 f < max{n/3, m/2}；3. 设计双法定人数构造（dual-quorum），包括TEE-Quorum（仅由TEE副本组成）和Mixed-Quorum（任意副本组成）；4. 设计TEE领导者快速路径，利用硬件强制非等义性绕过prepare-style保护阶段；5. 实现统一可信模块Checker+整合Damysus的Checker与Accumulator功能；6. 在HotStuff链式结构基础上实例化Raftel和流水线变体Chained-Raftel；7. 基于Intel SGX实现并评估。
AI.result: 在WAN设置下（f=32），Raftel和Chained-Raftel相比HotStuff吞吐量分别提升1.02×和1.05×，延迟降低61.46%和62.84%；在低延迟WAN中，相对加速比扩大至2.0×和2.8×。LAN设置下最高可达31.5 kTPS（f=32, 256B负载, 400批大小）。端到端KV存储基准测试中Raftel和Chained-Raftel分别达到84 TPS和92 TPS。崩溃恢复测试显示TEE领导者崩溃恢复时间比非TEE领导者快0.4秒。SGX开销分析显示吞吐量仅下降3.4%-6.7%，延迟增加最多0.2毫秒。性能接近完全TEE辅助协议，显著优于经典BFT。
AI.conclusion: 论文形式化了部分TEE部署下的BFT共识问题，推导出揭示阈值现象的紧致弹性界f < max{n/3, m/2}：TEE对容错的提升仅在TEE副本超过三分之二时才显现。双法定人数构造与TEE领导者快速路径两条设计原则有效利用异构信任，在任意TEE/非TEE混合配置下同时保证安全性与活性。Raftel与Chained-Raftel作为首个面向通用部分TEE部署的HotStuff风格协议，性能显著超越经典BFT并接近全TEE辅助系统。该框架可扩展至Multi-BFT和DAG-based共识等其他BFT协议。

title: Epoch: Compiling Diffusion Blocks for Sparse MoE Serving
summary: Diffusion language models generate text by refining a fixed-size block of token positions through many forward passes, a loop that does not match the per-forward execution unit used by most LLM serving systems. A dense MoE runtime binds all work to the refinement-iteration clock: it rebuilds similar routing structure on every forward, recomputes expert outputs for positions whose logits are already dead, and sends those positions through dense expert-parallel collectives. This paper presents \sys{}, a serving system that treats the diffusion block as a compilation unit. \sys{} compiles a small \emph{block plan} for the block-clock structure of one diffusion block and refreshes every value that can affect a live decode decision on the iteration clock. \sys{} realizes this plan along three dense axes of an MoE forward: \atlas{} compiles a coverage-driven active expert support per layer while recomputing gate logits every iteration; \lsp{} keeps full sequence shards as model state but routes only live, newly decoded, and refresh-required positions through fresh routed-expert computation; \freshlane{} carries this fresh token--expert worklist through expert-parallel dispatch, kernels, and combine, then restores the dense logical shard at the layer boundary. We implement \sys{} on 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs and evaluate it on three open-weight block-diffusion MoE models (LLaDA-MoE, LLaDA2.0-mini, and LLaDA2.0-Flash, spanning 7B to 100B total parameters) across GSM8K, HumanEval, MGSM, and MT-Bench. \sys{} improves end-to-end execution time by up to 2.7$\times$ over the strongest surviving baseline under the same 8-GPU placement and remains feasible at the largest batch sizes where multiple baselines run out of memory, while preserving task quality relative to the dense reference.

AI.tldr: Epoch是一个面向块扩散MoE语言模型(dLLM)的推理服务系统。它将扩散块视为编译单元,通过双时钟(块时钟/迭代时钟)分离,沿MoE前向的专家轴、令牌状态轴、负载轴三维度实现稀疏化,在8张H100上对比dInfer/SGLang获得最高2.7×加速。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM服务系统以单次前向为执行单元,适配自回归解码。但扩散语言模型(dLLM)在同一块token位置上反复运行完整前向进行去噪精炼,稠密MoE运行时存在严重冗余:重复重建路由结构、对已解码位置(logits已死)重新计算专家输出、并让这些位置走稠密的专家并行集合通信。在LLaDA2.0-mini上,MoE路径在batch size=1时占延迟60%,batch size=32时占77%,冗余已成为端到端瓶颈。
AI.method: 核心抽象是将扩散块(block)视为编译单元,区分两个时钟:块时钟(块开始到结束之间稳定,可规划复用)与迭代时钟(每次精炼前向都会变,不可重放)。提出"两时钟规则":缓存稳定的块结构,重算影响活跃解码决策的迭代值。沿MoE前向的三个轴设计三个机制:(1) Expert Atlas(专家轴):块级构建覆盖驱动的活跃专家支持集Sl,每迭代仍重算门控logits,但路由目标被限制在Sl内;(2) Liveness-Shard Parallelism(令牌状态轴):保留完整序列并行分片作为模型状态,通过活性掩码只让活跃/新解码/需刷新的位置进入新一轮路由专家计算,稳定解码位置读有界龄缓存(MC=5时余弦相似度仍>0.95);(3) FreshLane Dispatch(负载轴):仅把"新鲜令牌-专家"工单作为专家并行dispatch/combine的真实负载,在层边界合并恢复稠密逻辑分片。提供正确的精确性边界:路由覆盖下界(αR_l,t)、解码缓存龄上界(MC-1)、决策稳定性条件(‖ẑ-z‖∞<Γ)。基于vLLM风格融合MoE运行时实现,加四个钩子(块边界、路由、注意力布局、MoE流水线包装)。
AI.result: 在8×H100上评测LLaDA-MoE(7B)、LLaDA2.0-mini(16B)、LLaDA2.0-Flash(100B),任务覆盖GSM8K/HumanEval/MGSM/MT-Bench。端到端加速:batch size=128时1.1-1.3×,256时1.3-1.7×,512时1.7-2.7×(100B模型最高2.7×);在多个基线发生OOM的batch size=512下Epoch仍可行。在线服务P95 ITL在QPS≥16后Epoch保持55-60ms,SGLang升至100-110ms,约1.7-1.8×优势。消融显示三轴互补:Expert Atlas单独将计算减半,Liveness-Shard进一步压低计算,但抬升内存访问,FreshLane最终把内存访问降至0.29、通信降至0.60。质量保持:刷新周期MC=5位于延迟-精度曲线的拐点,任务分与稠密参考相当。
AI.conclusion: Epoch证明了扩散块作为规划单元的有效性:块级规划稳定结构、迭代级重算活跃值,把dLLM块内MoE冗余转化为端到端加速。系统首次以"块"而非"前向"作为dLLM-MoE服务的可复用执行单元,随模型规模与批大小扩大,优势同步扩大,同时保持任务质量。

title: Introvert Clustering for Distributed Graph Algorithms
summary: We introduce a graph decomposition primitive called introvert clustering, which strengthens standard low-diameter clustering by guaranteeing that every clustered vertex keeps at least a $\left(\frac12-\varepsilon\right)$-fraction of its relevant neighbors in its own cluster. Repeatedly applying this primitive yields a layered introvert network decomposition with $O(\log n)$ layers and weak diameter $O(\log n)$. We give two applications in the $\mathsf{LOCAL}$ model. For every constant $\varepsilon>0$, we obtain a $\widetilde O(\log^2 n)$-round deterministic algorithm for list $\left(\frac32+\varepsilon\right)\Delta$-edge coloring on graphs of maximum degree $\Delta\geq\Delta_0(\varepsilon)$; for bipartite graphs, the result holds for all $\Delta$. For every constant $0<\varepsilon<1/4$, we also obtain a $\widetilde O(\log^2 n)$-round deterministic algorithm for a $\left(\frac14-\varepsilon\right)$-locally balanced cut, where every vertex has at least a $\left(\frac14-\varepsilon\right)$-fraction of its neighbors on the opposite side. The resulting algorithms are remarkably simple: edge coloring processes the layers in reverse order and colors each cluster, while locally balanced cut processes them forward and computes a locally maximum cut within each cluster. The introvert guarantee enables these procedures beyond the usual greedy regime of network decomposition. We construct the decomposition in $O(\log^2 n)$ randomized rounds using Miller--Peng--Xu low-diameter clustering and a simple trimming procedure, and deterministically in $\widetilde O(\log^2 n)$ rounds via a white-box adaptation of the recursive network decomposition algorithm of Ghaffari and Grunau [FOCS 2024].

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种称为"内向聚类"（Introvert Clustering）的新型图分解原语，通过在标准低直径聚类基础上增加局部保证——每个被聚类顶点至少保留(1/2-ε)比例的相关邻居在同一簇内。迭代应用此原语可得到具有O(log n)层和弱直径O(log n)的分层内向网络分解。基于此分解，作者在LOCAL模型中获得两个应用：1) 对于足够大的最大度Δ，图上(3/2+ε)Δ的列表边着色的Õ(log²n)轮确定性算法（二部图对所有Δ成立）；2) (1/4-ε)-局部平衡割的Õ(log²n)轮确定性算法。分解可通过Miller-Peng-Xu低直径聚类结合修剪过程在O(log²n)随机轮次内构造，或通过对Ghaffari-Grunau递归网络分解算法的白盒改编在Õ(log²n)确定性轮次内构造。
AI.motivation: 标准网络分解在将串行局部算法并行化方面非常有效，但仅限于"贪心"模式（即贪心扩展总可行的情况）。在列表边着色低于2Δ-1贪心阈值、局部平衡割等问题中，任意部分解可能无法贪心扩展。标准低直径聚类只保证簇间边总数的比例，无法保证每个顶点的局部性质。需要一种增强的聚类原语，赋予每个簇内顶点足够的邻居，使其在贪心失效的场景下仍可处理。
AI.method: 1. **内向聚类原语**：在标准低直径聚类基础上增加"内向性"——每个被聚类顶点v满足|N(v)∩C|≥(1/2-ε)deg(v)。2. **分层内向网络分解**：迭代应用内向聚类，将每层的簇内边分配给该层，剩余边进入下一层，共O(log n)层。3. **随机化构造**：Miller-Peng-Xu低直径聚类（保证簇间边期望数λ|E|）+ 修剪过程（迭代移除不满足内向性的顶点，使簇间边数最多增加1/(2ε)倍）。迭代O(log n)次获得分层分解。4. **确定性构造**：白盒改编Ghaffari-Grunau递归网络分解（FOCS 2024）：在基例中加强聚类使任意小常数比例的边保持簇间；在递归中维护活动边集不变量；通过线图将顶点聚类转化为边聚类。5. **应用算法**：边着色按层逆序处理，用Bonamy-Delcourt-Lang-Postle定理着色每簇；局部平衡割按层正序处理，在每簇内计算局部最大割。
AI.result: **定理1（列表边着色）**：对任意常数ε>0，存在常数Δ₀(ε)，最大度Δ≥Δ₀的图可在O(log²n)随机轮次或Õ(log²n)确定性轮次内求解列表(3/2+ε)Δ边着色；二部图对所有Δ成立。**定理2（局部平衡割）**：对任意常数0<ε<1/4，可在O(log²n)随机轮次或Õ(log²n)确定性轮次内计算(1/4-ε)-局部平衡割。**定理3（随机分层内向分解）**：对任意常数ε∈(0,1/2)，可在O(log²n)随机轮次内构造(ε, O(log n), O(log n))分层内向网络分解。**定理4（确定性分层内向分解）**：对任意常数ε∈(0,1/2)，可在Õ(log²n)确定性轮次内构造(ε, O(log n), O(log n))分层内向网络分解。同时证明了1/2阈值对内向性基本紧致。
AI.conclusion: 内向聚类通过为每个被聚类顶点保留近一半邻居在同一簇内，扩展了网络分解的能力，使其能在贪心扩展不可行的场景下仍能有效工作。该原语在边着色中提供了恰好使(3/2+ε)Δ列表着色可行的松弛量，在局部平衡割中通过两个1/2因子直接产生1/4保证。两个应用算法都异常简洁：边着色逆序处理各层着色每簇，局部平衡割正序处理各层计算局部最大割。分解本身可随机化或确定性地高效构造。这表明网络分解可通过附加有用的局部保证来扩展，开启了超越标准贪心模式的新应用方向。开放问题包括：能否用(1+ε)Δ颜色达到Õ(log²n)轮复杂度？能否在poly(log n)轮内计算(1/2-ε)-局部平衡割？

title: CEDD-optimizer: Enabling Cost-Efficient Dataset Distillation on Geographically Distributed Edge Systems
summary: Centralized learning is a fundamental paradigm in modern AI, in which data are collected from distributed edge devices and aggregated at a central host for model training. However, this pipeline is often bottlenecked by the substantial communication overhead of data collection. Dataset Distillation (DD), with its high compression ratio, is therefore attractive for centralized learning on distributed data. Yet, the cost efficiency of DD in non-uniform edge environments remains largely unexplored. Geographically distributed edge devices face different energy and data-transfer prices, while key DD hyperparameters, such as the target compression ratio and number of distillation steps, substantially affect energy use, transfer overhead, and downstream test accuracy. These hyperparameters must therefore be tuned both locally and globally. We propose the Cost-Efficient Dataset Distillation optimizer (CEDD-optimizer), a hyperparameter-tuning framework for cost-efficient distributed DD. It minimizes total cost under a training-quality constraint by optimizing hyperparameter settings across edge devices while accounting for environmental non-uniformity. The framework comprises two modules: CEDD-calibrator and CEDD-solver. CEDD-calibrator identifies parameters for our energy and training-quality models: the former is determined through offline calibration, whereas the latter is estimated online through a three-step tuning scheme. Based on these models, CEDD-solver solves the cost-minimization problem to steer and improve the distributed DD workflow. Experiments across various image datasets show that our approach achieves up to a 20.8 improvement over the baseline DD method under the same quality constraint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CEDD-optimizer框架，针对地理分布式边缘系统上的数据集蒸馏（DD）进行超参数调优，在保证训练质量的前提下最小化总经济成本（包括边缘能耗、数据传输和云存储）。框架由CEDD-calibrator（离线能耗校准+在线三步精度建模）和CEDD-solver（求解成本最小化问题）两大模块组成，通过为每个边缘节点定制DPC（每类数据量）和IC（迭代次数）超参数配置，在异构地理环境中实现成本优化。实验在5个标准图像数据集和4种边缘硬件平台上验证，相比DD基线最高可实现20.8倍的成本降低，仅带来1%-1.5%的精度损失。
AI.motivation: 集中式学习中，数据从分布式边缘设备汇聚到中心主机进行训练，面临巨大的通信开销。数据集蒸馏（DD）虽因极高的压缩比成为有吸引力的解决方案，但其在地理分布式、能耗与数据传输价格非均匀的边缘环境中的成本效率尚未被充分研究。DD的两个关键超参数（每类数据量DPC和迭代次数IC）显著影响能耗、传输开销和测试精度，且不同地理位置的电力与网络价格差异巨大，因此需要在全局和局部对这些超参数进行调优。
AI.method: 方法包含三大核心组件：(1) 问题建模——将总成本（边缘能耗+数据传输+云存储）最小化作为目标，以测试精度不低于阈值为约束，针对每个边缘节点独立优化DPC(αᵢ)和IC(βᵢ)；(2) 成本建模——能耗建模为Eᵢ = (d₁,ᵢα²ᵢ + d₂,ᵢαᵢ + d₃,ᵢ)·βᵢ + d₄,ᵢ（线性于迭代次数、二次于DPC），数据量建模为Sᵢ = KVαᵢ；(3) 精度建模——基于置换不变性和统计矩理论，使用均值(μα, μβ)和方差(σ²α, σ²β)的二阶多项式作为测试精度的预测模型。系统设计采用CEDD-calibrator（离线识别能耗模型系数，在线通过三步调优方案估计精度模型系数）和CEDD-solver（使用scipy.optimize的SLSQP求解器）协同工作。三步调优方案包括：第一步用最小超参数运行DD；第二步在小范围内随机采样超参数并通过最小权完美二部匹配问题（MWPBM）分配给边缘节点，生成多种混合训练数据集；第三步在中心训练并拟合精度曲线，最终由求解器输出最优配置。
AI.result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、SVHN、ImageNette五种数据集和NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX、Jetson Orin Nano、MacBook Pro、TQMx80UC四种边缘硬件上的实验表明：(1) 能耗模型预测误差低于3%；(2) 精度模型在N>10时MAPE低于1%，绝对误差低于0.5；(3) CEDD-optimizer相比DD基线在相同精度约束下最高实现20.8倍成本降低，三步方案实现1.7-2.67倍降低，精度仅下降1%-1.5%；(4) 非均匀超参数配置优于均匀配置的Pareto前沿；(5) 在弱扩展下DD提供规模不变的效益（O(1)成本降低比），强扩展下为O(1/N)；(6) SLSQP求解器在0.006s内求解，比TRC/IDE/MINLP快数个数量级；(7) 在IID和近IID场景下均优于随机搜索、启发式搜索和穷举搜索。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统性地解决了地理分布式边缘环境下DD超参数调优的成本效率问题，提出的CEDD-optimizer框架通过理论建模与高效求解实现了显著的运营成本降低，同时保持下游深度学习任务的精度。研究的贡献包括：识别了地理价格非均匀性下DD调优的新挑战；构建了形式化的优化问题与轻量级预测模型（常数项未知数随边缘数量扩展不变）；提供了完整的calibrator-solver协同框架；并在多种数据集、定价和硬件条件下验证了其有效性。未来工作方向包括非IID数据扩展、联邦学习集成、时变电价优化以及与时钟频率调节的协同。

title: Stencil Computation at the Intersection of AI and HPC
summary: Tensor compilers such as TinyTC and OpenAI Triton were originally developed for AI workloads, but the same tiling and memory abstractions can be applied to implement efficient high-order stencils for scientific and industrial applications. We demonstrate this for an 8th-order, 25-point acoustic stencil with boundary conditions over an a demanding-sized grid, targeting GPGPUs, where we compare the hardware-specialized TinyTC implementation with a portable PyTorch/Triton implementation. The target platforms for evaluation include Intel B70, B580, GPU MAX 1550, NVIDIA A100/RTX6000 Blackwell/H100, and AMD MI325x. For instance, on Battlemage B580 TinyTC reaches 15.6 Gpts/s versus 13.5 Gpts/s for PT/Triton under random initialization, while zero-initialized runs reach up to 35.8 Gpts/s due to hardware memory compression. Using roofline and memory-hierarchy profiling, we show that -as expected- performance is predominantly bandwidth-limited and that compiler-managed L1/LSC caching can effectively replace programmer-managed shared-memory staging for this stencil class. Overall, the results position TinyTC as the performance-oriented path on Intel hardware and PyTorch/Triton as a strong portability/productivity baseline for cross-vendor HPC stencil development.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将面向 AI 的张量编译器（TinyTC 和 Triton）应用于 HPC 高阶 stencil 计算的可行性，以 8 阶 25 点声学 stencil（含 PML 边界条件，800³ 网格）为基准，在 Intel B580/B70/MAX 1550、NVIDIA A100/RTX6000/H100、AMD MI325x 等多平台对比 TinyTC、PyTorch/Triton、SYCL 和 OpenMP 四种实现。关键发现：(1) 性能主要受内存带宽限制；(2) Intel Battlemage 的硬件无损内存压缩使零初始化场景吞吐量翻倍以上（35.8 vs 15.6 Gpts/s），但随时间步推进收益衰减；(4) TinyTC 凭借编译器管理的 L1/LSC 缓存替代手工共享内存 staging，在 Intel 硬件上达到最优；Triton 因未启用 tensor descriptor 而未生成 2D block load，性能略逊但提供跨厂商可移植性。
AI.motivation: stencil 是科学计算的核心模式，性能优化历经多核、异构加速器、GPU 到 AI 加速器四个时代。当前 AI 浪潮催生的张量编译器（TinyTC、Triton）能否成为 HPC stencil 开发的一流工具，亟需系统评估：硬件专用路径与跨厂商可移植基线之间的权衡究竟如何。
AI.method: 采用 2.5D 寄存器队列算法（Micikevicius 策略）：3D 网格按 T_X×T_Y×T_Z 分块，X 方向 9 个平面驻留寄存器无访存，Y/Z 方向每步从全局内存加载并借助 LSC 缓存复用。实现包括：(a) TinyTC IR 使用 cooperative_matrix_load/store 的 2D 块加载与硬件边界保护；(b) PyTorch/Triton 采用"宽加载窄存储"边界处理（一个 tile 的额外 padding 消除加载掩码）；(c) SYCL 共享内存基线；(d) OpenMP target offload 基线。通过 roofline（unitrace）、STREAM 微基准、内存层级计数器（LSC/L3/DRAM）进行多维分析。
AI.result: TinyTC 在 Intel B580 随机初始化达 15.6 Gpts/s（零初始化 35.8 Gpts/s），Triton 13.5 vs 32.5 Gpts/s，SYCL 12.2 vs 20.2 Gpts/s，OpenMP 7.8 vs 8.9 Gpts/s。Roofline 证实全为带宽受限：TinyTC 维持 383.7 GB/s（接近 STREAM 实测 405 GB/s 峰值），最低 DRAM 流量（5.9 GB）与最高 L3 命中率（73.5%）。Triton 在 NVIDIA H100 达 42.9 Gpts/s、AMD MI325x 达 62.7 Gpts/s，B580 内存压缩特性使其在零初始化下与高端 GPU 差距收窄（性能比 1.1–1.9×），随机初始化下差距扩大（2.5–4.4×）但仍低于带宽比预期。B70 在 TinyTC 下呈现 1.3× 加速，符合 B580/B70 带宽比（540/400≈1.35）。
AI.conclusion: 张量编译器是 HPC 高阶 stencil 的实用工具，超出其 AI 原始用途。在 Intel 硬件上，TinyTC 通过暴露 tiling 与 2D 块加载的细粒度控制实现最佳性能；PyTorch/Triton 在跨厂商可移植性方面提供强力生产力基线。硬件专用路径（最大化峰值性能）与通用框架（最大化可移植性与开发效率）是互补而非互斥。Battlemage 的硬件压缩带来显著"免费午餐"，但仅在零初始化早期存在。文章建议采用务实策略：对性能关键 kernel 使用 TinyTC 等低层 DSL，其余保持 Triton/OpenMP 表达性，并强调每平台实现峰值性能需要架构特定优化。

title: Avatar: Toward Autonomous End-to-End Orchestration of Scientific Workflows using LLMs
summary: Scientific workflow management (WMSs) systems automate execution, yet orchestrate using fixed, hand-tuned rules. LLM agents promise more autonomous orchestration, but it remains unclear where to introduce agentic reasoning, how to bound its risk, and when it actually helps. We present Avatar, an actor-based architecture comprising an orchestrator, an executor, and a provenance monitor. Each actor's decision policy is pluggable (rule-based or LLM-backed) via a single adapter-validated action catalog, so conventional and agentic control run on the same core across different WMSs. We present an implementation using the Academy framework and evaluate Avatar across three workloads. We observe that Avatar's rule mode reproduces native execution, with a single unchanged core running all three. Moreover, LLM-backed Avatar reports a reduction of compute wastage by $55\%$ and cuts GPU-busy time by $40\%$. Overall, we envision Avatar as a step toward workflow systems that reason about their own orchestration rather than follow pre-fixed rules.

AI.tldr: Avatar 提出了一种基于 actor 的参考架构，用于科学工作流的端到端自主编排。该架构包含编排器、执行器和来源追踪三个组件，每个组件的决策策略可通过统一的、经过适配器验证的动作目录进行热插拔（基于规则或基于 LLM）。在 Academy 框架上实现的 Avatar 在三个不同工作负载上进行了评估：基于规则的模式能精确复现原生 TaskVine 和 Parsl 的执行行为，而 LLM 模式在计算资源节省（减少 55% 的浪费计算）和 GPU 时间节省（减少 40%）方面表现优异，揭示了代理式推理在何时有益的规律。
AI.motivation: 现有的科学工作流管理系统（WMS）虽然提供了执行抽象，却依赖固定的、手工调优的规则进行编排，难以整合 LLM 代理进行自主决策。主要挑战在于：在哪里引入代理式推理、如何约束其风险、以及何时真正有帮助。不同 WMS 必须独立解决这些问题，导致集成碎片化、难以泛化、评估成本高昂。本文旨在通过提供一种通用的参考架构来解决这一架构层面的空白。
AI.method: 1. 通过对 Pegasus、Parsl、Cromwell、Toil、CWL、WDL、Snakemake、Makeflow、Nextflow 和 FireWorks 等十个代表性 WMS 进行调研，提炼出三项基本职责：逻辑抽象管理、运行时执行、来源追踪与决策依据维护。2. 将这三项职责映射为三个相互作用的 actor 组件：编排器（Orchestrator）、执行器（Executor）和来源追踪（Provenance），它们通过消息总线进行通信。3. 每个 actor 的决策策略（policy）可插拔，采用统一的动作目录（action catalog）并通过适配器（adapter）进行验证和约束，确保基于规则和基于 LLM 的决策使用同一套动作接口。4. 基于 Academy 框架（0.5.0 版本）实现 Avatar 原型，采用 Parsl 2026.3.9、CCTools TaskVine 和 PyTorch 作为执行后端，调用 OpenAI 客户端 2.28.0 与 ALCF Sophia 推理端点的 `open-ai/gpt-oss-20b` 模型。5. 设计三种运行模式（M0：全程规则；M1：来源追踪用 LLM 诊断，编排仍用规则；M2：编排器也由 LLM 决策），通过改变策略而非架构来系统比较。
AI.result: 在三个工作负载上评估：（1）E1 弹性恢复（基于 TaskVine）：M0 精确复现 TaskVine 的恢复行为（重试、完成、永久失败计数完全一致），worker-seconds 差异保持在种子变化范围内；M2 利用 LLM 识别永久失败任务并提前放弃，使浪费计算减少高达 55%。（2）E2 弹性扩缩（基于 Parsl 流式工作流）：M0/M1 的自动扩缩器在低积压与低资源浪费区域表现优异（平均积压 ≈21），而 M2 因 LLM 推理延迟无法跟上高频扩缩决策（平均积压 ≈99），表明代理推理在高频、延迟敏感的控制中并非优势。（3）E3 主动学习（基于 Colmena 的 HOMO-LUMO gap 优化）：M2 通过观察学习进度识别收敛，在第 7 轮即终止（基线为 12 轮），达到相同最佳 gap（0.3997）的同时将 GPU 占用时间减少约 40%。总体而言，Avatar 约 1200 行核心代码在三个工作负载间保持字节级一致，证明架构的通用性。
AI.conclusion: Avatar 将科学 WMS 重新建模为编排器、执行器、来源追踪三个协同工作的 actor，决策策略可插拔，使同一实现能同时支持确定性规则与基于 LLM 的推理。实验证明 Avatar 具有代表性（规则模式下复现原生 TaskVine 与 Parsl 执行）、通用性（支撑静态容错 DAG、动态流式工作流与 GPU 主动学习）以及实用性（LLM 策略在需要上下文推理的决策上提供明显收益）。核心结论是：代理式推理最适用于低频、需要解读执行上下文、且能避免大量下游工作的决策场景，而高频控制仍以轻量规则更优。未来工作将扩展至多节点异构环境（CPU、GPU、多站点），引入执行器的资源选择与失败任务迁移决策，并探索基于错误类型的定向恢复策略。

title: X-CoSD: Communication-Efficient Cross-Vocabulary Collaborative Speculative Decoding
summary: This paper investigates collaborative speculative decoding (CoSD), a distributed large language model (LLM) inference framework in which an on-device small language model (SLM) drafts candidate tokens and a server LLM verifies them. Existing CoSD methods assume a shared vocabulary between the SLM and the LLM and incur substantial communication load because residual resampling requires token distribution exchange between the user device and the edge server. To address these limitations, we propose cross-vocabulary CoSD (X-CoSD), a lossless and communication-efficient CoSD framework for heterogeneous SLM-LLM vocabularies. X-CoSD is built on hybrid resampling (HR), which splits residual resampling across the common-vocabulary region on the device and the LLM-only region on the server, so that distribution transmission is required only for the common-vocabulary region. We further propose X-CoSD-E, an enhanced variant based on server resampling with device verification (SR-DV), in which the server sends only replacement candidates sampled from the server LLM and their corresponding probabilities for local verification at the device. We prove that both X-CoSD and X-CoSD-E preserve the server LLM distribution, and experiments show that they significantly improve token generation speed while maintaining generation quality comparable to that of the server LLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出X-CoSD框架，解决异构词表下协作推测解码（CoSD）的通信开销问题，通过混合重采样（HR）和服务器重采样-设备验证（SR-DV）两种机制，在保证无损解码的同时显著降低设备-服务器间的下行通信负载。
AI.motivation: 现有协作推测解码（CoSD）方法存在两大局限：1）假设设备端SLM与服务器LLM共享词表，而实际中两者常来自不同模型家族，词表不匹配；2）重采样时需传输完整的LLM词表分布，在无线网络中产生巨大的下行通信开销，成为实际部署瓶颈。
AI.method: 1）基于TLI（Token-Level Intersection）框架，将设备端候选生成限制在共享词表V_C内；2）提出混合重采样（HR）：将残差分布分解为共享词表区（设备端重采样）和LLM专属词表区（服务器重采样），服务器仅需传输V_C上的分布而非完整分布；3）提出X-CoSD-E（基于SR-DV）：服务器发送少量替换候选token及其概率，设备端进行验证，全部拒绝时回退到HR；4）理论上证明两种方法均保持服务器LLM分布（无损解码）。
AI.result: 在WMT-DeEn、XSum、CNN/DailyMail、GSM8K、MMLU五个任务上，使用Vicuna-68M作为设备SLM、Qwen2-7B和Llama-3.1-8B作为服务器LLM进行实验。结果显示：1）X-CoSD和X-CoSD-E的生成质量与服务器LLM相当（相对得分接近1.0），验证了无损性；2）下行通信负载相比Naive基线降低约5-6倍（从约1.2M bits降至约0.2M bits）；3）X-CoSD-E在不同下行速率下均保持高token吞吐量，对通信速率变化鲁棒；4）相比Naive、UL、U-HLM等基线，在保证无损解码的同时实现了更低的per-token延迟。
AI.conclusion: X-CoSD和X-CoSD-E是首个面向异构词表的通信高效无损CoSD框架，通过HR和SR-DV机制显著降低了设备-服务器间的通信开销，同时保持与服务器LLM一致的生成分布。实验证明其在通信受限的实际部署场景中具有显著优势，推动了协作推测解码在异构模型配置下的实用化进程。局限性在于性能受共享词表大小影响（实验中共用词表仅占LLM完整词表的约15-17%），未来需探索降低对共享词表依赖的方法。

title: OASIS: A Rubric-Based Multimodal Assessment Platform Using Large Language Models
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures; technical report. Project page: this https URL
summary: OASIS (Open Assessment and Scoring Infrastructure Stack) is a systems platform for rubric-based grading of video, audio, and text with large language models. Scoring one artifact with an LLM is straightforward; deploying assessment at scale requires encounter management, rubric versioning, modality-aware execution, provenance capture, and human review. OASIS pairs a standalone command-line interface with a canonical integrated Elephant + MAPLES stack for encounter management and multimodal grading orchestration. Both paths can target hosted APIs or self-hosted open-weight models through Ollama and OpenAI-compatible endpoints such as vLLM. SimRubrics rubric authoring and the Wayfinder conversational agent gateway are optional extensions that use the same authenticated interfaces as human operators. Given a rubric and recorded encounters, OASIS produces per-criterion scores, evidence, and rationales, preserving execution artifacts for audit. Distinctive features include rubric-as-program compilation, progressive execution plans, content-addressable grading identity, transcript-augmented multimodal grading, explicit review state, and a shared command surface for humans and autonomous agents. Though developed in medical education, the architecture is domain-agnostic, applying wherever structured performance can be evaluated from recorded or written artifacts. In production at UT Southwestern Medical Center since Fall 2023, the platform has processed more than 7,000 encounters. This publication includes the report and project information, not application source, binaries, installation materials, sample data, or a tagged software release.

AI.tldr: OASIS 是一个基于评分量表（rubric）的多模态评估系统平台，利用大语言模型对视频、音频和文本进行评分。它由独立命令行工具和集成的 Elephant + MAPLES 技术栈组成，支持托管 API 与自托管开源模型，提供从评分量表编译、分阶段执行、确定性内容寻址评分身份到人工审核的全套基础设施。该平台已在 UT Southwestern 医疗中心生产环境中处理超过 7,000 个评估场景，旨在让 LLM 评分成为可审查、可追溯的可信软件系统。
AI.motivation: 结构化表现评估（如医学执照考试、教师实习、语言能力测试）普遍存在评估者人工成本高、人与人评分一致性不理想的问题。虽然 LLM 已被证明能在笔记、转录文本和视频上与人类评分者达成较好一致性，但单次成功的模型调用不等于可部署的评估系统。现实使用需要：评估数据管理、评分量表与模型版本控制、媒体模态感知路由、执行工件捕获、人类审核工作流。该论文指出缺失的不是提示模板或工作流引擎，而是一个"以评分量表为本"的多模态评估系统，将数据管理、执行、来源追溯和审核统一在一个架构中。
AI.method: OASIS 由以下核心组件构成：(1) Elephant（Go）—— 基于 OpenAPI 规范生成的合同式 REST API，负责管理 encounters、文件存储（MinIO）和 PostgreSQL 元数据；(2) MAPLES（FastAPI + Prefect 3）—— 评分执行引擎，通过 rubric_zipper 将 Excel 评分量表编译为模态感知提示和 Pydantic 类型化结果模式，采用两阶段评分（自由响应 + 模式解析），每阶段用 flow_run_id 范围键独立缓存；(3) SimRubrics（Flask）—— 可选的 LLM 辅助评分量表质量分析工具，支持多模型共识；(4) OASIS CLI（Go 单二进制）—— 无需基础设施即可本地运行的评分工具，支持渐进式执行（doctor→plan→sample→scale）、内容寻址缓存、分布式批处理；(5) OASIS MCP 网关（FastMCP，可选）—— 将 MAPLES REST 工作流暴露为类型化 MCP 工具，并嵌入 Wayfinder 对话助手。设计采用七项决策：评分量表驱动、领域无关、先感知后评估、提供商无关但不锁定、成本可见、可审计可重放、渐进式与人工审核。
AI.result: 截至 2023 年秋季已在 UT Southwestern 医疗中心投入生产，处理超过 7,000 个 encounters，覆盖 3,000 余名学习者，支持文本、音频、视频三种模态。操作性观察显示：与人工评分者逐项一致率为 93–96%（未校正偶然性），近期多模态部署中 AI-人类 Cohen's κ 达 0.830（同一场景下人类-人类 κ 为 0.732），人工评分工作量减少 95–97%。平台已用于多项已发表研究（NEJM AI、JMIR AI、Discover AI）。还通过 vLLM 服务 Gemma 和 Qwen 系列模型验证了自托管推理对文本、转录优先音频和帧采样视频的可行性。
AI.conclusion: OASIS 将 LLM 评分转变为一类可审查的软件系统：评分量表被编译为类型化程序，每次评分拥有稳定的内容寻址标识，人工审核作为有状态转换被记录，每条执行路径都留下从评分量表版本到最终判定分数的可审计追溯。同一评分量表与工件模型可支持单用户本地运行、小型机构试点到大规模生产服务，托管 API 与自托管开源模型共用同一评分、审核与来源追溯结构。可选类型化 Agent 界面（包括 Wayfinder 助手）扩展而非强制替代人工流程。论文强调代理设计的一个普遍原则：代理通过与人类相同的认证接口和审核门控行事，自动操作与人工操作具有相同的身份、权限和问责性。当前公开发布仅含项目信息和技术报告，应用源代码、二进制、安装材料、样本数据和带标签的软件版本均不在此次公开范围内。

title: Evaluating Enterprise Analytics Agents: An End-to-End, Trace-Backed Methodology
summary: Enterprise analytics agents are not only text-to-SQL systems. They interpret business intent and choose metric definitions. They select data sources, execute tools, inspect results, and produce natural-language answers. Those answers may influence operational, financial, or executive decisions. Grading final answers hides where these agents fail. A plausible answer can use the wrong source of truth. It can skip a required decomposition, claim causality without support, or change its table interpretation across repeated runs. We present an end-to-end evaluation methodology for analytics agents. The methodology grades agent behavior across three families: semantic understanding, execution quality, and reliability. Grading uses question banks with human-written golden answers, repeated runs, and runtime traces. Each run first passes a run-validity check, then receives tiered, abstention-aware scores that feed a decision framework rather than a release gate. We instantiate the methodology on a controlled internal analytics agent at a large online marketplace. The case study uses 50 analytics questions, two anonymous model configurations, and three randomized repetitions per configuration, yielding 300 traces. The higher-capability configuration reduced early refusal from 73% to 0% and increased real-data answers from 21% to 73%. However, it also exhausted the tool-round budget on 16% of runs. It overran the schema-exploration budget on 77% of traces. It changed its table interpretation on 41 of 50 questions. On finance questions with structured golden answers, source table use and escalation improved, but canonical decomposition remained weak in both configurations. These results show why trust in analytics agents requires end-to-end, trace-backed evaluation rather than SQL correctness or final answer quality alone.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向企业分析型 agent 的端到端、基于轨迹的评估方法论，涵盖语义理解、执行质量、可靠性三大维度，强调不能仅以最终答案或 SQL 正确性来判断 agent 是否可信。
AI.motivation: 企业分析 agent 的答案可能影响运营、财务或高管决策，但仅评估最终答案会掩盖大量隐藏失败（如选错数据源、跳过必要分解、跨次运行解读不一致）。标准 text-to-SQL 评估和最终答案评分不足以衡量决策可信度。
AI.method: 三层流程：(1) 构建代表性问题库并配备人工编写的 golden answer（含必选/禁止源表、分解步骤、数值范围等），在隔离、随机、重复条件下运行 agent 并采集运行时轨迹；(2) 先做 run-validity 检查，再进行分层评分（primary signals 与 diagnostic signals），采用 abstention-aware 四档判定（yes/partial/no/unknown），未知结果不计入分母；(3) 评分结果输入决策框架而非发布门槛，并结合跨次一致性分析。配套提出一个将通用轨迹失败映射到分析领域失败模式的 taxonomy。
AI.result: 在某大型在线 marketplace 的内部 analytics agent 上用 50 道问题 × 2 个模型配置（Fast 与 Reasoning）× 3 次重复（共 300 条轨迹）实例化。结果：Reasoning 将早期拒绝率从 73% 降至 0%，真实数据回答率从 21% 升至 73%；但在 16% 的运行中耗尽工具轮次预算，77% 的轨迹超出 schema 探索预算，50 道题中有 41 道在重复运行中改变了表解读；金融题上必选源表使用率与升级行为改善，但规范分解能力在两种配置下都很弱（3% vs 10%）。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠最终答案正确性或 SQL 正确性会高估分析 agent 能力并掩盖关键失败模式；必须采用端到端、基于轨迹、abstention-aware 的评估方法，将可追溯性、升级/弃答、主信号与诊断信号分层、跨次稳定性、版本对比作为决策治理的五大原语，并通过与领域专家校准后再用于发布门槛。

title: The Double Measurement Confound in Agent Benchmarks: De-Scaffolding, Ground-Truth Scoring, and Reliability Beyond the Mean
comment: 31 pages, 18 figures; supplementary material included as appendix
summary: Agent benchmarks are increasingly used to compare large language models (LLMs) and guide deployment decisions, yet benchmark scores are meaningful only if they measure model capability rather than properties of the evaluation pipeline. We identify a double measurement confound: execution-critical decisions are performed by a fixed scaffold instead of the model, while the scorer evaluates outputs using criteria that may not reflect task correctness. We unify these issues within a measurement-theoretic framework that characterizes when benchmark scores can be interpreted as evidence of model capability, and instantiate it with an audit-and-repair protocol that (i) transfers execution-critical decisions from the scaffold to the model, (ii) replaces shape-based evaluation with seeded ground-truth scoring, and (iii) reports reliability beyond the mean through worst-case and tail-risk metrics. Experiments on ComtradeBench show that the joint intervention transforms a nearly flat leaderboard into a reliability spectrum that distinguishes both average performance and robustness across seeds. Applying the audit to existing benchmarks further shows that scorer validity is benchmark-specific, whereas scaffold ownership is an uncontrolled axis wherever we probed it. Our results suggest that benchmark scores should be interpreted together with their scaffolding level, scoring criterion, and reliability profile, providing a practical framework for more valid evaluation of LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别出LLM智能体基准测试中的"双重测量混淆"：固定的脚手架执行关键决策，而评分器仅评估输出形状而非任务正确性，导致基准分数无法反映模型能力。作者提出了一个审计-修复协议（脱脚手架、基于种子的真值评分、报告最坏情况等尾部风险指标），将原本几乎扁平的排行榜转化为能区分平均性能和鲁棒性的可靠性谱，并发布ComtradeBench作为带种子生成器的基准。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体基准测试的分数可能反映的是评估流程的特性而非模型能力本身。论文观察到ComtradeBench上Kimi和Claude获得相同的97.5分均值，而一个无LLM的规则脚本得96.8分；Qwen2.5-7B和Llama-3.3-70B甚至产生逐字节相同的奖励向量。这表明现有基准在区分模型能力方面几乎没有辨别力，亟需一个理论框架来诊断和修复此问题。
AI.method: 作者采用测量理论框架，将基准分数形式化为S(m,c,j)，证明双重混淆导致非可识别性（Proposition 1），而联合干预（脱脚手架+真值评分）可实现可识别性（Proposition 2）。具体方法包括：(i)将执行关键决策从脚手架转移到模型（设计L0/L1/L2三级脚手架谱）；(ii)用基于种子的真值F1分数替代形状评分；(iii)报告最坏情况、CVaR、Reliability@τ等尾部风险指标。开发BenchAudit作为可执行审计-修复协议，并提出per-benchmark有效性卡片。
AI.result: 在ComtradeBench上的实验显示：联合干预将原本无法区分的八个模型转化为从Claude-Fable-5（0.974）到Llama-3.3-70B和Qwen2.5-7B（0.000）的可靠性谱。关键的2×2联合干预实验表明，单独修复评分器或单独脱脚手架都不足以恢复模型差异——L0下所有模型提交载荷SHA-256完全相同；最坏情况可靠性重新排列了均值排名（GPT-4o均值第五但最坏情况为0.00，而小型Claude-Haiku-4.5最坏情况不低于0.787）。对τ-bench的外部审计显示四种脚手架可使同一模型的奖励变化高达0.267并改变排名；对BFCL的审计表明评分器种类多样，但脚手架所有权始终是未受控的轴。论文还揭示其自身的预注册压力测试在原评分器下被确认，但在真值评分下消失，验证了所诊断的混淆。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出四点实践建议：(1)测量模型而非脚手架；(2)针对真值评分而非形状评分；(3)将最坏情况、CVaR和Reliability@τ作为一等输出报告；(4)将脚手架级别视为受控变量。基准分数应与脚手架级别、评分标准和可靠性概况一起解读。该协议可叠加在现有基准上而非替代它们。未来工作包括在非自有基准上进行受控的所有权分解、将审计扩展到需要模型调用才能重放的评分器，以及解除L2接口下限的协议变体。

title: Cost-Aware Post-Hoc Deferral Under Calibration and Shift: An Environmental AI Case Study
