summary: Choosing a deferral policy for a frozen classifier requires more than ranking uncertain cases: confidence may be miscalibrated, errors have unequal costs, reviewers can err, and deployment data can leave calibration support. We study these interactions through EcoTrust, a post-hoc framework that compares automatic action with review using a six-group error-risk estimator, class-asymmetric costs, reviewer accuracy, and an optional support gate. On a Columbia River thermal-stress testbed, the learned estimator improves error-ranking area under the receiver operating characteristic curve from 0.869 to 0.889, but Chow's confidence rule has lower in-distribution cost (0.416 versus 0.567 per day). Across 12 off-the-shelf backends, learned risk and a calibration-matched, class-aware confidence estimator each beat raw Chow on six; a paired year-block bootstrap does not resolve their mean cost difference. In transfer to ten river stations, the gate flags every case and becomes an always-review fallback, attaining the lowest cost on eight stations only when review is perfect and unconstrained. These results characterize decision boundaries on one controlled task: richer risk signals do not reliably improve on calibrated confidence, and detected extrapolation does not imply transferable case-level ranking.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EcoTrust框架，研究在哥伦比亚河热应力预测任务中，针对冻结分类器的后验成本感知延迟策略。通过六组误差风险估计器、类别非对称成本、审核员准确率和支持门控，比较自动决策与人工审核。核心结论是：在校准良好的分布内后端上，Chow置信度规则优于学习风险模型；更丰富的风险信号并不总是提升部署成本；检测到的外推并不等于可迁移的逐案例风险排序。
AI.motivation: 延迟决策（learning to defer）在实际部署中面临多重挑战：置信度可能未校准、错误代价非对称、审核员可能犯错、部署数据可能超出校准支持范围。然而，简单的置信度规则（如Chow规则）与更复杂的风险学习模型在实际部署成本上的优劣尚不明确，特别是在环境监测等成本敏感场景下。论文旨在通过受控实验刻画这一决策边界。
AI.method: EcoTrust框架包含两个阶段：(1) 交叉拟合的元风险估计器g_φ，输入六组信号（置信度、熵、集成标准差、智能体冲突、共形预测量、马氏距离），输出误差概率估计r̂；(2) 成本感知决策规则，基于非对称代价c_FN、c_FP、c_h和审核员准确率a，比较自动决策与延迟审核的期望成本。可选支持门控使用马氏距离检测分布外样本，将风险估计设为0.5的下限。论文在哥伦比亚河The Dalles站点的NOAA/USGS数据上，以NOAA天气和USGS水文特征预测水温是否超过18°C（鲑鱼热应力阈值），比较12-13个现成后端。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 主后端（集成模型）上，EcoTrust的AUC从0.869提升至0.889，但Chow的分布内成本更低（0.416 vs 0.567/天）；(2) 13个真实后端中，学习风险和类感知校准置信度各胜6个，年度块自助法未能解析均值差异；(3) 转移至10个河流站点时，支持门控标记所有案例变为全审核回退，仅在完美审核下8个站点成本最低；(4) 审核员感知策略的断点a*=93.05%与模拟交叉点吻合；(5) 结论：更好的误差排序不等于更低的部署成本，检测到的外推不等同于可迁移的风险估计。
AI.conclusion: 论文提供了受控任务上部署选择的决策边界刻画，而非算法优势的证明。对于校准良好的分布内后端，推荐Chow置信度规则；学习风险模型仅在经时序校准数据验证成本更低后才考虑使用。支持门控定义了检测到外推时的保守回退策略，但不意味着可迁移的逐案例排序能力。需在更多任务和真实审核员条件下进一步验证。

title: How effective are traditional test criteria at detecting bugs in large language models generated code?
summary: Test adequacy criteria are widely used to evaluate and guide software testing. Although prior research has extensively examined these criteria using human-written programs, faults, and tests, the increasing adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) for code generation raises important questions about their effectiveness in detecting LLM-induced faults. To investigate this, we conduct an empirical study involving 5 LLMs and 4 benchmarks, simulating end-to-end workflows in which both code and tests are automatically generated. We collect 6,000+ faulty program instances and evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of 3 widely used adequacy criteria: statement coverage, branch coverage, and mutation testing. Our findings reveal several key insights. First, most faults introduced by LLMs are relatively trivial to catch. Second, the challenging faults are difficult to trigger using either traditional coverage-based or mutation-based criteria. Third, actual fault detection rates remain extremely low, often near zero, because test oracles fail to capture faulty behavior triggered by the generated test prefixes, exposing a critical limitation of automated test generation. Fourth, prompt-aware oracles can improve fault detection, but their overall effectiveness remains limited, highlighting the need for users to manually reason about test assertions. We further observe that mutation testing only marginally outperforms traditional coverage criteria in both triggering and detecting faults, raising questions about whether its significantly higher application cost is justified in this context.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模实证研究（5个LLM、4个基准、6066个非平凡故障）评估了语句覆盖、分支覆盖和变异测试三种传统测试充分性准则在检测LLM生成代码缺陷方面的有效性，发现这些准则对LLM生成代码的故障检测能力极弱，FDR仅约1-2%，且三者差异很小，而瓶颈在于测试预言（oracle）而非触发能力。
AI.motivation: 随着"vibe coding"等LLM驱动的开发模式兴起，代码和测试均可由LLM自动生成。传统测试充分性准则（语句/分支覆盖、变异测试）基于人类开发者错误的假设设计，其在LLM生成代码上的有效性尚未被系统研究；此外现有LLM测试生成工具仍依赖这些准则评估质量，若准则失效则需新的度量方法。
AI.method: 实验方法：(1) 使用4个Python基准（HumanEval+、MBPP、BigCodeBench、NaturalCodeBench）的原始与欠规范提示驱动5个LLM（GPT-5-Mini、GPT-4.1-Mini、Claude-Haiku 4.5、Deepseek-v4-Flash、Llama 3.3-70B）各生成10次实现，共233,300个；(2) 通过差异测试与参考答案对比，收集73,785个有效故障实现，按难度≥0.75筛选并保留每任务最难故障，最终得6,066个非平凡故障；(3) 用LLM-Plain生成大规模测试池；(4) 贪心随机采样100次构造最大化各覆盖准则的最小测试套件，测量故障触发率(FTR)与检测率(FDR)，采用Wilcoxon检验与Vargha-Delaney效应量比较准则；(5) 基于NL规范重生成预言，对比修正前后FDR。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 三种准则在FTR/FDR上差异极小（统计上虽有显著但效应量≈0.5），FTR平均32.9%/38.9%/32.2%（语句/分支/变异），FDR均仅约1-2%；(2) 变异测试相对覆盖准则仅边际提升，与其高昂代价不成比例；(3) LLM生成测试能触发25-78%故障但仅能检测0-10%，瓶颈在预言质量而非输入生成；(4) 基于NL规范的预言改进后FDR最高约30%，平均提升6.6%，仍远不够；(5) 发现LLM错误模式与人工注入变异体不耦合，提示LLM犯"不同种类"的错误，传统故障注入方法可能不适用。
AI.conclusion: 传统测试充分性准则（语句/分支覆盖、变异测试）在LLM生成代码场景下无法可靠预测故障检测能力；主要瓶颈从"触发故障路径"转移到"正确断言期望行为"，因此人类参与验证预言仍不可或缺。未来需开发面向LLM生成代码的新型充分性准则，并加强对预言质量、提示欠规范问题的研究，以适配全LLM驱动的软件开发新范式。

title: XAgent: eXecution-guided Agentic AI for Effective Localization and Resolution of GitHub Issues
summary: Agentic AI has enabled capabilities in leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to autonomously resolve repository-level GitHub issues. However, due to the reliance on limited static description of issues, existing agentic approaches suffer from incorrect localization and incomplete validation. Solely relying on this information can bias LLM reasoning toward the narrow scope of the issue description, leading to incomplete patches that fail to address the underlying issue. In this paper, we present XAgent, an execution-guided agentic framework that analyzes dynamic behavior and additional program context to localize and validate issues. The experimental results on the SWE-bench-lite dataset demonstrate that XAgent outperforms other existing approaches, achieving a resolve rate of 62.0% and a function localization accuracy of 72.8%, while maintaining cost efficiency. Our analysis further shows that XAgent successfully resolves 7 additional issues that the top existing baselines fail to address. This work highlights a shift from static, description-oriented patch generation toward dynamic execution-guided issue resolution, opening new opportunities for LLM-based coding agents to achieve more robust and generalizable software maintenance.

AI.tldr: XAgent是一个执行引导的智能体框架，通过对比失败与成功执行的调用树进行差异分析来定位bug函数，并利用上下文感知测试增强器生成更全面的验证测试，以解决现有方法过度依赖静态issue描述导致的定位不准和验证不完整问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的智能体方法在解决GitHub issue时过度依赖issue的静态描述进行bug定位和验证测试生成，导致两个核心局限：(1) 不正确的定位——关键词搜索受限于issue描述的噪声和不完整性，使LLM偏向无关函数；(2) 不完整的验证——验证测试仅基于issue描述，容易过拟合到问题的表面症状，导致补丁通过验证但未解决根本问题。论文以matplotlib-25433（定位偏误）和seaborn-2848（症状修复陷阱）两个具体案例进行动机论证。
AI.method: XAgent包含三阶段流程：(1) 复现阶段——复现智能体同时生成触发bug的复现脚本和展示正确行为的参考脚本；(2) 定位阶段——执行两个脚本收集调用树，使用All Path Tree Edit Distance (APTED)算法对比两棵树，识别仅在失败执行中出现的"删除节点"作为可疑bug函数集S，再用UniXcoder嵌入相似度排序器对函数排序，取Top-K=20；(3) 补丁生成与验证阶段——上下文感知验证增强器从复现智能体的轨迹中提取相关文件和函数作为程序上下文，零样本提示LLM基于该上下文生成3个额外验证测试（温度分别0.4/0.6/0.8）；补丁智能体迭代遍历排序函数生成候选补丁，用5个验证测试（3个上下文感知+2个复现脚本）和回归测试进行验证。骨干LLM为Claude Sonnet 4。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench-lite（300个实例）上：XAgent取得62.0%的解决率（186/300）和72.8%的函数级定位F1，均为SOTA；文件级定位F1为86.6%；成本约$1.56/issue，比ExpeRepair降低37%，token使用量减少约40%；唯一正确解决了3个最强基线（ExpeRepair、Refact、SWE-Agent）都未能解决的7个issue；搜索空间从全仓库平均20,769个函数缩减至仅在失败执行中独有的平均52个函数（中位数11个）；消融实验显示执行引导定位器贡献+4.5%函数F1和+1.3%解决率，验证增强器再贡献+5.3%解决率；嵌入相似度排序器优于Commit History和Proximity-based排序器；在所有复杂度指标（hunks数量、修改函数数、修改行数）下均表现最优；平均解析时间8.8分钟（其中执行引导定位仅49秒，占9.3%）；与人类编写的补丁精确匹配率仅8.3%，说明性能并非来自记忆；与ground-truth补丁的精确匹配率仅8.3%，排除了记忆的可能性。
AI.conclusion: XAgent通过从静态、描述导向的补丁生成转向动态执行引导的issue解决范式，显著提升了基于LLM的编码智能体在仓库级问题修复中的准确性、效率和泛化能力，为更鲁棒和可泛化的软件维护开辟了新方向。其核心贡献在于：(1) 基于差异分析的执行引导定位方法；(2) 上下文感知测试增强器；(3) 在SWE-bench-lite上建立新SOTA。

title: Keep Evaluation Fair: Detecting Data Leakage in Code Generation Benchmarks via Membership Inference Attacks
summary: Code generation benchmarks are widely used to evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs), but benchmark data leakage into training sets can inflate performance and undermine evaluation validity. DetectLeak, a method specifically designed for code generation benchmark leakage detection, relies on perplexity scores to identify likely leaked samples. However, perplexity mainly reflects general familiarity with code patterns and may perform poorly on complex or rare samples. It also overlooks other useful signals, such as code similarity, functional correctness, and semantic representations. To address these limitations, we propose CGMIA (Code-Generation-specific Membership Inference Attack), a method for detecting leakage in code generation benchmarks. CGMIA fine-tunes a shadow model on a subset of benchmark samples to construct labeled member and non-member data. For each sample, it collects the input prompt, generated code, and reference solution, and extracts expert features, including CodeBLEU, edit distance, test pass rate, and perplexity, together with semantic features from CodeBERT embeddings. An integrated learning module combines these features to capture both surface-level memorization signals and deeper behavioral patterns, enabling a classifier to predict whether a sample was included in the target model's training set. Experiments on eight code generation benchmarks show that CGMIA outperforms eight existing membership inference methods in most cases. It also effectively detects known leaked APPS samples in StarCoder-7B's training data.

AI.tldr: 提出CGMIA方法，通过结合专家特征（CodeBLEU、编辑距离、困惑度、测试通过率）与CodeBERT语义特征，利用影子模型训练成员推理分类器，以黑盒方式检测代码生成基准的数据泄露。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成基准（如APPS、HumanEval）的样本可能泄露到LLM训练数据中，导致性能虚高。现有唯一专用方法DetectLeak仅依赖困惑度，对复杂或罕见样本检测精度仅40-50%；其他MIA方法（Gotcha、CodeMI等）聚焦代码补全的版权保护，无法利用功能正确性等信号。
AI.method: 1）影子模型微调：微调影子模型构造成员/非成员标记数据；2）特征提取：对每个样本采集5次生成代码，提取4种专家特征（CodeBLEU、编辑距离、困惑度、测试通过率）和CodeBERT语义嵌入；3）集成学习模块：通过CNN压缩5个生成代码嵌入，线性投影对齐专家特征维度，融合为3584维向量输入三层MLP分类器；4）集成策略缓解影子-目标模型架构失配。
AI.result: 在8个基准（HumanEval-X、MBXP、NaturalCodeBench、EvoCodeBench、ClassEval）和4个目标模型（Qwen2.5-Coder、CodeGemma、DeepSeek-Coder、Phi-2）上，CGMIA在多数情况下优于8种基线方法（MCC平均提升0.17-0.26，AUC平均提升0.09-0.13）。在StarCoder-7B真实场景中可识别65%以上的108个已知泄露样本。方法对微调轮数不敏感，对影子模型失配具有鲁棒性，集成策略优于最差单一影子模型。
AI.conclusion: CGMIA是首个面向代码生成基准数据泄露检测的成员推理攻击方法，通过融合异构特征显著优于现有方法，在现实预训练泄露场景中具有实用价值，为代码生成评估的公平性提供了有效保障。

title: Socio-technical and Ethical Dimensions of Architecture Practices in FLOSS
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, to be published in 2026 IEEE International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution (ICSME)
summary: This project investigates how software architecture practices in Free/Libre Open Source Software (FLOSS) are shaped by socio-technical and ethical factors, and how education can support more explicit, inclusive, and reflective architectural work. Motivated by FLOSS's role in digital sovereignty, it is observed that architectural decisions are often undocumented and scattered across issues, pull requests, and mailing lists. While prior research has studied architectural artifacts, erosion, and communication, the interplay between architectural work, governance arrangements, and ethical commitments in FLOSS remains underexplored. The research follows a three-phase design: (1) multi-method case studies of 3-4 domain-pairs of architecturally non-trivial FLOSS projects, (2) framework and intervention design with practitioners and educators, and (3) pilot evaluations in projects and courses. It will produce (i) cross-case empirical evidence on FLOSS architecture practices, (ii) a conceptual framework linking architecture practices to socio-technical conditions and ethical dimensions, and (iii) lightweight practices and teaching formats that render architectural work more explicit and inclusive.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇博士论坛（Doctoral Symposium）论文，研究FLOSS（自由/开源软件）中的软件架构实践如何受社会技术因素和伦理因素影响，并探索如何通过教育使架构工作更显式、包容和反思性。作者提出了三阶段迭代研究设计（信息收集、方案生成、评估），将产出实证证据、概念框架和轻量级实践/教学方案。
AI.motivation: FLOSS是数字主权关键基础设施，但其架构决策常未文档化，散落于issue、PR和邮件列表中，且决策权集中在少数维护者手中形成瓶颈；现有研究将架构工件、侵蚀、沟通、治理、伦理等分散研究，缺乏整合视角，也缺乏将架构作为社会技术工作进行教学的研究。
AI.method: 三阶段迭代设计：(1) 多方法案例研究——3-4对领域配对的FLOSS项目（如LibreOffice/OpenOffice、GnuPG/Sequoia-PGP等），结合仓库挖掘、通信分析、半结构化访谈；(2) 基于Phase 1发现构建概念框架并与从业者/教育者共同设计轻量级实践与教学方案；(3) 在1-2个项目和1-2门课程中进行形成性评估。采用三角化、审计追踪、同行评议、成员检验、负面案例分析、反思性等保障效度策略。
AI.result: 预期产出：(i) FLOSS架构实践的跨案例实证证据；(ii) 连接架构实践与社会技术条件和伦理维度的概念框架；(iii) 不增加维护者负担的轻量级实践和教学格式。规划时间表为2026 Q3至2028 Q4完成博士论文。
AI.conclusion: 研究将连接实证软件工程与教育设计，揭示架构实践如何在FLOSS社区中实施，并通过治理、伦理和教学三个维度提供整体性视角，以支持更显式、包容和反思性的架构工作；同时该研究也明确寻求博士论坛对操作化、案例策略和干预可行性的反馈。

title: Beyond Repository Boundaries: Cross-Repository Graph Retrieval for Code Generation
summary: Repository-level code generation requires generated code to be compatible not only with the target repository but also with its dependency environment. Existing retrieval-based methods mainly retrieve context from the local repository, leaving external API usage dependent on the model's pretrained knowledge, which can be insufficient for unseen or version-specific APIs. Moreover, current retrieval strategies largely focus on one-hop evidence and overlook the structural relationships among code components. We propose CrossCoder, a cross-repository code generation framework that explicitly incorporates external libraries into the retrieval context through a unified knowledge graph over repository and library entities. CrossCoder identifies important nodes via planning and semantic retrieval, then selectively expands neighboring nodes to retrieve richer multi-hop contextual evidence for generation. To further evaluate dependency-version compatibility, we introduce VersionExec, an execution-based benchmark derived from BigCodeBench that evaluates generation under different dependency versions. Experimental results on RepoExec, DevEval, and VersionExec demonstrate that CrossCoder consistently improves both functional correctness (up to 6.3% on pass@1) and robustness to dependency-version changes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrossCoder框架，通过构建跨仓库的统一知识图谱，将外部库实体与仓库实体联合索引，采用"规划-检索"范式和图扩展策略实现多跳上下文检索，解决现有方法仅依赖仓库内检索和一跳依赖的问题。同时发布VersionExec基准，基于BigCodeBench构建，专门评估依赖版本兼容性。实验在RepoExec、DevEval和VersionExec上验证了方法在功能正确性和版本鲁棒性上的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有仓库级代码生成的检索方法存在三个局限：(1) 仅从本地仓库检索上下文，外部API使用依赖模型预训练知识，对未见或版本特定API不足；(2) 难以获取精确的版本特定API语义；(3) 检索策略主要依赖一跳证据，忽略代码组件间的结构关系。
AI.method: CrossCoder框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 知识图谱索引——构建异构无向图G(V,E)，联合索引仓库实体(文件、类、函数、变量)和外部库实体，通过contain/import/invoke/inherit四种边类型建立跨仓库连接，并采用文件级作用域投影限制搜索空间；(2) Plan-then-Retrieve算法——先生成实现规划，通过正则匹配(RegScore)和语义相似度(SemScore)选择基础节点，再以深度优先遍历进行图扩展，使用w_q^(n)(u)=w_q(v_b)/(n+1)的分数传播和阈值δ剪枝策略获取多跳上下文。
AI.result: 在RepoExec和DevEval上，CrossCoder在所有模型规模(GPT-OSS-20B/120B、Kimi-K2.5)上均取得SOTA，pass@1最高提升6.3%，且使20B模型可匹配或超越120B基线；在VersionExec上同样优于No Context、Header Only和RAG_Doc基线，NameError从26降至4；消融实验验证了规划、图扩展和库上下文三个组件的必要性。
AI.conclusion: CrossCoder通过跨仓库知识图谱和图扩展检索有效提升了仓库级代码生成的功能正确性和版本兼容性，证明了显式检索外部库源码上下文优于依赖文档检索的方案；VersionExec填补了版本兼容性评估基准的空白。未来工作将扩展至其他编程语言并采用知识蒸馏降低计算开销。

title: GraphDroid: Asynchronous LLM-Based Mobile App GUI Testing via History-Aware Exploration and Hybrid Intent Fulfillment
summary: Automated GUI testing is a widely adopted technique for ensuring mobile application quality by simulating user interactions to exercise functionalities. Despite the research breakthroughs in the past decades, covering complex functionalities that require multi-step action sequences still remains challenging. Traditional tools lack semantic understanding capability and can rarely synthesize such action sequences. Recent LLM-based tools can generate test intents describing target functionalities and leverage the LLM to fulfill the intents, but suffer from three key limitations: 1) loss of historical context for identifying uncovered functionalities, 2) synchronous intent generation that blocks exploration, and 3) per-step LLM-driven fulfillment incurring high cost and latency. To address these limitations, we propose GraphDroid, an intent-driven GUI testing framework that integrates a cluster-based memory mechanism to effectively identify uncovered functionalities from historically visited states for comprehensive application testing. For improving testing efficiency, GraphDroid adopts an asynchronous intent generation paradigm that eliminates the latency bottleneck and a hybrid intent fulfillment strategy that reserves the LLM for fulfilling complex intents while delegating simple intents to a lightweight heuristic algorithm. We evaluate GraphDroid on 41 real-world Android apps against six state-of-the-art baselines. Results show that GraphDroid outperforms all baselines, achieving up to 36.4% higher code coverage while incurring less than one eighth of the cost of the best pure LLM-based baseline. GraphDroid also exposes 19 bugs in the 41 apps and detects 13 of 52 crashes in the Themis bug benchmark, surpassing all the six baselines. Seven of the 19 bugs were previously unknown and we reported them to the developers. So far, four bugs have been confirmed and fixed.

AI.tldr: GraphDroid是一个面向Android应用的意图驱动GUI测试框架，通过基于聚类的记忆机制、异步意图生成和混合意图履行策略，有效覆盖需要多步操作序列的复杂功能，同时显著降低LLM推理的成本和延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的纯LLM驱动的GUI测试工具存在三大局限：1) 丢失历史上下文（仅保留最近步骤的详细信息），导致无法识别已访问状态中未覆盖的功能；2) 同步意图生成阻塞探索过程；3) 每步调用LLM进行意图履行带来高昂成本和延迟。传统工具和LLM增强工具缺乏语义理解能力，难以合成多步动作序列以覆盖复杂功能。
AI.method: GraphDroid包含三个核心设计原则：1) 基于聚类的记忆机制——通过状态抽象（结合DOM相似度和视觉嵌入相似度）和谱聚类将UI过渡图(UTG)组织为大小在[2,20]的状态簇，为LLM提供充分的跨状态上下文；2) 异步意图生成——基于历史记忆生成意图，无需停留在当前状态，与DFS探索并行执行，并通过两阶段去重（Sentence-BERT语义过滤+LLM合并）消除冗余；3) 混合意图履行——根据LLM预测的步数将意图分为简单（单步）和复杂（多步），简单意图由基于EVS（探索价值评分，受Go-Explore启发的引导机制）的启发式DFS算法履行，复杂意图由UI-TARS-1.5 GUI代理履行。框架在冷启动阶段使用深度受限的DFS构建初始UTG，然后迭代执行异步意图生成和混合履行直至时间预算耗尽。
AI.result: 在41个真实Android应用上对六个SOTA基线（DQT、GPTDroid、VisionDroid、DroidAgent、LLMExplorer、LLMDroid）进行评估（每应用2小时预算）：相对最佳基线LLMDroid，GraphDroid在活动覆盖、代码覆盖和发现状态数上分别提升30.3%、21.2%和50.9%；相对最佳纯LLM基线DroidAgent分别提升49.7%、36.4%和87.5%，且成本仅为其八分之一以下（$1.41 vs $11.97）。发现19个bug（7个未知，4个已确认修复），在Themis基准上检测出52个崩溃中的13个。平均每应用生成381个意图（237个去重后），82.4%的简单意图和72.7%的复杂意图被成功履行。消融实验验证三个核心组件均贡献显著性能。
AI.conclusion: GraphDroid通过意图驱动框架有效桥接了传统GUI测试与纯LLM方法之间的差距，能够高效覆盖复杂多步功能，同时大幅降低成本。实验证实三个核心组件（聚类记忆、异步生成、混合履行）各具不可替代的作用。框架设计对具体LLM选择不敏感，具有良好的鲁棒性。未来GUI代理能力的提升将进一步增强复杂意图履行的效果。

title: If It's Not Buggy, Don't Fix It: On the Dynamics of Iterative Bug-fixing with LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become ubiquitous in software development, with LLM-based automated program repair tools increasingly used during code review. In this report, we explore the iterative blind use of LLMs as bug-fixers. Across multiple models and repair environments, we find that LLMs consistently claim to detect bugs in entirely bug-free programs while the rate of repair of buggy programs is less than that of the damage to correct programs. We also explore the long-term dynamics of this iterative process, and find that this frequently reaches a pseudo-bug-fixing cycle where the same changes are added and removed again ad infinitum. Lastly, via mechanistic probing, we unveil the existence of a steering vector which controls the editing propensity, suggesting that LLMs have an internal representation of ``buggy code", and that this representation is what is falsely activated to induce pseudo-bug fixing. These results provide insight towards the dynamics of fully autonomous bug-fixing systems, as well as stopping conditions under ambiguous goals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM作为迭代式自动Bug修复工具时的动态行为,发现LLM倾向于对正确的代码"假修复"造成破坏,且存在反复增删同一改动的伪修复循环,并通过机制可解释性方法定位了控制该行为的内部表征向量。
AI.motivation: LLM作为自动化程序修复(APR)工具在代码审查中日趋普遍,常以"无监督的智能体循环"形式迭代地检测并修复Bug。然而在缺乏明确目标与停止条件时,这类迭代过程的长期动力学行为(代码正确性如何演变、何时停止)尚不清楚,尤其当用户盲目批准修改、上下文受限或多智能体委派时更为突出。理解这一动力学对设计可靠的全自主编码智能体至关重要。
AI.method: 1) 将迭代式Bug修复建模为代码空间C上的离散动力系统,采用全文件编辑与search/replace block(SRB)原子修改两种编辑模式,在无历史上下文的马尔可夫设定下迭代至多100轮,温度τ∈{0,0.7};2) 在CodeContests+数据集的20道题、每题40份C++提交上评估Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite与Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct,计算修复率α(错→对)与破坏率β(对→错);3) 对吸引子分类(固定点、周期、瞬态)并统计瞬态长度与周期长度分布;4) 通过对比"模型高置信度认为有Bug(Y)"与"高置信度无Bug(N)"的末token激活均值差构造线性探针,得到"代码缺陷"导向向量vl,再以γvl对残差流进行加法干预,观察对编辑倾向与下游任务(如issue计数)的影响,并用logit-lens排除简单读取Y/N token的解释。
AI.result: 1) 破坏率β几乎在所有配置下不低于修复率α:SRB模式下β最高可达0.44而α仅0.04左右,全文件编辑下二者较为接近;2) SRB相比全文件编辑显著产生更多周期循环与更长的瞬态,且更易出现退化(重复注释、search块找不到、identity替换等);3) 观察到混合正确/错误状态的周期(如长度2的对错交替),出现"伪Bug修复循环";4) 探针向量在第22层附近AUC接近1.0,但与Y/N读出方向余弦相似度近随机,说明并非简单编码token;5) 正向steering(γ>0)使模型更激进地"找Bug"并对Hello World等无误代码强加修改,负向steering(γ<0)几乎完全停止编辑循环;不同层还分别编码了格式、可读性等子概念。
AI.conclusion: LLM在迭代式Bug修复中并非可靠的保守修改者,而是对"代码有Bug"这一概念过度敏感,容易把正确代码改坏并陷入伪修复循环;SRB原子修改进一步放大了此问题。模型内部存在一个线性的"代码缺陷"表征,通过steering向量即可调控其编辑倾向,这为设计带停止条件与敏感度控制的自主编码智能体提供了可解释的干预手段。未来工作应扩展至更大模型、多文件与含明确目标的场景。

title: Ensembling LLMs for AI-Augmented Cybersecurity Software Requirements Generation
comment: 20 pages; 4 figures; frozen candidate corpus, ensembling code, and computed artifacts (metrics, curves, result tables) archived on Zenodo, see this https URL
summary: Translating high-level controls from security standards into concrete, system-specific requirements is central to cybersecurity requirements engineering. Large language models (LLMs) can accelerate this labor-intensive, recall-sensitive task, but any single run is unreliable: it misses valid safeguards while introducing plausible hallucinations, and outputs shift across runs and models. We reframe this variability as a resource: rather than selecting one output, we study post-generation ensembling, aggregating stochastic runs with information-retrieval data-fusion operators. We propose two strategies: Uniform fusion rewards mere cross-run agreement, whereas Naive-Bayes fusion weights each run by its estimated reliability. We evaluate both over 24 runs from 12 configurations across four model families, generated for ten ISO/IEC 27002:2022 controls and expert-judged against a gold standard of 72 valid requirements. Pooling every run's output recovers all 72 (whereas single configurations recover on average under half) but also 111 hallucinations. Fusion separates the wheat from the chaff, ranking valid requirements well ahead of hallucinations. In the areas under the precision-recall and ROC curves, Uniform fusion alone largely surpasses every original run and configuration by 0.142 and 0.118 over the best configuration. Naive-Bayes weighting adds a further 0.039 and 0.052, reaching 0.864 and 0.869 while attaining useful operating points earlier. Internal validation confirms the stability of these gains: they stay positive in at least 92% of out-of-bag bootstrap resamples and every structured-perturbation sample. Post-generation fusion thus turns apparent noise into a practical asset: a lightweight layer giving analysts broader coverage and a better prioritized review queue, using affordable, below-frontier models alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在网络安全需求工程中，如何利用信息检索(IR)中的数据融合方法，将多个大语言模型(LLM)运行的输出进行后生成集成(post-generation ensembling)。提出两种融合策略：Uniform融合(仅基于跨运行一致性)和朴素贝叶斯(Naive-Bayes)融合(按模型可靠性加权)。在涵盖四个模型家族、12种配置、24次运行的实验评估中，融合方法显著优于任何单一配置：AP从0.684提升至0.864，ROC AUC从0.699提升至0.869，并通过内部验证证明了增益的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 单个LLM运行在网络安全需求生成任务中表现不可靠：会遗漏有效的安全防护措施，同时产生看似合理但错误的幻觉(hallucinations)。现有的实证研究大多只评估单次运行，忽视了LLM输出的随机性和跨模型差异性。本文将这种可变性视为一种资源而非问题，提出通过后生成集成方法将多个LLM输出融合，以获得更好的覆盖率与更精准的优先级排序。
AI.method: 将每个LLM运行视为针对候选需求集合的黑盒检索系统，把后生成集成建模为基于投票的数据融合问题。具体方法包括：(1) 统一融合(Uniform Fusion)：等权计算候选需求被各运行支持的频率分数；(2) 朴素贝叶斯融合(Naive-Bayes Fusion)：按模型家族估计的TPR和FPR计算对数似然比权重，对各模型运行加权投票。评估采用IR范式，包括P@k/R@k操作点、F₂、ROC AUC、加权Youden指数等指标，并设计了两类内部验证：OOB自助法(200次复制)和固定权重的控制切片/运行扰动分析。
AI.result: 在10项ISO/IEC 27002:2022控制、72项专家评定的有效需求、111项幻觉候选的评判宇宙中：(1) 融合恢复了全部72项有效需求(单一配置平均仅恢复不到一半)；(2) Uniform融合在AP和ROC AUC上分别超过最佳配置0.142和0.118，归一化提升达86.2%和76.9%；(3) Naive-Bayes融合在此基础上再增加0.039和0.052，归一化提升达94.1%和89.6%，达到AP=0.864、ROC AUC=0.869；(4) Naive-Bayes在更浅的审查深度(k=91 vs 183)即达到最大F₂=0.831；(5) 增益在至少92%的OOB复制和所有结构化扰动样本中保持正向。
AI.conclusion: LLM运行的随机多样性和跨模型差异不是评估噪声而是可利用的证据。IR启发的数据融合为聚合LLM生成的网络安全需求提供了原理化且有效的后处理层：仅靠跨运行一致性(Uniform融合)就能大幅提升审查顺序，而朴素贝叶斯加权则在更浅的审查深度下进一步优化。该方法为安全需求工程的SQUARE流程中的三个步骤(启发、优先级排序、审查)带来具体改进，使次前沿模型的集成能产出优于任何单模型的优先级队列，且无需模型重新训练。

title: Retrofitting Code Using LLMs to Support Exceptional Behavior
summary: Exception Related Code (ERC), which includes throw statements, conditions (if statements) that guard those throw statements, and try/catch blocks, is an essential component of software systems, allowing developers to detect and handle exceptional states that deviate from the expected program behavior. However, manually writing ERC across large codebases is tedious. We propose a novel task: retrofitting existing code with ERC. Namely, given code (without ERC) and Exceptional Behavior Tests (EBTs) (e.g., check if method throws InvalidArgumentException if null is given as the value to the argument) we aim to automatically generate missing ERC, such that the given tests pass. We design and implement Exception Coder (EXCODER) that performs context engineering to help Large Language Models (LLMs) tackle this task. EXCODER integrates static and dynamic program analysis with LLMs by providing the extracted contextual information to the LLMs. To evaluate EXCODER, we build a benchmark constructed from GitHub Java repositories, where we systematically remove ERC in 304 methods from 75 projects. Our results demonstrate that EXCODER provides an effective, though imperfect, solution to this problem in automated code generation, offering developers the first way to implement ERC following test-driven development. When combined with Qwen 2.5 Coder 32b, EXCODER achieves pass@1, 5, and 10 rates of 85.92% (12.56 percentage points over baseline), 86.18% (12.82 p.p. over baseline), and 86.51% (13.15 p.p. over baseline), respectively, on developer-written test suites. Our manual inspection of the generated code further reveals limitations of EXCODER, pointing to directions for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"为现有代码补充异常处理代码（ERC）"这一新任务，并设计了 ExCoder 工具，通过静态与动态程序分析为 LLM 提供上下文，在给定目标方法和异常行为测试（EBT）的情况下自动生成缺失的 throw 语句和异常条件检查。基于 75 个 GitHub Java 项目中 304 个方法的基准测试，ExCoder 配合 Qwen 2.5 Coder 32b 在开发者测试集上达到 pass@1 85.92%（比基线提升 12.56 个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 手动编写异常处理代码（throw 语句、条件检查和 try/catch 块）在大规模代码库中繁琐且容易出错。现有基于 LLM 的工作主要关注如何避免未处理的异常，而非主动添加异常处理。此外，让开发者用自然语言描述预期的异常条件同样费时，因此采用 TDD 思路，让开发者通过异常行为测试（EBT）来表达意图更为自然。
AI.method: ExCoder 通过上下文工程（context engineering）为 LLM 提供五类上下文信息：①静态分析提取的异常构造函数签名（cExCons）和可用符号（cAvSym）；②动态分析提取的运行时异常信息（cThrExc，通过 try/catch 封装执行 EBT）、行覆盖率（cLCov，通过 Java instrumentation）以及非异常行为测试（c_nEBTs）。这些信息被整合到结构化提示词中，引导 LLM 在正确位置插入异常条件检查和 throw 语句。
AI.result: 在 75 个 GitHub Java 项目的 304 个方法上测试，ExCoder 在 5 个不同规模/架构的 LLM（Llama3.1 8b、Phi4 14b、Qwen 2.5 Coder 7b/32b、GPT-5 Mini）上一致优于基线。配合 Qwen 2.5 Coder 32b，pass@1/5/10 分别为 85.92%/86.18%/86.51%（比基线提升 12.56/12.82/13.15 个百分点）。消融实验表明 cAvSym 和 cExCons 贡献最大；其他动态上下文贡献较小。人工检查发现 24.71% 的通过 ERC 与真实实现存在语义偏差（"过宽松"占多数，约 63%），说明 EBT 覆盖不足是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: ExCoder 是首个利用 EBT 自动为现有代码补充 ERC 的工作，通过上下文工程显著提升了 LLM 在该任务上的表现，且与 LLM 自修复机制互补。但仍存在两大局限：①模型可能幻觉未定义的符号；②当 EBT 覆盖不足时，生成的异常条件检查往往比开发者意图更宽松。未来工作包括更好地利用动态分析信号、为其他语言/构建系统适配，以及探索如何编写更有效的 EBT。

title: Towards Scalable and Cost-Efficient Vulnerability Detection: A Study on Automatic Query Generation
summary: Static analysis remains a cornerstone of software security, yet the effectiveness of tools such as CodeQL is often limited by the substantial manual effort required to develop high-coverage query suites. While large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a potential solution for automated code reasoning, their practical utility in generating structured, executable security queries remains underexplored. In this paper, we conduct an empirical study to evaluate the ability of LLMs to synthesize CodeQL queries using vulnerability data from the National Vulnerability Database. Through this investigation, we explore the potential of using LLMs as an automatic CodeQL query generator. Subsequently, we systematically evaluate the performance of various LLM architectures across a diverse set of real-world vulnerabilities, measuring their ability to improve detection coverage and precision. Our findings reveal that LLM-generated queries significantly enhance the baseline CodeQL queries, yielding 82% improvement in average F1-score. Furthermore, we provide a detailed cost- benefit analysis showing that while direct LLM-based scanning of entire repositories is often computationally and financially prohibitive, leveraging LLMs to synthesize CodeQL queries offers a scalable and cost-effective alternative for large-scale vulnerability detection. Our results suggest that LLMs can effectively bridge the gap between unstructured vulnerability reports and formal static analysis specifications, offering a scalable path toward comprehensive automated vulnerability detection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用大语言模型（LLMs）从NVD漏洞数据中自动合成CodeQL查询，以扩展静态分析的漏洞检测覆盖范围。通过多模型对比实验发现，Kimi K2.5在成本与性能之间达到最佳平衡，使平均F1分数相对基线CodeQL提升82%，漏洞检测数量提升263%，为大规模漏洞检测提供了一种可扩展且经济高效的方案。
AI.motivation: 静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具如CodeQL的有效性受限于手动编写的高覆盖率查询集，而现有研究显示SAST工具仅能检测约12.7%的真实漏洞。同时，直接使用LLM扫描整个代码库存在计算与财务成本过高（如单次扫描需17美元且耗时44小时）、知识产权泄露风险以及基础设施要求高等问题。因此，如何利用LLM自动生成可执行的CodeQL查询，以弥合非结构化漏洞报告与形式化静态分析规范之间的鸿沟，成为一个关键问题。
AI.method: 提出了一个三阶段的自动查询生成管道：（1）语义分析阶段——漏洞评估推理器评估漏洞修复提交（VFC）的可泛化性，相关文档检索器通过RAG检索相关CodeQL API；（2）引导合成阶段——谓词生成器将漏洞模式转化为CodeQL谓词，查询生成器将其组装为完整查询；（3）迭代细化阶段——可编译性检查器验证语法，语法精炼器（最多三次迭代）自动修正错误。实验选用10种CWE类别（来自MITRE Top 25）、112个测试CVE，覆盖DeepSeek R1、Grok Code Fast 1、Gemini 3 Flash Preview、Kimi K2.5、GPT 5.2 Codex、Claude Sonnet 4.5等10个LLM，并对比默认CodeQL与PDBERT基线。
AI.result: （1）可编译性：原始LLM生成的查询几乎均不可编译，引入语法精炼器后，Gemini 3 Flash Preview可独立生成123条可编译查询（成本9.25美元），Sonnet 4.5结合Gemini 3作为精炼器可生成120条；（2）检测性能：Kimi K2.5在50个CVE上检测到漏洞，F1分数达24.04%，比基线CodeQL（13.20%）提升82%，检测数量从19提升至50（提升263%）；Sonnet 4.5检测数量最高（51个）但FDR较高；（3）补丁复杂度影响：Sonnet 4.5在短补丁（≤10行单文件）场景下F1提升63%，而Kimi K2.5和Codex在完整上下文中表现更优；（4）成本效益：Kimi K2.5以不到13美元生成96条查询，比Sonnet 4.5便宜65%，比GPT 5.2 Codex便宜25%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，利用LLM从漏洞报告中自动合成CodeQL查询是可行且高效的，能显著提升漏洞检测覆盖范围而无明显精度损失。Kimi K2.5为性价比最优模型。不同LLM在不同CWE类别上表现各异（无单一模型占优），多模型集成可最大化检测率。未来工作方向包括：整合可达性分析以减少假阳性、探索跨语言漏洞模式迁移（如C/C++到Java/Python），以缓解漏洞数据分布不均衡问题。

title: Spectral origin of the topological gap exponent d + η: mechanism, kernel, decomposition, and scope
summary: The topological gap $\Delta$ -- the excess $H_1$ total persistence of a critical point cloud over a density-matched null -- scales as $\Delta \sim L^{d+\eta}$. We derive this analytically: the spectral integral $I(\alpha) = \sum_{k\neq 0} S_{\mathrm{conn}}(k)\,|k|^{\alpha}$ scales as $L^{2-\alpha-\eta}$ when IR-dominated, giving $I(-2\eta) \sim L^{d+\eta}$. The decomposition $I(-2\eta) = I_0 \cdot I_{\mathrm{shape}}$ separates volume ($I_0 \propto N(1-m^2) \sim L^d$) from anomalous dimension ($I_{\mathrm{shape}} \sim L^{\eta}$); the volume factor accounts for the magnetization-driven per-configuration variance of $\Delta$. We prove the mechanism requires $d < 2 + \eta$ (IR dominance), confining it to $d = 2$ for physical systems; in $d = 3$ the spectral integral is UV-dominated, explaining why density normalization is needed. An $\alpha$-sweep for Potts $q = 4$ at $L = 32$--$256$ finds $\alpha_{\mathrm{opt}}$ in $[-0.75, -0.5]$, consistent with $-2\eta_{\mathrm{Ising}}$ and inconsistent with $-2\eta_{q=4} = -1$; we flag this as tentative pending $L \geq 1024$ confirmation. The $\langle m^2 \cdot I(-2\eta)\rangle$ hyperscaling product is dominated by the correlation $r(m^2, I) \approx -0.98$ via the shared $I_0$ amplitude, so we report it as a covariance-correction analysis. Under a heuristic argument extending Divol--Polonik to inhomogeneous Poisson intensities, the bare PH kernel is flat; the effective kernel acquires $k$-dependence only at criticality. The per-configuration agreement between $\Delta$ and $I(-0.5)$ is primarily a magnetization correlation: $R^2 = 0.91$ at $L = 256$ collapses to $R^2 \approx 0$ once $|M|$ is partialed out. Per-configuration evidence corroborates the $I_0$ Parseval identity but not the $|k|^{-2\eta}$ shape factor; the latter is established by ensemble $L$-scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文从临界结构因子出发，解析推导出持续同调拓扑间隙标度律 Δ ∼ L^{d+η}。核心发现是谱积分 I(-2η) = Σ S_conn(k)|k|^(-2η) 在红外主导（IR-dominated）时标度为 L^{d+η}，并可分解为体积分 I₀ ∝ (1−m²) ∼ L^d 与反常维度因子 I_shape ∼ L^η。证明该机制仅在 d < 2+η 时成立，物理上限制在 d=2；d=3 时为紫外主导。数值验证涵盖2D/3D Ising和2D Potts q=3,4模型。
AI.motivation: 此前 Δ ∼ L^{d+η} 的标度律已在多个自旋模型中被数值验证（如2D Ising: 2.249±0.038；Potts q=3: 2.272±0.024），但缺乏第一性原理推导。本文旨在从临界结构因子 S_conn(k) ∼ |k|^{-(2−η)} 出发，建立 Δ ∝ I(-2η) 的解析联系，阐明 d+η 中两个分量的物理起源及其成立范围。
AI.method:
1. 解析推导：将 Δ 表示为核函数 T̃₂(k) 与 S_conn(k) 的谱积分（式2），匹配 S_conn(k) ∼ k^{-(2−η)} 确定核函数指数 s = d−2+2η，从而得到 Δ ∝ I(−2η)（式3）。
2. 前向推导（式4–6）：将 I(α) 转化为 d 维径向积分，分析红外端（IR）与紫外端（UV）收敛性；IR 主导条件 p+d < 0 给出 I(α) ∼ L^{2−α−η}。
3. 分解（式7–8）：利用 Parseval 定理证明 I₀ = N·(1−m²)/4 抓住 m² 驱动的逐构型方差，I_shape = I(-2η)/I₀ ∼ L^η 提供反常维度。
4. 临界维度判据（式9，定理1）：d < 2+η 为必要充分条件；因 η < 1 在所有 d ≥ 3 物理系统中成立，故机制本质上是二维的。
5. 数值验证：FFT 计算 S_conn(k)，GUDHI 计算 alpha 复形 H₁ 持续性，bootstrap 估计不确定度；包含 L=32–512 范围的 2D Ising、L=32–256 的 Potts q=3,4、L=16–32 的 3D Ising。
6. 核函数平坦性猜想（猜想1）：扩展 Divol–Polonik 渐近到非齐次 Poisson 强度，推导 O(ε²) 阶 δTP 与 k₀ 无关。
AI.result:
1. 标度指数：2D Ising 的 I(-0.5) 标度为 L^{2.280±0.037}，与 d+η=2.250 在 0.8σ 内一致（表1）。
2. 比例稳定性：Δ/I(-0.5) 在 L=32–512 范围（16× 跨度的 L）CV=4.1%，所有 bootstrap 95% CI 重叠，比例常数 0.049±0.002（表2）。
3. 拓扑测量 η：Δ/TP_shuf ∼ L^η 给出 η=0.237±0.067，与 2D Ising η=1/4 在 0.2σ 内匹配。
4. 3D 验证：3D Ising 的 I(-0.073) ∼ L^{3.0015}（OLS 斜率），表明紫外主导，η 的贡献不可分辨。
5. 逐构型 R²：在 L=256 时 R²=0.91，但偏 |M|（二次回归）后 R² 降至 0.02，说明逐构型一致性几乎完全由 (1−m²) 共幅驱动。
6. 交叉系统：Potts q=3 测量 α=2.272±0.024 与 34/15 在 0.2σ 内匹配（解决了先前 2.6σ 张力）；Potts q=4 的 α-扫描在 L=32–256 给出 α_opt ∈ [-0.75, -0.5]，与 -2η_Ising 一致，与 -2η_{q=4}=-1 不一致（待 L≥1024 确认）。
7. 滤过稳健性：Vietoris–Rips 与 alpha 复形的 H₁ 持续性 r=0.999，比例常数差 2.40 倍，表明机制非滤过特异。
8. ⟨m²·I⟩ 乘积：r(m², I) ≈ -0.98 的强负相关通过共享 I₀ 振幅使该乘积成为协方差修正分析而非独立超标度诊断。
AI.conclusion:
1. 核心贡献：从临界结构因子解析推导了 Δ ∼ L^{d+η}，建立了 Δ ∝ I(-2η) 的理论框架。
2. 分解意义：I₀·I_shape 分解清楚区分了体积分贡献（L^d）与反常维度贡献（L^η），并解释了逐构型方差完全由磁化驱动（共享 (1−m²) 因子）。
3. 维度限制：机制严格限定于 d < 2+η，对物理系统即 d=2；d=3 时为紫外主导，需要密度归一化替代机制。
4. 未解问题：（a）Potts q=4 的 α_opt ≈ -0.5 是否普适——若成立，d+η 公式应解读为 d+η_eff，其中 η_eff ≈ 1/4 是 alpha 复形的几何常数（碰巧等于 Ising η），需 L≥1024 多种子热化确认；（b）裸核函数平坦性猜想（依赖未发表的 Divol–Polonik 扩展）；（c）dressed kernel 的第一性原理推导途径：Wilsonian RG、拓扑集团展开或 Kac–Rice 理论。
5. 方法论启示：拓扑超标度诊断应分开测量 ⟨m²⟩ 与 ⟨I⟩ 而非使用其乘积。

title: Physics-informed neural networks by Gradient-Guided Gaussian Adaptive Sampling (3GAS-PINNs)
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a mesh-free framework for solving partial differential equations, yet their performance in nonlinear problems is often limited by slow convergence, gradient imbalance, and insufficient resolution to capture localized intermittent structures such as shock waves[1]. These issues arise primarily from the use of fixed weights of loss and uniform collocation point distributions, which cannot adapt to the evolving complexity of the solution field during training. To address these challenges, Gradient-Guided Gaussian Adaptive Sampling Physics-Informed Neural Networks (3GAS-PINNs) is proposed in this paper, which combines uniform probability distribution and Gaussian-smoothed probability distribution derived from the spatial gradients of solution, to maintain global constraint satisfaction as well as concentrating collocation points in regions of high gradient. Thus, intermittency structures like shock wave and solitons can be accurately captured. The method is evaluated on three benchmark nonlinear problems, including one-dimensional forced Burgers equation, Korteweg-de Vries (KdV) equation and nonlinear Schrodinger equation, all of which exhibit steep gradients or strong nonlinearity. In comparison with baseline PINNs, 3GAS-PINNs can effectively promote the physical consistency in intermittent regions. The accuracy of the numerical simulation can be improved by a factor of up to 14.

AI.tldr: 提出3GAS-PINN方法，通过结合均匀概率分布与基于解场空间梯度的高斯平滑概率分布来自适应配置配点，解决PINN在非线性问题（激波、孤立子）中收敛慢、梯度失衡和分辨率不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统PINN在求解非线性PDE时存在收敛慢、梯度失衡以及难以捕捉激波、孤立子等局部高梯度间歇结构的问题，主要原因是固定损失权重与均匀配点分布无法适应训练过程中解场复杂度的动态变化。
AI.method: Gradient-Guided Gaussian Adaptive Sampling PINNs (3GAS-PINNs)：将均匀概率分布与由解的空间梯度推导出的高斯平滑概率分布相结合，用于自适应采样配点，在保证全局约束满足的同时，将配点集中于高梯度区域，以精确捕捉激波、孤立子等间歇结构。
AI.result: 在一维强迫Burgers方程、KdV方程和非线性Schrödinger方程三个非线性基准问题上进行评估，3GAS-PINN相比基线PINN能有效提升间歇区域的物理一致性，数值模拟精度最高可提升14倍。
AI.conclusion: 3GAS-PINN通过梯度引导的自适应高斯采样策略显著改善了PINN处理具有陡峭梯度和强非线性问题的能力，为解决含激波和孤立子等局部高梯度特征的PDE提供了一种有效方案。

title: World-Time Compute with Verified Code World Models
comment: 36 pages, 16 figures, 12 tables. Code and data available at this https URL
summary: LLMs generalize across a domain only after seeing many real, labeled examples, which most domains lack. We study a way to manufacture it cheaply. When a domain's dynamics can be written as code, one template instantiates into many world models: executable, verifiable programs over symbolic state, each an inexhaustible source of exactly-labeled trajectories. Fine-tuning an LLM on trajectories through many such worlds, which we call world-time compute, a training-time analogue of test-time compute, lifts generalization to held-out worlds it never trained on (synthesized world families). Gains are largest where capability is scarcest: +29 points at 0.5B; the largest model's lift is within noise, consistent with saturation. Labels can be trusted because the worlds are verified code: synthesized-then-checked dynamics are exact over 20-step rollouts and answer 10x out-of-distribution probes exactly (100%), whereas per-step LLM and MLP predictors compound error and collapse. Unlike domain randomization, each world is independently authored and verified; a corrupted-label control shows label exactness, not task variety, drives the gains. On real benchmarks (ARC-AGI grids, List Functions, CLRS) the same lever holds as per-world test-time training. On List Functions the harder cross-world form holds: one adapter trained on 128 disjoint worlds reaches 40% on held-out worlds versus 6% for a corrupted-label control (+34 points, CI [29, 39]). The gain is a saturating regularity, not a law: largest for few-step reasoning and small/weak models, fading for long chains, perception-induced tasks, and saturated tasks; cross-task transfer is weak without shared skill. Worlds are authored and served by OpenWorld, a zero-dependency framework (companion paper). Scope: symbolic state; pixel-native domains remain territory of learned models. All code, recipes, and this manuscript regenerate from one repository.

AI.tldr: 提出"世界时间计算"(world-time compute):用经过验证的代码世界模型作为训练信号,在符号域内以零训练成本实现精确、零复合误差的动力学,并通过遍历同一领域多个已验证世界来提升模型对未见世界的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 跨域泛化需要大量真实标注样本,而多数领域样本稀缺且昂贵。当域动态可用代码表达时,可廉价生成大量精确标注轨迹,作为可验证的训练信号。
AI.method: 核心方法:(1) 合成-验证中继——LLM 生成转换程序,经语法、沙箱不变量、探针集、可选批评者检验后才接受;(2) 同一模板生成多个独立验证的世界模型(Code World Models);(3) 在多世界轨迹上微调 LLM(世界时间计算,类似测试时间计算的训练时类比);(4) 关键消融:破坏标签控制实验以区分"任务多样性"与"标签精确性"的贡献。基线包括 LLM 逐步预测、MLP/1-NN 等学习式动力学模型,数据集涵盖合成诊断世界族与真实基准(ARC-AGI、List Functions、CLRS、Bongard-RWR)。
AI.result: 主要结果:(1) 验证代码在 24/24 步滚动中完全精确,LLM 逐步代理仅 0/24,MLP 分布外为 0%;(2) 诊断域中,0.5B 模型提升 +29 点,32B 仅 +3 点(任务饱和);(3) List Functions 上单适配器在 128 个未见世界训练,在 60 个保留世界达 40%,破坏标签对照仅 6%(+34 点);(4) ARC-AGI 上每世界 TTT 从 2% 升至 10%,破坏标签塌缩至 2%;(5) 编码世界 164 个任务上 7B pass@5 从 84% 升至 95%;(6) Bongard-RWR 视觉任务无提升——感知边界;(7) 跨语言框架迁移失败——清晰负面结果;(8) 混合循环(验证世界作为生成器+后备)在零人工标签下将 HumanEval-X 提升 +10 点(强基)+8 点(弱基)。
AI.conclusion: 经过验证的代码世界模型在符号态域内是学习式世界模型的正交路径:零复合误差、可审计、零数据。其作为训练信号经多世界遍历可迁移到未见世界,但前提是域内存在共享技能。增益呈描述性饱和曲线,适用于少步推理与小/弱模型;长链推理、感知主导任务、跨任务无共享技能时失效。关键启示:代码世界模型买精确性,买 OOD 鲁棒性,买可审计性——其代价是表达边界,即无法处理像素原生域。

title: Accountable and uncertainty-aware evaluation of sensor-based AI under distribution shift: devices, subjects, and nearly three years underground
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Manuscript prepared for Measurement Science and Technology
summary: Sensor-based AI systems are rarely operated under the conditions under which they were trained: devices, personnel and recording epochs change, and each change degrades performance in ways a random train-test split cannot reveal. We propose a staged, accountable evaluation protocol that treats the evaluation of a deployed model as a measurement with declared reference levels and a quantified uncertainty. Four cumulative generalisation stages hold out devices, subjects and time. Each stage is judged on quantiles of repeated trainings against chance references with the correct class count, an out-of-present-scope rate exposes silent misdirection towards classes that are no longer present in deployment relative to training, and an explicit decision rule ties roll-out decisions not to means but to 5% quantiles. We demonstrate the protocol on infrastructure-free geomagnetic localisation with smartphone-based recurrent classifiers in two real underground mines, including a replication of the scheme's training stages at the second site. Unchanged models are re-evaluated on data recorded 34 months after the training campaign, on a device generation unknown at training time and with a held-out surveyor. The 5% quantile of their present-conditioned precision there is 0.39 over 299 repeated trainings, 16.5 times the chance level; across the composition of the 42 reachable location classes the figure varies by +/-0.08, several times the spread between repeated runs. Repeated trainings of a single configuration show why means mislead: a bimodal configuration passes a mean-based test decisively while its 5% quantile lies more than an order of magnitude below chance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对传感器AI在分布偏移下部署的分阶段、可问责评估协议，将模型评估视为具有声明参考水平和量化不确定性的测量。该协议在两个真实地下矿井的地磁定位任务上得到验证，包括对34个月前训练数据的跨时间再评估。
AI.motivation: 传感器AI系统在部署时面临设备老化、人员更换、记录时间跨度等分布偏移问题，而传统的随机训练-测试分割无法揭示这些偏移导致的性能下降。现有指纹定位文献普遍使用单次测量活动的随机分割来报告系统性能，无法体现部署条件下的真实表现。作者借鉴测量科学中《测量不确定度表达指南》(GUM)的理念，呼吁将模型评估视为一项严谨的测量任务。
AI.method: 提出包含四个累积泛化阶段的评估协议：随机分割（声明上界）、跨设备、跨主体、跨时间。关键创新包括：(1) 使用具有正确类别数的随机参考基线；(2) 引入OOPS率（out-of-present-scope）揭示对部署中已不存在类别的隐性误判；(3) 基于重复训练的5%分位数（而非均值）作出部署决策；(4) 跨时间降解分解为类别损失、注释边界模糊和真实签名变化三部分。在两座地下矿井使用基于智能手机的地磁指纹LSTM分类器进行验证，包括34个月后未更换模型在新设备和新测量员上的再评估。
AI.result: 协议在两座地下矿（Markus-Röhling-Stolln银矿和Schlema-Alberoda铀矿）共7003次训练运行中得到验证。关键发现包括：(1) 随机分割在匹配配置下对设备变更场景高估+0.14，对人员变更场景高估+0.41；(2) 34个月后的跨时间再评估中，最佳特征集的5%分位数精度的当前条件精度为0.39，约为随机水平的16.5倍；(3) 均值测试可被双峰配置欺骗：通过均值测试但5%分位数低于随机水平一个数量级以上；(4) 随机分割下的特征排序无法预测部署排序（Kendall's τ ≤ 0.36且多数情况下接近零）；(5) 47点表观降解中，23点源于类别损失，16-26点源于注释边界，剩余2-23点为真实签名变化上界。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了将传感器AI系统部署评估作为测量的完整方法论，涵盖分阶段设计、声明参考水平、基于重复训练的不确定性陈述以及显式决策规则。核心实践建议：(1) 随机分割仅作为声明上界报告；(2) 基于重复训练集合的分位数与随机参考比较来判断部署；(3) 长期得分需条件化于当前类别清单并以OOPS率作防护；(4) 在部署所施加的偏移下选择模型而非依赖随机分割排名。完整研究消耗3237 GPU小时，而新系统采用该协议仅需0.68%的计算量。

title: Literati: Towards Anytime Optimal Shape Generalized Trees via AO*
summary: Decision trees are prized for their interpretability and strong performance on tabular data, but popular greedy top-down induction algorithms can yield suboptimal and unnecessarily complex structures. Optimal decision tree methods address this through global optimization, yet remain restricted to axis-aligned threshold splits, which limit the expressivity of each node and often force deep, complex trees to capture non-linear feature effects. Shape Generalized Trees (SGTs) generalize threshold splits to learnable univariate shape functions, improving expressivity and enabling more compact trees. However, existing SGT induction algorithms are greedy and offer no optimality guarantees. In this work, we introduce Literati, the first algorithm for optimal SGT induction. We propose a novel AND/OR graph formulation of the problem that jointly optimizes tree structure and shape function complexity. To solve this AND/OR graph, we develop an AO*-based algorithm with two enhancements that improve anytime performance while preserving optimality: a secondary heuristic for OR-node selection and a round-robin policy for AND-node exploration. Across 24 real-world datasets, Literati achieves higher training and test accuracy than state-of-the-art tree approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Literati算法，是首个用于最优Shape Generalized Tree（SGT）归纳的算法。作者提出了新颖的AND/OR图建模方法，联合优化树结构和形状函数复杂度，并基于AO*算法开发了带有两增强策略（次级启发式和轮询策略）的求解框架。实验表明Literati在24个数据集上取得了最优的精度表现。
AI.motivation: 决策树虽具备可解释性，但传统贪心算法产生次优结构；现有的全局最优方法受限于轴对齐阈值分割，表达力不足；Shape Generalized Trees虽更灵活但只能贪心归纳，缺乏最优性保证。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1. 将SGT归纳问题建模为AND/OR图搜索问题，数据状态表示数据分区，形状函数状态表示正在构建的分支规则；2. 使用AO*算法求解，配合可采纳启发式保证最优性；3. 引入两增强策略：OR节点选择的不可采纳次级启发式（基于CART的前瞻）和AND节点的轮询探索策略；4. 使用自适应离散化策略控制搜索空间。
AI.result: 在24个真实数据集（<500k样本）上，Literati的训练和测试准确率均优于现有最优树方法。K=1时（恢复轴对齐阈值树），在D≥4的所有深度上取得最高训练准确率；增加K能持续提升精度，K=3时效果最佳。测试准确率90.6%，比第二名ShapeTAO高1.0%，平均秩具有统计显著性优势。在DPDT对应的搜索空间中，Literati以更低运行时间达到相同或更优精度。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了Literati——首个最优SGT归纳算法，通过AND/OR图建模和AO*搜索联合优化树结构与形状函数复杂度，结合次级启发式和轮询策略实现强anytime性能。理论证明和实验验证表明其在24个数据集上超越现有最优树方法和贪心SGT方法。未来工作包括探索更多AO*框架内的可采纳和启发式策略。

title: Explaining f-Divergence-Based Regularization via Local Curvature and Sharpness-Aware Minimization
comment: Published at 5th Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents (CoLLAs), 2026
summary: Divergence-based regularization and Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) are two prominent approaches for improving generalization in deep learning, both motivated by robustness to perturbations. However, their relationship has remained largely unexplored. Building on classical second-order expansions of $f$-divergences, we show that the two methods are locally consistent under parameter-space perturbations: both induce curvature-sensitive penalties, with divergence regularization yielding a Fisher-weighted quadratic form and SAM penalizing sharpness through the dominant Hessian eigenvalue. For negative log-likelihood objectives with exponential-family output distributions, this correspondence becomes especially transparent, since the Fisher and Gauss-Newton matrices coincide. We further show that the same local geometric perspective extends to input-space perturbations, where divergence-based regularization is defined through transformations of the input. In this setting, the regularizer induces a pullback quadratic form on the input space, providing a more general perturbation framework than standard SAM while preserving the same local sensitivity interpretation. To validate the analysis empirically, we use the asymmetric $\alpha$-skew Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) family as a controlled testbed. Its local curvature coefficient scales as $\alpha(1-\alpha)$ and is maximized at the symmetric point $\alpha=\tfrac12$, which recovers the standard JSD. Loss-landscape visualizations in the input-perturbation regime show that stronger induced curvature penalization is associated with flatter local minima. Experiments on four benchmark datasets further demonstrate that both accuracy and negative log-likelihood are consistently best near this regime of maximal curvature penalization.

AI.tldr: 本文从局部二阶几何视角建立了f-散度正则化与锐度感知最小化(SAM)之间的形式联系，证明了在参数空间扰动下二者局部一致：散度正则化产生Fisher加权二次惩罚，SAM通过Hessian最大特征值惩罚尖锐性；对指数族输出的NLL损失二者完全一致。输入空间扰动则产生pullback二次型，比标准SAM更具一般性。以非对称α-偏JSD族为受控实验对象，验证了曲率系数α(1−α)在α=1/2处最大，且该处性能最优、损失景观最平坦。
AI.motivation: f-散度正则化与SAM虽都以扰动鲁棒性为动机来提升泛化，但二者关系此前缺乏严格的局部二阶几何刻画。本文旨在弥合这一理论缺口，从局部曲率角度统一理解两类方法，并揭示散度选择对正则化效果的影响机制。
AI.method: 1) 利用经典的f-散度二阶Taylor展开（Proposition 1），得到局部二次逼近为χ²型惩罚。2) 分别在参数空间（Corollary 1，Fisher矩阵形式）和输入空间（Corollary 2，pullback度量Γ_x形式）导出显式二次型。3) 对SAM做二阶展开并利用Rayleigh商，得到λ_max(H)主导的谱曲率惩罚。4) 借助Fisher = GGN = Hessian PSD部分的关系（对指数族NLL成立），将散度正则化与SAM的曲率几何统一。5) 以α-偏JSD族（局部系数α(1−α)）为受控实验台，在CIFAR-10/Fashion-MNIST/EMNIST/Oxford-IIIT Pet四数据集上做输入扰动（2%随机掩码）实验，并在CIFAR-10上做ResNet-18损失景观可视化对比。
AI.result: 1) 理论：f-散度在局部等价于φ″(1)/2乘以χ²二次型，参数空间对应Fisher矩阵，输入空间对应pullback度量Γ_x；SAM在近平稳点处等价于(ρ²/2)λ_max(H)谱惩罚；当Fisher=GGN时二者几何一致。2) α-偏JSD局部系数∝α(1−α)，α=1/2时最大。3) 实验：四个数据集上准确率与NLL均在α≈1/2附近最优；ResNet-18/CIFAR-10的2D损失景观显示α=0.5产生最平坦极小值，Hessian迹与最大特征值均最小（tr≈3.508, λ_max≈2.700），验证了更强曲率惩罚对应更平坦局部极小。
AI.conclusion: f-散度正则化与SAM在参数空间局部二阶几何上一致：前者产生Fisher加权二次惩罚，后者惩罚Hessian最大特征值；对指数族NLL损失两者因Fisher=GGN而完全对齐。输入空间扩展使该框架比标准SAM更具一般性。α-偏JSD族验证了局部曲率系数越大，模型性能越好、损失景观越平坦。然而，所有f-散度在二阶层面仅以φ″(1)缩放因子区分，意味着超越二阶的高阶项或结构性质（对称性、有界性等）才是散度选择的关键判据。

title: Constraint-Aware Discrete Black-Box Optimization Using Tensor Decomposition
comment: 32 pages, including supplementary material. ECML PKDD 2026
summary: Discrete black-box optimization is often addressed using approaches such as Sequential Model-Based Optimization (SMBO), which aims to improve sample efficiency by fitting surrogate models that approximate a costly objective function over a discrete search space. In many real-world problems, the set of feasible inputs is often given by logical constraints known in advance. However, existing surrogate modeling techniques generally fail to capture the symbolic rules governing feasibility in discrete input spaces. In this paper, we propose a surrogate modeling approach based on tensor decomposition that captures the structure of discrete search spaces while directly integrating feasibility information. To implement this approach, we formulate surrogate model training as a constrained polynomial optimization problem and solve a relaxed formulation using a differentiable penalty term derived from T-norms. Our experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks, including a pressure vessel design task, demonstrate that the proposed method improves sample efficiency by effectively guiding the search away from infeasible regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CA-TD方法,将离散逻辑约束直接集成到基于张量分解的代理模型中,通过多项式优化问题(POP)形式化训练过程,并使用基于T-范数的可微惩罚项(PGRAD)实现可扩展的梯度求解,以提高SMBO在带约束离散黑盒优化中的样本效率。
AI.motivation: 现有SMBO中的代理模型通常以纯数据驱动方式学习,无法捕捉离散输入空间中可行性的符号规则,导致在稀疏可行区域近似精度差、样本效率低下。需要在代理模型训练阶段而非仅在采集函数阶段直接整合逻辑可行性信息。
AI.method: 1) 将离散搜索空间表示为张量,采用CP/TR/TT分解构建代理模型;2) 将带约束代理训练形式化为多项式优化问题(POP),要求不可行点的代理输出不低于阈值τ_t;3) 提出两种求解策略:HSDP(基于SDP层次松弛,精度高但可扩展性差)和PGRAD(基于Łukasiewicz T-范数的可微铰链损失惩罚,支持Adam梯度优化);4) 通过M个模型的集成量化不确定性,使用EI采集函数平衡探索与利用。
AI.result: 在Ackley、压力容器设计、Warcraft路径优化、糖尿病治疗方案及7个组合优化任务(GAP、Ising、NAS、DNA结合)上的实验表明:CA-TD优于GP、TPE等朴素的带约束基线,在多数任务上与NN+MILP等强基线相当或更优;PGRAD相比HSDP可扩展至10^10搜索空间;约束感知版本始终优于无约束版本;无单一最佳张量格式,TT稳健,CP在特定任务(GAP/Ising)上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: CA-TD通过将符号可行性知识嵌入张量分解代理的训练过程(而非仅在采集阶段处理),有效提升了离散约束黑盒优化的样本效率;该框架对张量格式(CP/TR/TT)具有灵活性,TT作为稳健默认;未来工作包括通过稀疏张量表示扩展至更高维离散空间、自动秩选择以及推广到连续和混合变量领域。

title: XAI-Refine: An Automated Explanation-Knowledge Loop for Brain-Age Prediction
summary: Brain-age prediction models are commonly evaluated by predictive accuracy, yet accurate predictions alone do not establish that a model relies on reproducible or neurobiologically supported mechanisms. Post-hoc explanation methods can expose these mechanisms, but existing workflows typically stop at diagnosis or require correction targets to be specified before model analysis. We propose XAI-Refine, an automated explanation-knowledge loop for brain-age prediction from resting-state functional connectivity. At each iteration, XAI-Refine consolidates complementary post-hoc analyses across repeated training runs into reliable, structured model explanations. It converts each reliable explanation into a neutral neurobiological question, retrieves and verifies relevant literature, and compiles the verified evidence into an admissible set in the same typed explanation space. The target for refinement is defined as the minimal projection of the current model explanation onto the admissible set induced by applicable verified knowledge. This revised explanation is then translated into a differentiable constraint while preserving the originating model variable, measurement operator, and applicable scope. Candidate updates are promoted only when multi-seed validation confirms target-directed explanatory movement, predictive performance remains within a prespecified guardrail, and non-target explanatory drift remains bounded. Experiments on functional-connectivity-based brain-age prediction evaluate predictive performance, explanation reliability, literature alignment, and target-specific model revision, illustrating a structured route from post-hoc analysis to evidence-guided model refinement.

AI.tldr: XAI-Refine提出了一种自动化的"解释—知识"闭环框架，用于基于静息态功能连接的大脑年龄预测。该框架通过多轮迭代，将可靠的事后解释转化为经文献验证的最小修正解释，并翻译为可微的训练约束，在保持预测性能的同时使模型行为与已验证的神经科学知识对齐。
AI.motivation: 大脑年龄预测模型通常以预测精度为主要评估标准，但高精度并不能保证模型依赖的是可复现且有神经生物学支持的机制。现有事后解释工作流往往止于诊断，或需在模型分析前预先指定修正目标，缺乏一种从模型行为自动推导并执行证据引导修正的系统性框架。
AI.method: 框架包含四阶段迭代闭环：(1) 通过多随机种子训练和互补的事后分析家族（预测行为、纵向一致性、特征响应、归因结构、表征几何），提取满足复现性（支持率、覆盖率、稳定性）和忠实性阈值的可靠模型解释记录；(2) 将每条记录转化为模型盲的中性科学问题，通过文献检索、书目验证、证据提取和范围评估构建结构化知识记录，并将其编译为同一类型解释空间中的可执行容许集；(3) 通过最小变化投影将当前模型关系映射到容许集上，翻译为保持原始变量、测量算子和适用范围的差异化约束；(4) 通过响应探测和稀疏组合选择评估候选更新，仅在多种子验证满足预测保护栏、目标定向解释移动和非目标漂移有界时予以提升，迭代直至达到证据一致解释均衡。
AI.result: 在613名受试者的Emory健康大脑研究纵向队列上，XAI-Refine将MAE从4.5360降至4.3813，PCC从0.4788提升至0.5274，Confirmation从0.4000提升至0.6500，AEA从0.3646提升至0.5722，实现了84.44%的预定目标方向改进，且几乎未产生超出预测重训练自然变异的非目标漂移。在六轮匹配定量比较中，XAI-Refine在目标改善概率(NTIP)、目标响应特异性(TRS)、预测保持率(PPR)和验证到测试方向持久率(DPR)上均达到最优平衡。七个组件消融实验验证了可靠性过滤、模型盲问题、范围感知验证、最小投影、变量-算子保持、响应探测和稀疏组合选择的互补作用。单审稿人审计显示证据状态一致性83.8%、精确弃权一致性89.2%、最小修正正确性86.5%。
AI.conclusion: XAI-Refine提供了一条从模型解释到证据引导模型修正的可审计、结构化路径，其核心设计原则是将科学证据、解释几何和优化通过共享变量、算子和范围保持区分但相连。该框架为将已验证的科学知识转化为模型特定的、可审计的更新提供了一般机制，且无需预先指定修正目标，为科学模型自动化精炼提供了可检验的路线。局限在于依赖事后解释、文献检索和证据验证的可靠性，且知识一致性不等同于因果或临床验证。

title: Applying foundation model embeddings towards urban livability evaluation
summary: While accurate measurement of socioeconomic indicators remains challenging in data-scarce regions, which limits policy interventions and resource allocation, high-resolution geospatial data is widely available and can contain information on various livability statistics. We investigate which physical features are encoded within foundation model embeddings, such as AlphaEarth, AnySat, and TerraMind, and provide a systematic framework for identifying the most predictive geospatial indicators. By analyzing how different types of geospatial data influence urban livability predictions, our approach enables researchers to prioritize the most informative features for their specific applications. Additionally, we demonstrate how to leverage foundation model embeddings to enhance prediction performance for these outcomes. This work contributes a principled methodology for extracting actionable information from satellite imagery while accounting for complex spatial dependencies, with applications in predicting urban livability in regions with limited observation data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种系统框架，将 AlphaEarth、AnySat 和 TerraMind 三种地理空间基础模型嵌入整合到基于 Transformer 的多模态城市宜居性评估模型中，以预测荷兰 Leefbaarometer (LBM) 100m×100m 网格尺度的宜居性评分。结果表明，AlphaEarth 嵌入在所有嵌入中表现最佳并能有效补偿缺失模态，但在乡村地区性能下降，需多嵌入组合使用。
AI.motivation: 在数据稀缺区域，社会经济指标的准确测量仍然困难，限制了政策干预和资源分配。高分辨率地理空间数据虽广泛可用，但多源数据的采集、预处理和集成成本高昂，且可能遗漏有价值的数据集。地理空间基础模型嵌入能够将光学、雷达、环境和文本等多源信息整合为统一的实数向量表示，有望简化数据工程并提升预测性能。
AI.method: 1. **数据集**：基于荷兰 LBM v3.0 数据集，使用 100m×100m 网格尺度的整体宜居性（LIV）及五个子维度（PHY、NUI、SOC、AME、HOU），涵盖 13 个城市的 52,001 个样本。2. **多模态输入**：遥感影像（RS，2m）、数字表面模型（DSM，0.5m）、夜间灯光遥感（NLRS，10m）、POI 文本数据，以及三种基础模型嵌入——AlphaEarth（64 维，10m）、AnySat（1536 维，10m）、TerraMind（384 维，160m）。3. **模型架构**：基于 TMTMR（Transformer-based Multi-Task Multimodal Regression）模型，RS/DSM/NLRS 使用预训练 DenseNet 提取特征，POI 使用 BERT 提取文本特征，每种嵌入通过独立的卷积分支（3 层 3×3 卷积 + BN + ReLU + 自适应平均池化）提取特征后线性投影至 3×1024，与其他模态拼接后输入 12 头 Transformer 编码器，最终通过线性层输出多任务预测。4. **损失函数**：采用多任务平均绝对误差（MAE）。5. **实验设计**：对比基线（无嵌入）、单一嵌入、三种嵌入的两两组合及三者组合；同时在四个测试城市（Eindhoven、Hengelo、Dordrecht、Beesel）和 POI 有无条件下分层评估，并进行模态消融和缺失模态实验。
AI.result: 1. **整体性能**：嵌入显著降低 RMSE，AlphaEarth（aef）和 aef+tm 表现最佳，LIV RMSE 从基线 0.106 降至 0.098。2. **嵌入单独使用**：线性探针显示嵌入单独使用弱于多模态融合，但 probe-aef 在 PHY 和 AME 维度优于基线，表明这些嵌入编码了相关物理信息。3. **城市差异**：在 Eindhoven（现代城市）中 aef 和 aef+tm 效果最佳；在 Beesel（乡村社区）中单一嵌入会降低性能，仅 aef+as+tm 组合能恢复并超越基线，反映嵌入预训练数据的城市偏向性。4. **模态替换**：当去除 DSM/NLRS/POI 时，aef 可恢复接近全数据性能；aef+tm 在不使用任何传统模态时即可达到基线全数据水平。5. **缺失模态鲁棒性**：包含 AlphaEarth 的模型对 RS 缺失最为鲁棒（LIV RMSE 从 0.156 降至 0.112），但 RS 仍是最难替代的模态。6. **可解释性**：注意力分析显示高宜居性区域注意力熵更高且更分散，POI 始终获最高注意力权重；Full Grad-CAM 表明 AlphaEarth 帮助模型更好地整合跨模态空间上下文，关注图像边缘的有意义地物（如公园、历史水塔）。
AI.conclusion: 本文验证了地理空间基础模型嵌入（特别是 AlphaEarth）在城市宜居性评估中的有效性，证明嵌入能够增强预测性能并在数据稀缺场景中补偿缺失模态。实践建议包括：单一嵌入预算下优先选择 AlphaEarth；城市区域使用 aef 或 aef+tm 性价比最高；乡村区域需多嵌入组合；RS 仍是最难替代的模态。研究局限在于结果仅在荷兰验证，尚未测试跨文化和跨城市的泛化能力。未来工作将研究嵌入对空间偏差的影响、跨区域泛化以及时序嵌入的应用。

title: Tensor-Train Weak SINDy: Identifying High-Dimensional Nonlinear Dynamics
summary: In recent years, weak-form methods have made significant advances in data-driven discovery of dynamical systems. However, in high-dimensional settings, current techniques can prove expensive in both computation and memory. In this work, we introduce TT-WSINDy, which combines techniques of the Multidimensional Approximation of Nonlinear Dynamics (MANDy) and Weak Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (WSINDy) methods, implementing requisite computations in the tensor-train (TT) format. We demonstrate that this method is able to search an exponentially-growing space of candidate functions -- performing weak-form transformation, regression, and sparsification -- without suffering from the curse of dimensionality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TT-WSINDy方法，将MANDy的强形式张量分解与WSINDy的弱形式方法相结合，在张量训练(TT)格式下实现高维非线性动力系统的稀疏辨识，避免维度灾难。
AI.motivation: 传统SINDy及其弱形式扩展WSINDy在高维场景下面临计算与内存瓶颈：候选函数库规模随维度指数增长（$J^D$），导致矩阵运算不可行。需要一种能够利用低秩结构、对噪声鲁棒且绕过导数估计的方法。
AI.method: 1) 在TT格式中构建弱特征张量$\bm{\Theta}(\mathbf{X},\bm{\varphi})$，通过将测试函数作为第$(D+1)$个核融入MANDy框架；2) 提出TT-STLS与TT-MSTLS算法，利用TT伪逆（$O(NIR^3+KR^2)$）和基于左右密度矩阵的粗支持提取，在低秩潜空间完成稀疏回归；3) 提出低秩特征张量构造算法（Algorithm 5），利用截断SVD和随机化方法处理大数据集情形；4) 证明TT-WSINDy求解的优化问题与原始WSINDy等价（Proposition 12）。
AI.result: 在FPUT、Lorenz 96、Kuramoto模型和Chua电路四个ODE系统上验证：弱形式相对强形式在噪声下具有显著稳健性（相对系数误差更低）；对于Lorenz 96系统$D=6$至$12$维，TT-WSINDy相比flat WSINDy获得$2\times$至$7\times$的加速。复杂度分析显示：时间复杂度$O((JD)^2 M^3)$，内存复杂度$O(JDM^2)$，均为多项式量级，绕开了维度灾难。
AI.conclusion: TT-WSINDy成功将WSINDy拓展至高维设置，通过TT格式的伪逆计算与粗筛选-精筛选两阶段策略，在多项式复杂度内搜索指数增长的候选函数空间。弱形式的引入在保持TT结构的同时提供了对噪声的稳健性。未来工作包括：研究TT-MSTLS粗筛选的统计性质、拓展至PDE场景、以及两种特征张量构造方案的适用条件。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Sea-Ice Type Mapping with Multiple Ice Charts
summary: Sea-ice stage of development (SoD) describes the age and associated thickness of sea ice and provides important information for navigation, and operational ice monitoring. SoD labels are obtained from operational ice charts, where trained analysts interpret satellite observations and assign standardized stage codes to regions with similar ice conditions. These codes often represent ranges of compatible ice thicknesses rather than exact physical values. Deep-learning methods can automate SoD mapping and commonly adopt operational ice charts as reference labels for training. These annotations are not exact, however; this is because chart interpretation relies on analyst judgement and on the observations available at the time, so different ice services may assign different SoD labels to the same conditions. We term this variation across independently produced expert annotations multi-annotator label uncertainty; collapsing the annotations into a single deterministic target discards this variation. A second source of uncertainty originates in the learned model itself. In this paper, we quantify both sources: annotation uncertainty from disagreement among independent ice-service charts and model uncertainty from the learned predictive models. We then evaluate their relationship by testing whether model uncertainty is higher where ice services disagree. We observe that supervision incorporating information from multiple annotators can improve this correspondence, with soft supervision achieving the highest overall correlation of 0.256. The relationship becomes substantially stronger near the ice edge, where model predictive uncertainty closely tracks multi-annotator disagreement, reaching a correlation of 0.704 within 0--10 km. Among the uncertainty-estimation approaches, Monte Carlo dropout provides the best-calibrated confidence estimates, with an expected calibration error of 0.050.

AI.tldr: 本文针对海冰发展阶段（SoD）自动化映射中存在的标签不确定性（多机构冰情图标注差异）与模型不确定性，通过贝叶斯深度学习（如MC Dropout）量化两类不确定性，并发现两者在冰缘附近高度相关（0–10 km处相关系数0.704）。研究表明，采用多标注者软监督可显著提升不确定性的校准与一致性，MC Dropout在校准误差（ECE=0.050）方面表现最优。
AI.motivation: 海冰SoD标签依赖于不同冰务机构分析师的主观判读，存在多标注者差异（multi-annotator label uncertainty）。传统深度学习方法将其坍缩为单一确定性目标，丢失了这种差异信息，且未能量化模型自身的不确定性，从而影响冰区导航与业务监测的可信度。
AI.method: 采用基于深度学习的SoD自动分类模型，引入贝叶斯不确定性估计方法（如Monte Carlo Dropout）；将多个独立冰务机构的标注作为软监督（soft supervision）进行训练；同时设置硬监督基线；通过相关系数和期望校准误差（ECE）分别评估不确定性的对应关系与校准性能。
AI.result: 1）软监督使多标注者差异与模型不确定性间的整体相关性达0.256；2）冰缘附近（0–10 km）两者相关性显著提升至0.704；3）MC Dropout的期望校准误差最低（ECE=0.050），为校准最优的方法。
AI.conclusion: 海冰SoD制图中应同时考虑标注不确定性与模型不确定性。引入多机构标注的软监督策略能更好地对齐两类不确定性，尤其在冰缘区域；MC Dropout是提供可信置信度估计的有效途径，对极地业务化遥感应用具有重要价值。

title: Exact-Form Regret for Gradient Descent, Mirror Descent and Follow-the-Regularized-Leader
summary: Online gradient descent is usually studied through external regret, where the learner competes with fixed alternatives. Recent work shows that first-order methods control richer action-dependent deviations. We ask for a geometric characterization of the deviations with respect to which online gradient descent, mirror descent, and follow-the-regularized-leader (FTRL) achieve no regret. We identify exactness as the common principle. Exactness means that the relevant displacement field is generated by a scalar potential, or equivalently that the associated one-form is exact in the geometry used by the algorithm. This geometry depends on the algorithm. For gradient descent it is Euclidean geometry, for mirror descent it is the geometry induced by the regularizer, and for FTRL it is the cumulative dual state. Under mild regularity conditions, exactness yields sublinear regret, while nonzero circulation provides the complementary obstruction and leads to linear regret. This gives a unified geometric framework for understanding the deviation classes controlled by these algorithms and reveals that different first-order methods can control genuinely different classes of deviations. These deviation classes have direct consequences for learning, particularly in games. We study the equilibrium notions induced by exact-form deviations and introduce conservative correlated equilibrium, reflecting both the conservative geometry of the underlying displacement fields and the restricted family of deviations available to the players. We characterize its relation to correlated equilibrium, determine when the resulting equilibrium notions coincide and when they separate, and show how these relationships depend on the geometry and the learning algorithm. Overall, this work gives a unified geometric account of what first-order online learning algorithms are no-regret with respect to, beyond fixed comparators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"精确形式"(exact-form)概念作为几何框架，统一刻画在线梯度下降、镜像下降和FTRL所能控制的动作依赖型偏差类。精确性意味位移场由标量势生成（一形式是恰当的），它在温和正则条件下保证次线性遗憾，而非零环量则导致线性遗憾。精确形式类严格包含弱凸近端类，但其恒等径向闭包重合。在游戏均衡层面，作者引入"保守相关均衡"(ConCE)并证明ConCE=PCE，且在一维区间上ConCE=CE，但构造了二维连续支撑的反例使得CE⊊ConCE=PCE。另外，镜像下降与FTRL在Legendre内部重合但存在边界时可控偏差类不同，作者给出了ℓ_p幂次正则子的具体分离例子。
AI.motivation: 传统在线梯度下降分析仅给出外部遗憾保证，但近期研究表明一阶方法可控制更丰富的动作依赖型偏差类。然而现有工作（如对称仿射偏差、近端偏差）各自刻画了不同偏差类，缺乏统一的几何原理来解释哪些偏差受哪些算法控制，以及不同算法的偏差类之间关系如何。
AI.method: 方法核心是几何精确性原理。对OGD，若偏差ϕ的位移D_ϕ(x)=∇Ψ(x)（即梯度场），则遗憾通过势函数Ψ的伸缩实现次线性界；镜像下降中精确性对应一形式D_ϕ(x)^T d∇R(x)的恰当性；FTRL则要求累积对偶状态中的位移场恰当。逆向非零环量通过构造循环对手证明线性遗憾下界。通过Moreau包络恒等式建立近端偏差与精确形式偏差的联系，通过恒等插值定理分析径向闭包关系，通过ℓ_p正则子构造镜像下降与FTRL偏差类分离的实例，通过对偶边际密度构造区分CE与ConCE的均衡反例。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 对OGD的O(√T)精确形式遗憾界及非零环量的线性下界；(2) Moreau包络恒等式证明Φ_prox⊊Φ_exact^sm且RadI(Φ_prox)=Φ_exact^sm；(3) 镜像下降在Legendre内部及无Legendre假设下的精确形式遗憾界；(4) Bregman近端类是镜像精确类的子类但可严格更小（ℓ_p例子）；(5) FTRL精确形式遗憾界及FTRL⊊镜像精确的ℓ_p分离例子；(6) ConCE=PCE，一维区间上CE=ConCE，二维连续支撑上CE⊊ConCE=PCE。
AI.conclusion: 精确形式提供了一阶在线学习算法可控偏差类的统一几何刻画。精确性是核心原则：梯度场对应OGD，镜像度量下恰当一形式对应镜像下降，累积对偶状态下的恰当场对应FTRL。不同算法在不同几何下精确性条件不同导致偏差类严格分离。恒等插值调和了偏差类严格包含但均衡集合相同的现象。均衡层面，零误差下ConCE=PCE，一维区间上与CE重合，二维连续支撑上严格分离。未来方向包括弱化镜像下降正则性条件、构造全维绝对连续联合分布实现CE与ConCE分离、以及与Blackwell approachability、梯度均衡的更深联系。

title: Building the Harness Automatically: Self-Play in Code Distills a Text Harness for Black-Box Optimization
summary: Can an agent learn a numerical search strategy through executable practice and then transfer that strategy as text? We study low-budget black-box optimization, where unaided language models remain well below strong classical optimizers. During development, an agent repeatedly writes and evaluates optimizer programs. It then distills the resulting program and practice record once into a 197-word primary Harness A, which is frozen before evaluation. Harness A reduces Gemini Flash regret by 48\% in an independent $N=30$ study ($p<.001$), enters the GP-BO performance range on the practice family, and lowers mean regret on all three held-out BBOB landscapes. The same text improves every tested Gemini executor and transfers to Claude Sonnet, reducing regret by 43\% and 49\% ($p\leq.005$). An independent end-to-end replication produces Harness B, a different program and text at the same performance tier. The same framework also attains the lowest regret on a sealed YouTube reward-tuning production benchmark. Executable practice is thus a viable way to discover a search policy, and language a portable medium for deploying it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"练习-门控-蒸馏-冻结"框架：让智能体通过反复编写和评估优化器程序进行"可执行练习"，然后将所得经验一次性蒸馏为冻结的文本策略（Harness），用于提升语言模型在低预算黑盒优化中的表现。197词的主Harness A使Gemini Flash的遗憾降低48%，并可跨执行器、跨模型提供商迁移。
AI.motivation: 低预算黑盒优化场景下，无辅助语言模型的数值优化能力远逊于经典优化器（如贝叶斯优化、CMA-ES）。现有方法要么将LLM嵌入固定搜索流程（限制泛化），要么在线通过测试反馈修改提示（泄露评估信息）。本文旨在发现一种可在评估前冻结、可跨执行器移植的搜索策略。
AI.method: 四阶段流程：(1) 可执行练习——固定智能体在开发目标上迭代编写挑战者程序，与现有版本对比，仅当在新批次上平均遗憾更低时替换；(2) 门控——在新鲜开发种子上用固定验证规则筛选，失败者仅作审计；(3) 蒸馏——一次性将获胜程序及练习记录合成为短文本；(4) 冻结——密封执行接口、解析器、边界与推理配置，评估期间文本与θ均不可变。重复性目标定义为"性能层级"而非完全相同的代码或文本。
AI.result: Harness A（197词）使Gemini Flash的二次函数遗憾从64.2降至32.9，独立N=30研究中从69.5降至36.0（48%，p<.001），进入GP-BO性能区间；在三个BBOB保留景观上均降低基线LLM遗憾。该文本提升所有测试的Gemini执行器，并迁移至Claude Sonnet（43%与49%，p≤.005）。独立端到端复制产生不同程序和文本的Harness B（205词），在四个新鲜景观上均改善基线LLM（Holm校正后p≤.007）。同一框架在密封YouTube奖励调优生产基准上各预算检查点均获最低遗憾点估计（如20次评估时0.0495对比Google Vizier 0.0894、标准GP-BO 0.1410）。
AI.conclusion: 可执行练习是发现可测试搜索策略的有效途径，一次性蒸馏使其可移植，冻结则保持评估可解释性。跨模型、跨目标、跨独立运行的产物各异，但核心结果一致：在稀缺评估预算下实现有竞争力的搜索。文本harness并非与执行器无关的算法，而是由特定模型解释的策略。

title: Unthrottling the Tanh Jacobian in SAC: A Negative Result on Bang-Bang Control and MetaDrive
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Technical report. Negative result. Code: this https URL
summary: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) represents a continuous policy as an unbounded Gaussian that is squashed by tanh. The Jacobian of that map is $\partial a/\partial u = 1-a^2$, which vanishes as $|a|\to 1$. A natural concern is that this throttle starves the actor of critic signal exactly where extreme actions (full brake, full throttle) are optimal. We test a minimal intervention that restores the missing signal: one extra term in the actor loss whose gradient on the pre-tanh mean is the detached action-gradient of $Q$, with no gain parameter. On a minimum-time double integrator whose optimum is bang-bang at the action bounds, vanilla SAC already reaches near-optimal return ($-31.6$ vs. a calibrated optimum of $-30.3$) across ten paired seeds. An ungated bypass does saturate the policy (99% of eval steps with $|a|\ge 0.9$) and collapses return to $-195.5$. A gated bypass that fires only on the flat shoulder $|a|\in[0.9,0.999]$ also fails, and does so without leaving a saturated policy. Warm-started MetaDrive fine-tuning shows the same pattern: the bypass does not improve return, and where collision rate falls it is typically traded for out-of-road departures. Auto-tuned entropy coefficient rises against the bypass, which is a push toward the tails. The Jacobian effect is real. Treating it as a bug to be undone is not free, and on the tasks studied here it is not helpful. Saturating a bound is not the same as solving a problem whose optimum lives on that bound.

AI.tldr: 本文针对SAC算法中tanh squash函数在动作边界处Jacobian趋零导致critic信号衰减的问题，提出了一种最小干预方案（梯度旁路），并在最小时间双积分器bang-bang控制任务和MetaDrive自动驾驶微调任务上进行了测试。实验结果为负面：vanilla SAC在玩具任务上已接近最优；无门控旁路导致策略饱和在边界但丧失切换能力；有门控旁路同样失败但未产生饱和策略；MetaDrive上旁路未带来回报提升，仅在α=0的特殊设置下出现局部优势。
AI.motivation: SAC中tanh映射的Jacobian ∂a/∂u = 1−a²在|a|→1时趋于零，使得critic梯度在最优动作恰好处于边界（如全力刹车、全油门）的任务中被严重衰减。这引发一个自然担忧：策略可能因tanh的"节流"效应而无法到达动作边界。本文旨在检验这一假设，并测试一种最小修复方案——在actor损失中直接注入未被衰减的Q对a的梯度。
AI.method: 方法是在标准SAC actor损失上添加一个"梯度旁路"项：∂L_bypass/∂u_d = −m_d·w_d，其中w = ∇_a Q_min在当前a处取值且从critic计算图中detach，m是每维可选的掩码。本文设计两种掩码：(1) 无门控m≡1，忠实执行几何修复；(2) 有门控，仅当|a|∈[0.9, 0.999]时触发m_d=1；MetaDrive上额外乘以在失败窗口中写入的blame比特。评估环境为最小时间双积分器（bang-bang最优解在±1）和MetaDrive自动驾驶模拟器（从密度0.1预训练checkpoint热启动，在密度0.1/0.3上微调）。使用10对配对种子和Stable-Baselines3 SAC实现。
AI.result: 玩具任务：vanilla SAC最终回报−31.6（vs. 无cap基准−30.3，c=0.9参考−31.5），p95(|a|)=0.97。无门控旁路将饱和率从0.32提升至0.99，回报崩溃至−195.5，到达率仅2%。有门控旁路回报−108.6，到达率58%，饱和率反而降至0.05。两者均无法在40k步内达到−35阈值（baseline均可达）。MetaDrive：在entropy-on/off和frozen-α四种设置下，旁路均未产生一致的回报增益；碰撞率下降时通常伴随驶离道路率上升；唯一局部正面的单元是α=0的单种子设置，但该设置也削弱了baseline。
AI.conclusion: Jacobian效应确实存在，但将其视为需要修复的"缺陷"是有代价的——它改变了SAC的一阶条件，使训练目标从标准SAC偏移。在bang-bang控制问题上，真正的难点是符号切换而非首次接触边界，旁路项的持续边界推力反而阻碍切换。更合理的方向是改变动作边界表示本身（如Beta策略），而非在不变squash中重新注入已消失的Jacobian。这是关于特定干预的负面结果，而非对tanh作为边界处理器的整体判断。

title: Efficient Fairness Auditing Across Guidance Scales in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Causal Abstraction
summary: Fairness auditing of text-to-image diffusion models often requires generating large numbers of images across sampling configurations, making comprehensive evaluation computationally expensive. We propose a causal-abstraction-based audit instrument for efficiently evaluating fairness under interventions on the classifier-free guidance scale. Given a fixed prompt and a target feature function, we represent the diffusion process as a low-level structural causal model and construct a corresponding high-level model over abstract denoising states. We characterize the projected causal structure, establish identifiability of the fairness-relevant interventional query, and provide sufficient conditions under which the high-level model preserves this query. A probabilistic transformer implements the high-level model as an amortized predictor of target-feature distributions across guidance scales. Experiments evaluate distributional fidelity, fairness-query accuracy, and computational efficiency. We present two auditing demonstrations: one using standard Stable Diffusion 1.5 and another using StayFair, a fairness-enhanced Stable Diffusion model, to examine their behavior across guidance scales.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于因果抽象（causal abstraction）的高效公平性审计工具，用于评估文到图扩散模型在不同分类器无关引导（CFG）尺度下的公平性。通过将扩散过程抽象为低层SCM并构造对应的高层模型，结合Transformer神经因果模型实现摊销推断，在标准SD1.5和StayFair上验证了19.4倍的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 文到图扩散模型在不同CFG尺度下表现出的人口统计偏见差异显著，但传统公平性审计需要对每个prompt、引导尺度和随机种子运行完整的扩散过程，计算开销巨大。需要一种高效方法在避免重复完整推理的前提下评估公平性。
AI.method: 1) 将扩散过程建模为低层SCM，将中间扩散状态映射为低维语义属性；2) 构造高层SCM，通过部分投影C-DAG处理抽象导致的AIC违反；3) 建立查询特定的因果抽象一致性条件（Q-τ一致性），证明审计查询的可识别性；4) 使用滑动窗口因果Transformer作为神经因果模型，以负对数似然训练，自回归预测目标特征分布；5) 基于Hoeffding不等式构造置信区间进行审计判定。
AI.result: 在三个性别中性prompt（lawyer、librarian、scientist）上，以8个未见CFG尺度（2-20）评估：Wasserstein距离范围0.010-0.093，75%的配置满足R≤1（高低层差异不超过bootstrap参考）；推理速度提升19.4倍（5.035s→0.259s）；StayFair在lawyer prompt上将偏见从[0.367,0.468]降至[0.162,0.263]，但在librarian上改善有限。实证证实抽象映射存在AIC违反。
AI.conclusion: 因果抽象框架可作为有效的审计工具，在保持审计决策保真度的同时大幅降低计算成本。关键贡献包括：(1) 针对视觉生成模型的查询特定因果抽象方法；(2) 即使存在抽象损失和图结构差异，仍能保证审计查询正确性的形式化论证；(3) 在标准和公平性增强扩散模型上的实际应用演示。

title: Robust Industrial Cyber Physical Classification Using Neuromorphic Temporal Embeddings and Hybrid SNN XGBoost Under Machine Unlearning Attacks
summary: The digitalisation of electrical distribution networks has increased the exposure of power-grid infrastructure to cyber attacks. Existing intrusion detection systems (IDSs), however, often rely on computationally expensive deep learning models that are difficult to deploy at the edge. Periodic retraining also exposes these systems to machine unlearning attacks, where selective data removal can degrade detection performance. We propose a hybrid Spiking Neural Network (SNN) and XGBoost architecture that combines efficient temporal encoding with a lightweight classifier and provides structural resilience to such attacks. The SNN is trained once on clean data and used as a fixed feature extractor, while only the XGBoost classifier is retrained during model updates. Evaluated on two real-world public power-system datasets, the proposed method achieves 99.9\% accuracy (F1-macro 0.999) on the Synchrophasor dataset and 95.0\% accuracy (F1-macro 0.943) on the MSU/ORNL dataset, outperforming standalone baselines. Under selective label-flipping attacks, the hybrid model loses only 0.9\% F1-macro at 10\% poisoning and delays target-class collapse from 60\% to 70\% poisoning compared with raw models. These results demonstrate that neuromorphic temporal encoding can provide both accurate cyber-attack detection and improved resilience to data poisoning in cyber-physical systems.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于电网入侵检测的混合 SNN+XGBoost 架构,通过冻结的脉冲神经网络作为物理特征提取器与周期性重训练的 XGBoost 分类器分离,在机器遗忘攻击(标签翻转)下展现出结构化鲁棒性,在两个公开电力系统数据集上取得最优准确率,并将目标类别崩溃延迟 10 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 电力配电网的数字化使其面临日益严峻的网络攻击威胁。现有入侵检测系统(IDS)依赖计算昂贵的深度学习模型,难以在边缘部署;此外,周期性重训练会暴露于机器遗忘攻击(machine unlearning attacks),即通过选择性数据篡改降低检测性能。传统深度学习模型对训练时标签投毒缺乏结构性防御能力。
AI.method: 两阶段混合架构:(1) Stage 1 — Direct-SNN 特征提取器:采用 [256,128,64] 三层 LIF(Leaky Integrate-and-Fire)神经元(β=0.85, U_thr=1.0),跳过脉冲编码直接注入连续输入电流,通过代理梯度 BPTT(surrogate gradient, k=25)训练,使用滑动窗口(T=15)在 PMU 时序数据上生成 1350 维膜电位时间嵌入(max/mean/last 拼接);训练完成后冻结并用 SHA-256 签名部署。预处理包括 Min-Max 归一化、互信息特征选择(MSU/ORNL 从 128 维降至 50 维)。 (2) Stage 2 — XGBoost 分类器(300 轮,深度 10, LR=0.1)在冻结的 1350 维嵌入上周期性重训练,承受潜在投毒标签。鲁棒性来源:物理信号聚类(膜电势动力学反映信号物理特性)、标签无关特征提取、嵌入空间的结构化几何。
AI.result: 在 Synchrophasor 数据集(218,459 样本,9 特征)上取得 99.9% 准确率(F1-macro=0.999, MCC=0.998);在 MSU/ORNL 数据集(78,377 样本,128→50 特征)上取得 95.0% 准确率(F1-macro=0.943, MCC=0.885),均优于 7 个基线(MLP、LSTM、1D-CNN、GNN、RF、XGBoost、Rule-Based)。在机器遗忘攻击下(目标:Attack 类,投毒率 0-90%):10% 投毒时 F1-macro 仅下降 0.9%,目标类 F1 保持 0.954;目标类崩溃阈值(F1<0.5)从原始模型的 60% 延迟至 70%。消融研究证明直接注入(无脉冲编码)较 5 种传统编码方案提升 +22.94%。推理延迟 0.45 ms/样本,在 30 Hz PMU 速率下达约 74× 实时。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了神经形态时间编码作为关键基础设施 IDS 中对抗训练数据篡改的纵深防御策略。通过结构性地分离物理特征提取与分类器适配,证明了 SNN 膜电势动力学编码的物理信号结构对标签腐败具有不变性。未来方向:对自适应对手的评估、与显式标签清洗技术的结合、Intel Loihi 2 神经形态硬件部署验证。

title: Positional task conditioning for scalable defect detection across product families in large product catalogs
summary: Product families in large product catalogs suffer from inconsistencies such as duplicates and unit mismatches that degrade customer experience. Detecting these requires reasoning over multiple error types across lengthy product listings, where LLM classification quality degrades due to long-context limitations. We address this by decomposing detection into focused sub-tasks that reduce context and isolate error types, improving F1 from 52\% to 87\%. For scalable deployment, we introduce Positional Task Conditioning (PTC), which distills this capability into a single smaller model by reinforcing task identity at structural prompt boundaries. PTC outperforms rationale-based distillation across five models and two architecture families, achieving within 1.79\% F1 of the frontier at upto 98\% lower cost. Our system is deployed across multiple countries processing 10+ million product families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分而治之（D&C）框架将产品族多标签不一致检测分解为4个三分类子任务，使前沿LLM的F1从52%提升至87%；进一步提出位置任务条件化（PTC）蒸馏方法，在提示的结构性边界处插入任务标识符，使单一小型模型在5个LLM上一致优于推理链蒸馏（RBD），以高达98%的成本降低达到前沿模型F1的1.79%以内。系统已部署处理超过1000万产品族。
AI.motivation: 大型产品目录中产品族存在多种不一致缺陷（重复变体、单位冲突、属性过度填充、主题缺陷），但LLM在长上下文多任务推理中性能下降，且前沿模型部署成本过高，需要一种既能提升精度又能降低成本的检测方法。
AI.method: 1）将8种错误类型分组成4个语义相关的子任务（每任务三分类：egregious/non-egregious/no error），实现分而治之；2）提出位置任务条件化（PTC），在提示的三个结构性边界（提示前、输入数据前、输出规范后）插入任务标识符，训练单一学生模型处理多任务；3）设计合成数据注入管线，通过注入规划器避免跨错误干扰。
AI.result: D&C使Claude Sonnet 4.5的F1从52.14%提升至87.62%（精度提升54%）；PTC在5个LLM（Qwen3 8B/14B/32B、Mistral Nemo 12B、Mistral Small 24B）上一致优于RBD，F1提升1.53%-6.30%；Qwen3 8B PTC达84.23% F1，与前沿模型差距仅1.79%；推理成本降低98%（$63降至$1.17）；在4/5模型上PTC对RBD的改进具有统计显著性（p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: PTC是一种有效的多任务蒸馏方法，通过显式的位置性任务条件化解决RBD在长上下文中任务身份衰减的问题，使小模型在显著降低成本的同时达到接近前沿LLM的性能水平，适合大规模工业部署，未来可扩展至属性提取、实体匹配等任务。

title: PELM: Power Efficient On-Device LLM Inference with Speculative Decoding and Dynamic Voltage Frequency Scaling
summary: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) directly on mobile platforms at the edge is gaining traction due to a myriad of benefits, such as increased privacy, personalization, and reduced latency. However, LLMs have heavy computational requirements, which are difficult for resource-constrained mobile and edge platforms to fulfill. In addition to limited compute resources, mobile and edge systems often have a compact form factor and lack physical mechanisms to dissipate heat generated from high processor usage rates (e.g., fans) to prevent throttling and reduced processing power, which LLMs can easily cause. To mitigate these effects, prior works have proposed various power governing strategies, such as dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS), for reducing power and heat generation for heavy computational tasks on mobile platforms. Recently, DVFS methods tailored for mobile LLMs have also been proposed. However, these methods mostly focus on optimizing hardware parameters and processor frequencies, and they fall short under some thermally constrained scenarios. Drawing from recent advances in machine learning, we identify and take advantage of the key insight that not all tokens require full-depth inference to maintain high-quality generation. Motivated by this, we present PELM, a solution that augments traditional DVFS processor frequency tuning with two additional workload-specific knobs: 1) speculative decoding and 2) variable verification depth to expand the optimization space to multiple dimensions for more power efficient on-device LLM inference. In extensive evaluations across hardware platforms and datasets, PELM demonstrates superior performance compared to state-of-the-art power governing methods, with up to 23.1% speedup and 52.4% reduction in energy consumption, while maintaining comparable task performance. The source code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PELM 提出了一种面向移动/边缘设备上 LLM 推理的节能框架，将传统 DVFS 频率调节与自推测解码（self-speculative decoding）和可变验证深度（variable verification depth）相结合，通过深度强化学习（branch-DQN）联合优化三个维度的控制旋钮，在保持任务质量的同时显著降低能耗。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备部署 LLM 受限于算力和紧凑形态带来的散热难题。传统 DVFS 仅调节硬件频率，面临"降频省电则降速、升频提速则过热"的本质矛盾，且在热受限场景下表现不足。本文核心洞察是：并非所有 token 都需要全深度推理，中间层输出仍保留可用信息，从而为功耗管理开辟了新的优化空间。
AI.method: 1) 问题建模：将 DVFS 频率 f、自推测解码退出层 ex、推测长度 ns、验证深度 vd 联合建模为多目标优化问题（最小化功耗与时间、最大化输出保真度与推测加速比），并加入温度和 QoE 约束。2) 求解方法：转化为 Q-learning 问题，采用 branch-DQN 分支网络架构处理高维动作空间（CPU 最多 29 档、GPU 11 档频率 + 解码参数），设计包含速度奖励、变深奖励、热惩罚、利用率-频率匹配惩罚和功耗惩罚的复合奖励函数。3) 知识引导的 ε-greedy 探索策略借鉴 AIMD 拥塞控制思想。4) HQCache（Hidden Queue Cache）机制缓存中间层隐藏状态，避免变深验证时的 KV-cache 重算开销。5) 基于 LayerSkip 预训练模型实现早期退出能力。
AI.result: 在 Jetson AGX Orin 与 Orin Nano 两类平台上，测试 LLaMA-3.2-1B/3.1-8B/2-13B 三种规模模型、5 个数据集（GSM8K、NQ-open、HumanEval、WMT14、CNN/DailyMail）、4 种散热条件。PELM 相比现有 SOTA 功耗管理方法（BLTN、STSD、FUSE、zTT），最多实现 23.1% 加速、52.4% 能耗降低，任务质量（TSA）最大下降不超过 17.2%。在极端热约束（13B 最小散热）下，查询完成率比最佳基线高 32.4%。消融实验证实三个组件（DVFS/VD/SSD）均不可或缺，且系统开销极低（DQN 参数量仅 5,687，决策耗时 <1 ms）。
AI.conclusion: PELM 通过跨层协同设计打破了硬件频率调节与算法加速之间的隔阂，开辟了面向 LLM 推理的"功耗-性能-质量"多维优化空间。其基于 DRL 的闭环控制器展现出对不同负载强度、热条件和查询局部性的强鲁棒性。未来工作将拓展至量化模型、异构 SoC（CPU/GPU/NPU）、任务感知控制以及多租户边缘环境。

title: Muon-C: Operator-Aligned Muon for Convolutional Kernels
summary: Muon replaces matrix momentum with an approximately orthogonal polar direction, but its geometry depends on the matrix representation. For convolution, standard unfolding describes a local patch map rather than the convolution operator. We introduce Muon-C, an operator-aligned optimizer that represents kernel momentum as frequency-wise channel-transfer matrices, polarizes these blocks independently, and uses a critical Fourier grid to return updates exactly to the original finite kernel support. We show that the new geometry arises from combining the block partition and Fourier coordinates. The exact-polar direction is a linear minimization oracle under the critically sampled convolution norm.
