Its worst-case guarantee relative to the continuous convolution-operator norm is never weaker than unfolding and is strictly stronger for $3\times3$ kernels. On CIFAR-10 flow matching with matched applied-update RMS, Muon-C reaches 9.87 FID at 40k iterations, compared with 22.26 for unfolded Muon and 51.31 for Adam. It reaches their final quality using $0.62\times$ and $0.64\times$ their model FLOPs, respectively. Under equal tuning budgets, Muon-C achieves 3.42 FID. Gains persist across data scales and transfer to classification across convolutional architectures.

AI.tldr: Muon-C 提出了一种算子对齐的卷积核优化器，通过将卷积核动量表示为频率域通道传递矩阵并独立极化各频率块，替代了传统的局部块展开方法。在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet 上显著优于展开 Muon 和 Adam，仅需 62%-64% 的模型 FLOPs 即可达到基线最终质量。
AI.motivation: 标准 Muon 优化器在处理卷积核时采用空间块展开（unfolding）方式，但该方法对应的是局部块到输出的映射，而非卷积算子本身。算子的几何结构未被正确对齐，导致优化效率次优。卷积在现代深度学习（U-Net、ResNet、ConvNeXt 等）中仍占据核心地位，因此需要为卷积核设计算子对齐的优化器几何。
AI.method: 1. 傅里叶/算子对齐：将核动量沿空间轴变换为频率索引的通道传递矩阵，与卷积在平移模式上的自然线性映射一致。2. 独立分块极化：在每个临界频率上独立执行极化操作，而非对整个展开矩阵做单一极化——这是改变几何的关键，分块划分决定了谱范数信任域。3. 临界频率采样：使用与核大小完全一致的 k_h × k_w 傅里叶网格，使得独立分块更新能精确映射回原始有限核支撑，无需裁剪。理论上证明 Muon-C 是临界采样卷积范数下的精确线性最小化预言机，且相对于连续卷积算子范数的最坏情况保证不弱于全局展开方法，对 3×3 卷积核严格更强（保证因子 9/25 vs 1/3）。
AI.result: CIFAR-10 流匹配（匹配应用更新 RMS）：40k 步达到 9.87 FID（展开 Muon 为 22.26，Adam 为 51.31）；400k 步达到 3.47 FID（优于展开 Muon 的 3.83 和 Adam 的 3.81）。仅需基线 0.62× 和 0.64× 的模型 FLOPs 即可达到其最终质量。在 CIFAR-10 上达到 FID 4.0 的训练时间减少 14.3%-26.8%。ImageNet-1k-32：21.14 FID@40k（vs 展开 Muon 的 28.02）。ImageNet-100 分类（ResNet-34/50、ConvNeXtV2-T）均取得最高验证准确率。匹配的空间块消融（Muon-S）证明频率组织优于空间偏移块组织。局部几何分析显示 Muon-C 降低方向曲率，允许更大的有效步长。
AI.conclusion: Muon-C 为卷积核的优化器几何提供了一个系统化的设计原则：优化器应作用于反映底层算子自然线性映射的矩阵上，而非任意的张量展开。平移等变性自然地将卷积算子对角化为频率域通道传递矩阵，临界傅里叶网格使得独立的频率块极化与有限核支撑兼容。Muon-C 显著且一致地改进了生成和判别学习中的优化效率，收益在不同数据规模、不同调参预算、不同架构（卷积路由覆盖率从 6.7% 到 98.9%）间持续存在。算子对齐的观点为将 Muon 推广到其他结构化参数提供了路径。

title: Settling: Equilibrium Inference for Non-Convex Validity Sets
summary: Many learning systems return a single point estimate even when admissible outputs form disconnected or non-convex sets. Under squared loss, an ambiguous conditional distribution can therefore have a Bayes-optimal conditional mean that is invalid. We formalize this failure as conditional mean collapse and introduce Settling, an equilibrium-based inference operator that separates proposal generation, consistency evaluation, and test-time equilibrium selection. The operator treats a mean-seeking proposal as an initialization and refines it toward a locally stable configuration; conditional on initialization, refinement is deterministic. We establish exact-gradient descent, local convergence, and an inexact-gradient robustness condition relevant to learned consistency critics. In a reproducible 100-context geometric diagnostic, the mean-seeking baseline succeeds in 0/100 contexts, stochastic denoising in 100/100, and Settling in 99/100 while producing substantially lower trajectory roughness. A 1,200-run sensitivity study yields 97-100% success across obstacle-jitter ranges up to 0.20 and 94-100% across one-time initialization perturbations from 0.05 to 0.50. Cross-domain panels remain mechanism illustrations; learned high-dimensional validation remains an open empirical test.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Settling"框架，用于解决非凸有效性集合下条件均值坍缩的问题。核心思想是将推理从单步均值估计重构为基于一致性势能景观的均衡选择过程。
AI.motivation: 当有效输出构成不相交或非凸集合时，平方损失下的贝叶斯最优条件均值可能落在无效区域（条件均值坍缩）。作者将这种失败形式化，并指出Transformer中的凸聚合机制在受限设置下可能产生无效输出。
AI.method: Settling将推理分解为三个模块：(1) 提案网络生成均值的初始化假设；(2) 一致性能量函数定义非凸有效集；(3) 迭代梯度下降动力学将状态推向局部稳定均衡。理论分析包括：单调一致性改进引理（Lemma 2）、非精确梯度鲁棒性引理（Lemma 3）、局部收敛定理（Theorem 4）以及确定性均衡选择性质。
AI.result: 在100个随机障碍上下文的几何诊断中，均值基线成功率为0/100，随机去噪为100/100，Settling为99/100且轨迹粗糙度更低。1200次灵敏度扫描显示在障碍抖动≤0.20时成功率为97-100%，初始化扰动0.05-0.50时为94-100%。语义和传感器融合面板仅为机制演示，未提供量化跨域主张。
AI.conclusion: 论文正式建立了条件均值坍缩作为平方损失点推理的失败模式，并证明Settling作为均衡选择算子能在非凸有效集中恢复有效解。贡献在于推理级别的分解，而非梯度下降或固定点计算本身。作者明确将学习的高维部署作为开放经验问题，未来工作需验证习得提议和一致性评论器能否在实际数据上保持有用的盆地形和梯度对齐。

title: ALIGN-HOLD: Experience Alignment for Real-Time Hold Control in Large-Scale Ride-Hailing Matching at DiDi
summary: Real-time hold control is a high-leverage mechanism in large-scale ride-hailing systems: by selectively deferring driver-order pairs, the platform can wait for better matching opportunities and improve end-to-end passenger-driver experience. Existing production systems such as EXHOLD learn bandit-based hold policies from handcrafted combinations of trip completion, cancellations, waiting time, and driver effort. However, designing such rewards becomes increasingly difficult as marketplace preferences are heterogeneous and observed passenger-driver behavior can be sparse, noisy, and affected by dynamic supply-demand conditions. We present ALIGN-HOLD, a production-scale experience alignment framework that learns hold policy from implicit marketplace preferences. ALIGN-HOLD constructs complementary preference pairs from order trajectories, driver trajectories, and contemporaneous local matching graphs, and trains an experience Reward Model (RM) using balanced multi-view sampling and model-adaptive hard preference sampling. During simulator-based policy learning, the frozen RM provides a dense, context-dependent reward and supports label-free filtering of low-identifiability interactions whose behavioral feedback is difficult to attribute to matching quality. We deploy ALIGN-HOLD on DiDi's ride-hailing platform and evaluate it in a 28-day randomized A/B experiment, covering approximately 100,000 passenger requests per day. Compared with the deployed production policy, ALIGN-HOLD achieves statistically significant improvements in trip completion rate and driver income, while significantly reducing passenger cancellations before and after driver acceptance. Complementary ablations, RM diagnostics, and behavioral analyses validate the contributions of the proposed components. ALIGN-HOLD has been fully ramped up and is currently serving DiDi's Brazil marketplace.

AI.tldr: ALIGN-HOLD 是滴滴出行部署在生产环境中的实时"挂起控制"(hold control)框架，通过从市场隐式行为中学习经验对齐信号，替代传统手工设计的奖励函数。该系统基于多视角偏好构建、Bradley-Terry 奖励模型和低可辨识性过滤，在巴西市场每日约10万单的28天A/B实验中显著提升了订单完成率、司机收入并降低了乘客取消率。
AI.motivation: 传统网约车平台的实时挂起控制（如滴滴已部署的 EXHOLD）依赖人工组合的奖励函数（如行程完成率、取消率、等待时间、司机努力等）。随着市场偏好异质化、行为反馈稀疏且受供需动态影响，手工设计奖励难以扩展且无法捕捉潜在的市场体验目标。本文旨在从"经验感知奖励工程"转向"经验对齐"，直接从大规模市场行为中学习优化目标。
AI.method:
1. **多视角偏好构建**：从订单轨迹（同一订单成功 vs 未完成交互）、司机轨迹（同一司机 1小时内窗口内交互）和市场上下文（同一或相邻局部匹配图的边）三个互补视角构建隐式偏好对，将完成（TC）视为偏好侧。

2. **经验奖励模型（RM）**：采用 MLP-Transformer 打分器，使用 Bradley-Terry 损失进行训练。训练时 80% mini-batch 按 1:1:1 比例从三视角采样，20% 采用模型自适应困难偏好采样（从全局成对损失的 70-90 百分位采样）。

3. **RM 引导的策略对齐**：冻结 RM 后提供密集上下文相关奖励；通过动态检测每个训练切片中 RM 分数直方图的"高密度带"（半峰宽、突出度≥3、分数质量≥0.2%）过滤低可辨识性交互，仅用保留的交互更新 Transformer-LinUCB 上下文赌博机策略。

4. **执行层**：保留 EXHOLD 的护栏约束分层时间表，将学习到的 4 级经验等级映射为单调递增的挂起时长。
AI.result:
在滴滴巴西市场 28 天随机 A/B 实验（约 10万单/天，5个城市）中，相比已部署的 EXHOLD 基线：
- **订单完成率（TC）**：+0.57%（p=0.00011）
- **司机收入（DI）**：+0.64%（p=0.00906）
- **司机接单率（DA）**：+0.51%（p=0.00260）
- **乘客接单前取消（PCBA）**：-1.85%（p=0.00172）
- **乘客接单后取消（PCAA）**：-2.07%（p=0.00598）
- 接受/广播比 +1.41%，接受/呼叫比 +1.26%
- 整体挂起率仅变化 +0.04%（非全局激进干预）

**跨城市与时段一致性**：5 个城市均方向一致；高峰时段增益更大（TC +0.78%）。

**消融实验**：
- 去除多视角（仅订单中心）：TC +0.25%, DI +0.16%
- 去除模型自适应困难采样：TC +0.10%, DI -0.26%
- 去除低可辨识性过滤：TC +0.17%, DI -0.37%
- 完整方法表现最优

**RM 验证**：配对准确率 0.845，宏 AUC 0.852；三视角组合优于任一单视角（单视角最高 0.792）。

**行为分析**：ALIGN-HOLD 增加了对长接驾、长等待、低历史接受率队列的挂起，减少了对有利队列的挂起，且在高峰与稀疏市场更保守/积极地调整策略。该系统已完全 ramp up 并在滴滴巴西市场服务生产流量。
AI.conclusion: ALIGN-HOLD 将工业级网约车挂起控制从手工奖励工程推进到基于隐式市场行为偏好的经验对齐范式。其核心贡献包括：多视角隐式偏好构建、模型自适应困难偏好采样、基于分数分布的标签无关低可辨识性反馈过滤。大规模在线实验验证了其在不增加整体挂起强度的前提下，通过更精确的挂起决策分配提升了乘客-司机体验和市场效率，为大规模市场策略与异质体验对齐提供了实践方案。

title: EFQ-Softmax: Exp-Free Quantization for Softmax
summary: Low-bit attention accelerates Transformer inference by moving the $QK^\top$ and $PV$ matrix multiplications to FP8 or FP4 matrix engines. However, the softmax path often evaluates shifted-score exponentials in higher precision, forms a temporary probability block, and quantizes it before low-bit $PV$ multiplication. This exp-then-quantize path creates a mismatch between a high-precision probability producer and a low-bit matrix consumer. We propose EFQ-Softmax (Exp-Free Quantization for Softmax), a low-bit probability-generation method that directly maps shifted attention scores to block-scaled E2M1 operands. For each microscaling block, EFQ-Softmax selects an exponent-only scale from the local maximum, maps the shifted scores to a normalized residual domain, and generates nonnegative E2M1 probability codes using a single affine rule. The resulting operand is used consistently in both the $\widetilde{P}V$ numerator update and the $\widetilde{P}\mathbf{1}$ denominator update. The FlashAttention-style row-maximum update, historical rescaling, high-precision accumulation, and final normalization remain unchanged. We evaluate end-to-end quality on Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, and WAN2.2-TI2V-5B, and separately measure kernel-level performance on the A5 vector unit. EFQ-Softmax improves the Qwen3-8B seven-task mean from 0.6749 with MXFP4 to 0.6773 and the Qwen3-VL nine-task mean from 0.7826 to 0.8000. On WAN2.2, it maintains temporal consistency and visual quality comparable to the FP16 and MXFP4 baselines under VBench. On the A5 vector unit, EFQ-Softmax reduces the vector-stage latency of the fused probability-generation kernel by 40.33% on average across sequence lengths from 16K to 128K. These results show that direct low-bit probability generation can replace the conventional exp-then-quantize path while preserving end-to-end model quality.

AI.tldr: EFQ-Softmax 是一种无需显式指数运算的低比特 Softmax 概率生成方法，可将移位注意力分数直接映射为块缩放 E2M1 (MXFP4) 操作数，与 FlashAttention 在线递推完全兼容，可在保持模型质量的同时显著加速向量单元计算。
AI.motivation: 在 FP4/FP8 低比特注意力推理中，QK⊤ 和 PV 矩阵乘法已迁移至低比特引擎，但 Softmax 概率生成路径仍采用"先计算高精度 exp、再量化"的传统流程。这种高精度概率生成器与低比特矩阵消费者之间存在精度与效率的不匹配，且随着矩阵乘法加速，概率生成所占的注意力执行时间比例越来越大，成为瓶颈。
AI.method: EFQ-Softmax 将当前块的逐元素 exp 运算与后续 MXFP4 量化融合为直接映射流程：(1) 对每个微缩放块根据局部最大值选择仅指数形式的尺度 2^k_b；(2) 将移位分数映射到尺度归一化的残差对数域 z_t = x_t - k_b·log2 - log6；(3) 通过单一仿射规则 c_t = clip(⌊(z_t - τ)h⌋ + 1) 直接生成非负 E2M1 4 位概率码。该操作数同时被 PV 分子更新和 P·1 分母更新共享使用，行最大值更新、历史重缩放、高精度累加和最终归一化保持不变。(τ, h) 通过离线校准最小化注意力输出误差来选取。论文还提出 EFQ-Softmax-LUT 变体（16 级中间索引再折叠为 8 码）作为精度对比消融。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-8B 上 7 任务均值从 MXFP4 的 0.6749 提升至 0.6773（EFQ-Softmax-Mean），LUT 变体达 0.6784；在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上 9 任务均值从 0.7826 提升至 0.8000，6 个指代表达定位 split 全部提升；在 WAN2.2-TI2V-5B 文生视频任务中，VBench 各维度（主体一致性、背景一致性、时序闪烁、运动平滑度、成像质量等）与 FP16/MXFP4 基线相当，imagin质量甚至达到最高 0.7178；在 A5 向量单元上，融合概率生成核向量阶段延迟平均降低 40.33%（16K–128K 序列长度范围）。
AI.conclusion: EFQ-Softmax 证明了直接低比特概率码生成可以替代传统的"exp-然后-量化"路径，在保持 FlashAttention 在线递推不变的前提下，既能维持端到端模型质量，又能显著加速概率生成环节，为全低比特注意力核提供了一条实用路径。

title: EEGBind: Detecting Source-Level Interictal Epileptiform Discharges via EEG-Centric Multimodal Binding
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26)
summary: Source-level analysis of interictal epileptiform discharges (IEDs) is relevant to presurgical evaluation and treatment planning because it helps characterize where epileptiform activity is likely to arise. Beyond detecting whether an IED is present, this setting requires assigning IED-positive activity to clinically meaningful brain-region categories. This setting is challenging because source-region evidence in short electroencephalography (EEG) windows can be subtle, partial, and affected by subject variability, class imbalance, and imperfect multimodal context. We present EEGBind, an EEG-centric multimodal binding framework for five-class source-level IED classification. EEGBind treats EEG as the primary modality and binds synchronized video-context features around an EEG-centric representation. Instead of relying on early or overly strong multimodal fusion, which may perturb the source-sensitive EEG representation, EEGBind uses video context as auxiliary evidence for robust classification. A view-consistent repair stage is further used to improve hidden-set robustness while preserving the learned source-class boundary. On the NeuroMM 2026 Grand Challenge Track 3 NMM-Source-IED benchmark, EEGBind achieves 0.8395 on weighted-F1 and outperforms strong competitors. These results support EEG-centric multimodal binding as a practical strategy for source-level IED classification. The open-source code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: EEGBind 是面向源级间期癫痫样放电（IED）五分类任务的 EEG 中心多模态绑定框架，通过以 EEG 为锚点绑定同步视频上下文特征，并结合无交叉熵的视图一致性修复阶段，在 NeuroMM 2026 Track 3 基准上以 0.8395 加权 F1 取得第一名。
AI.motivation: 源级 IED 分析对术前评估和治疗规划具有临床价值，但短时窗 EEG 中源区证据微弱且受被试差异、类别不平衡影响；通用多模态融合易扰乱源敏感的 EEG 表示。需要一种以 EEG 为中心、视频为辅助上下文的绑定策略，以在利用多模态信息的同时保留源判别结构。
AI.method: 1) EEG 中心绑定：以 ST-EEGFormer-large 为 EEG 主干，七路同步视频特征经线性投影后，通过双层 8 头注意力探针与 EEG 表征融合，产生五类源区 logits；2) CE-free 视图一致性修复：冻结 EEG 编码器与分类头，对视频路由施加 Bernoulli dropout（p=0.15，至少保留 3 路）和路由掩码（至少保留 5 路），以 KL 视图一致性、余弦特征目标、掩码路由预测和队列对比损失优化视频投影与融合模块；3) 受试者不相交五折对数概率平均集成。
AI.result: 在官方隐藏集评估中，EEG-only 基线 0.6444，注意力探针基线 0.8019，单模型修复后 0.8395 提升至 0.8282，五折集成达到 0.8395 加权 F1 排名第一；消融实验显示修复各组件均有贡献；post-evaluation 控制实验中零视频推理和虚拟视频训练分别降至 0.7460 和 0.7448，证明增益来自有意义的视频上下文绑定而非模型容量。
AI.conclusion: EEGBind 通过 EEG 中心绑定、CE-free 视图一致性修复和受试者不相交五折集成的组合，为源级 IED 分类提供了实用策略；多模态上下文应以受控方式利用，不应扰乱源敏感的 EEG 决策边界。

title: NEXUS-MI: Communication-Aware Federated Personalization for Gateway-Coordinated Motor-Imagery Brain-Computer Interfaces
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based motor-imagery brain-computer interfaces (MI-BCIs) vary across subjects and sessions, complicating personalization from limited calibration data. Federated learning can exploit shared representations without centralizing raw EEG, but existing federated MI studies largely assume regular synchronization. We introduce NEXUS-MI, a gateway-coordinated federated personalization framework that treats synchronization as a coupled learning-and-communication control problem. Raw EEG and classifier heads remain local, while an edge coordinator maintains the shared backbone. We evaluate NEXUS-MI through offline replay using BCI Competition IV Dataset 2a (BCICIV-2a; 9 subjects, 4 classes) and OpenBMI (54 subjects, 2 classes). Session 1 supports backbone learning, and Session 2 provides limited-calibration personalization and held-out testing. An ideal-link reference and six heterogeneous-link policies characterize gateway participation, buffering, stale-update admission, and backbone-download control. The principal comparison holds delayed-update handling fixed while contrasting non-adaptive and communication-aware synchronization. Paired subject-level comparisons use Holm adjustment, and robustness across five matched realizations is assessed by hierarchical bootstrap. Communication-aware coordination reduced server-to-client backbone traffic by approximately 42% on both datasets, while cohort-level accuracy differences were small and realization-dependent. Cohort averages also concealed subject-level vulnerability, with losses reaching approximately 12 percentage points on BCICIV-2a relative to the ideal-link reference. These findings establish gateway synchronization as an explicit design variable in federated MI personalization and motivate joint evaluation of personalized accuracy, communication cost, update freshness, and subject-level reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NEXUS-MI框架，将运动想象脑机接口(MI-BCI)的联邦个性化建模为"学习-通信"耦合控制问题，通过网关协同的6种异构链路策略，在BCICIV-2a和OpenBMI数据集上证明通信感知同步可稳定降低约42%的服务器到客户端骨干网流量，但准确率效果不稳定且个体可靠性差异显著。
AI.motivation: MI-BCI信号因跨被试、跨会话的高度变异性导致解码器不稳定，限制其在家庭康复中的可靠部署。现有联邦MI-BCI研究普遍假设理想同步条件，忽视网关可用性、带宽波动、延迟更新等部署层面的真实约束，将通信策略视为背景开销而非影响个性化解码性能的一阶设计变量。
AI.method: 采用三层次"可穿戴-网关-边缘"架构，将解码器分解为共享EEG骨干网(联邦更新)与个性化分类头(本地适配)。定义6种网关协同策略P1-P6，在4个同步维度上系统变化：调度方式(非自适应全选 vs 通信感知优先级)、离线更新规则(丢弃/FIFO缓冲/最新待定更新)、陈旧更新准入(基版本检查 vs 阈值τs=2拒绝)、骨干网下载规则(始终下载 vs 版本感知τd=1刷新)。在BCICIV-2a(9被试4类)和OpenBMI(54被试2类)上采用会话协议(Session 1联邦骨干网学习+Session 2有限校准k∈{15,20,30}头适配+保留测试)，通过理想链路参考+异构链路(高/中/低可用性0.95/0.70/0.40)对比，利用EEGNet主干(2040骨干网参数+1988/994头参数)、120轮联邦通信、FedAvg聚合、Holm校正配对t检验+交叉分层Bootstrap(10000重采样5个匹配实现)进行统计推断。
AI.result: P5策略(通信感知调度+陈旧感知下载)相对P3在两个数据集上均稳定降低约42%服务器到客户端骨干网流量(OpenBMI 37.49→21.98 MB；BCICIV-2a 6.27→3.68 MB)，总流量分别降低15.72 MB和3.17 MB。在主控制实现OpenBMI EIB-PH下P5相对P3提升+0.99 pp(80.13→81.12%，Holm调整p=0.013)，但5次匹配鲁棒性分析中所有4个数据集-机制条件的交叉分层Bootstrap 95% CI均包含零；BCICIV-2a主比较下准确率差异不显著。组件分解表明流量节省主要来自陈旧感知骨干网下载机制，准确率提升来自在线优先级调度。严重可用性条件下，协调器拒绝上传率从轻度8.63%升至27.52%(P3)，P5陈旧度增加。个体层面，BCICIV-2a最大被试损失达-14.12 pp，OpenBMI最低被试准确率53%，各策略均存在≥5 pp下降的低精度尾部，通信暴露指标(拒绝率、陈旧度、缓冲、下载回避)与个体准确率差异无稳定相关性。
AI.conclusion: 网关同步策略是联邦MI-BCI个性化的显式一阶设计变量而非次要通信开销：通信感知协同在5个匹配实现中一致降低约42%的服务器到客户端骨干网流量，但准确率效果数据集依赖、实现依赖且在严格鲁棒性检验下不显著；群体均值掩盖个体可靠性差异。设计部署时需建立理想链路参考、将通信策略视为学习控制平面、采用版本感知骨干网刷新、避免将带宽节省调度器作为通用默认部署，并同时监控群体与个体可靠性(最差被试、阈值违规、低精度与大幅退化共现)。研究局限在于离线公共实验室数据集回放、固定Bernoulli可用性参数、5次主比较鲁棒性重复、未评估物理网关上的实时性与能耗，未来需在纵向家庭康复人群中验证并开发用户自适应同步。

title: Evaluating Model Retraining under Drift: Paired Comparisons of Cumulative Subgroup Disparity
comment: 44 pages, 10 figures, 34 tables. Reproducibility package version 2026.09.08-r2
summary: Choosing when to retrain a deployed classifier requires assessing subgroup error rates across the sequence of models used, including periods between updates. We compare complete scheduled, loss-triggered, and subgroup-gap-triggered policies with retaining the initial model on the same observations and delayed labels. For true-positive and false-positive rates separately, the outcome is the paired difference in absolute subgroup gaps summed over deployment windows. Population evaluation in simulation, action records, and alternative schedules assess how measurement and retraining behaviour affect these comparisons. In a follow-up sample of 400 new trajectories per condition across two simulated drift regimes, all three policies had lower mean cumulative disparity, equivalent to reductions of 0.04 to 0.88 percentage points in the average gap per window. Evaluating the unchanged models against the known generating distributions preserved all mean directions, but finite-window and population comparisons agreed on whether updating increased, reduced or left cumulative disparity unchanged in 69 to 92 percent of trajectories. Under subgroup-specific drift, smaller true-positive-rate gaps accompanied lower sensitivity in both groups. In an exploratory American Community Survey replay, person weighting reversed all three race false-positive-rate mean comparisons without changing predictions or actions; all three weighted intervals included zero. Policy comparisons require group-specific rates, action distributions, and an explicit evaluation population alongside mean disparity. These analyses are non-confirmatory. Shared replay requires policy-independent observations and complete labels after the specified delay.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种配对评估框架，用于在分布漂移条件下比较不同分类器再训练策略（冻结、定期、损失触发、子群差距触发）在累积子群公平性差距方面的表现。通过模拟和ACS人口普查重放分析，强调测量稳定性、动作模式和评估人群选择的重要性，所有分析均为非验证性。
AI.motivation: 部署的预测模型会随时间面临分布漂移，不同的再训练规则（定期、触发式）会产生不同的子群错误率序列及其累积差异。现有研究缺乏对完整再训练策略（包含动作分布、监控定义、参考人群）在共享观测和延迟标签下的配对比较框架，且未充分探讨有限窗口测量与总体集成、行动模式及评估人群对结论的影响。
AI.method: 采用配对差异方法，将更新策略与冻结基线在相同观测和延迟标签下比较TPR和FPR绝对子群差距的累积差异。提出基于正态特征的高精度数值积分方法对未改变的拟合模型进行总体评估。通过无漂移控制、随机再拟合参考、动作计数匹配和后视基准（穷举搜索≤512个调度）评估行动模式和计数分布的影响。使用中心化学生化bootstrap检验和Holm校正。在ACSEmployment基准上进行探索性人口普查重放，比较记录权重与人员权重下的差异。
AI.result: 在两种模拟漂移环境中，所有三种策略（定期、损失触发、差距触发）相对于冻结基线均显示出较低的累积差距（0.04–0.88个百分点/窗口），学生化bootstrap检验在Holm水平0.05下支持所有八项监控策略的差距减少。总体积分保留了所有均值方向但改变了69–92%的轨迹符号。在子群特定漂移下，较小的TPR差距伴随两组灵敏度的降低。在合并漂移下，损失触发策略以约少1.8次再拟合换取了比定期策略更高的差距。在ACS重放中，人员权重反转了所有三个种族-FPR均值比较（预测和动作固定），但所有加权区间均包含零。后视优势主要来自相同计数下的重新调度，允许更少再拟合仅贡献0.00077–0.00906个累积单位。
AI.conclusion: 定期和监控式再训练在两种模拟漂移条件下比冻结产生更低的累积子群差距，但较小的TPR差距并不保证组级别预测结果的改善。完整策略在行动频率上存在差异，评估人群的选择（记录权重vs人员权重）可逆转均值方向。降低累积差距不足以选择维护策略，必须结合组特定率、动作分布和明确的评估人群共同考量。所有分析均为非验证性的，共享重放假设策略不改变未来观测和完整延迟标签的可用性。

title: Privacy-Preserving Split Learning for Federated LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on domain-specific data is essential for downstream adaptation. In many deployments, a participant cannot hold the complete model locally. This happens because the model owner keeps the full model proprietary, or because the participant lacks sufficient compute resources. Split Learning (SL) addresses this by partitioning the model between the participant and a server so that only a small portion runs locally. When the underlying data is additionally distributed across multiple institutions with privacy requirements, Federated Learning (FL) further enables collaborative training across participants by sharing only model updates instead of raw data. In this combined setting, each client transmits intermediate activations to the server, and for LLM fine-tuning, this exchange poses an inherent privacy paradox. The autoregressive nature of LLMs causes the transmitted activations to leak the input, and existing perturbation-based defenses are fundamentally ineffective in this setting. We address this leakage through a learned obfuscate-and-recover scheme that protects participants' private datasets while still allowing an independently deployable model to be trained on the server side. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves strong privacy protection with modest utility loss and system overhead, making split-based federated LLM fine-tuning practically viable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PrivPair框架，针对联邦切分学习（Federated Split Learning）场景下大语言模型（LLM）微调时的中间激活（smashed data）隐私泄露问题，设计了一种基于"混淆-恢复"机制的轻量级客户端适配器方案。
AI.motivation: 在联邦切分学习中进行LLM微调时，由于LLM的自回归特性，输入与标签几乎相同，服务器作为白盒诚实但好奇的敌手，可利用其持有的模型副本从客户端传输的中间激活中重构出原始输入数据，导致严重的隐私泄露。现有基于扰动的防御方法（如差分隐私、NoPeek等）存在根本性局限：增强扰动会破坏训练效用，而减弱扰动则无法有效防御标签重构。
AI.method: PrivPair在客户端部署两个轻量级残差MLP适配器：混淆适配器W₁对发送到服务器的中间激活进行混淆处理，使其与服务器解码器不兼容；恢复适配器W₂将服务器返回的激活映射回与客户端模型兼容的表示。两个适配器在公共对齐数据集上联合训练，通过JSD、CKA、MSE和KL散度等损失函数平衡隐私保护与训练效用。训练中使用直通估计器（STE）保持主模型梯度流的有效性。理论分析证明了方案的收敛性和可训练性条件。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.2-3B、Llama-3.1-8B、Ministral-3-8B和Ministral-3-14B四个模型上，使用Banking77、CLINC150和MentalChat16K三个数据集进行评估。实验结果表明：相比无防御场景，PrivPair在Direct Forward、TAG、LAMP和BiSR四种攻击下均大幅降低重构质量（多数情况下接近零），同时保持接近无防御基线的训练效用（分类准确率和生成ROUGE-1）。客户端开销仅增加约5.4%的GPU内存和极低的计算延迟，端到端训练时间比无防御增加约40%（含一次性对齐成本）。在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano边缘设备上验证了可行性。
AI.conclusion: PrivPair通过"混淆-恢复"机制有效解决了联邦切分学习中LLM微调的隐私-效用权衡难题，证明了自回归LLM场景下扰动型防御的固有局限性。该方案无需上传适配器，服务器仍可获得完整可部署模型，符合标准联邦学习部署流程，为实际应用提供了可行的隐私保护方案。

title: A practical DIRECT-type algorithm for medium-scale black-box global optimization
summary: The DIRECT algorithm is a deterministic global optimization method known for its versatility and balanced exploration-exploitation strategy. However, DIRECT-type algorithms are primarily effective for low-dimensional problems and often exhibit slow convergence as dimensionality increases, limiting their applicability to more complex optimization tasks. To address this limitation, this paper introduces X-DTC-GL, a novel DIRECT-type algorithm that incorporates dynamic partitioning and hybridization techniques. The dynamic partitioning approach adaptively refines the search space based on local one-dimensional surrogate models, enabling rapid subdivision of promising hyper-rectangles. The hybridization strategy selectively employs a hill-climbing method to exploit promising regions identified by the surrogate models. Extensive experiments on four diverse benchmark suites demonstrate that X-DTC-GL significantly outperforms existing DIRECT-type baselines, achieving improvements of ~12% in solvability and ~27% in solution quality. Performance-profile analyses indicate the fastest convergence on up to ~40% of instances, the best runtime performance on ~17% of problems, and competitive overall execution times. By improving performance within the partition-based framework, these advances strengthen the algorithm's competitiveness in state-of-the-art black-box optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 X-DTC-GL 的新型 DIRECT 型全局优化算法，通过引入动态分区和混合爬山策略，有效缓解了传统 DIRECT 算法在高维问题中的收敛缓慢问题，在四个基准测试集上显著优于现有 DIRECT 型基线方法。
AI.motivation: 传统 DIRECT 型算法在低维问题上表现良好，但随着维度增加，其收敛速度急剧下降（需要对每个超矩形沿所有最长边进行三等分分割，且存在"全局拖拽"问题），限制了其在中高维黑盒优化问题中的应用。因此，亟需开发能够有效缓解维度诅咒、提升 DIRECT 型算法在高维场景下性能的改进方法。
AI.method: X-DTC-GL 算法在 I-DTC-GL 基础上引入两大核心增强机制：(1) 动态分区策略——在选定的潜在最优超矩形（POH）内沿其最长边构建一维代理模型（支持二次型 Q 和线性 L 两种近似），根据模型预测的最小值定位包含最优解的子超矩形，并对其进行迭代式细分；(2) 选择性混合爬山策略——在初始化阶段以及主循环中，当代理模型预测有改进潜力时启动 SQP 局部搜索。算法还包括 ε_imp（改进阈值）和 ε_size（最小边长阈值）两个数值保护参数来控制动态分区的深度。
AI.result: 在四个不同基准测试集（BS1-50 至 BS4-50，共 200 个测试实例，涵盖 BBOB、CEC、ABS、Layeb 等多样化函数）上，X-DTC-GL 的两个变体（Q 和 L）显著优于 DIRECT、I-DTC-IOl、I-DTC-GL、DIRMIN、tDIRECT、BIRMIN 和 NMSO 等基线方法，可解率提升约 12%，解质量提升约 27%；性能曲线分析显示，在最多约 40% 的实例上收敛最快，约 17% 的问题上执行时间最短；运行时分析与基线相当，且在高维下略快。然而，算法在病态多模态问题和含平台区域的函数（如 Step Ellipsoidal、Rosenbrock）上存在一定不足。
AI.conclusion: X-DTC-GL 通过动态分区与混合策略的协同设计，有效提升了 DIRECT 型算法在中高维黑盒优化中的竞争力，验证了基于代理模型的局部趋势利用对缓解维度诅咒的重要价值；未来研究方向包括：信息驱动的更灵活细分策略、更丰富的分区模式（如五等分、七等分）、在动态分区中引入下界控制，以及构建可根据优化进展自适应选择局部搜索方法的混合框架。算法已开源以确保可复现性。

title: Online Inverse Integer Linear Optimization via Small-Gradient Skipping: Constant Regret and Finite Mistakes
summary: In online inverse linear optimization, the learner predicts a weight at each round, observes the optimal action of the agent, and updates its prediction. In the general setting, the gap of $\log T$ between the regret upper bound $O(d \log T)$ and the lower bound $\Omega(d)$ is unresolved (here $T$ is the total number of rounds and $d$ is the dimension). When the action set is M-convex, the regret is known to be bounded by $O(d \log d)$, but the method attaining it computes a center of gravity at every round. This paper therefore proposes Small-Gradient Skipping (SGS), a mechanism that skips the update at rounds without a mistake in the case where the correct action is uniformly separated from the other candidates, and applies it to online gradient descent, the online Newton step, and MetaGrad. The number of mistakes is then bounded, for all three, by a quantity independent of $T$; and for the online Newton step and for MetaGrad with SGS, the dimension dependence of the regret becomes $O(d^2)$ when the forward problem is an integer linear program, that is, the factor $\log T$ is removed. Moreover, when the action set is M-convex, the regret is bounded efficiently without computing a center of gravity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对在线逆整数线性优化问题，提出了一种名为“小梯度跳过”（SGS）的机制。该机制在均匀间隔条件下，可应用于在线梯度下降（OGD）、在线牛顿步（ONS）和 MetaGrad 等方法，实现常数遗憾和有限错误次数。当正问题为整数线性规划且权重空间为概率单纯形时，ONS 和增长网格 SGS-MetaGrad 的遗憾界为 O(d²‖M‖₂ log(2‖M‖₂))，成功消除了先前 O(d log T) 界中对 T 的对数依赖。
AI.motivation: 在线逆线性优化中存在一个长期未解决的问题：已知最优遗憾上界 O(d log T) 与下界 Ω(d) 之间存在 log T 的差距，且现有与 T 无关的界要么维度上指数增长，要么需要计算重心（在 M-convex 结构下）这一重型操作。本文旨在填补这一空白，在均匀间隔条件下获得关于维度多项式、与 T 无关的遗憾界。
AI.method: 提出“小梯度跳过”（SGS）机制：在无错误的轮次（提案正确，0 可选作次梯度）跳过迭代和内部状态的更新，仅在错误轮次使用次梯度 g = x̂ᵗ - xᵗ 进行更新。将该机制分别应用于：（1）SGS-OGD，一阶梯度法；（2）ONS，二阶方法（ONS 本质上自动满足跳过性质）；（3）SGS-MetaGrad，包括固定网格和增长网格版本（增长网格按错误次数而非轮次细化）。通过均匀间隔条件 γ 的下界，将这些界转换为不同问题类（一般 ILP、线性不等式、M-凸、M♮-凸）的显式上界。
AI.result: 主要结果：对于均匀间隔 γ > 0 下的在线逆线性优化，（1）错误次数 K 与总轮次 T 无关；（2）累积次优遗憾 R^sub_T 与 T 无关；（3）累积决策遗憾 R^est_T 与 T 无关。具体地：SGS-OGD 给出 K ≤ 2L²D²/γ²；ONS 给出 K = O(dLD/γ · log max(2LD/γ, 1))，R̃_T = O(LD·d·log max(LD/γ, 1))；增长网格 SGS-MetaGrad 给出同阶结果但完全与 T 无关。对于一般 ILP 且权重空间为概率单纯形，ONS 和增长网格 SGS-MetaGrad 达到 R^est_T = O(d²‖M‖₂ log(2‖M‖₂))，每个错误轮次的计算成本为 O(d²) 加一次广义投影。M-凸结构下界为 O(d²)，多项式于维度，无需每次计算重心。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的 SGS 机制成功解决了在线逆线性优化中关于 T 的对数依赖问题：在均匀间隔条件下实现了与 T 无关、维度多项式的遗憾界。ONS 和增长网格 SGS-MetaGrad 对于一般 ILP（概率单纯形）达到 R^est_T = O(d²‖M‖₂ log(2‖M‖₂))，比之前的 O(d log T) 界消除了 log T 因子。对于 M-凸结构，界为 O(d²)，改进了之前需要每次计算重心的 O(d log d) 界。遗留问题包括上界与已知下界 Ω(d) 之间仍有 d 因子和 ‖M‖₂ 相关的差距，以及向噪声和损坏反馈设置的扩展。

title: In Medical Claims Data, Enhancing Predictive Performance for Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events Using Cross Attention
comment: 13pages, 3 figures. Accepted to KDD 2024 AIDSH workshop
summary: Medical claims data comprise the financial details, including the expenses and billing information, as well as the clinical information, such as the diagnoses and treatments, of patients visiting medical facilities. Recently, it has been acknowledged that large databases can be constructed from medical claims data for medical research purposes. However, the clinical information within these datasets is often medically unstructured, limiting its application in comprehensive analyses. This study enhances predictive model performance for major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), a leading cause of death worldwide. Models that predict MACE are crucial to clinical practice guidelines. We utilize a cross-attention mechanism to develop a method that effectively weights the relationships between diagnoses and treatments. Effectively repre- senting the clinical information contained in medical claims data, this approach generates more representative features for predicting MACE. The ROC-AUC score of our proposed cross-attention-based model was 0.7720, higher than other benchmark models including the conventional atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease model, the light gradient boosting machine, and a self-attention-based model. These results indicate that integrating the clinical structure of medical claims data using a cross-attention mechanism significantly enhances the performance of predictive models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于交叉注意力（Cross-Attention）机制的深度学习模型，用于预测重大不良心血管事件（MACE），通过有效建模医疗索赔数据中诊断与治疗之间的多对多关系，显著提升了预测性能（ROC-AUC达0.7720）。
AI.motivation: 医疗索赔数据虽包含丰富的诊断与治疗信息，但其临床结构非结构化，现有预测模型无法有效捕捉诊断与治疗之间复杂的多对多关联关系，限制了MACE预测性能。
AI.method: 构建融合健康体检数据与医疗索赔数据的深度学习模型：1)将诊断、医疗操作和处方编码按层次结构分解为子标记并进行嵌入；2)使用Transformer编码器分别编码诊断和治疗信息；3)引入交叉注意力机制（诊断作为Query，治疗作为Key/Value）学习诊断-治疗的多对多关系；4)结合12个月数据通过分类头输出预测概率。使用AdamW优化器和类平衡Focal Loss进行9折交叉验证训练。
AI.result: 在51,367名日本受试者数据上，所提交叉注意力模型的ROC-AUC为0.7720、MCC为0.1520，显著优于自注意力模型（0.7586）、LGBM（0.7559）和ASCVD模型（0.7521）。集成模型ROC-AUC进一步提升至0.7791，Wilcoxon秩和检验和DeLong检验均验证了统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 交叉注意力机制能够有效学习医疗索赔数据中诊断与治疗的多对多关系，生成更具代表性的临床特征表示，显著提升MACE预测性能，为高危人群识别和公共卫生干预提供了有效工具。未来计划将该机制扩展至大规模医疗索赔数据的预训练模型。

title: TempTPI: Informer-Based trajectory prediction for maritime vessels
comment: Accepted to IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026. \c{opyright} 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media
summary: Accurate long-term trajectory prediction for maritime vessels is essential for safety and logistical efficiency. While deep learning models, particularly Transformers, have shown promise in processing Automatic Identification System (AIS) data, they often struggle with the quadratic computational complexity of self-attention and the loss of accuracy over extended forecasting horizons. This study proposes TempTPI, a novel prediction framework that integrates an Informer-based encoder with a multi-channel temporal encoding mechanism. The Informer architecture leverages a ProbSparse self-attention mechanism to reduce computational overhead and focus on the most significant dependencies, while the temporal encoder utilizes Fourier-like frequency expansions to capture cyclic patterns (hourly, daily, and seasonal) in vessel behavior. We evaluate our model against the state-of-the-art TPTrans architecture using AIS data from Danish waters. Experimental results demonstrate that TempTPI consistently outperforms existing methods across prediction windows of 1 to 5 hours. Notably, at a 5-hour horizon, the proposed model achieves a 55% improvement in Mean Squared Error (MSE), offering a robust solution for long-range maritime situational awareness.

AI.tldr: TempTPI是一个用于海事船舶长期轨迹预测的深度学习框架，通过将Informer编码器（采用ProbSparse自注意力机制）与多通道时间编码机制相结合，在丹麦水域的AIS数据上实现了对当前最优模型TPTrans的显著超越，特别是在5小时预测窗口上MSE改善达55%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的AIS轨迹预测模型面临两大核心挑战：(1)标准自注意力机制的二次计算复杂度限制了对长输入序列的处理能力；(2)预测精度随预测时间延长而显著下降。此外，现有模型（如TPTrans、TrAISformer）缺乏显式的时间上下文特征建模，且仅以绝对坐标预测，进一步制约了长期预测性能。海事安全与物流效率对长期精准预测的需求迫切，亟需一种兼顾计算效率与长程预测稳定性的架构。
AI.method: TempTPI架构包含两大核心创新组件：(1) **Informer编码器**：采用ProbSparse自注意力机制，仅选择稀疏度度量下得分最高的top-u个查询，将复杂度从O(L_Q)降至O(log L_Q)；配合自注意力蒸馏操作（卷积+池化），将整体内存开销压缩至O((2-ε)L log L)；生成式解码器一次性输出完整预测序列，避免自回归累积误差。(2) **多通道时间编码器**：对"小时"、"星期"、"月份"三类循环特征进行Fourier-like频率扩展（TE_c(x) = {sin(k·x), cos(k·x)}，k=1..K），各通道通过独立线性投影与偏置项学习，再与数据投影输出融合后输入位置编码。预处理阶段将轨迹重采样至6分钟间隔、投影至Web Mercator坐标系，并以30分钟历史窗口预测30分钟未来轨迹。训练采用Adam优化器（lr=1e-4）、MSE损失（基于经纬度联合计算），并设计系统性消融实验评估输入窗口、预测窗口、数据量与滑动步长的影响。
AI.result: 在丹麦海事局提供的AIS数据（2025年10月1-14日，约1000艘MMSI的商业货运船舶）上的实验表明：(1) TempTPI在1至5小时全预测窗口内均优于TPTrans基线，5小时预测窗口下MSE改善约55%；(2) 消融研究验证了时间编码与Informer编码器各自的贡献——单纯替换编码器（TPInform）已显著降低损失，加入时间编码后获得一致的进一步改善；(3) 二次拟合曲线显示TempTPI损失随预测时长增长更为平缓，体现了更优的长期稳定性；(4) 训练曲线表明TempTPI在约50个epoch后稳定超越TPTrans，并展现出更平稳的学习轨迹；(5) 定性预测样本显示TempTPI能较好地通过Øresund和Great Belt等狭窄水道，但偶尔仍会出现预测轨迹进入陆地边界的情况。
AI.conclusion: TempTPI验证了Informer架构与时间编码结合在长期海事轨迹预测中的有效性，特别在长预测窗口下展现出显著的性能优势与稳定性，具备应用于海事态势感知与物流调度的潜力。但研究存在以下局限：(1) 仅使用单一月份（10月）两周数据，无法充分训练季节性周期特征；(2) 地理范围局限于丹麦水域，泛化能力待验证；(3) 陆地区域违规问题尚未有效解决（尝试引入land punishment导致训练不稳定）；(4) 模型对数据量需求高于TPTrans，小样本场景表现下降。未来工作应聚焦于更大规模多季节数据集、跨海域泛化性、参数调优以及陆地区域惩罚机制或约束优化方法的深入研究。

title: Exact Degeneracy Under Balanced k-Shot Sampling:Consequences for Small-Sample Discriminant Analysis on LLM Embeddings
summary: Balanced k-shot sampling draws exactly k labeled examples per class. We show that it induces an exact, provable degeneracy in a family of small-sample discriminant estimators. Under balanced sampling, the within-class scatter operator of Kernelized Linear Principal Component Discriminant Analysis (KLPCDA) is not merely rank-deficient but exactly a scaled orthogonal projector. We derive the consequences in closed form: two of KLPCDA's seven variants have every signal eigenvalue exactly equal, so their eigenvector selection criterion is provably indifferent rather than ill-conditioned, and a third has a provably void objective. This follows from the estimators' construction, not any dataset; we confirm it on frozen sentence embeddings and, separately, on residual-stream activations from a decoder-only generative model. An in-formula tie-break repairs the two repairable variants, with recovery gated by class count: the residual subspace constraint costs 5x more on few-class than many-class datasets (p=0.000001). We then evaluate the repaired framework on few-shot text classification on frozen LLM embeddings (n much smaller than d, up to 4096), across four datasets, three embedding sizes, and three trained baselines (SetFit, LoRA, in-context learning). A properly cross-validated logistic-regression probe still beats every KLPCDA variant on three of four datasets, at every embedding size; guidance carried from pixel, vibration-signal, and gene-expression data does not directly generalize to this feature space. Three independent geometric separability metrics fail to explain why one high-dimensional decoder-based embedding model underperforms smaller bidirectional encoders, ruling out anisotropy; the gap is substantially an estimation-efficiency effect, not a permanent ceiling, closing by more than 80% when the support set grows from k<=10 to k=30-50 (p=0.00195, both many-class datasets).

AI.tldr: 研究平衡k-shot采样对核化线性主成分判别分析（KLPCDA）的精确退化效应，证明类内散布算子在平衡采样下恰为缩放的正交投影器，导致其7个变体中的若干个在特征选择上变得完全无差别（indifferent）或目标函数完全失效（void）。提出两个可修复变体的公式内平局打破修复，并在四个少样本文本分类数据集上对比七个KLPCDA变体与正确交叉验证的逻辑回归探针及三个训练型基线（SetFit、LoRA、上下文学习）。主要结论是：调优后的逻辑回归探针在四个数据集中的三个上仍击败所有KLPCDA变体；先前基于像素、振动信号和基因表达数据给出的KLPCDA变体选择指南不能直接迁移到LLM嵌入空间。
AI.motivation: KLPCDA是针对小样本（n<<d）判别分析问题提出的七变体框架，此前已在高光谱图像、轴承故障振动信号、基因表达面板和人脸识别四个领域得到"哪种变体何时适用"的实证指导。但该框架是否可迁移到少样本文本分类的LLM冻结嵌入空间（n<<d, d可达4096）尚不清楚，且平衡k-shot采样协议（每类恰好k个样本）作为标准少样本评测范式，可能与KLPCDA的散布矩阵估计器存在结构性相互作用，导致先前未被记录的退化模式。
AI.method: 理论分析：证明在平衡k-shot采样下KLPCDA的类内散布算子W恰为(1/L)Π（Π为块对角正交投影器），其特征值为0（重数L）与1/L（重数n-L），且类间散布算子B恰好落在Π的零空间。由此推导No.5/No.1的特征值精确等于L或1/k（选择准则无差别），No.3的算子精确为零矩阵（目标失效）。提出基于变体自身第二项的公式内平局打破修复。实证评估：在Banking77、CLINC150、TREC、AG News四个数据集上，使用MiniLM（d=384）、BGE-large（d=1024）、E5-Mistral-7B-Instruct（d=4096）三种冻结嵌入，对比七个KLPCDA变体、调优逻辑回归探针、最近质心、SetFit、LoRA和上下文学习（Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct）。额外在decoder-only生成模型的残差流激活上独立验证退化机制。
AI.result: 1. 平衡k-shot采样下，KLPCDA的W算子在Banking77上精确验证为{0(重数77), 1/77(重数308)}，ΠBΠ最大值2.8e-36，No.5信号特征值测量为77.000000000±1.2e-10，No.3特征值在1e-12到1e-14（浮点噪声级别）。2. 平局打破修复将No.1/No.5从最不稳定变体提升至竞争集群，但在少类数据集上残余子空间约束代价显著高于多类数据集（48对比较中均值差距0.0379 vs 0.0072，5倍差异，Mann-Whitney p=0.000001）。3. 在d=384时正确交叉验证的逻辑回归探针在Banking77(0.797)、CLINC150(0.871)、AG News(0.716)上击败所有KLPCDA变体；TREC上No.6(0.506)略胜探针(0.472)但单个k值下Wilcoxon p∈[0.06, 0.58]不显著。4. 从d=384到1024时，多类数据集上探针-KLPCDA差距显著缩小（Wilcoxon p≤0.014, k≥5），但此趋势在d=4096时反转（p=0.002），原因为decoder-only架构而非维度本身（PCA投影至1024几乎无变化）。5. 三个独立几何可分性度量（原始余弦相似度、类内/类间余弦间隔、Fisher-LDA风格白化可分性谱）均无法解释E5-Mistral的劣势，且白化谱甚至将其排在最优，与实际精度相反。6. 将k从≤10扩展到30-50使E5-Mistral与BGE-large的精度差距缩小超过80%（Banking77: 0.217→0.040；CLINC150: 0.190→0.028），每对比较p=0.00195。7. 墙钟时间：KLPCDA/探针/最近质心在CPU上<0.1秒；SetFit 7.19秒；LoRA 3.29秒；上下文学习48.89±39.95秒（均需GPU）。
AI.conclusion: 平衡k-shot采样协议与KLPCDA类散布矩阵估计器之间存在结构性精确退化交互，导致三个变体（No.1、No.3、No.5）的特征选择准则变得provably indifferent或provably void，这种退化属于估计器构造本身的性质，而非任何数据集或特征空间的特性（已在冻结句嵌入与decoder残差流激活上独立验证）。尽管已为两个变体提出公式内平局打破修复，但跨领域（像素/振动/基因）开发的KLPCDA变体选择指南不能直接迁移到LLM冻结嵌入空间：正确交叉验证的线性探针在多数数据集与嵌入维度上仍优于所有KLPCDA变体。高维decoder嵌入模型（E5-Mistral）相对于较小双向编码器的劣势被三种独立几何可分性度量排除为各向异性效应，实证表明其主要是k-shot范围内的估计效率问题而非永久性瓶颈（k扩展到30-50后差距缩小超80%）。实践建议包括：少类任务优先选No.2/No.4/No.6；余弦间隔度量仅在同一架构内有效；极低k时优先上下文学习；若有更多标注则增加k优于更换编码器。

title: ProMeta: Few-shot PROTAC-targeted degradation prediction across E3 ligases
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, and 2 tables. Source code and reproducibility resources are available at this https URL and this https URL
summary: Proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) have emerged as a transformative therapeutic strategy that selectively degrades historically ''undruggable'' targets via the ubiquitin-proteasome system. Despite growing efforts to develop computational predictors of PROTAC degradation activity, existing supervised approaches remain severely challenged by data scarcity and imbalance across E3 ligases, limiting their ability to generalize beyond well-studied ligase contexts. In practice, labeled data are heavily concentrated on a few ligases (e.g., CRBN and VHL), while the majority of E3 ligases remain underexplored yet are critical for expanding the design space of targeted degraders. Developing methods that enable robust cross-ligase generalization with minimal labeled data is therefore essential for improving the practical utility of computational PROTAC discovery. We reformulate PROTAC degradation activity prediction across E3 ligases as a few-shot meta-learning problem and present ProMeta, a prototype-based graph neural network trained through episodic meta-learning on source-E3 tasks and evaluated on held-out target-E3 tasks through support-conditioned inference. ProMeta performs inference without updating the encoder by dynamically estimating class prototypes from minimal target-ligase support samples. On the CRBN-to-VHL benchmark, ProMeta achieves AUROC values of 0.796 under K=2, Q=3 and 0.883 under K=2, Q=5, improving by 19.9% and 6.8%, respectively, over the corresponding supervised GNN baseline. Reverse VHL-to-CRBN transfer under the same protocol yielded AUROC values of 0.702 (K=2, Q=3) and 0.821 (K=2, Q=5), confirming bidirectional applicability while revealing direction and data-regime dependence. Together, these results support ProMeta as a practical framework for cross-ligase few-shot prediction under the evaluated support/query protocols.

AI.tldr: ProMeta是一个基于原型网络和情节式元学习的图神经网络框架，将跨E3连接酶的PROTAC降解活性预测重构为少样本学习问题，通过动态从目标连接酶的支持集估计类别原型，无需调整编码器即可对新连接酶进行少样本预测。
AI.motivation: 现有监督学习方法严重依赖大量标注数据，且PROTAC标注数据在不同E3连接酶间分布极不平衡（主要集中在CRBN和VHL），导致模型在罕见连接酶上难以泛化，限制了计算PROTAC发现的实用性。
AI.method: 1) 分子表征：使用GCN编码器（3层，128维）从SMILES构建分子图，融合POI和E3连接酶的蛋白质序列嵌入（可学习权重α初始化为0.1）；2) 原型分类器：基于情节式元学习的Prototypical Networks框架，类别原型为支持集嵌入的均值；3) 情节式元训练：从源E3连接酶（CRBN或VHL）采样2-way K-shot Q-query episodes；4) 推理阶段：冻结编码器，融合ECFP4指纹后从目标连接酶的最小支持集动态估计原型，使用欧氏距离和softmax进行分类；5) 基准测试：CRBN↔VHL双向转移、罕见E3连接酶（FEM1B、IAP、MDM2、XIAP、cIAP1）的one-shot评估。
AI.result: CRBN→VHL：AUROC=0.796（K=2,Q=3）和0.883（K=2,Q=5），较监督GNN基线分别提升19.9%和6.8%；VHL→CRBN：AUROC=0.702和0.821；罕见E3连接酶：AUROC=0.700，优于PROTAC-STAN（0.550）和DegradeMaster（0.564）；案例研究：在VZ185衍生的12个PROTAC候选物上达到91.7%准确率，优于DeepPROTAC、PROTAC-STAN和DegradeMaster；在CDK6降解物上达到78.6%，在BCL-xL降解物上达到100%。
AI.conclusion: ProMeta作为一个实用的跨连接酶少样本预测框架，在评估的支持/查询协议下表现出色，但其性能具有方向依赖性和数据量依赖性；表观学习与原型决策的结合比单独使用任一者更有利于跨连接酶迁移；当前缺乏3D构象和三元复合物信息，且罕见E3连接酶分析受限于小规模查询集，未来将整合E(3)等变编码器并扩展元训练。

title: Beyond Conventional Federated Learning via High-Order Regularization
summary: Federated clients that perform several local optimization steps can return parameter displacements with widely different magnitudes. The quadratic regularization of FedProx grows linearly with displacement and therefore offers limited control over the contrast between ordinary and unusually large client movements. We here introduce HiFedProx, which replaces the quadratic penalty with a scale-matched power-type regularizer indexed by $p\geq2$. All powers have the same regularization-gradient magnitude at a reference displacement $R$, while every $p>2$ gives a weaker response below $R$ and a stronger response above it. An exact affine reference calculation shows that increasing $p$ compresses relative displacement disparities, although very large powers approach fixed-radius behavior and increase local curvature. HiFedProx combines this geometry with finite-budget stochastic client optimization and same-minibatch Armijo backtracking. In paired five-seed experiments on a frozen 60-writer FEMNIST subset, a common-parameter study over $p\in\{2,3,4,5,6,7,8\}$ shows similar clean-training performance but substantial gains under composite stress. The lowest moderate- and severe-stress losses occur at $p=7$ and $p=6$, improving over $p=2$ by $11.44\%$ and $23.16\%$, respectively. Although displacement-tail ratios continue to decrease through $p=8$, predictive performance peaks in an intermediate range and Armijo trial cost increases with $p$. These results indicate that the exponent should be calibrated rather than maximized. In our experiments, $p=5$--$7$ provides the most useful range.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HiFedProx，一种将 FedProx 中的二次近端正则项替换为标度匹配的幂次正则化器（指数 p≥2）的联邦学习方法，旨在更灵活地控制客户端参数位移的差异性，并在 FEMNIST 复合压力实验上验证了中等指数范围（p=5–7）的优势。
AI.motivation: FedProx 的二次正则化对客户端位移呈线性增长，对普通与异常大的客户端位移对比度控制有限。需要一种能在参考位移 R 附近保持温和、超过 R 后响应更强的高阶正则化机制，以更好地抑制异构联邦学习中的极端客户端位移。
AI.method: 将 FedProx 二次近端项 ‖u−w^t‖² 替换为标度匹配的幂次正则项 (μ/pR^{p−2})‖u−w^t‖^p（p≥2），使所有 p 在参考位移 R 处正则化梯度模长相同；p>2 对低于 R 的位移响应更弱、高于 R 时更强。结合有限预算随机客户端优化与同 minibatch Armijo 回溯线搜索，构成完整一阶联邦算法 HiFedProx（无需 Hessian 或高阶导数）。通过仿射参考子问题精确求解，给出位移-梯度范数比公式 r_(k)^(p) = R(s_(k)/(μR))^{1/(p−1)}，并证明 p→∞ 时趋近固定半径行为、局部 Lipschitz 常数 L_ϕ(D) = μ(p−1)(D/R)^{p−2} 随 p 增大。
AI.result: 在 60 位作者 FEMNIST 子集、五种子子、固定 (μ,R)=(0.03,1) 下扫描 p∈{2,…,8}：清洁训练损失相近（2.2610–2.2922）；中度压力下 p=7 损失最低（2.4095），较 p=2 改善 11.44%；重度压力下 p=6 损失最低（2.6235），较 p=2 改善 23.16%；p=8 虽位移尾部比最小（2.086，p=2 为 4.936），但预测性能不再提升且 Armijo 试验次数从 7835 增至 10070（增 28.52%）。准确率上 p=5 最高中度压力精度，p=6 最高重度压力精度。
AI.conclusion: 幂次指数 p 应校准而非最大化：在该协议下 p=5–7 为最佳中间平台区，p=6 适合严重大位移鲁棒性优先场景，p=8 的尾部压缩不再转化为预测收益且线搜索成本持续上升。仿射分析与 Lipschitz 常数分析定性解释了为何 p 过大反而损失有用幅值信息并增加局部曲率。该研究仅隔离了指数效应，未联合调优 (p,μ,R)，且限于单一架构、单一数据集子集，未测试未见客户端或非整数 p，外层收敛性有待后续工作。

title: Meta-LinEXP3: Online-within-Online Learning for Adversarial Linear Contextual Bandits
summary: Meta-learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for transferring knowledge across sequential bandit tasks. While substantial progress has been made for stochastic bandits and non-contextual adversarial bandits, meta-learning for adversarial linear contextual bandits (ALCBs) with random action sets remains largely unexplored. To address this problem, we propose Meta-LinEXP3, an online-within-online algorithm that constructs a predictable task-level prior from completed tasks to guide the inner LinEXP3 learner. For known context distributions, we develop a policy-centered estimator that achieves an intrinsic-dimension $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{n})$ per-task regret bound. For unknown distributions, we introduce a past-only regularized moment estimator with an $\mathcal{O}(n^{2/3})$ leading regret term and explicit finite-sample error. We further establish a direct connection between prior accuracy and transfer regret, showing that increasingly accurate priors yield sublinear transfer-dependent regret across tasks. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of Meta-LinEXP3, including its application to structured hyperspectral tensor sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Meta-LinEXP3算法，用于解决对抗性线性上下文老虎机（ALCB）中的在线-在线元学习问题。该算法通过外层任务级迁移机制和内层LinEXP3学习器的耦合，从已完成任务中构建可预测的先验，并在下一个任务中保持固定。对于已知上下文分布，提出策略中心估计器（PC-KDE）实现内在维度O(√n)每任务遗憾界；对于未知分布，提出过去正则化矩估计器（PRME）实现O(n^{2/3})主项并给出显式有限样本误差。理论建立了先验精度与迁移遗憾的直接联系——更精确的先验产生次线性的迁移相关遗憾。实验在合成数据、MovieLens推荐和KSC高光谱张量采样上验证了方法的有效性。所有理论结果已通过Lean 4形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的对抗性线性上下文老虎机（ALCB）方法（如ROBUST LinEXP3、REAL LinEXP3）针对单一任务进行分析，无法利用跨任务的共享结构。然而许多实际应用（推荐系统服务不同用户群、定价策略部署于连续销售周期等）天然产生一系列相关决策问题，在任务视野较短时重启ALCB学习器会丢弃有用信息。现有元学习工作主要针对随机老虎机和非上下文对抗老虎机，对具有随机动作集的对抗性线性上下文老虎机的元学习探索不足。
AI.method: 方法核心是"在线-在线"框架：1）外层学习器从已完成任务构建可预测的先验向量h_s，在任务s内保持固定；2）内层使用LinEXP3学习器，通过softmax先验与指数权重结合形成决策分布，与均匀探索混合。提出两种任务聚合机制——正余弦检索加权（PCRW）和均匀聚合（Uniform）。提出三种损失估计器：PC-KDE（已知分布，策略中心估计器）、PRME（未知分布，过去正则化矩估计器，使用逆概率加权）和LPE（轻量投影估计器）。分析使用变化先验引理、一般迁移与偏差分解定理、以及高斯传输计算等技术。
AI.result: 理论结果：1）PC-KDE实现每任务O(√n)遗憾界（内在维度d_U），数据依赖的PC-KDE精化界为2√(nA_ζΓ̄_s)；2）PRME实现O(n^{2/3})主项遗憾界，包含显式有限样本矩估计误差和失败事件余项；3）迁移分析建立先验精度ε_s与传输复杂度B_s的联系——当μ_s→∞、μ_s·ε_s有界上界、δ_s(1+μ_s)→0时，B_s→0，使得∑B_s = o(m)、∑B_s^{1/3} = o(m)，跨任务遗憾次线性。实验结果：合成任务中PCRW相对LinEXP3减少5.1%-22.1%遗憾（随任务对齐度提高）；MovieLens 100K上PCRW相对LinEXP3降低约15%最佳候选奖励差距；KSC高光谱张量采样中PCRW和Uniform相对零先验LinEXP3实现约1.1%累积MSE减少和1.2-1.3%前10轮早期搜索改善，所有理论结果已通过Lean 4.31.0形式化验证（无sorry/admit）。
AI.conclusion: Meta-LinEXP3为对抗性线性上下文老虎机提供了一种有效的元学习框架，通过构建可预测的固定任务先验实现跨任务知识迁移。主要限制在于：精确PC-KDE需要策略诱导矩，PRME引入O(d²)内存和逆概率方差；任务数量的改善依赖于先验精度可预测提升的可预测结构，无关任务可能无线索增益；MovieLens和KSC不完全满足无噪声线性/共同上下文分布模型。未来方向包括将分析扩展到近似策略矩和非线性应用特定的任务表示。

title: A Kernel-Based Modular Discriminant Analysis Framework for Small-Sample Learning
summary: The small-sample-size (SSS) problem remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning when labeled data are scarce due to cost, accessibility, or ethical constraints. While numerous approaches have been proposed, existing methods often struggle to maintain stable and discriminative representations under high-dimensional and limited-data conditions. Kernelized Linear Principal Component Discriminant Analysis (KLPCDA), a recently proposed modular framework, integrates variance preservation, inter-class separability, and intra-class compactness within a unified kernel space. Although its formulation has shown promising initial results, a systematic understanding of how its components interact across diverse SSS scenarios remains lacking. In this paper, we present a systematic cross-domain study of KLPCDA to characterize the interaction mechanisms among its core objectives. We analyze the behavior of its seven variants across multiple real-world SSS tasks, including hyperspectral image classification, mechanical fault diagnosis, medical diagnosis, and face recognition. Through extensive experiments and ablation studies, we investigate how different objective combinations influence performance under varying conditions such as noise, class imbalance, and high dimensionality. Our analysis reveals consistent patterns in the interaction of the three core objectives variance, between-class, and within-class terms, providing a unified and interpretable understanding of their roles in stabilizing representations and enhancing discrimination in SSS settings. Based on these findings, we further derive practical guidelines for selecting appropriate KLPCDA variants under different data characteristics. Experimental results demonstrate that KLPCDA achieves strong and robust performance across domains, while maintaining low computational complexity suitable for resource-constrained environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对KLPCDA（核化线性主成分判别分析）框架进行系统性跨域分析，通过七种变体在四个真实SSS（小样本）任务上的实验，揭示方差保持、类间可分性与类内紧凑性三个核心目标的交互机制，并给出变体选择的实用指导。
AI.motivation: 小样本学习是机器学习中的基础难题，现有方法在高维、有限数据条件下难以获得稳定且具判别性的表示。KLPCDA虽提出了一种融合三种目标的模块化核空间框架，但其各组件在不同SSS场景下的交互机制尚缺乏系统性理解，导致变体选择缺乏指导原则。
AI.method: 回顾KLPCDA框架的模块化结构，包含总方差C、类间散度Sb、类内散度Sw三个核心目标的七种组合变体。采用多项式核进行核映射，使用二阶段网格搜索策略优化核度d、子空间维数p和融合系数p1/p2，分类器采用1-NN。在Indian Pines（高光谱）、CWRU（轴承故障）、GSE44076（结肠癌基因表达）、JAFFE（人脸/表情）四个SSS数据集上，与PCA+LDA、RLDA、KPCA+LDA、SVM、FCNN、2D-CNN、HybridSN、ProtoNet-inspired、SimCLR-inspired等基线方法对比，采用Friedman检验和Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行统计显著性分析。
AI.result: KLPCDA七种变体在四个任务上均显著优于基线方法：Indian Pines上No.2 OA达54.85%，No.4 AA达51.79%，No.6 Kappa达48.20%；CWRU上No.4 OA达72.28%，AUC为0.82；GSE44076上No.5 OA达95.15%，F1为96.38%；JAFFE身份识别No.7 OA达98.64%，表情识别No.7 OA达44.34%。消融研究表明：Sw对细粒度识别至关重要，C提供全局稳定性与抗噪能力，Sb单独使用不稳定但与其他目标组合时有效；完全融合的No.1泛化性强但任务专一性不足。计算复杂度为O(n³)，存储O(n²)，仅依赖训练样本数，适合CPU部署和资源受限环境。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了KLPCDA的统一可解释框架，系统揭示了三个核心目标在不同数据特征下的角色与协同机制：方差保持提供全局稳定性、类内紧凑性保障细粒度判别、类间可分性需与其他目标协同才能发挥效力。基于分析结果提出了针对不同数据特性的KLPCDA变体选择实用指南。未来工作将扩展至半监督与小样本学习场景，并增强对类内细微变化的适应能力。

title: Development and Validation of a Physics-Guided Machine Learning Extrapolation Framework Using a Classical Transient Diffusion Benchmark
summary: Machine learning models used in engineering are typically trained within limited operating ranges, yet reliable predictions are often required beyond these domains. Consequently, the primary challenge is extrapolation rather than interpolation. Rigorous validation is hindered by the scarcity of data outside the training range. To address this limitation, a novel extrapolation framework is integrated with established machine learning architectures to enable accurate and physically consistent predictions beyond the training domain. The framework is established by systematically evaluating two physics-guided architectures: a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network and a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN). A classical one-dimensional transient diffusion problem is adopted as a benchmark because its exact analytical solution provides unlimited, reliable data across the spatio-temporal domain, enabling rigorous quantitative validation. The problem is particularly challenging because the solution evolves from an initial singularity through a strongly nonlinear transient regime before approaching a steady-state linear profile. When training data are confined to an intermediate portion of this evolution, backward extrapolation toward the singularity becomes especially demanding. To improve reliability, physics-guided coordinate transformations, boundary-aware learning strategies, and stability-enhancing temporal marching are incorporated. Extrapolation is evaluated using a train-predict-validate-extend strategy, in which validated predictions are recursively added to the training set to progressively extend the prediction horizon. The results demonstrate accurate and physically consistent predictions beyond the training domain, highlighting the framework's potential for engineering applications where data availability is limited.

AI.tldr: 本文针对工程中机器学习模型必须在训练域之外进行可靠外推这一核心难题，以一维瞬态扩散方程（具有精确解析解）为基准，提出了一种"训练–预测–验证–扩展"的序列外推验证框架，并在双向LSTM（BiLSTM）和物理信息神经网络（PINN）两种架构上分别引入物理引导的修正，系统评估并验证了外推可靠性。
AI.motivation: 工程实践中机器学习模型训练数据通常局限于有限工况范围，而实际需求却要求在训练域之外进行预测（外推）；同时，外推区域缺乏参考数据，难以严格验证外推结果的可信度，这构成了数据驱动工程中一个关键但尚未解决的难题。
AI.method: （1）选取一维瞬态热扩散方程作为基准（具有精确Fourier级数解析解），训练数据仅限Fo∈[0.001, 0.009]的窄窗口；（2）提出"train–predict–validate–extend"序列策略，每步预测均与解析解对比验证后再纳入训练历史，逐步推进外推前沿；（3）针对BiLSTM引入三种物理引导修正：根Fourier坐标变换（s=√Fo）、边界加权损失、松弛迭代步进；（4）针对PINN引入对数时间变换（τ=log(Fo+ε)）、硬边界条件强制满足和组合损失函数；（5）采用前向和后向两个方向、多个Fo目标点进行系统外推验证。
AI.result: 标准BiLSTM在Fo=0.0009处R²仅0.818，标准PINN更降至0.604，外推能力差；经物理引导修正后，PG-BiLSTM在Fo=0.0009处R²升至0.983、Fo=0.0091处R²=0.999；Modified PINN在Fo=0.0009处R²达到0.99973、Fo=0.0091处R²=0.99995；两个框架在训练域两侧的多个外推目标上均通过精确解析解验证；前向外推可靠性优于后向（因扩散平滑效应vs反问题不适定性）；两种架构均实现了物理一致且准确的外推预测。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献不是更好的热传导求解器，而是一种可转移的外推验证框架：通过对每个外推预测进行精确基准验证来量化可靠性证书；外推失败的根源不在于网络容量，而在于数学表征与物理结构的不匹配；针对特定物理特征（√Fo时间尺度、Fo⁻³/²奇异性、边界层高梯度）引入针对性架构修正，可显著提升外推可靠性；该框架可推广至数据有限且需外推的其他工程问题。

title: Multi-Pass, Multi-View Blended Learning for High-Fidelity Volumetric CT Synthesis from Chest X-Rays
summary: Reconstructing volumetric Computed Tomography (CT) from a single 2D chest radiograph (CXR) is an ill-posed inverse problem, further complicated by the scarcity of paired CXR-CT training data. Prior approaches address this by training on Digitally Reconstructed Radiographs (DRRs), which are synthetic projections derived from CT volumes. However, the domain gap between DRRs and real CXRs limits generalization, often resulting in coarse or anatomically inconsistent reconstructions when applied to clinical images. To address this challenging problem, this study introduces a Multi-Pass Multi-View Blended Learning framework for synthesizing high-fidelity volumetric CT directly from real chest X-ray (CXR) images. The proposed approach progressively decomposes the synthesis task into two distinct, complementary learning stages. Stage 1 is an unsupervised CXR-to-DRR Domain Adaptation, while Stage 2 includes three passes, namely, (a) supervised DRR-to-CT Transformation, (b) unsupervised Multi-View Slice Refinement, followed by (c) Progressive Transfer Learning (PTL). With such a blended learning paradigm, the proposed approach mitigates the synthetic-to-real domain gap while enhancing both the structural integrity and anatomical detail of the final output. On the LIDC-IDRI dataset, where paired DRR-CT ground truth is available for quantitative evaluation, the proposed method improves upon prior methods by up to 14% in PSNR and 7.6% in SSIM. The framework successfully generates structurally consistent and anatomically realistic high-fidelity CT volumes from real CXRs, marking a significant advancement toward clinical viability of CT reconstruction from standard radiographic images.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多遍多视图混合学习框架,直接从真实胸部X光(CXR)合成高保真体积CT,分两阶段(无监督CXR到DRR域自适应 + 三遍DRR到CT转换、多视图切片细化、渐进迁移学习)缓解合成-真实域差距,在LIDC-IDRI数据集上PSNR提升达14%、SSIM提升达7.6%。
AI.motivation: 单张2D CXR重建3D CT是严重的病态反问题,且缺乏配对CXR-CT训练数据。现有方法多基于DRR合成投影训练,但DRR与真实CXR的域差距导致模型泛化差,生成的CT粗略或解剖不一致,限制临床应用。
AI.method: Multi-Pass Multi-View Blended Learning框架,两阶段:Stage 1无监督CXR→DRR域自适应;Stage 2三遍(a)有监督DRR→CT变换,(b)无监督多视图切片细化,(c)渐进迁移学习(PTL)。通过混合学习范式缓解合成-真实域差距并提升结构完整性与解剖细节。
AI.result: 在LIDC-IDRI配对数据集上,PSNR较先前方法提升最高14%,SSIM提升最高7.6%,生成的结构一致且解剖逼真的高保真CT体积。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功从真实CXR合成结构一致、解剖逼真的高保真CT体积,标志CT从常规X光重建向临床可行性的重大进展。

title: Adversarial Training for Tabular Credit Scoring: A Multi-Attack Robustness Evaluation in P2P Lending
summary: Machine learning-based credit scoring is increasingly central to Peer-to-Peer (P2P) lending, yet its resilience to adversarial manipulation, where applicants strategically alter self-reported inputs to secure favourable decisions, remains poorly understood. Most adversarial-robustness evidence comes from image and text domains and evaluates a single attack against a matching defence, offering little guidance on how defences generalise across attack types in tabular credit data. We address this with a systematic train-test robustness benchmark on a large Lending Club subset, spanning three model families (logistic regression, a feed-forward neural network, and a transformer for tabular data) and four attacks confined to applicant-mutable features: Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM), Projected Gradient Descent (PGD), Salt-and-Pepper (S&P) noise, and DeepFool, plus a mixed-attack regime. Across a full grid evaluated with stratified cross-validation, adversarial training sharply improves robustness against the attack it is trained on and transfers well within the gradient-based family, but transfers weakly to non-gradient corruption, so single-attack defences overstate real-world resilience. Mixed training delivers the most balanced robustness across heterogeneous attacks while preserving clean-test performance, supporting multi-attack stress testing in credit-model governance.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对P2P借贷信用评分场景，系统评估了对抗性训练在多种攻击下的鲁棒性。研究使用Lending Club大规模数据集，比较了三种模型（逻辑回归、前馈神经网络、表格Transformer）在四种对抗攻击（FGSM、PGD、Salt-and-Pepper、DeepFool）以及混合攻击训练下的表现。核心发现：对抗训练对训练所用攻击类型大幅提升鲁棒性，且在梯度类攻击间（FGSM与PGD）良好迁移，但向非梯度类攻击（S&P）迁移很弱；混合训练提供最均衡的鲁棒性且不牺牲干净测试性能。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗鲁棒性证据主要来自图像和文本领域，且多为单一攻击对应单一防御的评估，无法指导表格型信用数据中防御在不同攻击类型间的泛化能力。P2P借贷场景下申请人可能战略性篡改自报特征以获得有利决策，模型对此类操纵的韧性研究不足，且操作化攻击者不太可能局限于单一威胁模型，因此需要系统性多攻击压力测试。
AI.method: 基于CRISP-ML流程，对Lending Club约40万条贷款数据（含396,030观测、28个特征）进行预处理（缺失值处理、编码、Min-Max缩放）。评估三类模型：逻辑回归、前馈神经网络、FT-Transformer。使用五种训练配置（Clean、FGSM、PGD、S&P、DeepFool、混合）和五种测试条件构成完整网格，采用分层5折交叉验证。攻击约束于申请人可篡改特征（annual_inc、dti、revol_bal、revol_util、purpose、zip_code），通过梯度掩码和结构有效的一位有效编码交换实现。FGSM/PGD采用ε=0.1、PGD迭代40次步长0.01；DeepFool设置η=0.025、最大迭代100次；S&P腐蚀量0.1。训练时采用80%干净样本+20%对抗样本增强。在Prosper数据集上进行外部复制验证。
AI.result: 1）干净基线：三模型ROC AUC在0.903-0.906，准确率约0.82-0.83。2）干净模型受攻击后适度退化（ROC AUC降至0.855-0.878），无模型崩溃。3）匹配训练大幅提升鲁棒性：神经网络FGSM/PGD测试ROC AUC达0.952-0.959；Transformer达0.980。4）FGSM与PGD之间强迁移（结构相似），但梯度类训练对S&P迁移很弱。5）混合训练为最均衡方案：Transformer混合训练在干净测试0.825、FGSM/PGD测试0.865（ROC AUC 0.979）、DeepFool测试0.826，几乎匹配最佳单攻击训练，同时保持干净性能。6）Prosper数据集外部复制确认相同定性模式：梯度类攻击最破坏、匹配训练恢复判别力最强、FGSM/PGD互换、跨家族迁移弱、混合训练最均衡。7）管理启示：建议将多攻击压力测试纳入信用模型治理。
AI.conclusion: 对抗训练显著提升信用评分模型在匹配攻击下的鲁棒性，且对梯度类攻击家族内迁移良好，但对非梯度腐蚀迁移有限。单一攻击防御会高估真实世界韧性，因此推荐采用多攻击/混合训练作为默认策略，尤其对高容量模型而言可在不牺牲干净性能前提下增强异质攻击下的均衡鲁棒性。未来研究应发展约束感知的攻击方法、面向金融表格数据的黑盒攻击、分布漂移下的鲁棒性评估，并将鲁棒性纳入模型治理框架。

title: Deep Neural Networks for Learning Intent from sEMG Signals to Support Hardware Devices for Post-Stroke Neurorehabilitation
summary: Finger-specific motor intent is a clinically meaningful control signal for post-stroke neurorehabilitation, where residual muscle activity may remain measurable despite weak or incomplete movement. We study five-finger multilabel intent decoding from impaired-arm high-density surface electromyography (sEMG) in PhysioMio, a bilateral longitudinal dataset collected from stroke patients. A common processing protocol aligns movement labels, applies 20--450 Hz Butterworth filtering and Symlet-4 wavelet denoising, segments overlapping 200 ms windows, and extracts twelve time- and frequency-domain descriptors per channel. Direct LSTM, CNN, and GNN baselines reveal complementary behavior: the LSTM attains the highest subset accuracy (0.545), whereas the GNN attains the highest macro F1 (0.706) and macro AUPRC (0.776). Architecture search then identifies CNN-Large as the strongest single-split CNN, with 0.593 subset accuracy and 0.714 macro F1, while CNN-Micro provides a compact architecture for embedded inference. To match a four-sensor hardware design, we retrain CNN-Micro using channels associated with ECRB, ECRL, FDS, and FDP and exclude the ground electrode from model input. Across five seeds, cross-channel knowledge distillation improves the four-channel student over direct training, reaching $0.5219 \pm 0.0114$ subset accuracy, $0.7612 \pm 0.0038$ finger accuracy, and $0.6095 \pm 0.0058$ macro F1. The selected 123K-parameter model accepts nine windows of 48 features and has been exported to ONNX. These results establish a reproducible software path from post-stroke sEMG to compact five-finger intent prediction for subsequent hardware-in-the-loop evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对脑卒中后康复场景，使用PhysioMio数据集从受损臂高密度sEMG信号中解码五指多标签运动意图，系统比较了LSTM、CNN、GNN三种深度学习基线，并进行CNN架构搜索，最后通过跨通道知识蒸馏训练了一个适用于四传感器硬件设计的紧凑型CNN-Micro模型（123K参数，已导出为ONNX），为后续Raspberry Pi 5硬件在环评估奠定软件基础。
AI.motivation: 脑卒中患者常因下行运动通路受损而丧失手部精细运动控制能力，但前臂可能仍保留可测量的残余肌电活动。sEMG作为一种非侵入式信号，可用于估计运动意图以驱动康复设备辅助或反馈。然而，脑卒中后的sEMG与健康人手势识别任务存在本质差异（异常协同收缩、募集模式改变、疲劳等），且康复应用需要多指激活模式而非单一手势类别。因此，需要将模型选择与信号处理、标注决策及硬件约束联合评估，构建一条从高密度信号到嵌入式部署的完整解码路径。
AI.method: 方法包含四个阶段：①数据协调——从PhysioMio原始parquet文件提取连续运动段，将16种手势映射为五位二进制手指目标向量，按患者级70/10/20划分数据集；②信号预处理——四阶Butterworth带通滤波（20–450 Hz，零相位前后向应用）+ Symlet-4小波软阈值去噪（4层分解、通用阈值），然后以50%重叠分割为200 ms窗口；③特征提取——每个通道窗口提取12个时频域手工描述符（RMS、MAV、IEMG、波形长度、方差、过零率、斜率符号变化、Willison幅度、平均频率、中位频率、谱熵、总功率，Welch周期图nperse=256），得到张量(C, W, F)；④模型族对比——通过共享适配器将张量转为(N, W, C×F)序列，LSTM分支采用两层128/256隐藏单元+全连接+Dropout，GNN分支以每个窗口为节点构建完全图并使用两层GCN+均值池化，CNN分支包含Nano至XLarge五个学生变体和ResNet-50/101/152教师，训练使用BCE损失、Adam优化器、Optuna架构搜索（兼顾延迟惩罚的复合目标）；⑤硬件导向通道缩减——选择对应ECRB、ECRL、FDS、FDP的四通道，采用直接训练、首层切片迁移初始化和跨通道知识蒸馏（T=2, α=0.5）三种模式各5个种子训练四通道CNN-Micro，最终导出为ONNX。
AI.result: 直接基线对比中LSTM子集准确率最高（0.545），GNN宏F1和AUPRC最高（0.706/0.776），呈现互补特性；CNN架构搜索中CNN-Large为最强CNN（子集准确率0.593，宏F1 0.714），CNN-Micro以158K参数保留相近性能（子集准确率0.578，宏F1 0.697）；健康到受损迁移改善CNN-Base但对LSTM效果混合；四通道硬件目标实验中，跨通道蒸馏显著优于直接训练和首层切片迁移，在5个种子上达到子集准确率0.5219±0.0114、手指准确率0.7612±0.0038、宏F1 0.6095±0.0058，选定模型123,317参数，固定输入(N,9,48)，已导出为ONNX。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了从脑卒中后高密度sEMG到五指意图预测的可复现软件路径，证明了LSTM与GNN编码的互补时间结构信息价值，CNN架构搜索可识别紧凑高效路径，健康到受损迁移的收益因架构而异；在四传感器硬件约束下，跨通道知识蒸馏比直接训练和权重切片迁移更有效，能以123K参数的紧凑模型保留有用的脑卒中后手指意图信息，为后续Raspberry Pi 5时序测试和硬件在环康复研究提供了具体的软件基础。

title: An Explainable Machine Learning Framework for Predicting Blood-Brain Barrier Permeability Using Molecular Descriptors
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Source code and processed data are publicly available on GitHub
summary: Blood-brain barrier (BBB) permeability is a critical determinant in the development of central nervous system therapeutics because it directly influences the ability of drug candidates to reach their target sites within the brain. In this study, an explainable machine learning framework was developed to predict BBB permeability using molecular descriptors generated from the MoleculeNet BBBP dataset with the RDKit cheminformatics toolkit. Fifteen physicochemical descriptors extracted from 2,039 compounds were used to train four supervised machine learning algorithms, including Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). Hyperparameter optimization was performed using GridSearchCV, while model interpretability was investigated using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP). Among the evaluated models, the optimized XGBoost classifier achieved the best predictive performance, with an accuracy of 88.97%, a precision of 88.92%, a recall of 97.76%, an F1-score of 93.13%, and a ROC-AUC of 0.9282. Stratified five-fold cross-validation further demonstrated the robustness of the proposed model, yielding a mean ROC-AUC of 0.8982 +/- 0.0130. Feature importance and SHAP analyses consistently identified TPSA, HBD, and LogP as the most influential molecular descriptors governing BBB permeability prediction. Overall, the proposed framework provides an accurate, interpretable, and computationally efficient approach for BBB permeability prediction and may serve as a valuable tool for the early-stage screening of CNS drug candidates.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个基于XGBoost的可解释机器学习框架，利用15个理化描述符预测血脑屏障（BBB）渗透性，最优模型准确率达88.97%，ROC-AUC为0.9282，并通过SHAP分析识别TPSA、HBD和LogP为关键影响因素。
AI.motivation: 血脑屏障的渗透性是中枢神经系统（CNS）药物研发的关键瓶颈。早期准确预测化合物能否透过BBB，有助于在药物筛选阶段淘汰不合格候选分子，降低研发成本并提高成功率。
AI.method: 使用MoleculeNet BBBP数据集（含2,039个化合物），通过RDKit提取15个理化分子描述符；训练并比较了逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）、支持向量机（SVM）、随机森林（Random Forest）和极端梯度提升（XGBoost）四种监督学习模型；采用GridSearchCV进行超参数优化；通过分层五折交叉验证评估模型稳健性；利用SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）进行模型可解释性分析。
AI.result: 优化后的XGBoost分类器表现最佳：准确率88.97%，精确率88.92%，召回率97.76%，F1分数93.13%，ROC-AUC为0.9282。分层五折交叉验证的平均ROC-AUC为0.8982 ± 0.0130，表明模型具有较好的稳健性。特征重要性与SHAP分析一致表明TPSA（拓扑极性表面积）、HBD（氢键供体数量）和LogP（脂水分配系数）是影响BBB渗透性预测的最重要分子描述符。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一个准确、可解释且计算高效的BBB渗透性预测工具，适用于CNS药物候选物的早期筛选。TPSA、HBD和LogP作为关键描述符，符合药理学领域关于分子极性、氢键能力和脂溶性对BBB穿透影响的既有认知，增强了模型结果的可信度。

title: Structure-Aware Unsupervised Anomaly Detection for Spacecraft Telemetry with Adaptive EVT Thresholding
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Accepted as a poster at SPAICE 2026
summary: Operational anomaly detection in spacecraft telemetry typically requires labeled historical anomalies or extended warm-up periods. These requirements are rarely met in practice. We propose an unsupervised, deployment-ready framework that produces predictions from the second month of operation without any labels, prior fault knowledge, or mission-specific tuning. The approach combines incremental monthly retraining, statistical model selection, and adaptive Extreme Value Theory (EVT) thresholding for false alarm control. On the ESA Anomalies Dataset (ESA-AD), it achieves $F_{0.5}=0.700$ on Mission~1 and $F_{0.5}=0.698$ on Mission~2 under strict chronological evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向航天器遥测的无监督、部署就绪的异常检测框架。该方法无需标签、先验故障知识或任务专属调参，结合增量月度重训练、统计驱动的模型选择以及基于极值理论(EVT)的自适应阈值控制误报。在ESA-AD基准上,Mission 1达到F0.5=0.700,Mission 2达到F0.5=0.698。
AI.motivation: 航天器遥测中的异常检测通常需要大量标注历史故障数据或漫长的预热期,而实际任务控制环境中这些条件几乎无法满足。同时,不同任务的遥测数据在统计特性上差异显著(单一模型难以泛化),且传统基准测试采用静态划分无法反映真实部署的时间因果约束。因此需要一种无需标签、无需GPU、可从第二个月即可部署且能适应不同任务结构的无监督框架。
AI.method: 1. **数据预处理**:将异步不规则采样对齐到任务特定均匀网格(M1:30s, M2:18s),采用零阶保持插值,并通过通道感知保留程序避免短事件丢失。2. **增量学习设置**:采用月度滑动窗口,仅用上月数据训练、下月评估,实现从第二个月开始部署。3. **任务统计表征**:通过Energy Distance(4.33, p<0.005)、变异系数(M1:0.13 vs M2:1.27)、K-means轮廓系数和PCA投影分析,发现M1呈低变异连续分布、M2呈高变异强聚类结构。4. **结构感知模型选择**:M1采用轻量LSTM自编码器(单层64隐藏单元,16维潜空间,MSE重构误差)捕获时间动态偏差;M2采用PCA+K-means+LOF流水线(LOF权重0.7,质心距离权重0.3)捕获局部密度与全局状态偏移。5. **EVT动态阈值**:对校准分数拟合广义帕累托分布(GPD),结合指数平滑(λ=0.05)与阈值变化率限制(δ=0.05)防止窗口间剧烈波动。6. **后处理**:间隔小于6小时的检测合并为单一事件。
AI.result: 在ESA-AD严格时序评估下:Mission 1达到事件级Precision=0.852、Recall=0.408、F0.5=0.700;TNR=0.977(高精度、保守型检测);Mission 2达到Precision=0.721、Recall=0.621、F0.5=0.698;TNR=0.801(更均衡)。M1累积F0.5在初始密集异常期达0.9以上,后期稳定在0.7-0.8;M2稳定在约0.7。相比工业无监督基线(M1:0.424,M2:0.882),M1显著提升而M2保持竞争力;相比监督方法(M1:0.786,M2:0.949),大幅缩小了无监督与监督方法的差距。计算成本:M1平均1041.71秒/窗口,M2平均214.65秒/窗口,纯CPU,峰值内存≤8.11GB。
AI.conclusion: 该结构感知无监督框架在无需标签、无需GPU、无需扩展历史数据的前提下,显著优于现有无监督基线(尤其在M1上),并接近监督方法的性能,证明了基于任务统计特性进行模型选择、结合EVT自适应阈值在真实部署场景中的有效性。该框架特别适用于早期部署阶段,可后续通过AutoML扩展以利用标签数据进一步优化。

title: Beyond Contact Sensors: Deep learning with Pseudo-Labeling for remote Photoplethysmography
summary: Heart rate is a critical biomarker of health, and remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables its contactless estimation from video data for telemedicine applications. Recent advancements in deep learning based rPPG methods achieve state-of-the-art results, outperforming classical signal-processing methods in complex scenarios. However, deep learning methods depend on datasets with precise synchronization between videos and ground truth signals collected via contact sensors, whereas signal-processing-based methods do not. To address this dependence on labeled datasets, which are labor-intensive to collect, we investigate under which circumstances pseudo-labels extracted using unsupervised signal-processing methods can replace contact sensors labels for training deep learning methods. Our systematic evaluations found that for datasets with imperfect synchronization, the pseudo-label approach outperforms supervised training on contact sensors. For datasets with good synchronization, results are mixed: within-dataset evaluation shows no significant difference between training methods, while cross-dataset evaluation favors supervised training. However, removing a single outlier participant significantly improves the pseudo-label approach's cross-dataset performance, highlighting the importance of label quality. These results demonstrate that signal-processing methods can generate valid training signals for deep learning models, reducing dependency on labor-intensive dataset collection while maintaining competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地研究了在远程光电容积脉搏波（rPPG）任务中，使用基于信号处理的伪标签（Pseudo-PPG，由POS算法提取）替代接触式传感器标签（Finger-PPG）来训练深度学习模型的可行性。
AI.motivation: 深度学习rPPG方法依赖大量与视频精确同步的接触式传感器标注数据，采集成本高、劳动密集，且手指与面部信号存在生理学差异（PTT、形态不同）。研究者希望探索使用无监督信号处理方法自动生成的伪标签替代接触式标签的可行性。
AI.method: 在两个数据集（CHILL软件同步，PURE硬件同步）上，使用两种深度学习架构（TS-CAN、Physnet），分别用三种训练信号（Finger-PPG、Pseudo-PPG由POS算法提取、Synced-PPG通过互相关对齐手指信号与POS信号）进行训练。采用10折受试者级交叉验证（数据集内）和跨数据集评估，以平均绝对误差（MAE）为指标，Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行统计推断。伪标签生成流程：YOLO5Face人脸检测 → POS信号提取 → 0.7-3.0Hz带通滤波 → Hilbert变换取包络。还进行了剔除低质量受试者的敏感性分析。
AI.result: 数据集内结果——CHILL（同步质量较差）：Pseudo-PPG显著优于Finger-PPG和Synced-PPG（如Physnet MAE：0.55 vs 1.46 vs 1.10；TS-CAN MAE：0.73 vs 8.61 vs 0.92）。PURE（硬件同步良好）：三种训练信号间无显著差异。跨数据集结果——CHILL→PURE：Pseudo-PPG显著优于Finger-PPG和Synced-PPG；PURE→CHILL：TS-CAN在Pseudo-PPG上表现较差，但Physnet上无显著差异。敏感性分析：PURE受试者9的POS信号噪声大，剔除后TS-CAN在Pseudo-PPG上的跨数据集性能显著改善（MAE从3.66降至1.10），证明标签质量直接影响泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 当数据集同步质量不佳时，基于信号处理的伪标签（Pseudo-PPG）是优于接触式传感器标签的训练信号；当同步质量良好时，伪标签在数据集内评估中可与接触式标签媲美，但在跨数据集泛化时易受低质量标签影响。本研究表明POS等信号处理方法可生成有效的深度学习训练标签，有助于降低rPPG数据集采集成本，但需开发无需真值的伪标签质量评估方法以提升规模化部署能力。

title: Field-level prediction of mid-plane stress tensor fields in concrete target penetration: a cross-velocity graph neural operator surrogate
summary: Although the impact resistance of concrete has been studied extensively, a framework linking mesoscale heterogeneity to full-field stress-tensor prediction has been lacking. Data were generated with a full-scale aggregate-resolved LS-DYNA model (projectile diameter 45 mm, mass 2.13 kg, target diameter 500 mm x thickness 200 mm, mesh 10 mm), verified against published penetration experiments (Frew 2006, Hanchak 1992, Forrestal 1996) by configuration similarity. The dataset contains six-component stress-tensor fields on the X-Z mid-plane for 400 cases (4 impact velocities x 100 aggregate seeds). Three contributions are reported. First, case-by-case verification of the terminal penetration state delimited the rest-state validity of penetration depth and anchored reliable observables to rigid-body motion and field-level stress evolution. Second, a field-level graph neural operator surrogate learned the time-varying stress-field evolution and evaluated cross-velocity leave-one-out extrapolation. Third, the full-scale, aggregate-resolved, cross-velocity, per-seed database was established as a reproducible resource. Cases at 100, 135 and 200 m/s still moved at window end (negative velocity, i.e. rebound), and only one 165 m/s case arrested. Penetration depth is therefore not reported as a rest-state scalar except for the single arrested case (69.33 mm); nose-node depth differences were confirmed as numerical artifacts of displacement integration after erosion. The single-step relative L2 error was 0.6977, reported honestly; autoregressive rollout from frame 11 to 39 took about 144 ms, a speedup of about 3.6x10^3 to 4.3x10^3 relative to single-core LS-DYNA, reported as application value. Validation is bounded by configuration similarity and field-level self-consistency; the framework is a simulation-trained decision-support method within the studied parameter space.

AI.tldr: 本文针对混凝土靶体侵彻问题，建立了一套从细观非均质性到全场六分量应力张量预测的完整框架。研究使用全尺度集料解析LS-DYNA模型生成400个工况的数据集（4个冲击速度×100个集料随机种子），通过终端状态验证揭示了低速度窗口内除一个165 m/s工况外均未在1 ms内静止的物理事实，并发现弹头节点位移提取存在数值伪影。提出了一种场级图神经算子代理模型，单步相对L2误差为0.6977（诚实报告的边界），自回归演化有界且不发散，跨速度留一法外推误差为0.75（内插为0.70），计算时间较单核LS-DYNA减少约3.6×10³至4.3×10³倍。
AI.motivation: 现有三类方法均存在不足：宏观经验公式将混凝土视为均匀介质，丢失样本间变异性；细观有限元虽能解析随机性但单次计算成本高（数分钟至数十分钟）且输出多为标量；数据驱动代理模型通常输出标量或低维场，未保留完整的六分量应力张量场。当需要同时满足全尺度、跨速度、逐种子及中面六分量应力张量预测时，缺少统一框架将细观非均质性与场级应力预测关联起来。
AI.method: （1）全尺度细观有限元建模：ogive弹头（CRH=3.0，直径45 mm，质量2.13 kg），圆柱混凝土靶（直径500 mm×厚度200 mm），四相（砂浆CSCM C30、集料JH-2花岗岩、ITZ线弹性、钢弹）结构，10 mm六面体网格（37948单元/42273节点），Fuller级配（5-25 mm），随机投放算法生成100个集料种子×4个速度级别=400个工况。（2）数据组织：六分量应力张量场σ=[6,64,64,40]，重采样至64×64规则网格（深度3.125 mm/横向7.8 mm），按30 MPa归一化。（3）场级图神经算子代理：节点特征22维（6分量应力×3帧+3维坐标+1维速度），64×64节点图，8轮消息传递，隐藏维度32，边权重由声阻抗调和均值与牵引调制构造（含7维边特征MLP修正），解码器32→32→6输出应力增量，自回归推进；lookback K=3，三步教师强制训练，损失权重0.5/0.3/0.2；200 m/s留作LOSO外推测试。（4）验证基准：与Frew 2006、Hanchak 1992、Forrestal 1996三组已发表侵彻实验进行配置相似性比较。
AI.result: （1）终端状态验证：100、135、200 m/s各工况在1 ms窗口末端弹体仍具显著负向刚体速度（-23至-46 m/s），仅165 m/s的一个工况（seed 207）静止，侵深69.33 mm；弹头节点在0.30-0.475 ms内因侵蚀失效，位移提取存在数值伪影，已弃用。（2）场级精度：单步相对L2误差0.6977±0.0034（三种子集成），略逊于FNO基线0.6907；K=1/3/5为0.7304/0.6977/0.6952，K=5已饱和；200 m/s外推误差0.75（内插0.70）。（3）物理验证自洽：峰值剖面相对误差0.45-0.58，衰减指数偏慢（Δp=+0.46至+0.74），峰值区深度偏深2-3 mm，活跃区面积为参考的2.11-2.81倍；上述现象源于条件均值平滑机制。（4）能量水平：参考值先升后降（峰值2.39于frame 15），代理自回归单调下降（0.557→0.447），动态范围压缩约50%，但有界不收敛。（5）计算效率：29步自回归约144 ms（RTX5060），较单核LS-DYNA（515-613 s）减少3.6×10³至4.3×10³倍。（6）跨样本方差：代理仅解释3.5%（R²=0.035），输出近似条件均值场。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了面向全尺度集料解析侵彻的场级代理框架：终端状态验证确认低速度窗口内几乎所有工况未在1 ms内静止，可靠观测量应锚定于刚体运动状态和场级应力演化而非鼻节点位移标量；场级图神经算子能学习中面六分量应力张量的函数空间映射，单步精度0.6977（诚实边界），自回归有界且结构级物理量一致，跨速度外推能力有所保留（0.75 vs 0.70）。数据集（4速度×100种子=400工况）作为可复现研究资源公开发布。框架定位为已研究参数空间内的仿真训练决策支持方法，非直接设计工具；主要边界包括：条件均值精度上限、10 mm网格未做收敛性验证、沙漏能占比17.7%偏高、仅进行配置相似性基准对比。

title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical NLP Classification with Compact Semantic Representations: An Experimental Analysis of Representation Compression
summary: Large language and sentence-embedding models provide rich semantic representations, but their high dimensionality poses a challenge for near-term quantum machine learning (QML), where quantum circuits can process only a limited number of input features. We investigate a hybrid quantum-classical pipeline that transforms high-dimensional sentence embeddings into compact representations for variational quantum classification. The workflow combines a pretrained sentence-embedding model, dimensionality reduction, angle encoding, a variational quantum circuit (VQC), and a classical decision layer. We systematically compare principal component analysis (PCA), neighborhood components analysis (NCA), and linear discriminant analysis (LDA), covering both unsupervised and supervised dimensionality reduction. Using the TREC question-classification dataset, we study the relationship between representation dimensionality, information retention, qubit count, and classification performance. Preliminary PCA experiments reveal a strong information bottleneck: reducing 768-dimensional embeddings to 3, 4, 5, and 8 dimensions retains about 8.2%, 10.2%, 11.9%, and 16.4% of the variance, with corresponding classification accuracies of 50.3%, 51.2%, 57.9%, and 63.4%. In contrast, supervised reduction is substantially more efficient. LDA reaches 85.3% accuracy and NCA reaches 83.1% using only 5 dimensions, under a leakage-free cross-validation protocol, compared with 85.1% for a full 384-dimensional classical baseline. These results indicate that supervised dimensionality reduction can preserve task-relevant information far more effectively than variance-based compression, making compact representations a promising route toward practical hybrid quantum-classical NLP models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并系统评估了一种混合量子-经典NLP分类流水线，结合预训练句子嵌入、降维、角度编码、变分量子电路（VQC）和经典决策层，比较了PCA（无监督）、NCA和LDA（有监督）三种降维策略在TREC问题分类任务上的表现。结果表明，有监督降维（LDA/NCA）在仅5维时即能达到甚至超过全维经典基线，而PCA在相同维度下受信息瓶颈限制严重。
AI.motivation: 近期量子机器学习（QML）在NLP中的应用受限于量子电路只能处理少量输入特征，而预训练语言模型产生的句子嵌入维度通常很高（如384或768维）。核心问题是：在量子可兼容的紧凑表示中能保留多少语义信息而不牺牲分类性能？作者旨在研究表示压缩对混合量子-经典NLP性能的影响，并区分经典降维与量子模型的贡献，而非预设量子优势。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 使用冻结的 sentence-transformer（all-MiniLM-L6-v2，384维）生成句子嵌入；(2) 比较三种降维方法——PCA（无监督，方差最大化）、NCA（监督，K近邻性能最大化）、LDA（监督，类间/类内方差比最大化）；(3) 将降维后的5维特征缩放到[-π, π]并通过单量子比特Ry旋转门进行角度编码；(4) 采用两层硬件高效变分量子电路（5量子比特，每层Ry、Rz参数化旋转加环形CNOT纠缠，共20个可训练参数）；(5) 测量单量子比特和相邻两量子比特Pauli-Z期望值（共10个特征），送入经典softmax分类器进行6类TREC分类；(6) 在restaurant和TREC数据集上进行实验，严格采用无泄漏交叉验证协议。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 在restaurant小数据集上，PCA从3到8量子比特的准确率达90.0%-95.7%；(2) 在TREC 6分类任务中，PCA存在严重信息瓶颈：384维压缩到3/4/5/8维时仅保留8.2%-16.4%的方差，准确率仅50.3%-63.4%；(3) PCA扩展实验表明方差保留与准确率不相关，准确率在20-50维即趋于平台；(4) 有监督降维显著优于无监督：LDA在5维达85.3%，NCA达83.1%，均匹配或超过全384维经典MLP基线（85.1%），远超PCA在5维的57.9%；(5) 数据泄漏分析显示"泄漏易感"协议会高估性能（NCA高估7.8%，LDA高估4.6%），证实无泄漏验证的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明：(1) 有监督降维远比方差驱动的无监督压缩更能保留任务相关语义信息，使紧凑量子表示成为混合量子-经典NLP的实用路径；(2) 解释方差并非下游任务准确率的可靠代理；(3) 量子VQC性能改进必须与匹配经典基线在相同压缩表示下对比，否则性能提升归因于经典降维而非量子表达能力；(4) 提出的三阶段混合流水线（经典特征提取→有监督流形对齐→变分量子分类）为NISQ时代量子文本分类器提供了实用部署框架。未来工作将探索更大量子比特表示（12-16比特）、自编码器非线性压缩以及物理硬件部署与错误缓解。

title: A Systematic Evaluation of Molecule Generation Models for De Novo Drug Design: From Benchmarks to Practical Insights
comment: This document is the unedited Author's version of a Submitted Manuscript subsequently accepted for publication in [Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling]. To access the final published article
summary: Molecule generation has emerged as a powerful computational tool for de novo drug design, enabling the exploration of chemical space beyond the limits of conventional virtual screening. The field has progressed rapidly, driven by advances in molecular representations, generative architectures, and target-aware modeling strategies. However, existing reviews typically address specific model families or application scenarios in isolation, rather than offering an integrated perspective on how these components collectively form a coherent generation workflow. In this review, we present a comprehensive evaluation of molecule generation models for de novo drug design, covering 82 methods across five deep generative frameworks, including recurrent neural network (RNN)- and Transformer-based models, variational autoencoders (VAEs), generative adversarial networks (GANs), flow-based models, and diffusion models. We first summarize widely used benchmarks and molecular representations, and then examine the methodological principles underlying both general and pocket-conditioned generation. A central contribution of this work is a systematic synthesis and comparative analysis of reported performance across commonly used benchmarks and evaluation metrics. We also summarize representative experimentally validated case studies. Looking ahead, we discuss future directions in standardized 3D data, interaction-aware generation, receptor flexibility, and multi-objective molecular design, with the aim of improving the reliability and experimental relevance of molecule generation. All collected benchmark resources, evaluation metrics, and model references are provided in a publicly accessible repository at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇系统综述，全面评估了82种用于从头药物设计的分子生成模型，覆盖五大深度生成框架（RNN/Transformer、VAE、GAN、流模型、扩散模型），整合了基准数据集、分子表征、训练目标、口袋条件生成、性能对比及实验验证案例，并指出了未来方向。
AI.motivation: 分子生成领域发展迅速，但现有综述通常孤立地讨论特定模型家族或应用场景，缺乏对从基准到实际应用的整合视角。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供从方法论基础到基准性能再到实践应用的系统性评估。
AI.method: （1）构建五大生成框架（RNN/Transformer、VAE、GAN、流模型、扩散模型）的统一分类体系，覆盖82种代表模型；（2）总结基准数据集（QM9、ZINC、GEOM-Drugs、MOSES、CrossDocked2020等）与评估框架（GuacaMol、PMO、PoseBusters、PoseCheck、GenBench3D）；（3）系统梳理分子表征（1D序列、2D图、3D结构）与蛋白口袋表征；（4）形式化统一训练目标（重构、分布对齐、一致性）；（5）汇总基准性能并进行跨模型对比，特别关注口袋条件生成在CrossDocked2020上的对接协议差异；（6）整理8个经实验验证的案例研究。
AI.result: （1）QM9/ZINC/MOSES上多项指标（有效性、唯一性、新颖性）接近饱和，难以有效区分模型；（2）CrossDocked2020上21种口袋条件模型对比显示PAFlow对接最优（Vina Score=-8.31），VoxBind药物相似性最高（QED=0.57），PocketFlow多样性最高（0.87），但不同对接协议（5种类型）严重影响绝对数值可比性；（3）8个实验验证案例中仅GDL（靶向RIPK1）完成了从体外到体内的完整验证流程，其余多停留在生化或结构验证层面，尚无进入临床的报道。
AI.conclusion: 分子生成模型在不同表征、数据集和评估协议下表现差异显著，单一指标的提升不能代表整体质量改善。未来需在标准化3D数据、口袋灵活性、相互作用感知生成、多目标分子设计及对接协议一致性方面取得突破，以提升分子生成方法的可靠性与实验转化价值。

title: Storage-Scalable Progressive Semantic Communication via Knowledge-Base Reuse
summary: Existing knowledge-base-assisted semantic communication schemes commonly adopt either single knowledge-base quantization (SKBQ) or multi-knowledge-base residual quantization (MKBQ). SKBQ incurs limited storage overhead but has restricted quantization capacity, whereas MKBQ supports progressive refinement by assigning an independent knowledge base (KB) to each stage, causing the KB storage to grow linearly with the transmission depth. To address this problem, we propose storage-scalable knowledge-base reuse quantization (SSKBQ), which reuses a compact set of KBs across multiple residual refinement stages and thereby decouples the number of transmission stages from the number of maintained KBs. A stage-aware residual supervision mechanism is further introduced to regularize intermediate quantized representations and encourage progressive refinement. Experimental results demonstrate that KB reuse provides an effective solution to the storage scalability problem while maintaining competitive progressive reconstruction performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向渐进式语义通信的存储可扩展知识库复用量化方案（SSKBQ），通过在多个残差细化阶段中复用少量知识库，解耦传输阶段数与知识库数量，从而在保持渐进式重建性能的同时显著降低存储开销。
AI.motivation: 现有基于知识库的语义通信方案存在存储与性能之间的权衡：单知识库量化（SKBQ）存储开销小但量化能力有限；多知识库残差量化（MKBQ）虽支持渐进式细化，但每阶段需独立知识库，存储随传输深度线性增长，高分辨率场景下代价难以承受。
AI.method: 方法包含两个核心设计：（1）存储可扩展知识库复用量化（SSKBQ）：使用K个可复用知识库（K≤T）覆盖T个渐进式传输阶段，将第j个知识库复用于τ_j个残差细化步骤，使KB存储复杂度从O(TNc)降至O(KNc)；（2）阶段感知残差监督机制：在总损失中引入对中间量化表示的阶段级监督损失L_res，按1/i加权惩罚，促使早期阶段更精细地减少残差。总训练目标为L_total = L_rec + L_vq + L_res。
